jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Opportunity:
We are looking for an upbeat, dynamic, innovative and creative individual who is highly involved and very passionate about Digital Marketing and Project Management. As a Digital Campaign Intern you will be responsible for supporting our Delivery Managers to deliver on campaign objectives for various affiliates globally. You will be at the forefront of our project deliveries and the work you'll do will directly impact the way affiliates will interact with our teams. In this position you will be focusing on :

• Assisting in project managing various digital campaigns to enhance customer satisfaction during asset delivery operations through the DIA Content Lab

• Managing updates of marketing materials in a timely manner in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders depending on the updates incl. communication/coordination with requestors (from the affiliates)

• Managing tickets within our project manager system, coordinating the organization of source files and asset managements for seamless identification and reuse within our global network.

• Staying curious, open-minded, and always willing to do more.

Who you are:

• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University /college in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week

• You are passionate about project management

• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully

• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills

• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind

• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment

• English proficiency is a must. Any other language is a big plus.

In exchange we provide you with:
Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high,

jobs.title: Business Solution Management Associate

titleByLocale.it: Addetto alla gestione delle soluzioni aziendali

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs.

As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide.

Main responsibilities

As a Business Solution Management Associate, you will help us in bridging the gap between strategic methodology and operational execution. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:

• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.

• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.

• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.

• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.

• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling.

How would your day to day look like?

As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization.

Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations.

In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. You might analyze workflows to improve solution-selling insights or collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the S3 methodology is effectively embedded across the region. Each day concludes by ensuring all project milestones are on track, balancing technical learning with a proactive, delivery-f

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The role
​
You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.

• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.

jobs.title: Service Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints.

About the role

As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals.
Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is.

What you'll do

Research support

• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals

• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks

• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation

• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets

Service design

• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction

• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders

• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing

• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly

Conversational design

• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces

• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context

• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings

• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX

Collaboration

• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts

• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques

• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions

• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints

Who we're looking for

• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field

• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do

• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments

• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus

• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking

Nice to have

• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail

• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences

• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods

• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design

• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible

What we offer: The internship experience

• A full

jobs.title: Software Testing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Purpose of the role

This position aims at offering the opportunity to develop competences in the area of testing, integration and validation of Software solutions in the field of Laboratory connectivity components in Roche Laboratories. Our team is responsible for developing connectivity solutions which are enabling interoperability of all components part of the Diagnostics of our clients (instruments, Network integrators, IT solutions, LIS…). The position will support this ambition by covering activities related to gain understanding of requirements at business and technical level so that they can support on the component, E2E and field validation of functionality, testing activities and integration with other solutions. The role will also provide technical requirements to development teams when appropriate.

How would your day to day look like?

You are a recent graduate (max 3 years after graduation) in the fields of Informatics, Telecommunications and Biotech.

What do we offer?

We offer a learning environment and opportunities to develop quickly yourself both on our domains and on your personal growth and leadership. 
• We offer you a mature organization with Innovative and passionate people, very customer centric and open to change and continuously improving and delivering value fast. You also will be trained on the basic competencies you need to work with us and will feel safe for failing and learning as the essence to growing with us.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Simulation Specialist Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.

• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.

• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.

• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery.

What You Will Learn & Develop

• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.

• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.

• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.

• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.

• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.

• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment.

Who You Are

You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.

• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.

• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).

• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.

• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.

• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.

• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Quality Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Main tasks and duties:

• Support Roche clinical studies and play a role in the development of new diagnostic tests, helping to ensure the quality and safety of our products.

• Perform quality review of clinical study documents (study protocols, investigator brochures and

• reports) to ensure that clinical studies of IVDs are planned, conducted, and documented in

• compliance with regulations, internal procedures and product specification documents.

• Support GCP inspection readiness activities, including through study file reviews.

• Support team initiatives, including process improvement/harmonization.

• Support project teams with Good Clinical Practice expertise.

Additional tasks, duties and responsibilities:
● Additional tasks as required.

Requirements:

• Preferred Education: Recent graduates from University degree or Master in scientific or technological discipline, ideally in Biomedicine, Biotechnology field.

• No previous experience needed.

• Fluent command of English.

• Interest in clinical studies, medical devices, quality management systems and software development processes. Knowledge of quality and regulatory standards is a plus but not

• mandatory: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ISO 13485, ISO 20916,

• FDA QSR, IVDR, GDPR

• This position is only available for candidates who have never worked in a company in Spain or used a "contrato de prácticas" before.

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, we see it as a plus and offer you special benefits.

Are you ready to apply?
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now!

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

At Diagnostics Insights Software, we are collaborating in digitalizing diagnostics and revolutionizing how data is accessed and utilized in Laboratories and Point of Care settings.

Building software products is great, but working on software with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer in Test, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and UX experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software engineering practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users’ lives at risk!

Main responsibilities:

• Confirm the correctness of requirements-driven tests, utilizing diverse testing approaches such as exploratory, white box, and black box testing.

• Execute tests across multiple testing levels , including end-to-end, system, integration, and unit testing.

• Perform various testing types , such as functional, performance, resiliency, and scalability testing, to ensure robust product quality.

• Automate and execute front-end and back-end tests for platforms and web applications .

• Develop and automate deployment and testing pipelines, supporting multiple project branches and stages.

• Track and report quality metrics , contributing to the maintenance and improvement of quality dashboards .

• Conduct root cause analyses of defects and newly discovered issues to continuously improve testing practices.

• Design and implement automation frameworks and validate toolchains to support testing processes.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards for all quality engineering deliverables.

• Collaborate closely with Test Architects, Test Leads, Test Managers, as well as designers, architects, and developers.

• Share, coach, and train the built-in quality mindset throughout the organization.

How would your day to day look like?
You will work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
You will deep dive on ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by performing thorough testing activities throughout the development lifecycle. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to design reviews, thorough test coverage, focused quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you

Who are you?

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• You are familiar with integration of automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing.

• You are familiar with the testing processes: design, plan, execution and reporting.

• Great written and verbal communication in English.

• Technologies & Tools: Kubernetes-based applications, AWS, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Typescript, Javascript, Playwright, Cypress, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Department Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Security and Privacy to join our dynamic team. As a Junior Penetration Tester, your main responsibilities will include supporting and assisting in penetration testing activities to ensure the security of Roche products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with Product Teams, executing predefined test strategies, and documenting the results. You will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities and aiding in the reporting process.

The Opportunity

• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).

• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.

• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.

• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.

• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.

• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.

• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.

• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness.

Program Highlights

• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.

• Access to training and development opportunities.

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are (Required)

• Must have graduated from a University degree program.

• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.

• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.

• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.

• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.

• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.

• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on.

Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Intern in the Global Digital Hub, you support the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Intern will collaborate closely with the Campaign Delivery Specialists to support affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

Responsibilities

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Incorporates feedback on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse teams and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations.

Further requirements

• Proficient in English and German language

• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week

• You are passionate about project management

• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully

• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills

• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind

• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment

In exchange we provide you with:

Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development.
This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field.

Your Responsibilities

As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods

• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results

• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research

• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations

• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment

What We Are Looking For

• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field

• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment

• Good communication skills and willingness to learn

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company

• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies

• A collaborative and international work environment

• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche

If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l’équipe:
sous la responsabilité de l’Ingénieur Réseau Terrain et du Responsable Régional Equipe Service, tu seras Rattaché(e) à l’équipe Service Excellence. En lien étroit avec les équipes supports et commerciales, tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur des missions liées à l’installation et aux maintiens des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d’analyses médicales privés et hospitaliers.

Quel sera ton impact?
● Assurer la conception des schémas réseau et déploiement .
● Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes en collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Ingénieur ITWF.
● Garantir les plans d’actions en lien avec la cybersécurité.
● Effectuer les retrofits hardware / software IT réseau roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions en place chez nos clients.
● Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche.
● Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting des interventions et upgrades réalisés.

Ton ADN:
● Tu recherches une alternance pour ton Bac+4 ou 5 de 12/24 mois à compter de septembre 2026
● De formation école d’ingénieurs spécialisé en informatique et réseau et cyber résilience, tu possède également une appétence dans le domaine de la santé.
● Tu as le sens de l’écoute et le sens des responsabilités .
● Autonomie et rigueur te caractérisent, tu aimes travailler en équipe.
● Tu possèdes un bon niveau d’anglais (B2).
● Tu aimes te déplacer et tu es titulaire du permis B depuis plus de 2 ans.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
- Cette alternance va te permettre de développer des compétences concrètes et solides en sécurités et architectures informatique et de découvrir le monde de la santé à travers les laboratoires d’analyses médicales.
- Nous considérons les alternants et les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
- Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler.
- Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact pour la santé de tous.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche´s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines.

Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC), a department within the small molecule research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug
candidates from early research into development.

The Opportunity

As an Intern in our team your main tasks will include:

• Execute and support the optimization of screening assays using liquid handling systems to accelerate the pre-formulation pipeline.

• Perform "head-to-head" manual assays at the bench to compare, validate, and troubleshoot results against automated processes, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

• Interpret complex datasets to provide recommendations on process improvements and formulation viability.

Who You Are

• You are a meticulous and independent experimentalist who enjoys troubleshooting

• You hold a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or Automation with lab experience, degree completed no more than 12 months prior to the internship start date

• You have proven experience operating liquid handlers (ideally Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Additional Information

• Desired Start Date: October 1, 2026 (Negotiable)

• Workload: 100%

• Duration: 12 months

• Note: This internship is not suitable for a Master’s or PhD thesis.

Application Process

To be considered for this position, please upload the following documents:

• Current CV

• Cover Letter

• Copy of Diplomas

Requirements for Non-EU/EFTA Citizens: due to Swiss regulations, the following documents are mandatory for your application:

• Proof of Enrollment: You must remain officially enrolled at your university for the entire duration of the internship.

• Mandatory Internship Letter: An official document from your university confirming that the internship is a required part of your curriculum.

Have we piqued your interest? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche ́s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questa posizione si trova in Chimica Preclinica, Manifattura e Controlli (pCMC), un dipartimento all'interno della piccola organizzazione di ricerca molecola in modalità terapeutiche pRED, dove pave, in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo, il percorso per portare droga candidati dalla prima ricerca allo sviluppo. L'opportunità Come Interno nel nostro team i vostri compiti principali includono:
• Eseguire e supportare l'ottimizzazione dei saggi di screening utilizzando sistemi di gestione liquida per accelerare il processo di pre-formulazione.
• Eseguire saggi manuali "head-to-head" in panchina per confrontare, convalidare e risolvere i risultati contro processi automatizzati, garantendo coerenza e precisione.
• Interpretare i set di dati complessi per fornire raccomandazioni sui miglioramenti del processo e sulla fattibilità della formulazione. Chi sei
• Sei uno sperimentatore meticoloso e indipendente che gode della risoluzione dei problemi
• Hai una laurea magistrale in chimica, scienze farmaceutiche, ingegneria chimica, o automazione con esperienza di laboratorio, laurea completata non più di 12 mesi prima della data di inizio stage
• Hai dimostrato esperienza di gestione dei liquidi (di solito Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali in inglese. Informazioni aggiuntive
• Data di inizio desiderata: 1 ottobre 2026 (negoziabile)
• Carico di lavoro: 100%
• Durata: 12 mesi
• Nota: Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi di laurea o dottorato. Processo di applicazione Per essere considerato per questa posizione, si prega di caricare i seguenti documenti:
• CV attuale

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche´s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC), a department within the small molecule research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug candidates from early research into development. The Opportunity As an Intern in our team your main tasks will include:
• Execute and support the optimization of screening assays using liquid handling systems to accelerate the pre-formulation pipeline.
• Perform "head-to-head" manual assays at the bench to compare, validate, and troubleshoot results against automated processes, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
• Interpret complex datasets to provide recommendations on process improvements and formulation viability. Who You Are
• You are a meticulous and independent experimentalist who enjoys troubleshooting
• You hold a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or Automation with lab experience, degree completed no more than 12 months prior to the internship start date
• You have proven experience operating liquid handlers (ideally Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional Information
• Desired Start Date: October 1, 2026 (Negotiable)
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: 12 months
• Note: This internship is not suitable for a Master’s or PhD thesis. Application Process To be considered for this position, please upload the following documents:
• Current CV
• Cover Letter
• Copy of Diplomas Requirements for Non-EU/EFTA Citizens: due to Swiss regulations, the following documents are mandatory for your application:
• Proof of Enrollment: You must remain officially enrolled at your university for the entire duration of the internship.
• Mandatory Internship Letter: An official document from your university confirming that the internship is a required part of your curriculum. Have we piqued your interest? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. • Vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en chimie, sciences pharmaceutiques, génie chimique ou automatisation avec expérience de laboratoire, diplôme complété au plus 12 mois avant la date de début du stage
• Vous avez prouvé l'expérience d'utilisation de gestionnaires de liquides (idéalement Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Bonnes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais. Informations complémentaires
• Date de début souhaitée : 1er octobre 2026 (négociable)
• Charge de travail: 100%
• Durée: 12 mois

• CV actuel
• Lettre de couverture

• Preuve d'inscription: Vous devez rester officiellement inscrit à votre université pendant toute la durée du stage.

Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Questo consente di eseguire le seguenti attività interessanti
• Controllo del fornitore: Si controlla e controlla i fornitori di servizi IFM esterni per una posizione definita e garantire prestazioni efficienti.
• Gestione della qualità: monitora la conformità agli accordi di livello dei servizi (SLA) e agli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e avvia misure correttive proattive per le deviazioni.
• Responsabilità finanziaria: Lei è responsabile del monitoraggio e della previsione dei bilanci per i servizi FM e identifica le potenzialità per ridurre i costi e aumentare l'efficienza.
• Responsabilità dell'operatore: in qualità di garanzia della conformità giuridica, l'utente garantisce che tutti gli obblighi legali e interni dell'operatore siano rispettati dai fornitori di servizi.
• Gestione dei progetti: conduce progetti indipendenti per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e l'implementazione di nuovi concetti di servizio con visione digitale.
• Gestione delle interfacce: moderando come driver di collaborazione centrale Tra le esigenze degli utenti interni e le possibilità operative dei partner esterni. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Hai completato con successo un Master/Diplom in Facility Management, Industrial Engineering o Supply Technology o hai una qualifica simile con una formazione a lungo termine (ad esempio uno specialista:in/master:in).
• Hai più di 5 anni di esperienza professionale consolidata nella gestione delle strutture, nella gestione dei fornitori di servizi esterni (gestione dei fornitori) e nella gestione dei progetti.
• L'utente fornisce una conoscenza approfondita del diritto contrattuale e del diritto degli appalti, nonché una solida conoscenza della gestione delle infrastrutture e della responsabilità dell'operatore.
• Sei sicuro nel gestire i sistemi CAFM e SAP e ha una forte mentalità di crescita per aiutare i cambiamenti proattivi in un ambiente dinamico.
• Si parla inglese e generalmente hanno eccellenti competenze comunicative. Come giocatore di squadra, si è in grado di lavorare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder e di comprendere relazioni complesse.
• Le missioni locali, principalmente tra le nostre sedi a Mannheim e Penzberg, possono essere considerate come arricchimento. Cosi' bene? E' meglio. Vi offriamo una varietà di migliori raccordi nelle nostre sedi. Solo con voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Si rende Roche unico con il vostro contributo. Ecco perché offriamo benefici eccezionali che ti sostengono, la tua vita, le tue finanze e la tua salute

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche we believe it’s critical to deliver medical solutions now — even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and creating a healthier future for all.

The IT Data Transfer and Migration Lead plays a critical role in supporting Roche’s Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives by leading enterprise-scale data migration and transfer strategies across complex systems and environments. This role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure scalable, compliant, and efficient data migration solutions that support business continuity and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity
As a Data Transfer & Migration Lead, you will lead the design and execution of migration strategies for acquired and partnering organizations, ensuring data transfer activities are delivered efficiently, securely, and in compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards.
In this role, you will:

• Lead the design, execution, and lifecycle management of enterprise-scale data transfer and migration strategies for Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives

• Design and implement scalable data architectures, advanced ETL/ELT frameworks, and automation tools to improve migration efficiency and reliability

• Drive technical excellence by mentoring engineering teams, setting architectural standards, and guiding complex technical decision-making

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define migration rules aligned with Roche’s enterprise architecture and compliance requirements

• Ensure data infrastructure and migration platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, and compliant with applicable standards including GxP where required

• Oversee system ownership and lifecycle management of data migration platforms, tools, and related operational processes

• Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align migration strategies with organizational priorities and business objectives

Who you are
You are a strategic and technically strong data engineering leader who thrives in complex, enterprise environments. You bring strong stakeholder management capabilities, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to lead high-impact transformation initiatives across global teams.

To be successful in this role, you have:

• 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data migration, or enterprise data architecture within complex global environments

• Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud data platforms, and advanced ETL/ELT patterns, with the ability to architect scalable data warehouses and data lakes

• Strong understanding of enterprise system interoperability, including platforms such as Veeva, SAP, ServiceNow, and related ecosystems

• Proven experience leading high-impact data migration or transformation projects with strong focus on governance, security, and operational resilience

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and influence architectural decisions across cross-functional stakeholders

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership on data strategy and execution

• Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming technologies, or AI-enabled data capabilities is considered an advantage

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

jobs.title: Communications and Corporate Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As our Communications & Corporate Affairs Partner , you will spearhead initiatives to engage stakeholders, influence policy, and articulate the organization's dedication to advancing health in line with Roche Philippines’ priorities. You will develop and implement strategic communication advocacy and campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences, driving our narrative with focused intent and clarity. This is a unique opportunity to lead critical initiatives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible difference in the healthcare landscape.

What you will be working on:
In this role, you will lead company advocacy and corporate reputation management by delivering purpose-driven communications. You will ensure a consistent narrative across internal and external stakeholders, markets, and cultures, collaborating cross-functionally to align communication strategies with healthcare and social sector priorities.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to.

• Strategic Communication & Brand Ambassadorship: Develops, enhances, and executes communication strategies for assigned therapeutic areas and corporate branding. Ensures Roche is flawlessly represented in all internal and external messaging, upholding a consistent commitment to excellence.

• Influence & Ecosystem Engagement: Manages interactions and builds strategic relationships with external media, patient groups, policymakers, and academics to advance advocacy goals and increase the company’s share of voice.

• Crisis Leadership & Reputation Management: Owns the communications strategy and execution during crisis situations, acting as the primary guardian of corporate reputation to mitigate risk and protect the brand.

• Championing Best Practices & Standards: Leads the development, implementation, and management of best-in-class communication policies, procedures, and templates to drive consistency, operational efficiency, and high-quality standards.

• Omnichannel Reach & Media Management: Manages and leverages Roche Philippines’ media channels to their fullest potential, expanding reach and impact through both traditional and digital platforms.

• Employee Engagement & Internal Culture: Leads internal communications and employee engagement initiatives, utilizing local and network resources to foster an inclusive, purpose-driven culture.

• Measuring Success & Continuous Improvement: Develops metrics and mechanisms to measure the results of communication plans and tactics, sharing best practices and identifying opportunities for ongoing optimization across the network.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Acts as a high-agility partner, collaborating with cross-functional teams (locally and globally) and external partners to ensure communication activities directly support the achievement of business objectives.

Who you are:
You are a Corporate Communications expert who demonstrates:

• Healthcare Passion: A strong understanding of health and pharmaceutical concepts, universal healthcare, access to medicines, and the building blocks of health, with proven experience in driving related advocacy initiatives

• Strategic Agility: Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment. You're a strategic thinker with a knack for systems-level organization

• Business Acumen: Strong understanding of market dynamics, organizational drivers, and financial indicators to make informed decisions that align with broader business goals.

•

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Bei Roche sind wir davon überzeugt, dass es entscheidend ist, medizinische Lösungen sofort bereitzustellen – auch wenn wir Innovationen für die Zukunft entwickeln. Wir setzen uns mit Leidenschaft dafür ein, das Leben von Patient:innen zu verändern und sind mutig in unseren Entscheidungen und Taten. Wir sind der Meinung, dass gutes Handeln eine bessere Welt bedeutet.
Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Genauigkeit, unanfechtbarer Ethik und dem Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um einen besseren Morgen zu schaffen.
Die Organisation „Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, die Teil der globalen Konzernfunktion „Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites” ist, stellt die Infrastruktur für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Stakeholder:innen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Patientenversorgung. Hier erwartet Dich ein modernes Organisationsmodell, in dem Du deine Talente eigenverantwortlich in eine sinnvolle Tätigkeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Raum für Kreativität und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte findest Du bei uns nicht.

In deinen Rollen als Digital Service Expert und Digital Engineer für ServiceNow im Kreis Digital Services bei Roche bist du die treibende Kraft hinter der konsequenten Digitalisierung und Automatisierung unserer Prozesse. Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der massgeblichen technischen Betreuung und strategischen Weiterentwicklung des Site Service Portals basierend auf ServiceNow. Du gibst dich nicht mit bestehenden, manuellen Abläufen zufrieden, sondern analysierst komplexe Geschäftsprozesse tiefgreifend, um sie in automatisierte, digitale Workflows zu transformieren. Dabei nutzt du die Möglichkeiten der ServiceNow-Plattform voll aus, um intelligente Lösungen zu schaffen, die Medienbrüche eliminieren und die Effizienz spürbar steigern. Du verantwortest die nahtlose Integration dieser automatisierten Abläufe in das Portal und stellst sicher, dass die Anwendung für die Nutzer intuitiv und reibungslos funktioniert. Durch deine administrative Expertise stellst du zudem die Stabilität und Skalierbarkeit des Systems sicher, überwachst die Performance und passt die digitalen Prozesse agil an neue Anforderungen an. Dein Ziel ist es, das Site Service Portal zu einer skalierbaren Self-Service-Plattform auszubauen, die durch die Automatisierung wertvolle Zeit spart und einen modernen, digitalen Standard für das gesamte Unternehmen setzt.

Deine Möglichkeit

• In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team verwaltest du den täglichen Betrieb des Site Service Portals und stellst die Stabilität, Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit der ServiceNow-Plattform sicher. Du entwickelst neue digitale Prozesse, behebst proaktiv Fehler und setzt kontinuierlich Verbesserungen um, damit unsere digitalen Prozesse mit den dynamischen Anforderungen des Unternehmens Schritt halten.

• Du skalierst unsere digitalen Lösungen, indem du neue Services und automatisierte Workflows in das Portal integrierst. Deine Rolle ist entscheidend, um den Weg von der Anforderung zur automatisierten Lösung so kurz wie möglich zu halten.

jobs.title: GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission

As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.

• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.

• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.

• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Comp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The opportunity

• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)

• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.

• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.

• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.

• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs.

Who you are
As the successful candidate you hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.

• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.

• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Sviluppo leader: sviluppo farmaceutico delle formulazioni parenterali per lo sviluppo e il mercato clinico (comprese le estensioni di linea). Comprendere il comportamento della stabilità (ad esempio biofisica, degradazione chimica)
• Gestione dei dati: garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei dati strutturati e non strutturati in tutto il dipartimento.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilizzare tecniche di statistica e machine learning avanzate per eseguire l'estrazione di dati in profondità. Identificare le tendenze e le correlazioni associate ai dati scientifici.
• Competenze funzionali come project management: Rappresentanza dello Sviluppo Farmaceutico come responsabile del progetto farmaceutico nei team CMC globali, rappresentante funzionale in team interfunzionali e comitati globali all'interno di Roche.
• Inserimenti normativi: autorizzare sezioni di prodotti farmaceutici per IND/IMPDs clinici e MAAs. • Provata esperienza di stabilire e gestire grandi set di dati, compresa l'esposizione a script associati all'analisi dei dati.
• Profonda comprensione della modellazione statistica, tra cui regressione lineare/logistica, analisi dei cluster, previsione delle serie temporali, analisi dei dati di studio longitudinale e test multivariato.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo dei prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti associati.
• Comprensione dei requisiti normativi per diverse fasi cliniche e commerciali di sviluppo.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen für verschiedene klinische und kommerzielle Entwicklungsstufen.
