Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que Scientifique en Développement Pharmaceutique, vous faites partie du département Développement Pharmaceutique (PTD) à Bâle, Suisse. Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux (molécules de synthèse et produits biologiques) de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme. L'opportunité
• Développement avancé: Développement pharmaceutique de formulations parentérales pour le développement clinique et le marché (y compris les extensions de lignées). Comprendre le comportement de stabilité (par exemple biophysique, dégradation chimique)
• Gestion des données : assurer une intégration transparente des données structurées et non structurées dans l'ensemble du département.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilisez des techniques avancées de statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour effectuer l'extraction de données en profondeur. Déterminer les tendances et les corrélations associées aux données scientifiques.
• Expertise fonctionnelle en tant que gestion de projet : Représentation du développement pharmaceutique en tant que chef de projet pharmaceutique dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités mondiaux au sein de Roche.
• Présentations réglementaires : Autoriser les sections des produits pharmaceutiques pour les ID/IMPD cliniques et les AAM. Qui vous êtes En tant que candidat retenu, vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes. Ou vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle (industrie) dans une entreprise pharmaceutique.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'établissement et de la gestion de grands ensembles de données, y compris l'exposition à des scripts associés à l'analyse des données.
• Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation statistique, y compris la régression linéaire/logistique, l'analyse en grappes, la prévision de séries chronologiques, l'analyse longitudinale des données des études et les essais multivariés.
• Connaissance du développement des produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences connexes.
• Compréhension des exigences réglementaires pour les différents stades cliniques et commerciaux du développement.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et comportement collaboratif, avec une réflexion de bout en bout et globale, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Platform Architect - Data Platforms
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution/Platform Architect - Data Platforms
Preferred Location: Pune

The Opportunity:
The Platform Architect for Data Experience & BI Platforms is responsible for the design, development, and oversight of the organization's BI architecture. This role ensures the BI platforms are robust, scalable, secure, and meets the data and analytics needs of the business, enabling actionable insights and strategic decision-making. The Platform Architect would contribute to our mission to deliver a frictionless insight experience by making data easy to discover, understand, and use—through trusted, governed, and conversational access to unified enterprise knowledge for both people and AI agents.

As the Platform Architect - Data Platforms, you are responsible for:

• Platform Strategy and Design: Define the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for the entire BI ecosystem, including Insights, Reporting Tools and Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, data ingestion pipelines. Select and recommend appropriate BI technologies to meet business requirements and performance standards.

• Architecture Implementation: Oversee the configuration and integration of BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) with various data sources.

• Innovation and Emerging Technologies: Drive the adoption of AI and conversational analytics into the BI landscape; investigate and evaluate new AI solutions to enhance data experience and platform capabilities

• Performance and Optimization: Monitor the BI platform’s performance, identifying and resolving bottlenecks in data loading, query execution, and reporting. Implement best practices for data governance, security, and access control.

• Collaboration and Guidance: Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and translate them into technical design specifications. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to BI developers and data engineering teams.

• Standards and Governance: Establish standards and procedures for data quality, data lineage, and metadata management within the BI environment. Stay current with industry trends and emerging BI technologies to continuously improve the platform.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) working in business intelligence, data warehousing and data architecture roles, with significant time spent in an architect capacity.

• Proven experience in designing and delivering large-scale, complex BI solutions using cloud-based data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Redshift).

Technical / Business Skills

• Expertise with one or more major BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Thoughtspot)

• Experience with SaaS Platforms, AWS Platforms

• Understanding of DWH / Data Lakes / RDBMS / OLTPS & OLAPS

• Good understanding of AI integration patterns( LLM integrations, MCP concepts)

• Familiarity with data governance, security principles, and compliance standards including SIEM

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, and influence strategic decisions.

Additional Qualifications

• Exceptional communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to drive consensus on solutions and navigate conflicts to achieve alignment.

• Fluent English due to job nature

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employee

jobs.title: Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX).

Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:

• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)

• Lab Equipment & Maintenance (LEM)

This structure enables strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Manager, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in project management and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third-party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category Strategy Owner in charge of driving, coordinating, and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement functions (such as Business Partners, Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive LEM/LCC sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to-day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions.

As a Procurement Manager, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a category and sourcing subject matter expert, conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source, negotiate, and manage suppliers in this space to maximize value for Roche.

• You are a procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies, and project management s

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Gerente de Consultoría , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en el desarrollo y la entrega de soluciones innovadoras de procesos de negocio para los clientes. Comenzarás trabajando estrechamente con los clientes para comprender sus necesidades y desafíos. Aprovechando tu experiencia, diseñarás una estrategia y un plan de solución a medida, lo que a menudo conducirá a una mayor eficiencia y eficacia dentro de sus procesos o funciones internas.

La Oportunidad

• Gestionarás proyectos individuales o colectivos con el apoyo de nuestro dinámico Equipo de Consultoría de Roche, fomentando la colaboración y el intercambio de conocimientos para lograr resultados sobresalientes.

• Colaborar estrechamente con las Áreas (Chapters) de Estrategia y Comercial para desarrollar e implementar soluciones que alcancen los objetivos comerciales clave.

• Ser responsable de la ejecución exitosa de los proyectos orientados al cliente, garantizando la entrega oportuna y la alineación con los objetivos del proyecto.

• Aprovechar el análisis de datos y la investigación para identificar desafíos clave, oportunidades y áreas de mejora dentro de los procesos del cliente y la cartera tecnológica de Roche.

• Traducir información compleja en hallazgos y recomendaciones claros y concisos, adaptándolos a las necesidades específicas del cliente y a sus procesos de toma de decisiones.

• Facilitar discusiones colaborativas con los clientes para desarrollar y perfeccionar estrategias integrales basadas en evidencia que aborden sus desafíos y objetivos únicos.

• Utilizar tu profundo conocimiento de la cartera tecnológica de Roche para recomendar soluciones óptimas que maximicen el valor y el retorno de la inversión para el cliente.

• Captación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio: Identificar y colaborar en el cierre de nuevos acuerdos que amplíen nuestra base de clientes.

• Desarrollo y lanzamiento de nuevos negocios: Impulsar la innovación mediante la creación y el lanzamiento de nuevas iniciativas empresariales para los clientes.

• Crecimiento del negocio de clientes existentes: Aumentar los ingresos y el valor para los clientes actuales a través de iniciativas estratégicas de crecimiento de ventas.

Quién eres

• Graduado Universitario de Carreras de Ingeniería, Ciencias y Tecnología (Cédula Profesional vigente)

• Cuentas con más de 5 años de experiencia en mejora de procesos, diseño de procesos y análisis de negocios en empresas relacionadas con Diagnóstico Clínico.

• Posees un nivel de inglés de negocios obligatorio para interactuar en entornos internacionales.

• Destacas por tus habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para explicar conceptos complejos a diversas audiencias.

• Eres reconocido por tu capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y enfoque proactivo en la resolución de problemas.

Preferred

• Experiencia previa en firmas de consultoría trabajando en entornos de ritmo rápido.

• Conocimiento en metodologías específicas como Six Sigma, Lean o Kaizen.

• Dominio de herramientas de mapeo de procesos y visualización de datos.

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocación

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Mexico City. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the g

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione di Consulting Manager è un documento fondamentale nello sviluppo e nell'introduzione di soluzioni innovative ai processi di negoziazione per i clienti. Lavoreremo a stretto contatto con i nostri clienti per comprendere le loro esigenze e desideri. Dopo aver sperimentato, progetta una strategia e un piano di soluzione a medida, dove un menu porterà ad una maggiore efficienza ed efficacia all'interno dei nostri processi o funzioni interne. La Opportunidad
• Gestionarás progetti individuali o collettivi con il supporto della nuova dinamica Equipo de Consultoría de Roche, promuovendo la collaborazione e lo scambio di conoscenze per ottenere risultati sobresalienti.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le Aree (Capitoli) di Estrategia y Commercial per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni che affrontino obiettivi commerciali chiave.
• Ser responsabile della consegna di successo di progetti orientati al cliente, garantendo l'opportunità e l'allineamento con gli oggetti del progetto.
• Approvare l'analisi e l'indagine dei dati per identificare informazioni chiave, opportunità e aree di miglioramento nei processi dei clienti e nel portafoglio tecnico di Roche.
• Tradurre informazioni complete in raccomandazioni chiare e concise, adattandole alle esigenze specifiche del cliente e seguendo il processo decisionale.
• Facilitare le discussioni collaborative con i clienti per scoprire e perfezionare strategie integrali basate su prove che affrontano obiettivi e obiettivi unici.
• Utilizzare la vostra conoscenza approfondita del portafoglio tecnico di Roche per consigliare soluzioni ottimali che massimizzino il valore e il rendimento dell'inversione per il cliente.
• Catturare nuove opportunità commerciali: identificare e collaborare con nuovi clienti che ampliano la nostra base clienti.
• Lancio e lancio di nuove iniziative imprenditoriali: promuovere l'innovazione attraverso la creazione e il lancio di nuove iniziative commerciali per i clienti.
• Crecimiento del negocio del negocio de esistentes clientes: Aumentare il patrimonio e il valore dei clienti attuali attraverso iniziative strategiche di aumento delle vendite. Quién eres
• Laureato Universitario de Carreras de Ingeniería, Ciencias y Tecnología (Cédula Profesional vigente)
• Cuentas con più di 5 anni di esperienza nel miglioramento dei processi, progettazione di processi e analisi delle negoziazioni in aziende legate alla diagnostica clinica.
• Per interagire nei mercati internazionali è richiesto un livello di negoziazione inglese.
• Fornisce le tue abilità comunicative e la capacità di spiegare concetti complessi a diversi tipi di pubblico.
• Sono riconosciuti per le tue capacità analitiche, il pensiero critico e l'approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi. Preferibile
• Precedente esperienza in società di consulenza che lavorano con tempi di risposta rapidi.
• Conoscenza di metodologie specifiche come Six Sigma, Lean o Kaizen.
• Dominio degli strumenti della mappa dei processi e della visualizzazione dei dati. Questa posizione non offre vantaggi di trasferimento Laddove si applica la trasparenza retributiva, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla sede di distacco principale. Per questo ruolo, la sede principale è Città del Messico. Se sei interessato ad ulteriori località in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi alla retribuzione più avanti nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Solution Architect - Commercial Content Supply Chain

Roche Digital Technology (RDT ) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Be part of the revolution in our commercial content ecosystem. You will spearhead the adoption of Generative AI (GenAI) and Automation solutions, building robust technical foundations and seamless integrations that empower bespoke customer experiences at scale.

Serving as a Lead Architect and Strategist , you will orchestrate the technology roadmap and direct the comprehensive deployment of systems designed to achieve measurable business impact.

The opportunity:

• Defining the Vision and Strategy by serving as the lead architect for our future-state digital supply chain ecosystem.

• Curating the Technology Stack through the selection and integration of modern tools at the crossroads of artificial intelligence and automated workflows.

• Providing Implementation Oversight by directing technical execution and deployment phases to guarantee consistent alignment with our strategic business objectives.

• Driving Personalization at Scale by engineering robust frameworks that facilitate highly.

Who you are:

• Substantial Professional Background including at least a decade in software engineering, with a minimum of five years focused on architectural leadership.

• Strategic Domain Expertise in the architectural design and large-scale deployment of Commercial Content Supply Chains .

• Adobe Platform Mastery , specifically regarding technical proficiency across AEM and AEP integrated technology stacks.

• Engineering Excellence in crafting tailor-made applications through advanced Java , Python , and JavaScript development.

• AI-Driven Innovation demonstrated through the successful execution of GenAI implementations that catalyze significant business value and ROI.

• Life Sciences Insight with a nuanced perspective on Pharma customer journeys and highly regulated industry workflows.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 075-35 425 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed pack

Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. Proverai l'adozione di soluzioni Generative AI (GenAI) e Automation, costruendo solide basi tecniche e integrazioni senza soluzione di continuità che consentono di esprimere le esperienze dei clienti su scala. • Fornire la supervisione dell'implementazione, indirizzando fasi di esecuzione e di distribuzione tecniche per garantire un allineamento coerente con i nostri obiettivi strategici aziendali.
• Guidare la personalizzazione a Scale mediante l'ingegneria di strutture robuste che facilitano molto. Chi sei:
• Sfondo professionale sostanziale che include almeno un decennio di ingegneria del software, con un minimo di cinque anni focalizzati sulla leadership architettonica.
• Esperienza di dominio strategico nella progettazione architettonica e distribuzione su larga scala delle catene di approvvigionamento dei contenuti commerciali .
• Adobe Platform Mastery, in particolare per quanto riguarda la competenza tecnica negli stack di tecnologia integrati AEM e AEP.
• Eccellenza ingegneristica nella realizzazione di applicazioni su misura attraverso lo sviluppo avanzato di Java , Python e JavaScript.

jobs.title: Healthcare System Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsibilities:

• The HSP partners with healthcare system stakeholders to drive healthcare system innovation and unlock possibilities to deliver value for the ecosystem and society

• As part of this, the HSP contributes to identifying, mapping, engaging and managing ecosystem stakeholders.

• The HSP acts as trusted partner and the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. She or he shares the stakeholder community vision and value internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• The Healthcare System Partner lives the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, acts as catalyst and coach externally and internally.

• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners.

• The HSP looks across the individual ecosystem and catalyzes our ability to see broader trends and patterns in healthcare systems. They need to bring outside insights into Roche to influence strategy AND to bring our expertise, science and knowledge out to the ecosystem

Experiences, Knowledge and Qualifications:
Skills & Experience:

• Deep understanding of healthcare system, processes and governance

• Excellent customer engagement and management skills

• Experience leading cross functional teams is required. Cross-functional leadership experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is desirable.

• System thinker and deep listener

• A sensitive leader who senses, reflects and responds

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization and customer experience excellence

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools for the benefit of all stakeholders is highly desirable.

• Able to manage complex projects

Knowledge

• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions

Capabilities:

• Fluent in local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications:

• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.

• Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies

• Education in health policy

• CCXA Academy (desirable)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Addetto alla gestione delle soluzioni tecniche

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs.

As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level.

Main responsibilities

As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:

• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.

• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.

• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)

• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)

• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)

• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.

• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.

• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data.

How would your day to day look like?
As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts.

The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. jobs.title: Application Specialist - Molecular Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.

This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.

• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.

• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.

• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.

• Provide scientific documentation to customers.

• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.

• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.

• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.

• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.

• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who you are:

• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.

• Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions - an advantage.

• Fluent in English (oral and written).

• Technical vocabulary & terminology.

• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).

• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).

• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, administration and decision making.

• Work well in a team environment.

• Service/Customer oriented.

• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are driven by a shared ambition: to create a healthier future through continuous innovation, advancing science, and expanding access to healthcare for people worldwide. Our purpose is to help build a world where people can spend more time with those who matter most.

As healthcare continues to evolve, Global Procurement is transforming to deliver greater strategic value—enhancing supplier partnerships, driving innovation, and improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems globally. By actively managing a complex supplier ecosystem, we ensure we meet today’s needs while anticipating those of tomorrow.

The Opportunity

As Analytics & Insights Business Partnering Lead , you will lead the strategic direction of Analytics within the Procurement Enablement chapter. This function is central to building a best-in-class Procurement organization through data-driven insights, governance, capability development, and digital innovation.

You will shape how data is leveraged across Global Procurement, unlocking its full potential to inform decision-making, drive performance, and create tangible business impact. Operating in a highly dynamic, global environment, you will guide teams to apply structured thinking, advanced Analytics, and actionable insights to complex business challenges.

Your Impact

In this leadership role, you will act as a strategic advisor and capability builder, working across Procurement, Finance, and cross-functional Analytics teams. You will lead, coach, and inspire others while delivering high-impact Analytics solutions and fostering a strong data-driven culture.

Key areas of accountability include:

• Setting the vision and strategy for Analytics and insights within business partnering, aligning with broader Global Procurement objectives

• Acting as a senior subject matter expert, guiding best practices in data strategy, Analytics, visualization, and insight generation

• Leading the development and continuous improvement of Analytics products, frameworks, and scalable solutions

• Influencing senior stakeholders to embed data-driven decision-making and improve data quality across the organization

• Building and developing high-performing teams, while contributing to cross-functional initiatives, squads, and enterprise-wide programs

• Championing innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies, methodologies, and ways of working

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a strong track record in Analytics, Procurement, and account management within complex, matrixed organizations. You bring both strategic vision and hands-on expertise, along with the ability to influence at the highest levels.

You will typically bring:

• A university degree (business, Analytics, or life sciences preferred)

• 10+ years of experience in Procurement, Analytics, business analysis, or management consulting

• Proven experience translating complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions

• Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to influence and drive adoption of new strategies and technologies

• Deep expertise in data, visualization, and insight generation, combined with experience leading teams and initiatives

• Category management experience is highly advantageous

• Previous account management experience also desirable

• Fluency in English

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, siamo guidati da un'ambizione condivisa: creare un futuro più sano attraverso l'innovazione continua, avanzando la scienza e espandendo l'accesso alla sanità per le persone in tutto il mondo. Il nostro scopo è quello di aiutare a costruire un mondo in cui le persone possono trascorrere più tempo con coloro che importano di più. Man mano che l'assistenza sanitaria continua a evolversi, Global Procurement si sta trasformando per offrire un maggior valore strategico: migliorare le partnership dei fornitori, guidare l'innovazione e migliorare i risultati per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari a livello globale. Gestire attivamente un ecosistema di fornitori complesso, ci assicuriamo di soddisfare le esigenze di oggi, anticipando quelle di domani. L'opportunità In qualità di Lead di partner commerciali di analisi e informazioni, guiderai la direzione strategica di Analytics all'interno del capitolo Procurement Enablement. Questa funzione è centrale per la costruzione di un'organizzazione di appalti di classe migliore attraverso intuizioni basate sui dati, governance, sviluppo delle capacità e innovazione digitale. Potrai modellare come i dati vengono sfruttati attraverso Global Procurement, sbloccando il suo pieno potenziale per informare il processo decisionale, le prestazioni di guida e creare impatto commerciale tangibile. Operando in un ambiente altamente dinamico e globale, guiderai i team ad applicare il pensiero strutturato, l'analisi avanzata e le intuizioni attuabili a complesse sfide aziendali. Il tuo impatto In questo ruolo di leadership, si agirà come consulente strategico e costruttore di capacità, lavorando tra i team di Procurement, Finance e Analytics cross-functional. Potrai guidare, allenare e ispirare gli altri offrendo soluzioni di analisi ad alto impatto e promuovere una forte cultura basata sui dati. Le principali aree di responsabilità includono:
• Impostare la visione e la strategia per l'analisi e le intuizioni all'interno del business partnering, allineando con gli obiettivi di Global Procurement più ampi
• Agire come esperto di materia senior, guidando le migliori pratiche nella strategia dei dati, analisi, visualizzazione e generazione di informazioni

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. In disease areas like Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis, you will be responsible for shaping and executing on strategies that allow us to increase R&D productivity using digital clinical outcome assessments, digital biomarkers and exploratory digital measures collected from wearables, smartphones and other sensor-based digital health technologies (DHTs). You will be part of a team of experts located in Basel and South San Francisco and report to the Sensor Data Insights group lead in the Computational Biology and Medicine department.

The Opportunity:

• Partner with drug development teams to shape high-impact opportunities that drive clinical trial productivity improvements with sensor-based DHTs; embed them into disease area, clinical development, and biomarker strategies.

• Lead the delivery of these roadmaps. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un'organizzazione globale che consente alle unità di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche (pRED e gRED) di diventare più basate sui dati, più digitalmente adept, e meglio preparate per le sfide del futuro. All'interno del CoE, la Medicina Computazionale si concentra sullo sviluppo e l'applicazione di soluzioni di analisi dei dati innovative per supportare lo sviluppo clinico, migliorando la nostra comprensione della malattia, della progressione della malattia e della risposta individuale del paziente al trattamento. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED e gRED, creiamo farmaci migliori aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura data-driven. Come Digital Measures Lead , si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'integrazione di tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori nel cuore dei nostri programmi di sviluppo di droga pRED e gRED. Nelle aree di malattia come il morbo di Alzheimer e la Sclerosi Multipla, sarete responsabili di modellare ed eseguire strategie che ci permettono di aumentare la produttività R&D utilizzando le valutazioni dei risultati clinici digitali, i biomarcatori digitali e le misure digitali esplorative raccolte da wearables, smartphone e altre tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori (DHT). Sarete parte di un team di esperti che si trova a Basilea e nel sud di San Francisco e riferirete al gruppo Sensor Data Insights leader nel reparto Biologia e Medicina Computazionale. L'opportunità:
• Collaborare con i team di sviluppo della droga per creare opportunità ad alto impatto che favoriscano i miglioramenti della produttività di trial clinici con DHT basati sui sensori; integrarli in aree di malattia, sviluppo clinico e strategie di biomarcatore.
• Sviluppare mappe stradali complete per realizzare queste opportunità, compresa la valutazione delle esigenze di misura non soddisfatte; valutare, sviluppare, convalidare i DHT basati sui sensori; guidare verso l'accettazione della comunità e della regolamentazione
• Guidare la consegna di queste roadmap. Ciò include la garanzia di approvazione e risourcing della governance; la consegna del team di matrice CoE leader; la gestione dei partenariati di fornitori/tecnologie; l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei DHT basati sui sensori in studi clinici, tra cui progetti di studio, operazioni, analisi dei dati; l'interpretazione dei risultati di supporto.
• Promuovere partnership esterne con industria, fornitori di tecnologia, centri accademici, regolatori e pazienti per rafforzare e accelerare questi sforzi.
• Guidare la comunicazione scientifica e la leadership di pensiero sia all'interno che all'esterno di Roche attraverso conferenze e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, mentre sostenere il rigore scientifico e la concentrazione dei pazienti in tutte le attività. Chi sei?
• Ha un Ph.D. o un'esperienza equivalente in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience o una disciplina correlata accoppiata con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale sfruttando DHT basati sui sensori per migliorare la produttività R&D nelle prove di Fase I-IV
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza in neuroscienze, tra cui la malattia di Alzheimer e la sclerosi multipla, e capire come i DHT basati sui sensori possono essere applicati per i casi di uso di prova clinica in queste aree (ad esempio l'efficacia/sicurezza

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.

The Opportunity
As a TDL, you will lead Technical Development Teams (TDTs) to develop and drive Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (CMC) strategies for clinical drug candidates from early human trials through product launch ensuring technical integrity and proactive risk mitigation.

• Leadership: Lead technical teams throughout the product lifecycle, from preclinical development to product launch, ensuring the scientific integrity of the CMC strategy.

• Strategy & Execution: Designs and implements multifaceted technical strategies - encompassing manufacturing processes, drug product and device configurations, and global supply chains - to ensure seamless regulatory approval and commercial success.

• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Provides enterprise-level perspectives to ensure deliverables remain patient- and customer-focused; serves as a primary liaison to asset teams, senior management and governance committees, delivering transparent updates that facilitate informed decision-making.

• Operational Excellence: Oversees end-to-end CMC development, including financial stewardship, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking to ensure flawless execution.

• Risk & Decision Management: Drives informed decision-making for CMC investments and risk mitigation, developing robust contingency plans and proactively communicating potential impacts to relevant leadership and governance bodies.

Who You Are

• You are a recognized thought leader in CMC/product development with a proven ability to lead complex, high-stakes pharmaceutical projects.

• Education: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Technical Expertise: Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, including a strong background in biologics process development and CMC team leadership.

• Strategic and Critical Thinking: Advanced understanding of the full drug development process with a history of successful innovation. Business acumen is a plus

• Program Management: Demonstrated ability to handle complex cross-functional programs while thinking strategically and proactively.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional negotiation and verbal/written communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior management and third parties.

.
Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across

La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio. L'opportunità Come TDL, guiderai i team di sviluppo tecnico (TDTs) per sviluppare e guidare strategie di chimica, manifatturiera e controllo (CMC) per i candidati alla droga clinica dai primi studi umani attraverso il lancio del prodotto garantendo l'integrità tecnica e la mitigazione del rischio proattivo.
• Leadership: Leader team tecnici in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dallo sviluppo preclinico al lancio del prodotto, garantendo l'integrità scientifica della strategia CMC.
• Strategia & Esecuzione: Progetta e implementa strategie tecniche sfaccettate, che comprendono processi produttivi, configurazioni di prodotti e dispositivi, e catene di approvvigionamento globali, per garantire una perfetta approvazione normativa e un successo commerciale.
• allineamento aziendale e governance: fornisce prospettive a livello aziendale per garantire che i responsabili rimangano pazienti e orientati al cliente; funge da collegamento primario ai team di asset, ai comitati di gestione e governance senior, fornendo aggiornamenti trasparenti che facilitano il processo decisionale informato.
• Eccellenza operativa: supervisiona lo sviluppo CMC end-to-end, tra cui la gestione finanziaria, la previsione delle risorse e il tracciamento delle pietre miliari per garantire l'esecuzione impeccabile.
• Gestione del rischio e delle decisioni: guida il processo decisionale informato per gli investimenti CMC e la mitigazione dei rischi, lo sviluppo di piani di contingenza robusti e la comunicazione proattiva dei potenziali impatti per gli organismi di leadership e di governance rilevanti. Chi sei
• Sei un leader di pensiero riconosciuto nello sviluppo CMC / prodotto con una comprovata capacità di condurre progetti farmaceutici complessi e ad alto consumo.
• Istruzione: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chimica, Farmacia, Ingegneria Chimica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Competenza Tecnica: Ampia esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, tra cui un forte background nello sviluppo dei processi biologici e nella leadership del team CMC.
• pensiero strategico e critico: comprensione avanzata del processo di sviluppo completo della droga con una storia di innovazione di successo. Business acumen è un plus
• Gestione del programma: capacità dimostrata di gestire programmi interfunzionali complessi mentre si pensa strategicamente e proattivamente.
• Comunicazione e influenza: negoziazione eccezionale e capacità comunicative verbali/scritte, con un track record di influenzare la gestione senior e terze parti. . Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world.

Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within?

As an intern, you will contribute to Mission Eco-Possible, an active initiative designed to align CAC DIA operations with Roche’s global sustainability strategy and support a 25% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030. The project focuses on turning the affiliate’s emissions baseline into a practical roadmap for action, with particular attention to Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the Central America and Caribbean context. Within your first months, you are expected to help design and implement an internal environmental sustainability campaign, support the definition of a feasible action plan and investment needs for emissions reduction, and develop an emissions reporting tool aligned with Roche Group guidelines. • Design and implement an internal cultural campaign focused on environmental sustainability and the 2030 Eco-Mission

• Support the definition of a feasible action plan to reduce Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the CAC regional context

• Assess investment needs and support feasibility analysis for proposed sustainability initiatives

• Develop an emissions reporting tool for the affiliate aligned with Roche Group guidelines

• Analyze current emissions drivers, including fleet operations, refrigerants, business travel, and e-waste

• Translate sustainability data into clear dashboards, reports, and visual materials for internal use

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support implementation and engagement across the organization

• Help connect local actions to Roche’s broader net-zero and SBTi-aligned commitments

• Knowledgeable in ESG principles and greenhouse gas accounting frameworks such as the GHG Protocol

• Able to conduct technical and financial feasibility analyses for sustainability projects and investment decisions

• A strong communicator who can turn complex data into compelling stories and work effectively with different stakeholders

• Fluent in Spanish and English.

• Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable driving initiatives in a dynamic regional environment

If you meet most but not all qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Additional information

• The internship is expected to start between 1 and 16 July 2026 and will last 6 months.

• Work term: full

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

• Mentor junior developers, fostering their professional growth and upholding high engineering standards.

Who You Are

We are looking for a passionate and collaborative software engineer with a talent for building scalable, reliable platforms. You thrive on engaging with scientific partners to solve comple

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

Who We Are:
Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years.
In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients.
As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need.

The Opportunity:
As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality.
Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.

• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.

jobs.title: IT Project Specialist (Puerto Montt)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Gestionar, coordinar y ejecutar actividades de proyectos relacionados con sistemas e infraestructura IT para proporcionar y asegurar un servicio de calidad a nuestros clientes.
Ejecutar actividades de soporte de segundo nivel local. Ser referente técnico a nivel local. Identificar y dar solución a problemas complejos asociados a las plataformas informáticas.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Liderar la ejecución de proyectos de IT relacionados con instalación, integración y mejoras de sistemas (hardware y software), asegurando cumplimiento en alcance, tiempos, calidad y coordinación con áreas internas y clientes.

• Brindar soporte técnico de segundo nivel en soluciones informáticas, resolviendo incidencias complejas, configuraciones avanzadas, integraciones con sistemas host y conexión de instrumentos, priorizando la resolución remota.

• Gestionar y ejecutar entrenamientos técnicos, manteniendo actualización continua en sistemas e infraestructura IT, y asegurando el cumplimiento de programas de formación corporativos.

• Asegurar una comunicación efectiva con stakeholders y participar en el diseño de soluciones IT, contribuyendo con información técnica para propuestas, licitaciones y evaluación de riesgos.

• Garantizar la operación y soporte continuo de sistemas IT mediante monitoreo, mantenimiento preventivo, gestión de casos y documentación, asegurando cumplimiento de SLAs, políticas de compliance y normativas corporativas.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario o técnico en Informática, Sistemas, Tecnólogo Médico o carreras afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en el área de informática, idealmente con conocimiento en sistemas de salud.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio-avanzado.

• Conocimiento en manejo de sustancias peligrosas.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Tissue Diagnostics

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services.

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

This is a field based role: the territory includes North and Central Illinois (Chicago down to Springfield) and the state of Iowa. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory border. We prefer the candidate to reside in the greater Chicago area.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• Communicates competitive market information internally.

• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellows

Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. • Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. • Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.
• Communicates competitive market information internally.
• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellows

jobs.title: Capital Investment Finance GBPS (Secondment-Temporary)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. This is a temporary or secondment position

As Global Business Process Specialist—Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and drive the deployment of large-scale SAP S4 initiatives, owning key areas such as Asset Accounting, CAPEX, and Lease Accounting while ensuring successful project delivery and integration.

• Execute and continuously enhance end-to-end business process management (E2E BPM) strategies, delivering integrated solutions across processes, technology, and analytics while enabling global business adoption.

• Design and redesign global, cross-divisional processes to be standardized, lean, and fit-for-purpose, ensuring alignment with best practices and organizational goals.

• Govern business processes by prioritizing and implementing change requests, ensuring effective execution, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement, while creating meaningful impact across both business and IT.

Who You Are:

• You bring a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a related field, along with 5–7 years of experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or similar functions.

• You possess strong technical and process expertise, including deep knowledge of end-to-end processes, IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, procurement, and hands-on experience in asset and lease accounting within SAP environments.

• You demonstrate a strong methodological foundation (BPM, Six Sigma, Lean, Scrum, PDCA, Kaizen) combined with an agile, customer-centric mindset and high attention to detail and quality.

• You excel in stakeholder management, communication, and leadership, with a proven ability to influence, manage change, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across global, multicultural, and matrixed organizations, with business-fluent English.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunit
