jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You are part of a high-performing and high-impact team that co-creates and implements the Roche Diagnostics strategy in order to realize our vision “innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, changing lives”. You play a pivotal role in maximizing the overall value delivery of the Diagnostics strategy for our customers and patients and in unlocking the power of the organization for our customers and patients.

As part of the Diagnostics Strategy team, you will lead key strategic initiatives, like M&A Integrations or Operating Model changes that enable the realization of the Divisional Strategy. You have the opportunity to shape and drive strategy activities, methodologies, and best practices with a view to reaching a critical strategy understanding and expertise throughout the organization. When an M&A is decided you will lead or be part of the M&A integration team that is defining the integration approach and will play a key role in making the integration a success by reaching the defined end state objectives. You will collaborate closely with a variety of senior stakeholders from different parts of the Diagnostics organization and report into a Strategy Team Lead.

Expected areas of accountability would include driving and implementing strategic initiatives across functions, but are not necessarily limited to those outlined below:

The Opportunity

• Broad understanding of the Diagnostics business as a prerequisite to design the fit for purpose operating model, Organisational Design and integration approaches

• Knowledge of multiple M&A Integration areas and aspects (like: M&A Integration phases, Org.Design, System Integration or legal and tax considerations)

• Use of knowledge of business and integration insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose integration topics with a wide range of complexity.

• Proactively builds knowledge of the external environment to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive integration decisions.

• Leads and/or oversees and coordinates the Operating Model design or integration work from planning to implementation including identifying opportunities and risks while developing/overseeing action plans to address them. Develops and leads/coordinates program / project planning

• Proven ability to influence business leaders and decision makers to achieve required outcomes.

• Further develop and refine aspects of our overarching organisational design and operating model (e.g., structures, roles, interfaces, etc.), run health checks of the organization

• Drive the understanding of the organisational design choices

In a highly cross-functional environment,you will also provide project and matrix leadership consistent with the Roche values, leadership capabilities and mindset. The incumbent will seek to inspire and ignite passion in others to create sustainable change and to leverage the efforts of a diverse range of people and teams.

Who you are

• University degree level qualification in a relevant discipline, typically with 5-7+ years of experience, preferably in large matrix Diagnostics or Medical Device CompaniesIndustry

• Experience in a consultancy company or strategy development and implementation in a corporate or global strategy role &

• Proven experience with post-merger integrations inside or supporting in/with diagnostics companies

• Structured thinking, proven problem-solving skills & t rack record of successful project & program management-

• Highly developed

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei parte di un team di alto livello e ad alto impatto che co-crea e implementa la strategia Roche Diagnostics per realizzare la nostra visione “innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute, cambiare la vita”. Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella massimizzazione del valore complessivo di consegna della strategia Diagnostica per i nostri clienti e pazienti e nello sblocco della potenza dell'organizzazione per i nostri clienti e pazienti. Nell'ambito del team Diagnostics Strategy, guiderai iniziative strategiche chiave, come le integrazioni M&A o i cambiamenti del Modello Operativo che consentono la realizzazione della Strategia Divisionale. Hai l'opportunità di plasmare e guidare attività di strategia, metodologie e best practice al fine di raggiungere una comprensione e competenze strategiche critiche in tutta l'organizzazione. Quando un M&A è deciso, guiderà o parte del team di integrazione M&A che sta definendo l'approccio di integrazione e svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rendere l'integrazione un successo raggiungendo gli obiettivi definiti dello stato finale. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con una varietà di stakeholder senior provenienti da diverse parti dell'organizzazione Diagnostics e riferire in un Team Lead Strategy. Le aree di responsabilità previste includono la guida e l'attuazione di iniziative strategiche tra le funzioni, ma non sono necessariamente limitate a quelle descritte di seguito: L'opportunità
• Ampia comprensione del business Diagnostics come prerequisito per progettare la vestibilità per il modello operativo, la progettazione organizzativa e gli approcci di integrazione
• Conoscenza di più aree e aspetti di integrazione M&A (come: fasi di integrazione M&A, Org.Design, Integrazione di sistema o considerazioni legali e fiscali)
• Utilizzare la conoscenza delle conoscenze di business e integrazione, metriche, competenze e principi decisionali per diagnosticare efficacemente gli argomenti di integrazione con una vasta gamma di complessità.
• Proattivamente costruisce la conoscenza dell'ambiente esterno per diagnosticare e implementare efficacemente le strategie per aiutare a guidare le decisioni di integrazione.
• Conduce e/o supervisiona e coordina il lavoro di progettazione o integrazione del Modello Operativo dalla pianificazione all'implementazione, tra cui l'individuazione di opportunità e rischi, sviluppando e supervisionando piani d'azione per affrontarli. Sviluppa e conduce/coordina il programma/progetto
• comprovata capacità di influenzare i leader aziendali e i decisori per raggiungere i risultati necessari.
• Sviluppare e perfezionare ulteriormente gli aspetti del nostro overarching design organizzativo e modello operativo (ad esempio, strutture, ruoli, interfacce, ecc.), eseguire controlli sanitari dell'organizzazione
• Guidare la comprensione delle scelte di progettazione organizzativa In un ambiente altamente interfunzionale, fornirete anche la leadership di progetto e matrice coerente con i valori Roche, le capacità di leadership e la mentalità. L'incumbent cercherà di ispirare e accendere la passione in altri per creare un cambiamento sostenibile e sfruttare gli sforzi di una vasta gamma di persone e team. Chi sei
• Laurea di livello universitario in una disciplina rilevante, tipicamente con 5-7 anni di esperienza, preferibilmente in diagnostica di matrice di grandi dimensioni o società di dispositivi mediciIndustria
• Esperienza in una società di consulenza o sviluppo strategico e attuazione in un ruolo di strategia aziendale o globale &
• Esperienza comprovata con integrazioni post-merger all'interno o supporto in/con società di diagnostica
• pensiero strutturato, comprovate capacità di problem solving e record rack di successo progetto e gestione dei programmi
• Altamente sviluppato
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You are part of a high-performing and high-impact team that co-creates and implements the Roche Diagnostics strategy in order to realize our vision “innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, changing lives”. You play a pivotal role in maximizing the overall value delivery of the Diagnostics strategy for our customers and patients and in unlocking the power of the organization for our customers and patients. As part of the Diagnostics Strategy team, you will lead key strategic initiatives, like M&A Integrations or Operating Model changes that enable the realization of the Divisional Strategy. You have the opportunity to shape and drive strategy activities, methodologies, and best practices with a view to reaching a critical strategy understanding and expertise throughout the organization. When an M&A is decided you will lead or be part of the M&A integration team that is defining the integration approach and will play a key role in making the integration a success by reaching the defined end state objectives. You will collaborate closely with a variety of senior stakeholders from different parts of the Diagnostics organization and report into a Strategy Team Lead. Expected areas of accountability would include driving and implementing strategic initiatives across functions, but are not necessarily limited to those outlined below: The Opportunity
• Broad understanding of the Diagnostics business as a prerequisite to design the fit for purpose operating model, Organisational Design and integration approaches
• Knowledge of multiple M&A Integration areas and aspects (like: M&A Integration phases, Org.Design, System Integration or legal and tax considerations)
• Use of knowledge of business and integration insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose integration topics with a wide range of complexity.
• Proactively builds knowledge of the external environment to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive integration decisions.
• Leads and/or oversees and coordinates the Operating Model design or integration work from planning to implementation including identifying opportunities and risks while developing/overseeing action plans to address them. Develops and leads/coordinates program / project planning
• Proven ability to influence business leaders and decision makers to achieve required outcomes.
• Further develop and refine aspects of our overarching organisational design and operating model (e.g., structures, roles, interfaces, etc.), run health checks of the organization
• Drive the understanding of the organisational design choices In a highly cross-functional environment,you will also provide project and matrix leadership consistent with the Roche values, leadership capabilities and mindset. The incumbent will seek to inspire and ignite passion in others to create sustainable change and to leverage the efforts of a diverse range of people and teams. Who you are
• University degree level qualification in a relevant discipline, typically with 5-7+ years of experience, preferably in large matrix Diagnostics or Medical Device CompaniesIndustry
• Experience in a consultancy company or strategy development and implementation in a corporate or global strategy role &
• Proven experience with post-merger integrations inside or supporting in/with diagnostics companies
• Structured thinking, proven problem-solving skills & t rack record of successful project & program management-
• Highly developed

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. • Ein umfassendes Verständnis des Diagnostics-Geschäfts als Voraussetzung für die Gestaltung der Passform für zielorientiertes Betriebsmodell, Organisationsdesign und Integrationsansätze

• Einsatz von Kenntnissen über Unternehmens- und Integrations-Einsichten, Metriken, Know-how und Entscheidungsprinzipien, um Integrationsthemen mit einer Vielzahl von Komplexität effektiv zu diagnostizieren.
• Proaktiv baut Wissen über das externe Umfeld auf, um Strategien effektiv zu diagnostizieren und umzusetzen, um Integrationsentscheidungen anzutreiben.

Der Incumbent wird versuchen, Leidenschaft in anderen zu inspirieren und zu entzünden, um nachhaltige Veränderungen zu schaffen und die Bemühungen einer Vielzahl von Menschen und Teams zu nutzen. Wer bist du?
• Hochschulabschluss-Qualifikation in einer relevanten Disziplin, typischerweise mit 5-7+ Jahren Erfahrung, vorzugsweise in der großen Matrix Diagnostics oder MedizinprodukteunternehmenIndustrie
• Erfahrung in einem Beratungsunternehmen oder Strategieentwicklung und Umsetzung in einer Corporate oder Global Strategie Rolle &
• Erprobte Erfahrung mit Post-Merger-Integrationen innerhalb oder Unterstützung in/mit Diagnostik-Unternehmen
• Strukturiertes Denken, bewährte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten & t Rack Rekord von erfolgreichem Projekt- & Programmmanagement-
• Hochentwickelt

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Vous faites partie d'une équipe à haut rendement et à fort impact qui co-crée et met en œuvre la stratégie de diagnostic Roche afin de réaliser notre vision, d'innover le diagnostic, de façonner les soins de santé, de changer les vies. Vous jouez un rôle central en maximisant la valeur globale de la stratégie Diagnostics pour nos clients et patients et en débloquant la puissance de l'organisation pour nos clients et patients. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Stratégie diagnostique, vous dirigerez des initiatives stratégiques clés, comme les intégrations de M et A ou les changements du modèle opérationnel qui permettent la réalisation de la Stratégie divisionnaire. Vous avez l'occasion de concevoir et de diriger des activités stratégiques, des méthodologies et des pratiques exemplaires en vue d'atteindre une compréhension et une expertise stratégiques essentielles dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Lorsqu'une M&A est décidée, vous dirigerez ou participerez à l'équipe d'intégration des M&A qui définit l'approche d'intégration et jouera un rôle clé pour faire de l'intégration un succès en atteignant les objectifs définis de l'état final. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec divers intervenants chevronnés de différentes parties de l'organisation Diagnostics et vous ferez rapport en chef d'équipe stratégique. Les domaines de responsabilisation prévus comprendraient la conduite et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives stratégiques dans toutes les fonctions, mais ne se limitent pas nécessairement à ceux décrits ci-dessous : L'opportunité
• Une compréhension large de l'activité Diagnostic comme préalable à la conception de l'ajustement à des fins de modèle opérationnel, conception organisationnelle et approches d'intégration
• Connaissance de multiples domaines et aspects d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions (comme les phases d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions, la conception, l'intégration des systèmes ou des considérations juridiques et fiscales)
• Utilisation des connaissances sur les perspectives d'affaires et d'intégration, les paramètres, l'expertise et les principes de décision pour diagnostiquer efficacement les sujets d'intégration avec un large éventail de complexité.
• Développer activement les connaissances sur l'environnement extérieur afin de diagnostiquer et de mettre en œuvre efficacement des stratégies permettant d'orienter les décisions d'intégration.
• Dirige et/ou supervise et coordonne les travaux de conception ou d'intégration du modèle d'exploitation, de la planification à la mise en oeuvre, y compris la détermination des possibilités et des risques tout en élaborant ou supervisant des plans d'action pour y remédier. Élaborer et diriger/coordonner la planification des programmes et des projets
• Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les chefs d'entreprise et les décideurs pour obtenir les résultats requis.
• Développer et affiner les aspects de notre conception organisationnelle globale et de notre modèle opérationnel (par exemple, structures, rôles, interfaces, etc.), effectuer des contrôles de santé de l'organisation
• Favoriser la compréhension des choix de conception organisationnelle Dans un environnement hautement interfonctionnel, vous assurerez également un leadership de projet et de matrice conforme aux valeurs de Roche, aux capacités de leadership et à l'état d'esprit. Le titulaire cherchera à inspirer et à susciter la passion chez d'autres pour créer un changement durable et pour tirer parti des efforts d'un éventail varié de personnes et d'équipes. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire dans une discipline pertinente, généralement avec 5-7 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans une grande matrice Diagnostics ou entreprises d'instruments médicaux
• Expérience d'une société de conseil ou d'une stratégie de développement et de mise en œuvre dans un rôle de stratégie d'entreprise ou globale &
• Expérience éprouvée des intégrations post-fusion à l'intérieur ou en support dans/avec des entreprises de diagnostic
• La pensée structurée, les compétences éprouvées de résolution de problèmes et l'enregistrement de la réussite de projet et de gestion de programme-
• Hautement développés

jobs.title: Servicenow Integration Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Introduction

The Digital Integration Engineer takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and skillfully navigates group dynamics, fostering strong collaboration and acting as a technical mentor. In this role, you will lead small to medium (S/M) initiatives, effectively prioritize with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategic goals. You will leverage extensive experience to design, develop, and implement complex, end-to-end integrations primarily leveraging ServiceNow platform capabilities (e.g., IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP APIs) with various external enterprise systems.
The Opportunity:

• Drive ownership of ambiguous tasks and "grey zone" topics, successfully leading small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level.

• Engineer end-to-end integrations by leveraging ServiceNow capabilities including IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP APIs with external systems.

• Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing by navigating group dynamics in diversified settings and acting as a technical mentor for the team.

• Lead feasibility studies and technical evaluations to ensure all integration solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant.

• Manage stakeholders effectively by prioritizing demands and maintaining a "bigger picture" view of how components fit the overall product strategy.

• Influence platform governance through enterprise-level technical decision-making and the formulation of global integration strategies.

• Champion technical excellence by sharing knowledge at internal events such as DevOps Days, Tech Talks, and Tech Live sessions.

• Ensure documentation integrity by developing comprehensive data maps, API specifications, and ServiceNow Update Set best practices.

Who you are:

• Proven Integrator: You have extensive experience in designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow integrations and complex platform solutions.

• Educated & Experienced: You are educated to a degree level in a relevant field and bring a strong track record of driving technical initiatives.

• ServiceNow Specialist: You possess deep expertise in ServiceNow technical architecture and multiple modules, including ITSM, HRSD, and CSM.

• Technical Leader: You are a recognized mentor capable of aligning development plans with global strategies and fostering a collaborative team environment.

• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to challenge the status quo and navigate complex group dynamics to achieve engineering quality.

• Integration Expert: You have deep proficiency in IntegrationHub, MID Servers, and scripted integrations, with a focus on security and performance.

• Communication Pro: You are a skilled communicator who can simplify complex technical strategies and manage senior stakeholder expectations effectively.

#RDT2026

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportun

jobs.title: PRACTICANTE DE TALLER
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante de taller , te unirás a nuestro equipo técnico para aprender sobre el mantenimiento de equipos de diagnóstico médico de vanguardia . Esta es una oportunidad única para desarrollar tus habilidades técnicas en un entorno ágil, colaborativo y con un impacto real en la salud de los pacientes .

Oportunidad

• Apoyas las actividades del taller, adquiriendo conocimientos profundos sobre equipos de diagnóstico médico y procesos de gestión .

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .

• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .

• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .

• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .

• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .

• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .

• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente .

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .

• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

• Te caracterizas por tu proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y orientación al detalle .

• Eres una persona con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo y una fuerte ética profesional .

• Experiencia previa o conocimientos en gestión de laboratorios clínicos sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Ecosystem Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
El Medical Ecosystem Partner (MEP) está en el centro de la nueva organización en Roche, desafiando el papel que jugamos en la sociedad para pasar de ofrecer medicamentos de clase mundial a construir alianzas, co-crear, innovar y liderar la atención médica. Es directamente responsable de entregar los mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización de una manera más rápida.

El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general.

La Oportunidad

• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.

• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.

• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.

• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.

• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.

• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”

• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.

• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.

• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.

• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.

• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones

• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Asegurar la excelencia en el servicio técnico a través de la gestión de acciones proactivas, de mantenimientos y soporte especializado. Apoyar la puesta en marcha de equipos y asesorar a los clientes en el uso óptimo de la tecnología para cumplir con los estándares globales de calidad de la compañía.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.

• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.

• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.

• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio.

• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Scientist/Ingegnere - Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration, Next-Gen Sequencing Workflows, Ricerca & Early Development
titleByLocale.en: Scientist/Engineer - Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration, Next-Gen Sequencing Workflows, Research & Early Development
titleByLocale.de: Scientist/Ingenieur - Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration, Next-Gen Sequencing Workflows, Forschung & Early Development

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a key contributor in chemistry and biology. Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will help bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, performing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• You will contribute to efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems.

• You will support the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.

• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance, solving potentially complex problems by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents.

• You will conduct early-stage troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.

• You will act as a technical resource for colleagues with less experience, serving as a go-to person for explaining complex molecular biology and sequencing chemistry concepts to a team of talented engineers.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware.

A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company.

This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are (Required):

• You have a PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering (or a closely related discipline) with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Master's degree in one of the above disciplines with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.

jobs.title: Clinical Supply Chain Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
***12 Month Opportunity***

Roche is a global healthcare leader at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to improving the lives of patients through the development of groundbreaking medicines and diagnostic tools. With a heritage spanning over 125 years, we are committed to sustainable healthcare and delivering medical solutions that address some of the world’s most complex health challenges.

Our Global Clinical Supply Chain Organization is the backbone of our clinical research, ensuring that no patient goes without treatment and no clinical trial is delayed. By joining our newly expanded team in Mississauga, Canada, you will be part of a strategically significant hub that fosters agility, cross-functional collaboration, and the delivery of life-saving biopharmaceuticals to more than 100 molecules across 600+ clinical trials globally.

The Opportunity

• You will take ownership of the clinical study supply chain for Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP), ensuring effective and cost-conscious delivery across diverse disease areas.

• You will execute end-to-end demand and supply planning within ERP systems, such as SAP, to maintain robust aggregate and long-range program oversight.

• You will lead the alignment of key activities and timelines across cross-functional teams to ensure every clinical trial is supplied in strict accordance with agreed scopes.

• You will strategically forecast, plan, and initiate the procurement of comparator drugs and other study materials required for complex clinical protocols.

• You will integrate all relevant regulatory and quality requirements into the supply plan to ensure compliance with international standards and GMP environments.

• You will drive business excellence by owning and optimizing Clinical Supply Chain processes, influencing change, and ensuring global system integration.

• You will collaborate with Technical Development Teams and Clinical Operations to bridge the gap between drug development and patient-centric delivery.

Who you are

• You possess a minimum of five years of experience in Clinical Supply Chain, Planning, or Manufacturing, ideally within the Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical industry.

• You hold an academic degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Engineering, complemented by a solid understanding of clinical trial design and drug technical development.

• You are skilled at navigating ERP systems and IRT functionalities to manage complex inventory and supply chain optimization simulations.

• You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in GMP environments, with a keen eye for quality assurance, regulatory affairs, and budget planning.

• You are a confident stakeholder manager who excels at building customer focus and earning respect through impactful, needs-driven actions.

• You possess an agile mindset, showing a willingness to experiment with new ideas and lead process improvement activities in a self-directed team environment.

• You are an action-oriented professional with the ability to influence others, make decisive choices, and travel internationally to support global operations.

*** Relocation not available for this position***
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you will ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. This role plays a crucial part in coordinating and completing timely, high-quality digital campaigns while maintaining our delivery standards. You'll collaborate closely with affiliate business teams, brand teams, third-party vendors, campaign coordinators, and global campaign coordinators to bring digital initiatives to life.

The Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you will:

• Manage Campaign Delivery : Oversee the end-to-end digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, from initiation through final implementation, ensuring all projects meet established quality and timeline standards.

• Coordinate Stakeholder Feedback : Incorporate insights and feedback from diverse stakeholders, revising digital campaign content requests to align with expectations and project objectives.

• Drive Process Improvement : Coach stakeholders on new processes and requirements that enhance efficiency and optimize our ways of working in digital campaign delivery.

• Support Campaign Leadership : Collaborate with Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators on client communications, change management initiatives, and service offering updates.

• Establish Best Practices : Adopt and maintain existing processes, establish governance principles, and ensure proper documentation and implementation across your area of responsibility—contributing to our Center of Excellence.

Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong passion for project coordination and a solid understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your exceptional organizational and communication skills allow you to juggle multiple projects with ease, consistently delivering high-quality results on time. You thrive in collaborative environments, building strong relationships with diverse stakeholders and gracefully adapting to feedback to exceed expectations.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

• Minimum 1+ years of proven project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or content creation

• Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management

• Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities with a demonstrated track record of managing multiple simultaneous projects

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups

• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders

• Strong time management skills to prioritize competing priorities

• Openness to learning new project management tools and software

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments

Ready to make an impact? If you're excited about driving digital campaign success and leading seamless project delivery, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join Roche's Global Digital Hub and help shape the future of our digital campaigns.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Ou

You'll collaborate closely with affiliate business teams, brand teams, third-party vendors, campaign coordinators, and global campaign coordinators to bring digital initiatives to life. The Opportunity In this pivotal role, you will:
• Manage Campaign Delivery : Oversee the end-to-end digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, from initiation through final implementation, ensuring all projects meet established quality and timeline standards.
• Coordinate Stakeholder Feedback : Incorporate insights and feedback from diverse stakeholders, revising digital campaign content requests to align with expectations and project objectives.
• Drive Process Improvement : Coach stakeholders on new processes and requirements that enhance efficiency and optimize our ways of working in digital campaign delivery.
• Support Campaign Leadership : Collaborate with Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators on client communications, change management initiatives, and service offering updates.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
• Minimum 1+ years of proven project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or content creation
• Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management
• Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities with a demonstrated track record of managing multiple simultaneous projects
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups
• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders
• Strong time management skills to prioritize competing priorities
• Openness to learning new project management tools and software
• Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments Ready to make an impact? If you're excited about driving digital campaign success and leading seamless project delivery, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join Roche's Global Digital Hub and help shape the future of our digital campaigns. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Quote Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape .

Description of the area
The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM.

The Opportunity:

• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .

• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .

• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .

• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .

• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .

• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .

• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .

• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards .

Who you are:

• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .

• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .

• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .

• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .

• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Process Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement. Process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Prepare and follow up unidentified open items in clearing account when execute daily/monthly bank reconciliation.

• Liaise with the stakeholder for preparation and transaction posting of Inter-company non trade related debit and credit notes. Preparation of monthly reconciliation, highlight and rectify anomalies encountered. Generate statement of accounts to the customers. Track and resolve disputes and route to local affiliates as and when required

• Attend to all matters requested for accounts receivable when required. Initiate the dunning process and generate reminders for overdue accounts. Prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for stakeholder further actions. Execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities for countries assigned. Manage Cash pool account reconciliation

• Prepare preliminary and final Inter-company Account Receivable balances to reconcile against counterparty balances. Ensure timely and accurate deal settlement and posting of treasury related transactions including Inter-company foreign exchange, loan, accrual and actual interest, bank charges and etc.Creation and maintenance of the customer master data records in system. Credit management – Perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit worthless checks and make credit limit recommendation.

• Collection management – Ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if necessary as per company’s debt collection procedure.. Demonstrated good customer service skills while initiating outbound calls and received inbound calls with customer. Handling of AR bad debt allowance and write off management. First point of contact for operational support and issue solving Liaise with customer for balance confirmation and monitoring of daily sales order status.

Who you are

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines.

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required. Participate in internal and external compliance audit queries

• Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations : Work collaboratively with Country Chief Accountant and stakeholders. Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively to identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

​

Thank you for your application. Please take note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 millio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you will ensure that Roche’s people practices work seamlessly for the business by managing the end-to-end execution of payroll, tax, and social insurance. You will play a vital role in providing advisory support and maintaining data integrity while keeping customer-focused principles at the heart of every interaction.

• Execute end-to-end payroll activities , including data maintenance for tax, social insurance, and local/global benefits administration with high accuracy.

• Provide expert customer service by resolving complex inquiries, managing requests, and troubleshooting issues related to pay, time, and benefits.

• Oversee time and absence management , collaborating with managers to ensure compliance with local policies and accuracy in employee records.

• Manage technical data flows , monitoring Workday integrations and processing mass upload files to ensure vendor accuracy and timely processing.

• Ensure regulatory compliance across various countries and jurisdictions, keeping up-to-date with evolving legal requirements and internal documentation.

• Foster key stakeholder relationships , partnering proactively with P&C Chapters and providing guidance to first-level support teams to enhance service delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement by participating in global projects and implementing initiatives to optimize performance and service quality.

Who You Are
You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for customer centricity. You thrive in fast-paced, multicultural environments and take full accountability for delivering consistent, high-quality results across borders.

• Professional Experience: You bring 1–3 years of experience in payroll services and benefits administration , ideally within a Shared Service Center environment.

• Language Skills: You are fluent in German and English

• Technical Proficiency: You have advanced Excel skills (v-lookup, pivot tables) and a solid understanding of the payroll cycle and HR processes.

• Analytical Ability: You have an excellent eye for detail and can navigate complex data structures to resolve errors and ensure accuracy.

• Matrix Collaboration: You have a proven track record of delivering results in a matrix organization and are comfortable working independently with competing priorities.

• Solution Orientation: You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, utilizing active listening and critical thinking to drive process improvements.

• Growth Mindset: You are adaptable to change, enjoy learning new tools (such as Workday or ServiceNow), and thrive in ambiguous situations.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de la paie, du temps et des avantages sociaux, vous vous assurerez que les gens de Roche travaillent de façon transparente pour l'entreprise en gérant l'exécution de bout en bout de la paie, de l'impôt et de l'assurance sociale. Vous jouerez un rôle vital en fournissant un soutien consultatif et en maintenant l'intégrité des données tout en maintenant les principes axés sur le client au cœur de chaque interaction.
• Exécuter de bout en bout des activités de paie, y compris la maintenance des données pour l'impôt, l'assurance sociale, et l'administration des prestations locales/mondiales avec une grande précision.
• Fournir un service à la clientèle expert en résolvant les demandes complexes, en gérant les demandes et en dépannant les problèmes liés à la rémunération, au temps et aux avantages.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Reporting to Technical Services Lead

The Opportunity:

• Maintaining a positive, empathetic and professional attitude toward customers at all times.

• Responding promptly to customer inquiries and complaints

• Communicating with customers through various channels.

• Acknowledging and resolving customer complaints.

• Understand technical information/specification and principles of product to be able to handle customer inquiries and complaints.

• Monitor reagent and consumable inventory to ensure continuous running of analyzers.

• Keeping records of customer interactions, visits, transactions, comments, inquiries and complaints.

• Communicating and coordinating with other departments to provide solutions and maintain maximum customer engagement and loyalty.

• Analyze menu gaps and propose solutions to customers.

• Ensure customer satisfaction and provide professional customer support.

• Perform operator and applications training for customers and internal staffs

• Develop, prepare and maintain training materials.

• Liaise and align with GCS and CIR to manage technical issues and training.

Who you are

• You should hold a Bachelor or master Degree in Health/Science disciplines

• Multi-national companies experience in the similar capacity level

• Preferably, at least 2 years’ experience in Clinical Laboratory.

• Preferable with teaching experience

• Marketing and business development experience will be a plus

• In-depth product knowledge

• Use of Personal Computer

• Effective Communication skill

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Technical Services Project Manager and Capo Team
titleByLocale.en: Technical Services Project Manager and Team Lead
titleByLocale.de: Technical Services Project Manager and Teamleiter
titleByLocale.fr: Technical Services Project Manager and Chef d'équipe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Professional Technical Services team (Field Service Engineering) in Hungary is a dedicated group of experts committed to delivering high-quality engineering and technical solutions in the field of in vitro diagnostics (IVD) . As part of Roche Diagnostics, the team focuses on creating long-lasting partnerships with healthcare providers by ensuring our diagnostic systems are installed and maintained to the highest standards, ultimately supporting reliable patient results across the country.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Services Project Manager and Team Lead, you will play a dual role that balances high-level project execution with people leadership. You will be responsible for ensuring compliant, professional services for our customers while developing a high-performing team of Field Service Engineers.

In this role, you will split your focus between driving complex technical implementations (60-70%) and mentoring your team (30-40%). You will be the bridge between technical excellence and strategic growth, ensuring our laboratory solutions are delivered seamlessly while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

As a Technical Project Manager (60-70%):

• You will manage the full project lifecycle for laboratory implementations, from initial tender to handover.

• You will conduct on-site technical assessments, develop and execute detailed project plans to meet stakeholder expectations, identify and mitigate risks.

• You will oversee the installation of systems, testing, and reagent applications, ensuring all deliverables are met on time and within scope.

As a Team Lead (30-40%):

• You will lead, coach, and develop a customer-focused, future-ready and high-performing Field Service Engineering team, attract and retain top talent, and foster a continuous learning culture.

• You will manage resource planning and workload, oversee the business portfolio (SWA, NPC, M&TD), monitor team KPIs and service data to ensure high-quality technical support for Hungarian customers.

Who you are

• Experienced Leader: You have a proven track record in leading and developing teams, with the ability to motivate others and facilitate professional growth.

• Technical Expert: You hold a BSc/MSc in Engineering (e.g. Electrical, Mechatronical, Mechanical, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, etc) and have 3-5 years of experience in laboratory technology or medical devices.

• Project Specialist: You are proficient in project management methodologies and tools, with a focus on delivering outcomes in complex, changing environments.

• Strategic Thinker: You possess a growth mindset and the ability to think at an enterprise level, identifying business development opportunities within the healthcare system.

• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in Hungarian and proficient in English, with the interpersonal intelligence needed to build sustainable relationships with diverse stakeholders.

• Mobile and Flexible: You are willing to work in a field-based environment across Hungary to support our customers where they need us most.

Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

• You will oversee the installation of systems, testing, and reagent applications, ensuring all deliverables are met on time and within scope. As a Team Lead (30-40%):

• Experienced Leader: You have a proven track record in leading and developing teams, with the ability to motivate others and facilitate professional growth.
• Technical Expert: You hold a BSc/MSc in Engineering (e.g. Electrical, Mechatronical, Mechanical, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, etc) and have 3-5 years of experience in laboratory technology or medical devices.
• Project Specialist: You are proficient in project management methodologies and tools, with a focus on delivering outcomes in complex, changing environments.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess a growth mindset and the ability to think at an enterprise level, identifying business development opportunities within the healthcare system.
• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in Hungarian and proficient in English, with the interpersonal intelligence needed to build sustainable relationships with diverse stakeholders.
• Mobile and Flexible: You are willing to work in a field-based environment across Hungary to support our customers where they need us most. Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.
