jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche können Sie so sein, wie Sie sind – mit all den einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Entfaltung, offene Dialoge und aufrichtige Beziehungen. Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position:

• Die Abstimmung des Projektportfolios mit den Kapazitäten und Fähigkeiten von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ist die Kernaufgabe

• Als Projekt-Liaison sind Sie die primäre Kontaktperson für Projekte aus Forschung und Entwicklung (REDs), Einlizensierungen sowie für lokale und globale Planungsrollen und -gremien. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern wie Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenik, Regulatory und Quality gewährleisten Sie, dass die jeweiligen Projektziele abgestimmt sind.

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung für strategische Projektplanung & Machbarkeit und führen somit die langfristige strategische Planung aus, insbesondere eine 5-Jahres-Ausblicks für Betriebsanlagen und Personal, sowie Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Kapazitätsbewertungen.

• In der Rolle des Ressourcenkoordinators stimmen Sie Ressourcen in Kollaboration mit den Sektionen innerhalb von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ab und überwachen die Planung innerhalb der Abteilung.

• Sie fungieren als Fachexperte und Berater für Herstellungsprozesse und/oder -anlagen und stellen Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme sowie strategischer Fragestellungen bereit. Sie leiten komplexe Untersuchungen, identifizieren Ursachen und implementieren wirksame Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen.

• Als Mentor und Coach unterstützen Sie unsere Mitarbeiter bei deren kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer beruflichen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.

• Treten Sie als treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung auf , indem Sie innovative Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung und Produktivitätssteigerung identifizieren, Lean-Prinzipien und digitale Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Abläufe nutzen und implementieren.

• Fungieren Sie als Matrix-Lead , welcher die strategische Planung und Zielsetzung der Abteilung gestaltet und der einen starken Teamgeist und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Dringlichkeit sowie der hohen Motivation fördert, um diese Ziele zu erreichen.

Wer Sie sind:

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Chemie oder Chemieingenieurwesen und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozesschemie für synthetische Moleküle.

• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deuts

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche puoi essere quello che sei, con tutte le qualità uniche che porti con te. La nostra cultura promuove lo sviluppo personale, il dialogo aperto e le relazioni sincere. Qui sarai apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, in modo che tu possa crescere personalmente e professionalmente. Vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che ogni persona abbia accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a far parte di DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione:
• Allineare il portafoglio di progetti con le capacità e le capacità di DS Clinical & Commercial Supply è il compito principale
• In qualità di collegamento di progetto, sei la persona di contatto principale per i progetti di ricerca e sviluppo (RED), per le licenze nonché per i ruoli e i comitati di pianificazione locale e globale. In collaborazione con stakeholder interni ed esterni come lo sviluppo tecnico della molecola sintetica, la galenica, la regolamentazione e la qualità, ti assicuri che i rispettivi obiettivi del progetto siano coordinati.
• Prenderai la guida della pianificazione strategica e della fattibilità del progetto e quindi effettuerai una pianificazione strategica a lungo termine, in particolare una prospettiva quinquennale per le strutture operative e il personale, oltre a svolgere studi di fattibilità e valutazioni di capacità.
• Nel ruolo di Coordinatore delle risorse, coordinerai le risorse in collaborazione con le sezioni di DS Clinical & Commercial Supply e supervisionerai la pianificazione all'interno del dipartimento.
• Agirai come esperto in materia e consulente per processi e/o attrezzature di produzione, fornendo la tua esperienza per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi e questioni strategiche. Condurrai indagini complesse, identificherai le cause profonde e implementerai misure correttive e preventive efficaci.
• In qualità di mentore e coach, sostieni i nostri dipendenti nello sviluppo continuo delle loro capacità e conoscenze professionali.
• Agire come forza trainante per il miglioramento continuo identificando soluzioni innovative per ottimizzare i processi e aumentare la produttività, sfruttando e implementando principi snelli e soluzioni digitali per migliorare le operazioni.
• Agire come una matrice guida che modella la pianificazione strategica del dipartimento e la definizione degli obiettivi e promuove un forte spirito di squadra e una cultura di collaborazione, urgenza e alta motivazione per raggiungere questi obiettivi. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in chimica o ingegneria chimica e almeno 10 anni di esperienza nella chimica di processo per molecole di sintesi.
• Hai una conoscenza approfondita della sintesi chimica, delle tecnologie dei processi chimici e della produzione in un ambiente cGMP.
• In qualità di esperto tecnico, capisci come motivare i team in un'organizzazione a matrice e creare una forte coesione per avere successo insieme.
• I tuoi punti di forza risiedono nella collaborazione: mantieni ottimi rapporti con le parti interessate e gestisci abilmente trattative e progetti interfunzionali.
• Sei un motore attivo del cambiamento, creando una cultura flessibile e aperta a nuove opportunità.
• Sei una forza trainante per il miglioramento continuo e affronti nuove sfide con passione.
• Comunichi fluentemente in tedesco
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche you can be who you are – with all the unique qualities you bring with you. Our culture promotes personal development, open dialogue and sincere relationships. Here you will be valued, accepted and respected for who you are, so that you can develop personally and professionally. We want to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure that every person has access to healthcare today and for future generations. Become part of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, where every voice counts. The position:
• Aligning the project portfolio with the capacities and capabilities of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply is the core task
• As a project liaison, you are the primary contact person for research and development projects (REDs), in-licensing as well as for local and global planning roles and committees. In collaboration with internal and external stakeholders such as Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenics, Regulatory and Quality, you ensure that the respective project goals are coordinated.
• You will take the lead on strategic project planning & feasibility and therefore carry out long-term strategic planning, in particular a 5-year outlook for operational facilities and personnel, as well as carrying out feasibility studies and capacity assessments.
• In the role of Resource Coordinator, you will coordinate resources in collaboration with the sections within DS Clinical & Commercial Supply and oversee planning within the department.
• You will act as a subject matter expert and consultant for manufacturing processes and/or equipment, providing your expertise to solve complex technical problems and strategic issues. You will lead complex investigations, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective and preventative measures.
• As a mentor and coach, you support our employees in the continuous development of their professional skills and knowledge.
• Act as a driving force for continuous improvement by identifying innovative solutions to optimize processes and increase productivity, leveraging and implementing lean principles and digital solutions to improve operations.
• Act as a matrix lead that shapes the department's strategic planning and goal setting and promotes a strong team spirit and culture of collaboration, urgency and high motivation to achieve these goals. Who you are:
• You have a degree in chemistry or chemical engineering and at least 10 years of experience in process chemistry for synthetic molecules.
• You have in-depth knowledge of chemical synthesis, chemical process technologies and production in a cGMP environment.
• As a technical expert, you understand how to motivate teams in a matrix organization and create strong cohesion in order to be successful together.
• Your strengths lie in collaboration: You maintain excellent relationships with stakeholders and skillfully navigate negotiations and cross-functional projects.
• You are an active driver of change, creating a flexible and open culture for new opportunities.
• You are a driving force for continuous improvement and tackle new challenges with passion.
• You communicate fluently in German

Here you are valued, accepted and respected for the person you are, so that you can develop yourself personally and professionally. • They are the link between our operational processes and the global corporate standards. Their focus is on guaranteeing compliance with cGMP regulations, SHE guidelines and Roche principles, while also making the processes robust and efficient.

• As a mentor and coach, our employees support you in their continuous development of their professional skills and knowledge.
• Be a driving force for continuous improvement by identifying innovative solutions for process optimization and productivity enhancement, using lean principles and implementing digital solutions to improve processes.

• They have a degree in chemistry or chemical engineering and at least 10 years of experience in process chemistry for synthetic molecules.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. That’s what drives us.

In People & Culture our vision is to bring our Roche purpose to life by unlocking the greatness in all our people and organisation. We build trust by protecting and creating value through our partnership with customers to deliver not just services, but impactful experiences. We are a catalyst for enabling high performance while nurturing a sense of belonging and an inclusive culture where we can all thrive as we discover the best ideas and develop truly innovative solutions for patients and Roche’s future success.

As the Consulting Practice Lead & Organisation Development Community Lead, you will shape the strategic vision for how we transform our organization to realise Roche’s 10-Year Ambitions. Leading the Global Consulting Practice, you and your team partner with senior leadership teams to improve organizational performance and health, utilizing deep expertise in transformation, organizational design, leadership team effectiveness and culture shaping. As a member of the P&OG Chapter Enabling Team, you will create and ensure a chapter vision, strategy, and priorities that provides value and business impact.

Your Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the strategic direction for our consulting practice:

• Lead the Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) professionals to support leaders with organizational design, team effectiveness, cultural shaping and transformation.

• Collaborate with business leaders to co-create strategies that support large-scale enterprise transformation.

• Build consulting capabilities across the organization, ensuring our partners have the tools and skills to drive change.

• Foster a strong network of experts , ensuring constant knowledge transfer and the exchange of best practices globally.

• Drive harmonization of processes and define high-quality standards and KPIs for the practice.

• Catalyze action by forming agile teams to deliver on high-priority initiatives.

• Coach and develop chapter members, ensuring a diverse and ready pipeline of talent.

Who You Are

You are a strategic thinker who thrives in complex, multicultural environments and is passionate about inclusive leadership. You bring a growth mindset and the following qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in Organizational Development, Leadership Development, or a related field.

• 5+ years in leadership roles , specifically leading global teams or communities of experts.

• Expertise in organizational design and driving large-scale change transformations.

• Proven ability to consult on organizational performance, leadership development, team dynamics and adult learning.

• Agile mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence stakeholders across a matrixed environment.

This position is open as a result of an external promotion, reflecting our commitment to developing leaders who are recognized both within and beyond our organization.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Vous apportez un état d'esprit de croissance et les qualifications suivantes:
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en développement organisationnel, en leadership ou dans un domaine connexe.
• 5 ans et plus dans les rôles de leadership, en particulier les équipes mondiales ou les communautés d'experts.
• Expertise en conception organisationnelle et en transformation à grande échelle du changement.
• Capacité éprouvée de consulter sur la performance organisationnelle, le développement du leadership, la dynamique d'équipe et l'apprentissage des adultes.

Cette position est ouverte à la suite d'une promotion externe, reflétant notre engagement à développer des leaders reconnus au sein et au-delà de notre organisation. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? jobs.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Principal DevOps Engineer (DevOps Lead)

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Description
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity
The Principal DevOps​ ​Engineer​ (DevOps Lead) ​is a key member in engineering and DevOps groups and will apply knowledge of design principles, practices in the implementation of complex, enterprise-scale software systems. The Principal engineer is a hands-on leader of the DevOps function. General responsibilities include design concept generation, participating in reviews for components or features, development, and testing of the core software stack, and reliability testing.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software​ ​Development​: This is a software development position to write high quality software that will perform at scale, be supportable, and be extensible

• Process​ ​&​ ​Operations: Ensure the software stack integrates with our existing CI pipeline and contribute to continuous improvement; independently design, plan and deliver high-quality software

• Leadership​: Ensure a culture that values technical excellence together with support and compassion for individuals

• Evangelism: As a key evangelist, you will work to evangelize a healthy DevSecOps software development practice within the Roche Engineering Community

Who You Are:

• BS in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or related field.

• 10+ years of hands-on experience in public cloud AWS, Google, or Azure (AWS Preferred) of which at the minimum 5 years of experience in the software industry.

• Scripting experience is required and highly desirable, using shell, python, ruby, or similar languages.

• Experience leading DevOps teams and in building and maturing CI/CD pipelines

• Expertise in overall areas in DevSecOps including CI/CD with build & release, Internal tooling, and production operations.

• Build and operation tools that monitor backend production, Make sure backend services scale economically, Develop tooling framework, Help the dev team resolve production issues

• Hands-on System Administration experience with Unix based systems including experience with system configuration and networking (DNS, DHCP, rout tables and routing).

• Experience automating using infrastructure as code: AWS Cloudformation, Terraform, etc.

• Hands-on automation development using chef or ansible desired

• Experience deploying or managing large scale distributed Unix environments Partake in an on-call rotation alongside the engineers who build our production backends, Comfortable with large scale production systems and technologies, including load balancing, monitoring, distributed systems, and/or configuration management.

• Experience in contemporary platforms extended from cloud such as docker containers, Mesos, and/or Ku

jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte de données/d'information - Plateformes de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . The Information Architect will do this by identifying, classifying, standardizing information objects and creating information flows, working closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners, and Business Analysts .

The Opportunity:

• Design and maintain the comprehensive information landscape and streamline both incoming and outgoing information flows for MRHub .

• Establish and enforce critical standards and governance for information objects in close partnership with the Data Engineering Lead .

• Drive quality assurance by performing periodic reviews on the compliance and integrity of all information objects and architectural flows .

• Provide strategic leadership on information modeling to project and operational teams, ensuring alignment with global informatics goals .

• Identify and organize complex information requirements and objects for MRHub to ensure seamless traceability and easy access .

• Support remediation of sub-optimal data flows within business processes to enhance overall system efficiency and performance .

• Ensure architectural accuracy by maintaining up-to-date automated flows in Archimedes and creating conceptual designs that fit IT/Business strategies .

• Collaborate with Agile teams and Solution Architects to document governance, compliance, and master data standards within solution architecture .

Who you are:

• Extensive experience leading complex data science and information architecture projects from end-to-end with a drive for significant business impact .
Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions and data frameworks .

• Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks, information lifecycles, and governance best practices .

• Deep technical proficiency in programming languages such as Python and R, coupled with the ability to architect and maintain complex version control workflows using Git.

• Comprehensive expertise in cloud-native database management and serverless architectures, specifically within the AWS ecosystem including Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, and API Gateway.

• Strong background in data infrastructure and lifecycle management , with a proven ability to deploy, scale, and optimize high-performance backend services.

• Educated professional with a relevan

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme di dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il ruolo di un Architetto Informativo è quello di comprendere i processi aziendali e gli oggetti informativi e lavorare con i membri del team informatico e aziendale per identificare e progettare flussi informativi e standard informativi che soddisfano le esigenze aziendali. L'Architetto dell'Informazione lavora verso la coerenza all'interno e all'interno di gruppi e guida per il riutilizzo e la semplicità di oggetti informativi. L'Architetto dell'Informazione lo farà identificando, classificando, standardizzando gli oggetti di informazione e creando flussi di informazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli Stakeholder di Business, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners e Business Analysts . L'opportunità:
• Progettare e mantenere il panorama informativo completo e semplificare i flussi di informazioni in entrata e in uscita per MRHub .
• Stabilire e far rispettare gli standard critici e la governance per gli oggetti informativi in stretta collaborazione con Data Engineering Lead .
• Assicurazione della qualità di guida eseguendo revisioni periodiche sulla conformità e l'integrità di tutti gli oggetti informativi e flussi architettonici.
• Fornire leadership strategica sulla modellazione delle informazioni ai team di progetto e operativi, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi informatici globali.
• Identificare e organizzare complessi requisiti di informazione e oggetti per MRHub per garantire una tracciabilità senza soluzione di continuità e un facile accesso.
• Rimediazione del supporto dei flussi di dati sub-ottimi all'interno dei processi aziendali per migliorare l'efficienza e le prestazioni del sistema complessivo.
• Assicurare l'accuratezza architettonica mantenendo flussi automatizzati aggiornati in Archimedes e creando progetti concettuali che si adattano alle strategie IT/Business .
• Collaborare con i team Agile e Solution Architects per documentare la governance, la conformità e gli standard di dati master nell'architettura delle soluzioni . Chi sei:
• Esperienza estesa che conduce complessi progetti di data science e architettura dell'informazione da end-to-end con un'unità per un impatto commerciale significativo. Provato record di lavoro a stretto contatto con la leadership senior per informare e influenzare le decisioni strategiche di business di alto livello e i quadri di dati.
• Competenze dimostrate nella progettazione e nell'attuazione di quadri di scienza dei dati a livello aziendale, cicli di vita dell'informazione e migliori pratiche di governance.
• Profonda competenza tecnica nei linguaggi di programmazione come Python e R, unitamente alla capacità di architetto e mantenere flussi di lavoro complessi di controllo delle versioni utilizzando Git.
• Comprehensive competenze nella gestione di database cloud-native e architetture serverless, specificamente all'interno dell'ecosistema AWS tra cui Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda e API Gateway.
• Forte background nell'infrastruttura dei dati e nella gestione del ciclo di vita, con una comprovata capacità di implementare, scalare e ottimizzare i servizi di backend ad alte prestazioni.
• Professionista istruito con un relevan

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Data/Information Architect - Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation den Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Community von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die dazu beitragen, die digitale Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen zu gestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu treiben und das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft, bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der digital eine Kernkraft für alle Roche ist, die intelligentere Möglichkeiten der Arbeit ermöglicht, das menschliche Potenzial zu entsperren und Durchbrüche zu treiben, die wirklich für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wichtig sind. Die Rolle eines Informationsarchitekten ist es, Geschäftsprozesse und Informationsobjekte zu verstehen und mit Mitgliedern des Informatik- und Geschäftsteams zu arbeiten, um Informationsflüsse und Informationsstandards zu identifizieren und zu entwerfen, die den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen. Der Informationsarchitekt arbeitet auf Konsistenz innerhalb und über Gruppen und Laufwerke zur Wiederverwendung und Einfachheit von Informationsobjekten. Der Informationsarchitekt wird dies tun, indem er Informationsobjekte identifiziert, klassifiziert, standardisiert und Informationsflüsse erstellt, eng mit Business Stakeholdern, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners und Business Analysts zusammenarbeitet. Die Gelegenheit:
• Gestalten und pflegen Sie die umfassende Informationslandschaft und optimieren Sie sowohl eingehende als auch ausgehende Informationsflüsse für MRHub .
• Erstellen und Durchsetzung kritischer Standards und Governance für Informationsobjekte in enger Partnerschaft mit dem Data Engineering Lead .
• Führen Sie die Qualitätssicherung durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen über die Einhaltung und Integrität aller Informationsobjekte und architektonischen Strömungen aus.
• Strategische Führung zur Informationsmodellierung für Projekt- und Betriebsteams, die die Ausrichtung auf globale Informationsziele gewährleistet.
• Erkennen und organisieren Sie komplexe Informationsanforderungen und Objekte für MRHub, um eine nahtlose Rückverfolgbarkeit und einfachen Zugriff zu gewährleisten.
• Unterstützung der Abhilfe von Teil-optimalen Datenflüssen innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, um die Gesamtsystemeffizienz und -leistung zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie die architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Ströme in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die IT/Business-Strategien passen.
• Mit Agile Teams und Solution Architects zusammenarbeiten, um Governance-, Compliance- und Masterdatenstandards in der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer du bist:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung führende komplexe Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Ende bis Ende mit einem Antrieb für signifikante geschäftliche Auswirkungen . Bewährte Erfolgsbilanzen der engen Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Führungskräften, um strategische Entscheidungen und Datenrahmen auf hoher Ebene zu informieren und zu beeinflussen.
• Gezeigtes Know-how bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von unternehmensweiten Data Science-Frameworks, Informationslebenszyklen und Governance-Best Practices .
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und R, verbunden mit der Fähigkeit, Architekt und komplexe Versionskontrolle Workflows mit Git.
• Umfassende Expertise in der Cloud-native Datenbankverwaltung und serverlosen Architekturen, insbesondere im AWS-Ökosystem wie Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda und API Gateway.
• Starker Hintergrund in der Dateninfrastruktur und dem Lifecycle Management, mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, hochleistungsfähige Backend-Dienste zu implementieren, zu skalieren und zu optimieren.
• Ausgebildeter Profi mit einem Relevan
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte de données/d'information - Plateformes de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Le rôle d'un architecte de l'information est de comprendre les processus opérationnels et les objets d'information et de travailler avec les membres de l'équipe informatique et opérationnelle pour identifier et concevoir les flux d'information et les normes d'information qui répondent aux besoins opérationnels . L'Architecte de l'information travaille à la cohérence au sein et entre les groupes et les moteurs pour la réutilisation et la simplicité des objets d'information. Pour ce faire, l'architecte de l'information identifiera, classifiera, normalisera les objets d'information et créera des flux d'information, travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, les architectes de solutions, les architectes de logiciels, les partenaires d'affaires en TI et les analystes d'affaires. La possibilité :
• Concevoir et maintenir le paysage global de l'information et rationaliser les flux d'information entrants et sortants pour MRHub.
• Établir et appliquer des normes et une gouvernance critiques pour les objets d'information en partenariat étroit avec le responsable de l'ingénierie des données.
• Diriger l'assurance qualité en effectuant des examens périodiques sur la conformité et l'intégrité de tous les objets d'information et flux architecturaux .
• Assurer un leadership stratégique en matière de modélisation de l'information aux équipes chargées des projets et des opérations, en assurant l'alignement sur les objectifs informatiques mondiaux.
• Identifier et organiser des besoins d'information et des objets complexes pour MRHub pour assurer une traçabilité transparente et un accès facile.
• Appuyer la remise en état des flux de données sous-optimaux au sein des processus opérationnels pour améliorer l' efficacité et la performance globales du système .
• Assurer la précision architecturale en maintenant des flux automatisés à jour dans les Archimèdes et en créant des conceptions adaptées aux stratégies IT/Business.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Agiles et les architectes de solutions pour documenter la gouvernance, la conformité et les normes de gestion des données dans l'architecture de la solution. Qui vous êtes :
• Une vaste expérience a conduit des projets complexes de science des données et d' architecture de l' information de bout en bout avec un élan pour un impact commercial significatif . Expérience prouvée de la collaboration étroite avec les cadres supérieurs pour éclairer et influencer les décisions stratégiques et les cadres de données de haut niveau .
• Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la mise en oeuvre de cadres informatiques à l'échelle de l'entreprise, de cycles de vie de l'information et de pratiques exemplaires en matière de gouvernance.
• Compétence technique approfondie dans les langages de programmation tels que Python et R, associée à la capacité d'architecte et de maintenir des flux de travail complexes de contrôle des versions à l'aide de Git.
• Expertise complète dans la gestion des bases de données cloud-native et les architectures sans serveur, en particulier dans l'écosystème AWS, y compris Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda et API Gateway.
• Forte expérience dans l'infrastructure de données et la gestion du cycle de vie, avec une capacité éprouvée de déployer, d'étendre et d'optimiser les services de backend haute performance.
• Professionnel formé avec un relevan

jobs.title: Prozessexperte für Rezepterstellung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Das Arbeitsumfeld

Die Einheit Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) stellt die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline sowie Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen pharmazeutischen Produktion für unsere Patienten sicher.
Die Abteilung MSAT Process Automation bietet für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte im GMP-Bereich den technischen Support, Engineering, Daten und Dokumente. Dabei sind produktionslinienbezogene Gruppen für die Konfiguration und den Support der Produktions-Automationssysteme verantwortlich; technische Chapter stellen die standardisierte Nutzung der Systeme sicher und tragen zu effizienten Produktionsprozesstransfers bei.

Kernthemen, mit denen wir uns in MSAT Process Automation befassen:

• Umsetzung von Herstellvorgaben in Checkpläne, Batch- und MES-Rezepte

• End-to-End Direct Support und Configuration Management für Automationssysteme der Produktion

• Herstellprozessbezogene Datenbereitstellung & Analyse

• Anwendertraining

• Anforderungsmanagement für alle Produktions-Automationssysteme und Datenreports

• PLS (PCS7) Umsetzung und Support

• Application Administration für prozessnahe Automation

• Business Process Oversight, Data Oversight und Configuration Oversight für alle automatisierten Herstellprozesse von Transfer, Make, Assess und Release

Dein zukünftiges Team

Wir sind ein gut eingespieltes, selbstständig agierendes Team und fühlen uns überwiegend im Manufacturing Produktionsumfeld als Rezeptersteller und 1st Level Support für die Produktionssysteme zu Hause. In diesem agilen Umfeld ist es für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit, kunden- und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten und dabei viele Schnittstellen zu bedienen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Rezepterstellung für pharmazeutische Entwicklungs- und Marktprodukte: Planung und Umsetzung von beschriebenen Herstellprozessen in automatisierte Produktionsabläufe auf MES- und Batchebene

• Konfiguration von Prozess- und Stammdaten

• 1st Level Support und Fehleranalyse (24/7) für automatisierte Produktionssysteme

• Analyse und Bereitstellung von Prozessdaten

• Standardisierung von Prozessen, Rezepten, PLS-Phasen und Konfigurationen

• Anforderungensmanagement für Produktionssysteme

• GMP-gerechte Dokumentation sämtlicher Arbeitsaktivitäten

Dein Profil passt gut zu uns, wenn

• Du Dein naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen hast oder alternativ tiefgreifende Erfahrung aus der pharmazeutischen Produktion vorweisen kannst,

• Du über fundierte verfahrenstechnische oder biotechnologische Kenntnisse verfügst und es Dir Spaß macht, diese in die Sprache der Prozessautomation zu übersetzen,

• Du GMP-Dokumentation als wichtig empfindest und bereit bist, Deine Expertise jederzeit in der sicheren Bedienung des Sematic Batch Client sowie in Routine-GMP-Prozessen (z.B. Abweichungen und Changes) sowie in Audits und Inspektionen einzubringen,

• Du praktische Erfahrung im GMP-Bereich von Labor oder Produktion mitbringst,

• Du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement gesammelt hast,

• You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken and you are able to influence at all levels,

• Du idealerweise eine Affinität zu Lean Methoden besitzt,

• Du gerne Dein Wissen erweiterst (z.B. durch externe Seminar- und Kongressbesuche) und dieses mit Deinen Kollegen und den Anwendern in den Produktionsbetrieben teilst,

• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, über Durchsetzungsvermöge

jobs.title: Calibration Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Im Bereich Engineering & SHE in Kaiseraugst stehen dir zahlreiche Möglichkeiten offen, das Tätigkeitsgebiet im Bereich der pharmazeutischen Herstellung von festen und flüssigen Arzneiformen kennenzulernen. Engineering & SHE ist der zentrale Bereich für die Kalibrierung unserer GMP-Produktionssysteme (z.B. Temperatur, Druck, Masse) und unterstützt den Standort Kaiseraugst bei der Einhaltung der GMP-Produktionsvorgaben.

Die Möglichkeit:
Als Calibration Specialist umfasst dein Tätigkeitsgebiet folgende Aufgaben:

• Selbstorganisierte Koordination von Kalibrierungen - Überwachung, Dokumentation und fristgerechte Durchführung von Kalibrierungen

• Aufrechterhaltung des qualifizierten Anlagenstatus der betreuten Messmittel

• Dokumentenmanagement – Erstellung, Review und Update von Dokumenten

• GMP-gerechte Durchführung und Dokumentation deiner Aufgaben

• Entwicklung von Vorschlägen und Koordinierung der Umsetzung von Massnahmen zur Verbesserung der Qualität, Sicherheit, Effizienz der Kalibrierprozesse sowie der Kostenreduktion

• Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Pikett-Dienst

Wer Du Bist:
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Fachkenntnisse und mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Kalibrierung. Idealerweise im Bereich Kalibrierung von pharmazeutischen, chemischen oder biotechnologischen Anlagen

• Technische Ausbildung im relevanten Tätigkeitsfeld: z.B. EMSR-Techniker oder Ingenieur: Richtung Bio-/Verfahrenstechnik, Steuer-& Regeltechnik

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse diverser Messinstrumente und Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld; wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen mit Umgang und Kalibrierung von Waagen

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von technischen GMP-Anforderungen der Zulassungsbehörden (RHI, FDA, EMA etc.)

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse (SAP, Computerized Calibration Management System, Comos, MS Office, Google Suite, QS Systeme)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nel campo di Engineering & SHE in Kaiseraugst, troverete numerose possibilità per conoscere il campo di attività nel campo della produzione farmaceutica di forme farmaceutiche solide e liquide. Engineering & SHE è l'area centrale per la calibrazione dei nostri sistemi di produzione GMP (ad esempio temperatura, pressione, massa) e supporta il sito Kaiseraugst in conformità ai requisiti di produzione GMP. La possibilità: come specialista di calibrazione, il vostro campo di attività comprende i seguenti compiti:
• Coordinamento auto-organizzato delle tarature - monitoraggio, documentazione e implementazione tempestiva delle calibrazioni
• mantenimento dello stato di stabilimento qualificato delle apparecchiature di misura supervisionate
• gestione dei documenti – creazione, revisione e aggiornamento dei documenti
• implementazione orientata al GMP e documentazione dei vostri compiti
• sviluppo di proposte e coordinamento delle misure per migliorare la qualità, la sicurezza, l'efficienza dei processi di calibrazione e la riduzione dei costi Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Global Business Process Specialist - Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029.

The Opportunity

• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting

• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.

• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.

• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.

• Strong Business and IT Knowledge: Requires strong knowledge in both business and IT to effectively discuss and justify business requirements and assess the feasibility of technical solutions.

• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.

• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.

• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.

• Technical and Process Expertise: The role demands a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, deep process knowledge, and technical expertise in areas like IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, and various laws and regulations. Past experience as functional consultant and/or end user in asset & lease accounting i

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum (m/w/d) im Team Digital Customer Excellence
Roche Pharma AG

Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 101.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt.

Das Kundenerlebnis in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen, Digital-First zu denken und Omnichannel-Marketing zu leben entspricht Deinem Mindset? Wir wollen jeden Touchpoint unserer Kunden mit Roche mit einer besonders positiven Customer Experience belegen. Passt das zu Dir? Dann bist Du bei Roche und in unserem Team genau richtig. Ein umfangreicher Einarbeitungsplan hilft Dir gemeinsam mit dem Team, alle Teilbereiche von Digital Customer Excellence kennen- und verstehen zu lernen. Und dann heißt es mit Unterstützung deines Buddys aus dem Team „Learning by doing“.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Superior Customer Experience mitgestalten

• Unterstützung und Auswertung digitaler Kampagnen und Omnichannel-Kommunikation für strategische, abteilungsübergreifende Produkte

• Wissenstransfer digitaler Konzepte in die Kundeninteraktion und standortweite Implementierung

• Omnichannel-Kommunikation (Fokus Digital) erlebbar machen

• Analyse & Bewertung nutzerfreundlicher digitaler Plattformen und Kanäle

• Erarbeitung und Mitwirkung bei digitalen Kampagnen und Konzepten

• Maßnahmen mitgestalten, die einen WOW-Effekt bei unseren Kunden erzeugen und ein nachhaltiges CX-Mindset fördern

• Recherche und interne Kommunikation von Best-Practice-Beispielen zu Customer Centricity

• Content-Erstellung für deutschsprachige Kanäle; Workshop-Moderation und Ergebnisdokumentation in deutscher Sprache

Wer Du bist:
Für Dein Praktikum im Team von Digital Customer Excellence (Bezeichnung der Abteilung) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.

• Du bist Student (m/w/d) mit den Schwerpunkten Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Digitales Management und/oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Du bist ein "Early Adopter" von neuen, digitalen Tools/Plattformen und zeichnest Dich aus durch Deine Neugierde in Bezug auf die Entwicklung und Implementierung digitaler Kommunikationsformen.

• Du verfügst über eine gute digitale Affinität sowie eine analytische Herangehensweise.

• Interesse an Marketing in der Pharmabranche und allgemeinen Fragestellungen im gesundheitspolitischen Umfeld.

• Idealerweise praktische Erfahrungen im Vertrieb oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Interesse an CX/UX & Content Management wünschenswert.

• Du überzeugst durch Deine kommunikative Persönlichkeit und Dein Ideenreichtum.

• Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Dein analytisches Denken hast Du in Projekten eingesetzt und diese selbstständig vorangetrieben.

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, gibst und erhältst gerne Feedback und agierst immer mit dem Ziel, das Portfolio des Teams zu verbessern.

• Sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden D

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity
The purpose of Medical Affairs Manager is to RDV’s objective of clinical adoption by representing in clinical world and delivering medical value. The MAM provides scientific & medical excellence, ensures appropriate medical communication to external stakeholders following the Symphony principles. The MAM interacts with appropriate RDV team member, HCPs and other decision makers on topics of mutual interest.

• Develops, coordinates and implements - in close communication with the commercial organizations – medical, scientific and clinical strategies to enhance and forward the understanding of the medical value of RDV in related therapeutic area across BAs

• Engages with HCPs, KOLs and other external stake holders to enhance the clinical knowledge of RDV’s medical value products

• Ensures strategic and project alignment with Roche Business Area medical functions as appropriate

• Support the commercial organization in all matters pertaining to the Medical Function as defined by Dia Symphony such as Advisory Board meetings, Speakers presentation, Medical education / training activities

• Develop MSA expertise for MSA activities

• Acts as the clinical/ medical point of contact for related therapeutic area

• External communication with HCPs on company products, research developments, and changes in standards of care including unsolicited and non-promotional and/or off-label/pipeline content request with the highest integrity, compliance and adherence to legal, regulatory and Roche guidelines, policies & procedures.

• Provides clinical expertise in the development, management and maintenance of clinical and scientific communications, including research, publications, and educational materials, meeting/event presentations and information etc. on all Roche tests and disease areas

• Provide industry forum representation and manage scientific exchange for large reference labs

• Critically analyze medical and scientific literature, data, clinical trial study designs and clinical outcomes of published studies and effectively communicate knowledge within and external to the organization

• Attends appropriate International Scientific congresses. Develops in-depth understanding of clinical practices and regulations, maintains understanding and insight into current lab and clinical practices and guidelines.

• Maintain all activities within Good Promotional Practices, Roche Diagnostics quality and regulatory guidelines

• Utilize Roche medical expertise for responding to documented adverse events and off-label issue management

• Market Access (optional): Formulate and lead selected product access plan through collaboration with business areas. Collaborating with business, identify and select product (medical and scientific related) and formulate the plan in order to gain access in the market. Interact with Hospital Authority, Government or other organizations (e.g. Pharma companies) to establish funding availability for particular disease diagnosis/testing

• Other duties may be assigned by the management

Who you are

• Medical Doctor or Master in relevant medical area

• Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in healthcare industry

• Clinical research, Medical Affairs related experience preferred

• Excellent leadership skill with ability to lead and facilitate cross-functional working groups and teams

• Medical writing and speaking

• Understanding on scientific

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Lo scopo di Medical Affairs Manager è quello di RDV obiettivo di adozione clinica, rappresentando nel mondo clinico e fornendo valore medico. Il MAM fornisce l'eccellenza scientifica e medica, assicura un'adeguata comunicazione medica agli stakeholder esterni seguendo i principi della Sinfonia. Il MAM interagisce con un membro del team RDV appropriato, HCP e altri decisori su argomenti di interesse reciproco.
• Sviluppa, coordina e implementa - in stretta comunicazione con le organizzazioni commerciali - strategie mediche, scientifiche e cliniche per migliorare e trasmettere la comprensione del valore medico di RDV nella relativa area terapeutica attraverso BA
• Engages con HCP, KOL e altri supporti di posta esterna per migliorare la conoscenza clinica dei prodotti di valore medico di RDV
• Assicura l'allineamento strategico e di progetto con le funzioni mediche di Roche Business Area
• Sostenere l'organizzazione commerciale in tutte le questioni relative alla funzione medica definita da Dia Symphony come riunioni del comitato consultivo, presentazione di relatori, attività di educazione medica / formazione
• Sviluppare competenze MSA per attività MSA
• agisce come punto di contatto clinico/medico per la relativa area terapeutica
• Comunicazione esterna con HCP sui prodotti aziendali, gli sviluppi della ricerca e le modifiche degli standard di assistenza tra cui la richiesta di contenuti non richiesti e non promozionali e/o off-label/pipeline, con la massima integrità, conformità e aderenza alle linee guida legali, regolamentari e Roche, politiche e procedure.
• Fornisce competenze cliniche nello sviluppo, nella gestione e nella manutenzione di comunicazioni cliniche e scientifiche, tra cui ricerca, pubblicazioni e materiali didattici, presentazioni di meeting/evento e informazioni ecc. su tutti i test Roche e le aree di malattia
• Fornire la rappresentanza del forum dell'industria e gestire lo scambio scientifico per grandi laboratori di riferimento
• analizzare criticamente la letteratura medica e scientifica, i dati, i progetti di studio clinico e i risultati clinici degli studi pubblicati e comunicare efficacemente la conoscenza all'interno e all'esterno dell'organizzazione
• Partecipa a congressi scientifici internazionali appropriati. Sviluppa una comprensione approfondita delle pratiche e dei regolamenti clinici, mantiene la comprensione e la comprensione delle attuali pratiche e delle linee guida e del laboratorio.
• Mantenere tutte le attività all'interno di buone pratiche promozionali, Roche Diagnostics qualità e linee guida di regolamentazione
• Utilizzare competenze mediche Roche per rispondere a eventi avversi documentati e gestione dei problemi off-label
• Market Access (opzionale): Formulare e guidare il piano di accesso dei prodotti selezionato attraverso la collaborazione con le aree di business. Collaborare con il business, identificare e selezionare il prodotto (medico e scientifico correlato) e formulare il piano al fine di ottenere l'accesso sul mercato. Interagire con l'Autorità ospedaliera, il governo o altre organizzazioni (ad esempio le aziende farmaceutiche) per stabilire la disponibilità di finanziamenti per una particolare diagnosi di malattia/testing
• Altri compiti possono essere assegnati dalla direzione Chi sei
• Medico o Maestro in area medica pertinente
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante nel settore sanitario
• Ricerca clinica, Esperienza relativa agli affari medici preferita
• Eccellente capacità di leadership con la capacità di guidare e facilitare i gruppi di lavoro e le squadre interfunzionali
• Scrittura medica e conversazione
• Comprensione sulla scienza

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir fördern die Wissenschaft, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Ihre Chance Zweck des Medical Affairs Managers ist es, das Ziel der klinischen Adoption durch die Vertretung in der klinischen Welt und die Bereitstellung von medizinischem Wert. Die MAM bietet wissenschaftliche und medizinische Exzellenz, sorgt für eine angemessene medizinische Kommunikation an externe Stakeholder nach den Symphonieprinzipien. Das MAM interagiert mit geeigneten RDV-Teammitgliedern, HCPs und anderen Entscheidungsträgern zu Themen von gemeinsamem Interesse.
• Entwickelt, koordiniert und implementiert – in enger Kommunikation mit den kommerziellen Organisationen – medizinische, wissenschaftliche und klinische Strategien, um das Verständnis des medizinischen Wertes von RDV in verwandten therapeutischen Bereichen über BAs zu verbessern und weiterzuleiten
• Vernetzt mit HCPs, KOLs und anderen externen Stakeholdern, um die klinischen Kenntnisse der Medizinprodukte von RDV zu verbessern

• MSA-Expertise für MSA-Aktivitäten entwickeln

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Votre opportunité L'objectif du directeur des affaires médicales est de réaliser l'objectif de l'adoption clinique en représentant dans le monde clinique et en fournissant une valeur médicale. Le MAM offre l'excellence scientifique et médicale, assure une communication médicale appropriée aux intervenants externes suivant les principes symphoniques. Le MAM interagit avec un membre approprié de l'équipe du RDV, des HCP et d'autres décideurs sur des sujets d'intérêt mutuel.
• Développer, coordonner et mettre en œuvre - en étroite communication avec les organisations commerciales - des stratégies médicales, scientifiques et cliniques visant à améliorer et à faire progresser la compréhension de la valeur médicale du VRD dans le domaine thérapeutique connexe dans les BAs
• S'engage avec les HCP, les KOL et d'autres détenteurs externes de participation pour améliorer les connaissances cliniques des produits à valeur médicale RDV.
• Assurer l'alignement stratégique et projet avec les fonctions médicales du secteur d'activité Roche, selon le cas
• Soutenir l'organisation commerciale dans toutes les questions relatives à la fonction médicale telles que Dia Symphony telles que les réunions du conseil consultatif, présentation des conférenciers, éducation médicale / activités de formation
• Développer l'expertise MSA pour les activités MSA
• Agir en tant que point de contact clinique/ médical pour le domaine thérapeutique connexe
• Communication externe avec les PCH sur les produits de l'entreprise, les développements de la recherche et les changements dans les normes de soins, y compris la demande de contenu non sollicitée et non promotionnelle et/ou hors étiquette/pipéline avec la plus haute intégrité, conformité et respect des lignes directrices, politiques et procédures juridiques, réglementaires et Roche.
• Fournit une expertise clinique dans le développement, la gestion et la maintenance des communications cliniques et scientifiques, y compris la recherche, les publications et le matériel éducatif, des présentations de réunions/événements et des informations, etc. sur tous les tests Roche et les domaines de la maladie
• Assurer la représentation des forums de l'industrie et gérer les échanges scientifiques pour les grands laboratoires de référence
• Analyser critiquement la littérature médicale et scientifique, les données, les plans des études cliniques et les résultats cliniques des études publiées et communiquer efficacement les connaissances à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'organisation
• Assister à des congrès scientifiques internationaux appropriés. Développer une compréhension approfondie des pratiques et des règlements cliniques, maintenir la compréhension et la compréhension des pratiques et des lignes directrices actuelles en laboratoire et en clinique.
• Maintenir toutes les activités dans le cadre de bonnes pratiques promotionnelles, de la qualité de Roche Diagnostics et des lignes directrices réglementaires
• Utiliser l'expertise médicale de Roche pour répondre aux événements indésirables documentés et à la gestion hors étiquette
• Accès au marché (facultatif): Formuler et diriger un plan d'accès à certains produits en collaboration avec les secteurs d'activité. Collaborer avec les entreprises, identifier et sélectionner le produit (médical et scientifique) et formuler le plan afin d'obtenir l'accès au marché. Interagir avec l'administration hospitalière, le gouvernement ou d'autres organismes (p. ex., les compagnies pharmaceutiques) pour établir la disponibilité du financement nécessaire à un diagnostic ou à un test de maladie particulier
• D'autres tâches peuvent être attribuées par la direction Qui vous êtes
• Doctorat ou maîtrise en médecine
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans le secteur de la santé
• Recherche clinique, expérience liée aux affaires médicales préférée
• Excellente compétence en leadership avec la capacité de diriger et de faciliter les groupes de travail et les équipes interfonctionnels
• L'écriture médicale et la parole
• Compréhension scientifique

jobs.title: Digital Content Strategist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of priorities related to content. You are responsible for supporting Roche disease area teams in translating their brand strategy into content. In addition, you work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that all content related activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. This position has a global scope.

Your Opportunity
In the position of Digital Content Strategist in the area of Immunology/CVRM you will be focusing on:

• Aligning content strategy across disease area teams to ensure business objectives flow seamlessly through the full content supply chain

• Developing customer engagement goals and driving customer-centric content planning that solves identified business problem

• Building integrated omnichannel plans by collaborating with strategy leads, insights teams, and data analytics experts to ensure content reaches customers effectively

• Auditing and optimizing content by identifying gaps, repurposing existing assets across new channels and formats, and maximizing content value

• Fostering cross-functional collaboration across commercial, medical, corporate communications, and global teams to co-create innovative content strategies

• Measuring content performance through KPIs and A/B testing, while building a repository of best practices tailored to customer segments

• Driving continuous improvement by establishing governance principles, encouraging experimentation, and recommending enhancements to service and responsiveness for business partners

Who you are
You are an upbeat, dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about planning, creating and executing content strategies. As a Digital Content Strategist you are an accomplished expert, with a deep knowledge of digital content and demonstrated success executing content strategies and providing high quality enablement of customer engagement. You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You are passionate about personal growth and learning, constantly focusing on improvement of our customer's experience. You have:

• Degree in Life sciences or healthcare experience (considered as a plus) with 3–5 years digital marketing experience

• Content Development experience: Create resonant digital content across multiple channels (email, paid media, congresses)

• Rapid Learning: Quickly master disease areas, competitive landscapes, and brand-specific marketing challenges

• Strong planning, influencing, and cross-functional facilitation skill

• Fluent English; excellent presentation, customer service, and team alignment abilities

• Detail-oriented, organized, independent problem-solver; adaptable to pressure and international schedules; tech-savvy quick learner

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave f

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

Your Opportunity
The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. In the position you will be focusing on:

● Managing the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.
● Incorporating feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.
● Instructing stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area
● Supporting Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication
● Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-
quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. You have:

● Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
● Min 1+ years of proven experience in project management, preferably in digital marketing or content creation.
● Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management.
● Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
● Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
● Experience in coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders, strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Openness to learn project management tools and software, experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additio
