jobs.title: Design Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.

Your Opportunity:
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.
In this position you will be focusing on:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• Exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• Skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global diverse community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver l

jobs.title: Executive Business Coordinator & BioSafety Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
The Executive Business Coordinator & Biosafety Specialist serves as a strategic collaborator to the Country Manager and the Leadership Team. This role combines high-level executive support and organizational management with the specialized responsibility of serving as the site Biosafety Officer (BSO). The position ensures operational excellence, seamless leadership coordination, and full compliance with biological safety standards.

Main Responsibilities
Executive Support & Leadership Management
- Executive Assistant to the CM: Act as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the Country Manager; managing complex calendars, travel, and high-priority communications.
- Leadership Team Coordination: Support the leadership team’s administrative activities, including preparing agendas, documenting meeting minutes (when applicable), and tracking action items to ensure organizational alignment.
- Strategic Liaison: Facilitate communication between the CM and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring the CM is briefed and prepared for all engagements.

Organizational Business Management & Events
- Event Management: Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of organizational events, including town halls, leadership retreats, and corporate functions.
- Operational Oversight: Manage administrative workflows and special projects as assigned by the CM to improve organizational efficiency.
- Collaboration with finance and procurement team for purchase requisition creation
- Establish a good relations with service providers and negotiate to maintain expenses within the defined budget
- Ensure good record management of all contracts, according to the record management SOP
- Ensure contracts are executed until service delivery and partners payment

Biosafety Management (Biosafety Officer Duties)
- Policy Development: Create, develop, and revise local biosafety policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with local laws, Roche Group requirements (K17), and industry standards like the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual.
- Risk Management: Partner with line management to ensure risk assessments for potentially infectious materials are performed and periodically revised.
- Compliance & Inspections: Conduct regular inspections and surveillance of workplaces handling contaminated instruments to ensure compliance with biosafety levels and legal requirements.
- Safety Programs: Organize health programs for employees, specifically managing Hepatitis B vaccinations and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Training & Reporting: Support line management in delivering documented biosafety training and maintaining procedures for reporting incidents or accidents involving infectious materials.
- Waste & Vendor Management: Ensure procedures are in place for the legal disposal of biological waste and assist in qualifying outsourced vendors according to K15 and K17 standards.
- Regulatory Liaison: Coordinate interactions between the site, local biosafety authorities, and Group SHE, ensuring all notifications and permits are fulfilled.
- Self-Assessment: Perform regular self-assessments to verify program compliance and report biosafety metrics, risks, or gaps to site leadership.

In the capacity of Biosafety Officer, this role holds the following specific authorities:
- Work Stoppage: Authority to stop any activity immediately in the event of imminent danger related to biological exposure.
- Regulatory Issuance: Authority to issue detailed biosafety regulations specific to

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Executive Business Coordinator & Biosafety Specialist serves as a strategic collaborator to the Country Manager and the Leadership Team. This role combines high-level executive support and organizational management with the specialized responsibility of serving as the site Biosafety Officer (BSO). The position ensures operational excellence, seamless leadership coordination, and full compliance with biological safety standards. Main
• Responsibilities Executive Support & Leadership Management - Executive Assistant to the CM: Act as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the Country Manager; managing complex calendars, travel, and high-priority communications. - Leadership Team Coordination: Support the leadership team’s administrative activities, including preparing agendas, documenting meeting minutes (when applicable), and tracking action items to ensure organizational alignment. - Strategic Liaison: Facilitate communication between the CM and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring the CM is briefed and prepared for all engagements. Organizational Business Management & Events - Event Management: Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of organizational events, including town halls, leadership retreats, and corporate functions. - Operational Oversight: Manage administrative workflows and special projects as assigned by the CM to improve organizational efficiency. - Collaboration with finance and procurement team for purchase requisition creation - Establish a good relations with service providers and negotiate to maintain expenses within the defined budget - Ensure good record management of all contracts, according to the record management SOP - Ensure contracts are executed until service delivery and partners payment Biosafety Management (Biosafety Officer Duties) - Policy Development: Create, develop, and revise local biosafety policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with local laws, Roche Group requirements (K17), and industry standards like the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual. - Risk Management: Partner with line management to ensure risk assessments for potentially infectious materials are performed and periodically revised. - Compliance & Inspections: Conduct regular inspections and surveillance of workplaces handling contaminated instruments to ensure compliance with biosafety levels and legal requirements. - Safety Programs: Organize health programs for employees, specifically managing Hepatitis B vaccinations and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). - Training & Reporting: Support line management in delivering documented biosafety training and maintaining procedures for reporting incidents or accidents involving infectious materials. - Waste & Vendor Management: Ensure procedures are in place for the legal disposal of biological waste and assist in qualifying outsourced vendors according to K15 and K17 standards. - Regulatory Liaison: Coordinate interactions between the site, local biosafety authorities, and Group SHE, ensuring all notifications and permits are fulfilled. - Self-Assessment: Perform regular self-assessments to verify program compliance and report biosafety metrics, risks, or gaps to site leadership. In the capacity of Biosafety Officer, this role holds the following specific authorities: - Work Stoppage: Authority to stop any activity immediately in the event of imminent danger related to biological exposure. - Regulatory Issuance: Authority to issue detailed biosafety regulations specific to

jobs.title: Technical Service Engineer - Oujda
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
L’ Opportunite
Dans le cadre du cycle client (Ventes, Déploiement et Suivi) et de la stratégie de
maintenance de la filiale, Le Technical Service Engineer installe et maintient les équipements chez les clients afin de garantir le niveau de satisfaction des clients et le bon fonctionnement des systèmes.

Missions Princiaples
Garantir la réalisation des actions techniques du SAV, leur traçabilité et le niveau de satisfaction des clients sur son secteur
- Réalise l’installation technique des systèmes sur les sites clients, l’exécution des maintenances préventives et curatives ainsi que les mises à jour des systèmes installés.
- Réalise également les désinstallations et réinstallations des systèmes sur site.
- Porte une attention particulière à la qualité des actions techniques et administratives réalisées, en respectant le cadre défini par le groupe et la (Valeurs, Contrat, Normes ISO, recommandations Constructeur, cadre réglementaire…) pour parvenir à l’obtention des objectifs fixés.
- Contribue aux plans d’action « Satisfaction Client » de son secteur et est responsable de l’exécution de ceux qu’il initie.
- Contribue activement aux différents processus ou méthodes mis en place pour conquérir de nouveaux clients, fidéliser et développer nos clients existants.
- Renseigne, quantitativement et qualitativement en temps réel, l’ensemble des interventions dans les outils mis à sa disposition et les qualifie selon les règles en cours.

Assurer la mise en œuvre d’actions d’amélioration et de fiabilisation des systèmes installés
- Remonte les informations techniques à son responsable et alerte celui-ci en cas de difficulté particulière.
- S’informe sur les informations diffusées par les supports techniques et les applique dans son activité.
- Conçoit ses actions en intégrant systématiquement l’amélioration de la Satisfaction Clients.

Garantir le respect des normes et des règles
- Connaître les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent son activité
- Relayer l’information en termes de Qualité, Sécurité, Hygiène et Environnement et donne l’alerte en cas de manquement
- S’assurer de la bonne application des directives et instructions dans son périmètre de travail

Garantir la transversalité, la synergie et la communication au sein de l’entreprise
- Echange avec les collègues d’autres services et contribue à renforcer la culture d’entreprise.
- S'assurer que toutes les activités menées respectent les exigences de qualité et les réglementations en vigueur.

Qui Vous Etes?
Experience et Competences Requises
- Maîtrise Technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)
- Anglais technique
- Aisance relationnelle
- Fort sens du service et orientation client
- Bonne résistance au stress
- Esprit d'équipe
- Pédagogie

Note: Le contrat de travail pour ce poste sera établi par l'intermédiaire d'une agence tierce.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet engagierten Talenten eine besondere Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie zu sammeln und gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag für die Welt zu leisten.

Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben?

In diesem Praktikum arbeitest Du an der datenbasierten Optimierung von HVACR-Systemen, um Energieverschwendung in Gebäudebetrieben sichtbar zu machen und gezielt zu reduzieren. Du analysierst bestehende Facility-Daten von mehr als 100 Assets, identifizierst ineffiziente Betriebsweisen wie gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen oder unnötige Laufzeiten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate erstellst Du ein Mapping der zehn energieintensivsten Assets, entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung von Ineffizienzen und erarbeitest einen priorisierten Optimierungsplan für das lokale Facility Management. Damit trägst Du direkt zur Priorität Environment in Roche’s Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie bei, insbesondere zu Climate Change und Sustainable Operations. Die Rolle bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, mit Daten sofort messbare Umweltwirkung und Kosteneinsparungen in einer komplexen Infrastruktur zu erzielen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du analysierst historische Facility-Daten, um Muster von Energieverschwendung und ineffizientem Anlagenbetrieb zu identifizieren

• Du erstellst ein Mapping und Inventar der zehn energieintensivsten Assets auf Basis von Datenmustern

• Du entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung betrieblicher Ineffizienzen, zum Beispiel für HVACR-Unstimmigkeiten oder Abweichungen von Produktionsplänen

• Du bewertest bestehende Daten nach definierten Kriterien und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab

• Du schlägst Anpassungen von Produktionszeiten und HVACR-Betriebszeiten vor, um unnötigen Energieverbrauch zu vermeiden

• Du quantifizierst das Einsparpotenzial jeder Maßnahme in Bezug auf Energieverbrauch, Kosten und CO₂-Fußabdruck

• Du erarbeitest einen umsetzbaren Optimierungsplan mit einer priorisierten Liste technischer Anpassungen für das lokale Facility Management

• Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und stimmst Dich mit relevanten Stakeholdern ab

Wer Du bist

Du bist aktuell an einer Universität in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energiemanagement, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt HLK/Gebäudetechnik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Umwelttechnik oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums einbringen.

Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• Du hast Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und kannst mit größeren Datensätzen sicher arbeiten

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Information Security & Privacy By Design team is the engine behind Roche’s security governance. We design, deliver, and support the digital frameworks that protect our organization, including IRAAM (Information Risk Assessment And Mitigation), PETRA (Policy Exceptions Tool for Risk Assessment ), OIA (Outsourcing Impact Assessment), and our cutting-edge GenAI security agents .
As an AI & Automation Engineer , you are the vital architect bridging the gap between high-level security expertise and scalable, self-service execution. Your mission is to democratize security and privacy knowledge by building intelligent agents and low-code tools that empower Roche employees. You don’t just manage risk; you build the "digital brains" that make risk management proactive, intuitive, and frictionless.
You are an "implementer" who thrives on turning strategic advice into functional code. You believe that security governance is most effective when it is invisible, automated, and powered by data.

Description of the Area

The Information Security & Privacy By Design team makes Roche’s information security governance accessible through actionable processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate information risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee third-party and personal data processing risks. Our processes are primarily instantiated in the ServiceNow IRM Platform . We work closely with Information Security, Privacy, Risk & Compliance, and IT teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s information risk posture.
You’ll be working within the Information Security Governance (ISG) area. ISG is responsible for defining the strategic agenda for information security and privacy topics at the Roche Group level. This is realized within the global Information Security Management System (ISMS) which aligns business and IT strategies, business and technical projects, policies, standards, directives, procedures, governance, legal / regulatory, compliance, and other requirements at a global level.
The Information Security & Privacy by Design area is accountable for co-developing, in collaboration with key stakeholders, and stewardship of the strategic direction of the Information Risk Assessment processes based on organizational objectives, industry practices and legal / regulatory requirements - e.g IRAAM, PETRA, OIA. This includes oversight, awareness, direction and continuous improvement to the end-to-end processes and their relevant risk modules in alignment with the global ISMS, corporate directives and Roche management systems (e.g. privacy, quality, risk).

Job Responsibilities

1. AI Solution Development & Knowledge Engineering

• Security AI Stewardship: Own the development and roadmap of internal AI-based advisory tools. You will transform static security policies and KB articles into interactive, intelligent agents.

• Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG): Build and optimize data pipelines to ingest diverse sources—including Google Docs, ServiceNow KB articles, and slide decks—into AI models to ensure accurate, grounded advisory.

• Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Continuously refine LLM performance to ensure security and privacy advice is technically sound, brand-aligned, and user-friendly.

2. Low-Code & Automation Engineering

• Self-Service Platforms: Leverage Roche’s low-code platforms( e.g. LEAP Outsystems or similar) to build front-end interfaces that provide employees with 24/7 security guidance

You’ll be working within the Information Security Governance (ISG) area. ISG is responsible for defining the strategic agenda for information security and privacy topics at the Roche Group level. This is realized within the global Information Security Management System (ISMS) which aligns business and IT strategies, business and technical projects, policies, standards, directives, procedures, governance, legal / regulatory, compliance, and other requirements at a global level. The Information Security & Privacy by Design area is accountable for co-developing, in collaboration with key stakeholders, and stewardship of the strategic direction of the Information Risk Assessment processes based on organizational objectives, industry practices and legal / regulatory requirements - e.g IRAAM, PETRA, OIA. This includes oversight, awareness, direction and continuous improvement to the end-to-end processes and their relevant risk modules in alignment with the global ISMS, corporate directives and Roche management systems (e.g. privacy, quality, risk). Job Responsibilities 1. AI Solution Development & Knowledge Engineering
• Security AI Stewardship: Own the development and roadmap of internal AI-based advisory tools. You will transform static security policies and KB articles into interactive, intelligent agents.
• Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG): Build and optimize data pipelines to ingest diverse sources—including Google Docs, ServiceNow KB articles, and slide decks—into AI models to ensure accurate, grounded advisory.
• Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Continuously refine LLM performance to ensure security and privacy advice is technically sound, brand-aligned, and user-friendly. 2. Low-Code & Automation Engineering
• Self-Service Platforms: Leverage Roche’s low-code platforms( e.g. LEAP Outsystems or similar) to build front-end interfaces that provide employees with 24/7 security guidance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale : Bretagne.

Missions
Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements

• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques

• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives

• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes

• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances.

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale

• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)

• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité

• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Entwicklung

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, das Dir die Möglichkeit bietet, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich zu wachsen? Möchtest Du Deine theoretischen Kenntnisse in einem praxisorientierten Umfeld anwenden und in einem spannenden Bereich mit deutschlandweiter Bedeutung tätig werden? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und profitiere von individueller Betreuung und regelmäßigem Feedback, um Dein Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen. In deinem Praktikum wirst du direkt an den Head of Mobility Management berichten.

Über uns

Mobility - nachhaltig, rentabel und attraktiv. Als Mobility Management-Gruppe sind wir verantwortlich für die Mobilität unserer ca. 20.000 Roche Mitarbeiter. Digitale Mobilitätsplattformen, Flugreisen, Deutsche Bahn, ÖPNV, Fahrräder, Elektroautos und zukünftig auch Transporter fürs Beamen? Mit unseren drei Fachbereichen: Travel Management Roche Deutschland, Fleet Management für Mannheim, Penzberg und Ludwigsburg sowie Mobility Site Services in Mannheim und Penzberg gestalten wir die Zukunft der Mobilität. Wir suchen motivierte Talente wie dich, die mit uns auf diese aufregende Reise gehen.

Deine Aufgaben: Vielfältig und spannend!

• Du übernimmst die Durchführung von (Teil-)Projekten, darunter die Optimierung von Prozessen mit Tools wie bspw. Lucid Charts

• Du interviewst verschiedene Stakeholder um stets den Ist-Zustand des Prozesses adäquat darzustellen

• Du führst Prozessmappings in Tools wie bspw. Lucid Chart aus

• Du stellst Business Cases auf und bewertest verschiedene Optionen um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen

• Durch deine kreative Ader unterstützt du uns mit deinen Ideen für unsere Werbekanäle und bei der ansprechenden Gestaltung von Präsentationen

• Du unterstützt uns im Team dabei, effektiv zu arbeiten durch bspw. die Organisation in unserem G-Drive

Wer bist du?

• Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ähnliches oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium

• Du überzeugst mit einer analytischen Herangehensweise, hinterfragst konventionelle Denkmuster und verfügst über ein hohes Maß an Eigenständigkeit und Koordinationsfähigkeit

• Du hast dich bereits Prozessoptimierung auseinandergesetzt und ein Talent für das Strukturieren und Gestalten von Informationen

• Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und eigeninitiative Arbeitsweise und deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

• Du hast Routine im Umgang mit dem MS / Google-Office-Paket: Unsere Arbeit basiert hauptsächlich auf Google-Tools wie G-Sheets und G-Slides. Vorkenntnisse sind daher ein Plus, aber mit Excel- oder PowerPoint-Erfahrung wirst Du Dich schnell einfinden.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- (C-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B-Niveau) runden Dein Profil ab.

Rahmendaten und Vorteile

• Dauer: 6 Monate Vollzeit (37,5h/Woche)

• 2268€ Vergütung im Monat

• Das Praktikum ist im Rahmen von “Mobile Work” auch zum Teil von zuhause möglich

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50,0 %) in unseren Mitarbeiterkantinen

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden sowohl in unserem Team als auch darüber hinaus!

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus: Mit dem Roche Aktiv-Center in Mannheim bietet Roche vielfältige Angebote zur Gesundheitsförderung

• Nut

jobs.title: Ingénieur Service et Maintenance - Touraine (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale : Touraine.

Missions
Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements

• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques

• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives

• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes

• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances.

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale

• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)

• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité

• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regional Field Service Engineer - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)

titleByLocale.it: Regional Field Service Ingegnere - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)
titleByLocale.en: Regional Field Service Engineer - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)
titleByLocale.de: Regional Field Service Ingenieur - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)
titleByLocale.fr: Regional Field Service Ingénieur - Implementation Team Europe (Poland)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Regional Field Service Engineer - Implementation Team Europe
Location: Poland

Join our high-performing Field Service team and directly contribute to healthcare excellence across Europe. This critical role offers the unique opportunity to leverage your technical expertise and problem-solving skills to install complex analytical laboratory systems and act as a knowledge expert for the entire region. We are seeking someone eager to learn in a diverse environment, committed to co-creation, and focused on delivering exceptional service to our customers and, ultimately, patients.

The Opportunity
As a Regional Field Service Engineer, you are accountable for achieving service excellence across the Europe region. You will act as the knowledge expert, ensuring the successful setup and operation of our CoreLab analytical platforms.

• Lead Complex Installations: Successfully install and technically release CoreLab analytical laboratory instrument platforms for customer use.

• Act as Knowledge Expert: Contribute to large customer projects and serve as a technical resource, transferring knowledge and supporting other Field Service Engineers across borders.

• Ensure Compliance: Document all regional service activities accurately and timely in the CRM system, ensuring full compliance with company quality procedures.

• Drive Service Excellence: Independently analyze and resolve most technical questions and problems, only referring the most complex issues to senior levels.

• Monitor and Optimize: Develop and monitor local reports to ensure the efficient and productive delivery of services and actively monitor costs for your own service activities. Actively gather information in preparation for meetings, delivering and sharing the outcome with others.

• Manage Project Lifecycle: Focus on installations for large projects that require special attention based on continuous Roche affiliates and customer demands and specifications.

• Stay Current: Remain aware of new service bulletins and Global Customer Support (GCS) updates, implementing new ways of working and promoting teamwork.

Who You Are
We are looking for you to bring dedication, technical depth, and a commitment to service to our team.

• Technical Background: You have full technical higher education (precision mechanics, electronic, Information Technology, Medical Technology, or related specialties).

• Experience Level: We welcome applications from recent university graduates and those with 1–3 years of experience who are eager to grow their professional footprint and build a long-term career within Roche.

• Core Technical Skills: You possess basic knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, and Information Technology (IT) and Networking concepts.

• Soft Skills: As an excellent communicator, you possess the analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills necessary to bridge complex challenges with clear solutions autonomously. With a mastery of organization and prioritization, you consistently deliver high-quality customer service while demonstrating the ability and willingness to collaborate seamlessly within a multi-cultural environment.

• Language skills: You are fluent in English (verbal and written).

• Mobility & Operational Requirement: You hold a valid driver’s license and are prepared for frequent travel throughout Europe. To support this high level of mobility, you reside close to an international airport, ensuring efficient travel and seamless connectivity for our European operation

jobs.title: Decision Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of innovation. As a Decision Analytics Consultant , you won’t just be analyzing requirements; you will be a trusted advisor and a strategic bridge between complex technical landscapes and business outcomes.
You will lead end-to-end business analysis workstreams, leveraging advanced analytics and statistical modeling to tackle ambiguity and transform complex clinical or operational data into actionable insights. Your mission is to ensure that every solution we build provides demonstrable value to our patients and our organization.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

• Strategic Advisory & Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams. You will act as a consultant to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and aligning project goals with long-term solution roadmaps.

• Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret complex datasets (quantitative and qualitative) to inform product and UX decisions; Experience translating user behavior, metrics, and feedback into actionable insight; Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, or Tableau

• Solution Design & Product Development: Translate complex business requirements into strategic implementation plans. You will design data products (datasets, KPI frameworks) and evaluate vendor solutions to ensure they meet our technical and business standards.

• User Behavior & Experience Analysis: Strong capability to analyze user journeys, pain points, and interaction patterns; Experience with usability testing, A/B testing, and heuristic evaluations; Familiarity with UX research tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Mixpanel

• Requirements Elicitation & Problem Structuring: Expertise in breaking down ambiguous business problems into structured requirements and hypotheses; Ability to synthesize stakeholder needs, technical constraints, and user expectations into clear functional and non-functional requirements; Skilled in creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows

• Process Excellence & Mentorship: As a senior member of our Community of Practice, you will mentor junior and intermediate BAs, proactively shaping our methodologies and driving continuous improvement in our operational workflows.

• Technical Integrity: Drive the analysis and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability, maintaining a focus on data governance and change management.

Who You Are
You are someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves tackling "gray areas," and is passionate about the intersection of technology and human health. You bring structure to chaos and are a natural communicator.
Qualifications & Experience:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy, with at least 3+ years within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields - Information Systems / Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on IT, Analytics, or Operations), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or UX-related discipline, Data Analytics / Data Science. Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in - MBA (Information Systems or Product Management focus), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),Data Analytics / Business Analytics is highly desirable.

• Analytical Mastery: SQL, BI tools (Tableau/Power BI), UX analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel), and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence). Familiarity

jobs.title: Technical Maintenance Assessor (Concepción)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Asegurar la excelencia en el servicio técnico a través de la gestión de acciones proactivas, de mantenimientos y soporte especializado. Apoyar la puesta en marcha de equipos y asesorar a los clientes en el uso óptimo de la tecnología para cumplir con los estándares globales de calidad de la compañía.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.

• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.

• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.

• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio.

• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

The Opportunity:

• You will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

• You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

• You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline like Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field.

• You have proven procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant related commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You have experience in procurement systems, processes and skills in project management.

• You possess knowledge and experience in the Clinical Laboratories commodity area (Genomics and Genetics, Bio

jobs.title: Ingénieur d'Application Séquençage (d/f/m)
People & Culture Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As People & Culture Project Manage r, you will be part of Roche’s People Support Solutions (PSS) organization and Customer Experience Area of Practice, leading complex global and regional People & Culture initiatives with significant impact across a dynamic and matrixed environment.

The Opportunity

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex global or regional People & Culture projects and initiatives, including organizational and HR supported transformation programs, with significant business impact

• Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across all organizational levels, including senior leadership and executive sponsors

• Establish project governance structures, define project scope and objectives, and ensure alignment with business priorities and strategic goals

• Manage project timelines, budgets, resources, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID) to ensure successful project execution

• Drive communication, change management, and training activities to support organizational adoption and business readiness

• Apply and adapt delivery methodologies including waterfall, agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean, and Design Thinking based on project needs

• Coach and support teams throughout their agile transformation journey, fostering collaboration, continuous improvement, and agile mindsets

Who You Are

• Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development and/or equal practical experience in these fields

• Proven experience managing complex global projects or programs with significant scope, budget, and business impact

• Experience supporting HR / People & Culture initiatives, transformation programs, or organizational change initiatives within global or matrix organizations

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leadership and executive-level stakeholders

• Experience working with both traditional project management methodologies and agile frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe, Lean, or Design Thinking

• Experience coaching teams or supporting agile transformation initiatives within complex organizational environments is preferred

• Excellent communication, cross-cultural collaboration, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a global environment

This position does not offer relocation benefits.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Resumo da Vaga
Buscamos um estudante de Direito proativo, organizado e, acima de tudo, entusiasta da tecnologia . Se você acredita que o Direito pode ser mais ágil através da digitalização e do uso inteligente de ferramentas de IA, essa vaga foi feita para você. Você apoiará o time jurídico em frentes contratuais, administrativas e de suporte ao contencioso, sendo importante peça na organização e modernização dos nossos processos internos e departamento.

Principais Responsabilidades

• Gestão de Contratos: Elaboração de instrumentos de baixa complexidade baseados em minutas pré-aprovadas e gestão do fluxo de assinaturas via DocuSign . Apoio na revisão de cláusulas contratuais operacionais e rotineiras.

• Apoio ao Contencioso: Interface direta com as áreas internas (P&C/RH, Comercial e Finanças) para obtenção de subsídios e documentos necessários para a defesa em processos trabalhistas, de consumo e crédito e cobrança, apoiando nossos escritórios parceiros. Organização e envio e recebimento de relatórios mensais junto aos escritórios parceiros. Gestão do controle de contencioso da área.

• Administrativo: Gestão financeira da área (suporte a pagamentos e controle com abertura de requisições de pagamento e gestão de notas fiscais), organização de planilhas de controle financeiro.

• Comunicação e Atendimento: Gestão da caixa de e-mail institucional do jurídico e triagem de demandas. Suporte inicial de atendimento às áreas para esclarecimento de dúvidas jurídicas gerais. Atualização constante da Intranet jurídica e gestão de procurações da companhia.

• Foco em Inovação: Atuar como um facilitador da transformação digital , identificando oportunidades de melhoria de processos e sugerindo o uso de ferramentas de IA para otimizar o dia a dia do time.

Requisitos e Qualificações

• Formação: Cursando Direito (preferencialmente a partir do 5º/6º semestre / 3º ano).

• Excel: Domínio da ferramenta para criação e manutenção de controles e indicadores.

• Organização: Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prazos com atenção aos detalhes.

• Comunicação: Boa escrita e facilidade de interlocução com diferentes áreas da empresa.

• Digital Mindset: Interesse genuíno por novas tecnologias, ferramentas de produtividade e Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao Direito. Ser importante impulsionador da digitalização de fluxos da área.

• Inglês: intermediário/avançado.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre a Roche:
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos impulsiona a inovar. Avançar continuamente na ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à saúde - hoje e nas gerações futuras. Criando um mundo onde todos nós teremos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

A Oportunidade:
Você busca uma experiência prática onde a teoria da faculdade encontra o mundo real? Como Estagiário de Suporte de Campo em Recife , você será o braço direito dos nossos Especialistas. Seu papel será fundamental para garantir a disponibilidade dos ativos e a excelência no atendimento ao nosso cliente.
Aqui você terá voz ativa e aprenderá a gerir uma operação de campo de ponta a ponta, vivenciando desde a execução técnica até a apresentação estratégica de resultados. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

• Apoio Técnico: Auxiliar em manutenções preventivas e corretivas diretamente no campo.

• Monitoramento e Gestão: Acompanhar e atualizar indicadores de performance (KPIs) da operação.

• Comunicação Estratégica: Redigir comunicados técnicos e informativos para o cliente final sobre o status das atividades.

• Documentação: Organizar relatórios de visitas, checklists de manutenção e o planejamento de atividades.

• Melhoria Contínua: Participar ativamente de análises de causa raiz para evitar a reincidência de falhas.

Requerimentos:

• Formação: Cursando Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção), Tecnologia em Manutenção ou áreas correlatas.

• Localidade : Recife

• Ferramentas: Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google.

• Tecnologia: Habilidade no uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimização de tarefas.

• Comunicação: Excelente capacidade de escrita (essencial para o contato com o cliente).

• Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio em ferramentas de gestão de manutenção ou leitura técnica.

Sobre você:
Buscamos alguém com perfil "mão na massa", que tenha curiosidade genuína e paixão por resolver problemas complexos. Se você é organizado, proativo e deseja entender como a manutenção impacta diretamente a satisfação do cliente e o sucesso do negócio, você possui o DNA que procuramos.

Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Avançar continuamente na ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à saúde - hoje e nas gerações futuras. Criando um mundo onde todos nós teremos mais tempo com als pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche. A Oportunidade: Você busca uma experiência prática onde a teoria da faculdade encontra o mundo real? Como Estagiário de Suporte de Campo em Recife, você será o braço direito dos nossos Especialistas. Seu papel será fundamental para garantir a disponibilidade dos ativos e a excelência no atendimento ao nosso cliente. Aqui você terá voz ativa e aprenderá a gerir uma operação de campo de ponta a ponta, vivenciando desde a execução técnica até apresentação estratégica de resultados. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:
• Apoio Técnico: Auxiliar em manutenções präventivas e corretivas diretamente no campo.
• Monitoramento e Gestão: Acompanhar e atualizar indicadores de performance (KPIs) da operação.
• Comunicação Estratégica: Redigir comunicados técnicos e informativos para o cliente final sobre o status das atividades.
• Documentação: Organizar relatórios de visitas, checklists de manutenção e o planjamento de atividades.
• Melhoria Contínua: Participar ativamente de análises de causa raiz para evitar a reincidência de falhas. Requerimentos:
• Formação: Cursando Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção), Tecnologia em Manutenção ou áreas correlatas.
• Localidade : Recife
• Ferramentas: Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google.
• Tecnologia: Habilidade no uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimização de tarefas.
• Comunicação: Excelente capacidade de escrita (essencial para o contato com o cliente).
• Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio em ferramentas de gestão de manutenção ou leitura técnica. Sobre você: Buscamos alguém com perfil "mão na massa", que tenha virginidade genuína e paixão porsolvr problemas complexos. Se você é organizado, proativo e deseja entender como a manutenção impacta diretamente a satisfação do cliente e o sucesso do negócio, você possui o DNA que procuramos. Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta posição. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Acerca de Roche
En Roche, nos apasiona transformar la vida de los pacientes y somos audaces tanto en nuestras decisiones como en nuestras acciones, ya que creemos que un buen negocio significa un mundo mejor. Esa es la razón por la que venimos a trabajar todos los días. Nos comprometemos con el rigor científico, una ética intachable y el acceso a innovaciones médicas para todos. Hacemos esto hoy para construir un mejor mañana. Roche está firmemente comprometida con un entorno de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Nos esforzamos por formar equipos que representen una variedad de antecedentes, perspectivas y habilidades. Abrazar la diversidad nos permite crear un excelente
lugar para trabajar e innovar para los pacientes.
Resumen de la posición:
Como Pasante de Marketing, serás un motor de transformación en nuestra organización. Acompañarás iniciativas y procesos que fortalecen las estrategias de mercadotecnia y de negocio de cada área terapéutica. Tu rol será clave para que los procesos de marketing soporten la ejecución de nuestros planes táctico en el sistema de salud. Creemos en tu capacidad para dejar una huella positiva y construir, junto a nosotros, un lugar dondeimpactamos positivamente la vida de muchos pacientes a través de nuestras estrategías de negocio.
Principales responsabilidades
• ● Proveer el soporte para implementar las estrategias del portafolio: apoyo en ejecución de los eventos locales del Área Terapeútica (AT) y ejecución de campañas omnicanal.
• ● Reusar, crear y desarrollar materiales promocionales y no promocionales utilizando la herramienta de sometimiento correspondiente (Veeva Promomats)
• ● Colaborar con él/la Therapeutic Area Support Partner en el proceso de creación, ejecución y cierre de eventos comerciales relacionados con el AT.
• ● Colaborar y coordinar procesos con Agencias creativas y/o audiovisuales
• Cualificaciones de la posición:
• ● Educación:Cursando actualmente estudios universitarios en carreras de marketing, administración de empresas o carreras afines.
• ● Experiencia profesional: No es necesaria experiencia previa. Será una oportunidad para contribuir a la organización mientras desarrolla su experiencia y conocimientos en Marketing.
• ● Conocimientos específicos: Inglés B2/ Upper Intermediate
• Mindset y Skills esperados:
• ● Adoptar los valores de Roche: integridad, coraje y pasión
• ● Interés genuino en la gente.
• ● Iniciativa.
• ● Comunicación efectiva.
• ● Inglés intermedio - avanzado.
• Adicionalmente, se espera que el/la Disease Area Marketing Intern demuestre los Principios Operativos de Roche y contribuya al Grupo Roche.
• Los Principios Operativos de Roche son:
• ● Poner a los pacientes primero.
• ● Seguir la ciencia.
• ● Actuar como un solo equipo.
• ● Abrazar las diferencias.
• ● Acelerar el aprendizaje.
• ● Simplificar radicalmente.
• ● Generar impacto ahora.
• ● Pensar a largo plazo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Rare Blood Disorders Account & Community Manager – DC/Baltimore Ecosystem

From the beginning, Genentech has been a team of highly dedicated, passionate individuals. We are a place where people are united around a single purpose and an ambitious vision. Together, we aspire to deliver ever better health outcomes for patients while lowering overall healthcare costs. Our goal is to compel the customer to act on behalf of their patients while showing great commitment to the rare disease community, whose support is key. Utilizing innovative methods to identify patients who may benefit from treatment, we must take a highly strategic approach to patient access while assisting patients and their caregivers to navigate the healthcare system.

The Opportunity:
The RBD-ACM is a key role that focuses on understanding and addressing the needs of healthcare providers, specialty pharmacies, patients/caregivers, and patient advocacy groups. They aim to improve patient outcomes, lower costs, and enhance the quality of care. By taking ownership of their Therapeutic Area, they collaborate with stakeholders to maximize impact and improve the customer and patient experience. They provide information about products, influence the business strategy, and represent all relevant products within their area. They drive clinical demand within guidelines, ensure appropriate medication choices, and increase patient and caregiver demand for information. They gather insights, support the national strategy at a local level, and represent Genentech products ethically and professionally.

• Serve as the primary point of contact and identify opportunities for implementing ecosystem and TA squad strategies in the therapeutic area, engaging with healthcare providers, specialty pharmacies, patients/caregivers, and patient advocacy team members

• Mobilize ecosystem and organization experts to partner with customers and address their clinical, educational, and business goals, aiming for improved patient outcomes, lower costs, and enhanced quality of care

• Proactively identify and develop solutions for complex accounts within and across ecosystems, including academic, delivery network focused, and TA specialty accounts

• Deliver education to healthcare providers on product information, appropriate use, dosing and administration, based on FDA approved guidelines. Collaborate with specialty pharmacies to reinforce the value proposition of the Therapeutic Area, conduct business reviews, and identify opportunities. Provide patients/caregivers and patient advocacy group members with resources and information to empower their discussions with healthcare providers and active participation in healthcare decisions

This is a field based role, the territory will cover the Greater DC/Baltimore area including Northern VA. It is preferred that candidates live in the territory for consideration

Who you are:
Qualifications

• Business, Scientific or Clinical degree, Bachelor’s degree level at minimum

• Previous cross-functional industry experience in commercial life sciences (pharma or biotechnology) or related industry engaging with key healthcare ecosystem players (e.g., payers, health systems), is required

• 6 or more years of experience working in a sales role with HCPs, ideally representing multiple products and working across a complex healthcare system environment

• Demonstrated expertise in coaching, training, and mentoring others to help them achieve their goals and responsibilities, exceeding targets and expectations

• Strong ability to proactively seek and apply relevant information to solve complex problems, assimilate and effectively communicate clinical and product information, and address operational issues in healthcare product delivery, including reimbursement and supply. Understanding of applicable laws, codes, and company policies in the healthcare industry

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous 4-6 years of account management skills or patien

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Rari disturbi del sangue Account & Community Manager – DC/Baltimore Ecosystem Fin dall'inizio, Genentech è stato un team di individui altamente dedicati e appassionati. Siamo un luogo in cui le persone sono unite intorno a un unico scopo e una visione ambiziosa. Insieme, aspiriamo a fornire risultati di salute sempre migliori per i pazienti, riducendo al contempo i costi complessivi di assistenza sanitaria. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di costringere il cliente ad agire per conto dei loro pazienti, mostrando grande impegno per la comunità delle malattie rare, il cui sostegno è fondamentale. Utilizzando metodi innovativi per identificare i pazienti che possono beneficiare del trattamento, dobbiamo adottare un approccio altamente strategico all'accesso dei pazienti, aiutando i pazienti e i loro assistenti a navigare nel sistema sanitario. L'opportunità: Il RBD-ACM è un ruolo chiave che si concentra sulla comprensione e sull'affrontare le esigenze dei fornitori di servizi sanitari, delle farmacie speciali, dei pazienti/caregiver e dei gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti. Essi mirano a migliorare i risultati del paziente, ridurre i costi e migliorare la qualità della cura. Prendendo la proprietà del loro Area Terapeutica, collaborano con gli stakeholder per massimizzare l'impatto e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e del paziente. Essi forniscono informazioni sui prodotti, influenzano la strategia aziendale e rappresentano tutti i prodotti rilevanti all'interno della loro area. Essi guidano la domanda clinica all'interno delle linee guida, assicurano scelte farmacologiche appropriate e aumentano la domanda paziente e caregiver di informazioni. Essi raccolgono intuizioni, sostengono la strategia nazionale a livello locale, e rappresentano prodotti Genentech eticamente e professionalmente.
• Servire come punto di contatto primario e identificare le opportunità per l'attuazione di strategie di ecosistema e TA nell'area terapeutica, impegnandosi con fornitori di servizi sanitari, farmacie speciali, pazienti/caregiver e membri del team di advocacy paziente
• Mobilitare esperti di ecosistema e organizzazione per collaborare con i clienti e affrontare i loro obiettivi clinici, educativi e aziendali, mirando a migliorare i risultati dei pazienti, ridurre i costi e migliorare la qualità della cura
• Identificare e sviluppare in modo proattivo soluzioni per conti complessi all'interno e all'interno di ecosistemi, tra cui la rete accademica, messa a fuoco e TA account speciali
• Fornire istruzione ai fornitori di assistenza sanitaria sulle informazioni sui prodotti, uso appropriato, dosaggio e amministrazione, in base alle linee guida approvate dalla FDA. Collabora con farmacie speciali per rafforzare la proposizione di valore dell'Area Terapeutica, condurre recensioni aziendali e identificare le opportunità. Fornire ai membri del gruppo di advocacy pazienti/caregivers e pazienti risorse e informazioni per potenziare le loro discussioni con i fornitori di assistenza sanitaria e la partecipazione attiva alle decisioni sanitarie Si tratta di un ruolo basato sul campo, il territorio coprirà la maggiore area DC/Baltimore tra cui Northern VA. È preferito che i candidati vivono nel territorio per considerazione Chi sei: Qualifiche
• Laurea in economia, scientifica o clinica, livello di laurea al minimo
• È necessaria una precedente esperienza di settore interfunzionale nelle scienze della vita commerciale (farmaco o biotecnologia) o nell'industria in relazione con i principali operatori dell'ecosistema sanitario (ad es. finanziatori, sistemi sanitari).
• 6 o più anni di esperienza che lavorano in un ruolo di vendita con HCP, rappresentando idealmente più prodotti e lavorando in un ambiente di sistema sanitario complesso
• Competenze dimostrate nell'addestramento, nella formazione e nella mentoring degli altri per aiutarli a raggiungere i loro obiettivi e responsabilità, superando obiettivi e aspettative
• Forte capacità di cercare e applicare in modo proattivo informazioni pertinenti per risolvere problemi complessi, assimilare e comunicare efficacemente le informazioni cliniche e di prodotto, e affrontare le questioni operative nella consegna dei prodotti sanitari, compreso il rimborso e la fornitura. Comprensione di leggi, codici e politiche aziendali applicabili nel settore sanitario Preferiti:
• Precedente 4-6 anni di competenze di gestione del conto o patien
