descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Position Rare Blood Disorders Account & Community Manager – DC/Baltimore Ecosystem Von Anfang an war Genentech ein Team von hoch engagierten, leidenschaftlichen Individuen. Wir sind ein Ort, an dem Menschen um einen einzigen Zweck und eine ehrgeizige Vision vereint sind. Gemeinsam wollen wir immer bessere Gesundheitsergebnisse für Patienten liefern und gleichzeitig die Gesamtkosten für die Gesundheitsversorgung senken. Unser Ziel ist es, den Kunden dazu zu zwingen, im Namen ihrer Patienten zu handeln, während er großes Engagement für die seltene Krankheitsgemeinschaft zeigt, deren Unterstützung entscheidend ist. Durch die Verwendung innovativer Methoden zur Identifizierung von Patienten, die von der Behandlung profitieren können, müssen wir einen hochgradig strategischen Ansatz für den Patientenzugriff bei gleichzeitiger Unterstützung von Patienten und deren Pflegepersonen zur Navigation des Gesundheitssystems ergreifen. Die Gelegenheit: Der RBD-ACM ist eine zentrale Rolle, die sich auf das Verständnis und die Bewältigung der Bedürfnisse von Gesundheitsdienstleistern, Spezialapotheken, Patienten/Betreuern und Patienten-Werbungsgruppen konzentriert. Sie wollen die Patientenergebnisse verbessern, die Kosten senken und die Qualität der Pflege verbessern. Durch die Beteiligung an ihrem Therapeutischen Bereich arbeiten sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um die Auswirkungen zu maximieren und die Kunden- und Patientenerfahrung zu verbessern. Sie liefern Informationen über Produkte, beeinflussen die Geschäftsstrategie und stellen alle relevanten Produkte in ihrem Bereich dar. Sie treiben die klinische Nachfrage innerhalb von Richtlinien an, sorgen für entsprechende Medikamente und erhöhen den Bedarf an Informationen für Patienten und Pflegepersonal. Sie sammeln Erkenntnisse, unterstützen die nationale Strategie auf lokaler Ebene und stellen Genentech-Produkte ethisch und professionell dar.
• Als primärer Ansprechpartner dienen und Möglichkeiten für die Umsetzung von Ökosystem- und TA-Quadratstrategien im therapeutischen Bereich identifizieren, sich mit Gesundheitsdienstleistern, Spezialapotheken, Patienten/Karriere und Patientenvertretung Teammitgliedern beschäftigen
• Mobilisieren Sie Ökosystem- und Organisationsexperten, um mit Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten und ihre klinischen, pädagogischen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Ziele anzusprechen, um verbesserte Patientenergebnisse, geringere Kosten und verbesserte Pflegequalität zu erreichen
• Proaktiv zu identifizieren und zu entwickeln Lösungen für komplexe Konten innerhalb und außerhalb von Ökosystemen, einschließlich akademischer, konzentrierter Liefernetzwerke und TA-Spezialkonten
• Bereitstellung von Bildung an Gesundheitsdienstleister über Produktinformationen, angemessene Nutzung, Dosierung und Verwaltung, basierend auf FDA genehmigte Richtlinien. Mit Spezialapotheken zusammenarbeiten, um die Wertvorstellung des Therapeutischen Bereichs zu stärken, Unternehmensbewertungen durchzuführen und Chancen zu identifizieren. Bereitstellung von Patienten/Betreuern und Patientenvertretung Gruppenmitgliedern mit Ressourcen und Informationen, um ihre Gespräche mit Gesundheitsdienstleistern und aktive Teilnahme an Gesundheitsentscheidungen zu stärken Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle, das Gebiet wird den Greater DC/Baltimore Bereich einschließlich Northern VA decken. Es ist bevorzugt, dass Kandidaten in dem Gebiet leben, um zu berücksichtigen Wer du bist: Qualifikationen
• Business, Wissenschaftlicher oder klinischer Abschluss, Bachelor-Abschluss mindestens
• Vorherige funktionsübergreifende Branchenerfahrungen in der gewerblichen Lebenswissenschaften (Apothek oder Biotechnologie) oder in der damit verbundenen Industrie, die sich mit wichtigen Akteuren des Gesundheitswesens (z.B. Zahler, Gesundheitssysteme) befasst, sind erforderlich
• 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in einer Vertriebsrolle bei HCPs, die sich ideal für mehrere Produkte auszeichnet und über eine komplexe Gesundheitssystemumgebung arbeitet
• Gezeigtes Know-how in Coaching, Training und Mentoring anderer, um ihnen dabei zu helfen, ihre Ziele und Aufgaben zu erreichen, Ziele und Erwartungen zu übertreffen
• Starke Fähigkeit, relevante Informationen proaktiv zu suchen und anzuwenden, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen, klinische und Produktinformationen zu assimilieren und effektiv zu kommunizieren und operative Probleme in der Gesundheitsproduktlieferung, einschließlich Erstattung und Versorgung zu lösen. Verständnis der geltenden Gesetze, Codes und Unternehmenspolitiken in der Gesundheitsbranche Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Vorherige 4-6 Jahre Account Management Fähigkeiten oder Terrasse
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La position Compte sur les troubles sanguins rares et gestionnaire communautaire – écosystème DC/Baltimore Dès le début, Genentech a été une équipe de personnes très dévouées et passionnées. Nous sommes un endroit où les gens sont unis autour d'un but unique et d'une vision ambitieuse. Ensemble, nous aspirons à obtenir des résultats de santé toujours meilleurs pour les patients tout en réduisant les coûts globaux des soins de santé. Notre objectif est d'obliger le client à agir au nom de ses patients tout en montrant un grand engagement envers la communauté des maladies rares, dont le soutien est essentiel. En utilisant des méthodes novatrices pour identifier les patients susceptibles de bénéficier d'un traitement, nous devons adopter une approche hautement stratégique de l'accès des patients tout en aidant les patients et leurs soignants à naviguer dans le système de santé. La possibilité : Le RBD-ACM est un rôle clé qui vise à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des fournisseurs de soins de santé, des pharmacies spécialisées, des patients/soins et des groupes de défense des droits des patients. Ils visent à améliorer les résultats des patients, à réduire les coûts et à améliorer la qualité des soins. En s'approprier leur domaine thérapeutique, ils collaborent avec les intervenants pour maximiser l'impact et améliorer l'expérience des clients et des patients. Ils fournissent des informations sur les produits, influencent la stratégie commerciale et représentent tous les produits pertinents dans leur région. Ils conduisent la demande clinique à l'intérieur des lignes directrices, assurent des choix de médicaments appropriés et augmentent la demande d'information des patients et des soignants. Ils recueillent des idées, soutiennent la stratégie nationale au niveau local et représentent les produits Genentech de manière éthique et professionnelle.
• Servir de point de contact principal et identifier les possibilités de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'équipes d'écosystèmes et d'AT dans le domaine thérapeutique, en collaboration avec les fournisseurs de soins de santé, les pharmacies spécialisées, les patients/soins et les membres de l'équipe de défense des patients
• Mobiliser les experts de l'écosystème et de l'organisation pour qu'ils s'associent à leurs clients et s'attaquent à leurs objectifs cliniques, éducatifs et commerciaux, en vue d'améliorer les résultats des patients, de réduire les coûts et d'améliorer la qualité des soins
• Identifier et développer de manière proactive des solutions pour des comptes complexes à l'intérieur et à l'intérieur des écosystèmes, y compris des comptes spécialisés universitaires, axés sur les réseaux de prestation et des comptes spécialisés d'AT
• Offrir aux fournisseurs de soins de santé des informations sur les produits, leur utilisation, leur dosage et leur administration, sur la base des directives approuvées par la FDA. Collaborer avec les pharmacies spécialisées pour renforcer la proposition de valeur du secteur thérapeutique, effectuer des examens commerciaux et cerner les possibilités. Fournir aux patients/soins et aux membres du groupe de défense des droits des patients des ressources et des informations leur permettant de discuter avec les fournisseurs de soins de santé et de participer activement aux décisions en matière de soins de santé C'est un rôle sur le terrain, le territoire couvrira la région du Grand DC/Baltimore, y compris l'AV du Nord. Il est préférable que les candidats vivent sur le territoire pour considération Qui vous êtes : Compétences
• Diplôme d'entreprise, scientifique ou clinique, niveau de baccalauréat au minimum
• Une expérience antérieure interfonctionnelle de l'industrie des sciences de la vie commerciales (pharmacie ou biotechnologie) ou de l'industrie connexe, en collaboration avec les principaux acteurs de l'écosystème de la santé (p. ex. payeurs, systèmes de santé), est requise
• 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans un rôle de vente avec des HCP, représentant idéalement plusieurs produits et travaillant dans un environnement complexe du système de santé
• Expertise démontrée dans le coaching, la formation et le mentorat d'autres personnes pour les aider à atteindre leurs buts et leurs responsabilités, dépassant les objectifs et les attentes
• Forte capacité de rechercher et d'appliquer de façon proactive des informations pertinentes pour résoudre des problèmes complexes, assimiler et communiquer efficacement des informations cliniques et des informations sur les produits, et aborder les problèmes opérationnels liés à la livraison des produits de santé, y compris le remboursement et l'approvisionnement. Compréhension des lois, codes et politiques d'entreprise applicables dans le secteur de la santé Qualifications préférées :
• 4-6 ans de compétences en gestion de compte ou patien

jobs.title: Facilities Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping complex operations running smoothly? Roche is seeking a Facilities Specialist to serve as a key contributor to our facilities management team. You'll coordinate maintenance, manage SAP systems, supervise contractors, and be the trusted liaison between our internal customers and facilities services. If you have SAP Plant Maintenance expertise, strong customer service skills, and thrive in regulated environments, this role offers the perfect blend of technical and interpersonal challenge.

The Opportunity
Essential Job Functions & Major Contributions

• Coordinates facility repair and maintenance frequently involving the supervision of contractors. Inspects completed work for quality, compliance with local procedures and documentation for final approval. Primary liaison between internal customers and facilities management for unscheduled maintenance and projects, local personnel and equipment relocations, and small projects.

• Coordinates and supervises various contracted maintenance services that includes but is not limited to mechanical, plumbing and electrical equipment and systems. Assesses service provider performance at least annually.

• Primary or back-up SAP Plant Maintenance coordinator, adding equipment master records, functional locations, setting up maintenance plans and general equipment task lists, generating and tracking PM and maintenance orders, documenting order completion, and auditing of maintenance records and reports to ensure regulatory compliance of the maintenance program. Generates CMMS reports based on gathered metrics.

• Assist with delegating repair/service tickets to the Facilities Team

• Assists with handles invoices for review, approval, payment, and filing. Acts as the primary liaison GenMark Facilities group, service providers and Accounts Payable.

• Responsible for collection and prompt reporting of any customer service-related issues directly to the Facilities Manager or Director. Responsibilities may include preparing, tabulating, and analyzing customer satisfaction surveys related to any or all of the wide array of service provided by the group through ServiceNow.  

• Support O&M technical leads, which may include periodically performing daily rounds and on-call services

• Maintains GMP SOPs and non-GMP Facilities documents

• Trained to input SOP Change Requests

• Other tasks delegated to by the Manager

Who You Are
Education & Experience

• Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, etc.

• Minimum 2 years working experience with SAP Plant Maintenance Module software and knowledge of Archibus

• Minimum 4 years’ experience working in a customer service intensive role and /or facilities maintenance planning

• Exceptional customer service skills

• Experience working in an ISO and FDA regulated environment.

• Advanced computer skills - e.g., MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Workspace

Preferred:

• Technical/trade school specializing in electrical, plumbing or mechanical systems.

• Thorough expertise using SAP Plant Maintenance Module software, Archibus, and ServiceNow

• 6 or more years’ experience working in a relevant Facilities Management and Planning position

• Experience working with Monday.com

This position is not eligible for relocation.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $66,900 - $124,200 USD Annual. Act

jobs.title: Strategic Marketing Project Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di progetti di marketing strategico

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

• Project Undertaking and Delivery: Assist and take ownership of key projects from various teams (MWA/OMSS/CB); responsible for decomposing strategic objectives into specific action plans. Lead project progress control, resource coordination, and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.

• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.

• AI Technology Empowerment: Act as the department's AI application expert; guide and assist product groups in building AI-based product management tools and intelligent workflows to drive digital transformation. Precisely identify business pain points within the ML department; develop and promote AI solutions to enhance the quality and efficiency of content generation.

• Team Productivity Enhancement: Leverage AI technology to deeply optimize internal approval processes, online operating systems, and user-facing business material preparation, significantly reducing the time investment of Product Managers in repetitive and administrative tasks.

• Large-scale Event Management: Oversee the planning and execution of major internal and external conferences (both online and offline) and brand promotion activities; responsible for vendor management and on-site operations.

• Omni-channel Media Operations: Optimize and maintain departmental marketing communication channels (e.g., WeChat, webinar platforms, and 3rd party professional media); ensure published content is highly aligned with corporate branding and compliance requirements.

• Vendor and Budget Management: Manage vendors to ensure projects meet departmental KPIs and compliance policies; monitor project implementation and strictly control budgets following the ROI principle.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Biological Engineering, Marketing, Business Management, or a related discipline.

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Deep expertise in AI application tools (e.g., LLMs, Workflow Automation) and digital marketing; ability to translate business needs into technical AI solutions.

• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.

• At least 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Kottayam)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager (Individual Contributor) based in Kottayam , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Kottayam territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead (Associate Principal)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Operations Lead

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Business Operations Lead , you serve as a strategic and tactical partner to the Functional Leadership team, driving strategy and goals in alignment with Site and Network objectives. You are a multi-discipline professional representing the Site Business Support group, working collaboratively to drive excellence in project portfolio management, change leadership, and operational excellence. You play a key role in deploying site-wide business processes and leading strategic projects, such as product technical transfers and business programs. You push boundaries to enable a continuous improvement mindset and implement lean practices that result in quick and efficient innovation.

Your Opportunity

• Functional Partnership & Excellence: You drive business results by facilitating functional goal development using lean strategy tools. You manage the functional project portfolio process, leading prioritization to ensure alignment with resource management and business timelines.

• Operational Excellence (OE) Deployment: You act as a strong advocacy and change agent for Lean/OE to build a strong continuous improvement culture. You lead process improvement activities to realize productivity outcomes and coach improvement projects to achieve functional goals.

• Organizational Change Management (OCM): You develop and implement effective change management programs to drive execution excellence. You lead site-wide initiatives to build OCM business processes and change leadership capabilities at both leadership and individual levels.

• Program & Project Management: You provide leadership for site-wide initiatives, including CAPEX and Product Technical Transfers. You ensure due diligence is performed to mitigate risks to safety, quality, compliance, and delivery.

• Coaching & Capability Building: You act as a coach for colleagues, helping them develop skills in project management and change leadership methodologies. You serve as a subject matter expert on continuous improvement methods and tools.

• Communication & Safety: You manage functional communications in line with the site plan, ensuring impactful content and timing. You ensure a safe working environment by complying with all Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements and site security measures.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.

• Experienced Professional: You have a minimum of 8 years of related working experience, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment.

• Project Expert: You possess a proven track record of at least 5 years managing small to medium-scale projects of varying complexity. PMP certification is preferred.

• Technical Specialist : You have essential competencies in Project Portfolio and Program Management, and you are a certified Black Belt in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.

• Change Leader: You have experience leading change initiatives on local, regional, or global levels and are familiar with industry change management standards such as PROSCI .

• Strategic Influencer: You possess excellent verbal and written

jobs.title: RWD Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Strategic planning
● Shape and influence strategy for complex evidence generation deliveries and cross-functional projects
● Lead and/or support evidence generation strategy/plan setting up as critical component of local integrated evidence plan for multiple portfolio and pipeline products across therapeutic areas
● Provide epidemiological inputs with solid understanding of strategic business context in the medical planning process across therapeutic areas
Implementation
● Lead the RWD project/studies design, analyses and interpretation.
● Map / license RWD sources and build research collaborations to increase the availability of fit - for - purpose RWD.
● Implement the RWE plan and execute RWE projects timely in close collaboration with cross - functional partners.
● Identify and implement scientifically innovative RWE programs that can support to address business needs and overcome key challenges in drug development using RWD or enable to provide meaningful RWE in support of regulatory decision making (e.g. label changes, new indications), payer decision making and clinical practice.
Communication
● Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying internal and external stakeholders in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance
● Communicate scientifically and develop/maintain KOL network in medical/clinical community to ensure appropriate academic consultation/support and address the varying evidence requirements of stakeholders
● Lead the development of new and innovative partnerships with external stakeholders across healthcare ecosystems to co - design and execute innovative study designs and implementation science that address pre identified evidence needs.
Development
● Act as a coach, mentor or consult to provide technical expertise on the RWE/epidemiology basics and internal/external trainings.
● Serve as franchise / division level RWE lead to ensure a broad understanding of the value of RWE to the product value demonstration both locally and globally.
● Maintain process standards across the therapeutic areas according to Roche SOPs, China CDE requirements and GPP guidelines with regard to pharmacoepidemiology

Qualification and Experience
● Education/Qualifications
- Master degree or above in the epidemiology, biostatistics, public health or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in designing, implementation and report of epidemiology/observational studies
- Working experiences as real world data scientist/epidemiologist in multinational pharmaceutical company or Clinical Research Organization, experience in oncology studies will be plus
● Leadership Competencies
Ability to work effectively in a matrix team
● Job Required Competencies
- Expert knowledge of epidemiology/observational methodologies and applications
- Previous experience as a key RWD scientist or lead epidemiologist
- Good knowledge of statistical programming skill (including SAS programming)
- Strong communication skills and ability to work both, independently and collaboratively, as required
- Demonstrated project management skills is strongly preferred
- Business acumen
- Be able to handle technical discussion in fluent English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to health

Communication ● Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying internal and external stakeholders in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance ● Communicate scientifically and develop/maintain KOL network in medical/clinical community to ensure appropriate academic consultation/support and address the varying evidence requirements of stakeholders ● Lead the development of new and innovative partnerships with external stakeholders across healthcare ecosystems to co - design and execute innovative study designs and implementation science that address pre identified evidence needs. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love
Your Opportunity ​

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products)

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• Responsible to report incident/accident immediately to SHE department. Attend / complete all requisite on-line and F2F trainings (Role specific, Safety Responsibility and Compliance) within specified time limit to ensure the learning outcome after the training has been implemented.

• Responsible to own the SHE goals as individual goals and play his/her part to achieve the goal in line with strategies/action plan.

• Identifies, collects and immediately reports all safety related information on Roche products to Local

• Safety Responsible as per Roche requirements and local regulations.

• Responsible for maintenance of records (electronic and physical as per the Local Core Map policy.

• Any other duties that maybe assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Who you are
EDUCATION

• Science degree ( Pharm D / Dentistry will be an added advantage)

• Business Degree is a plus

EXPERIENCE & KNOWLEDGE

• Minimum 3 years of relevant therapeutic area experience

• Consistent track record of achieving objectives, collaboration and team work

• Experience in agile ways of working is a plus

• Cross functional experience

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience

• excellence.

• Growth mindset

• Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling

• engagement at the specialist level.

• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on

• future-based solutions.

• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders.

Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. We strive for excellence and extraordinary results and take a genuine interest in our people and their well-being, and our patients.

Take pride in knowing you can make a difference to millions of patients worldwide in developing diagnostics and treatments for oncology, neuroscience, inflammation, immunology, ophthalmology, rare disease

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Would you like to start your professional career in the healthcare industry with a biotech leading company? We are looking for "early-in-career" colleague to join our team.
The role is based in Kaunas, Lithuania and up to 12-months assignment.

If you are a recent graduate from University Degree or you are enrolled in a Master/Postgraduate degree in business discipline, this could be a great opportunity for you.

What you can learn?

You would provide support directly to the Head of Customer Support and Service, who is leading the Roche Customer service and support and will share with you best practices, tools and build your skills for succeeding in a career. Kick-start your career with Roche! You'll gain hands-on experience in using cutting-edge digital tools. You'll also learn valuable project management skills in a dynamic international setting, working alongside diverse stakeholders and using agile methodologies like SCRUM and SAFe. Based in Kaunas, Lithuania, you'll be part of a multidisciplinary and multicultural team and receive mentorship from the Head of Service and Customer support, who will share insights and help you build a successful career.

Main projects and tasks:

Office Support & Facilities Coordinator

• Office equipment and premises maintenance coordination

• Workshop hygiene, cleaning coordination

• Office food, coffee and supplies coordination

Returns, replacements and decontamination of near patient care devices

• Manage device return from patients

• Manage device replacements to patients and closely collaborate with Supply Chain team

• Manage device decontamination and preparations for a return to centralized location

• Document all returns, replacements and decontamination activities in the system

Indirect Procurement Invoices management

• Upload invoices to the system in a timely manner

• Proactively follow up and communicate with colleagues to approve invoices on time

• Proactively collaborate with accounting team on resolving invoices management issues

Support Service team

• Implementation and coordination of service team projects & events

• Coordinate products transfer from/to workshop

• Coordinate shipments deliveries to workshop

• Prepare, collect signatures and archive instruments handover acts

• Coordinate and manage various activities for asset monitoring (physical checking at customer site, signatures collection, documents archiving, but not limited)

• Proactively follow up service team certifications training matrix, collect signatures and archive certificates

• Proactively coordinate service tools certification and closely collaborate with the team for tools calibration

• Support the service team with customer contact, instrument and asset management in the data management system.

Who You Are:

• Recent graduate from a university degree or master's program

• Prior project management exposure, with the ability to manage multiple timelines and priorities

• Strong collaboration and communication skills

• Ability to prioritize and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail

• Fluency in English and Lithuanian language

Salary: 1200-1500 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of skills and experience.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result i

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理

• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant - German speaking (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role until the end of 2028.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and German

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum im Project Portfolio Management mit Schwerpunkt IT-Architektur & KI-Anwendungen (m/w/d)

Möchten Sie die Zukunft des Project Portfolio Managements mitgestalten und innovative KI-Lösungen entwickeln? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Wer wir sind:
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg (DOZ) ist der zweitgrößte Produktionsstandort innerhalb Roche Global Operations und Rohstofflieferant für die gesamte Diagnostics Division. Als führender Hersteller für biologische und chemische Einsatzstoffe ist DOZ ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt im weltweiten Roche Netzwerk.

Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n Praktikanten/in, die/der unser Team im Bereich Project Portfolio Management (PPM) verstärkt. In dieser spannenden Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT-Architektur und der Implementierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz, um unsere Projektmanagementprozesse zu optimieren und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Wenn Sie begeistert vom Projektmanagement und der Steuerung eines großen Projektportfolios sind, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung einer zukunftsweisenden IT-Architektur für das Project Portfolio Management: Sie helfen uns dabei, eine skalierbare und effiziente Architektur zu konzipieren, die den Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Projektlandschaft gerecht wird.

• Identifizierung und Evaluierung von Potenzialen für den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen im PPM: Sie recherchieren und bewerten innovative KI-Lösungen, die zur Verbesserung von Prognosen, Ressourcenplanung, Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung im Projektportfolio eingesetzt werden können.

• Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) für ausgewählte KI-Anwendungen: Sie sind aktiv an der Umsetzung erster Prototypen beteiligt, um die Machbarkeit und den Mehrwert von KI-basierten Lösungen zu demonstrieren.

• Analyse von Projektmanagement-Daten zur Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen: Sie unterstützen uns bei der Datenanalyse, um Engpässe und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in unseren bestehenden PPM-Prozessen zu identifizieren.

• Dokumentation von Prozessen, Architekturen und Best Practices: Sie tragen zur Erstellung und Pflege relevanter Dokumentationen bei, um Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung des Teams im Tagesgeschäft des Project Portfolio Managements: Sie erhalten Einblicke in die täglichen Abläufe und unterstützen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Ihr Profil:

• Immatrikulierte/r Student/in der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.

• Hohe Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung .

• Begeisterung für Projektmanagement oder erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt- oder Portfoliomanagement.

• Interesse an IT-Architektur und Faszination für KI sowie Bereitschaft, sich in neue Technologien

• Analytische, problemlösungsorientierte Denkweise und der Wunsch, Herausforderungen aktiv anzunehmen .

• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, gute Kommunikation und Teamgeist.

• Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Einblicke in die spannende Welt des Project Portfolio Managements und der KI-Entwicklung in einem d

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：（高级）治疗领域专员

您是谁：
（高级）治疗领域专员是公司与相应疾病领域医生的主要接触点,发掘和管理内外部资源,通过各种学术活动、推广或非推广活动把罗氏的专业知识、科学和技术、产品关键信息带入生态系统,准确及时的传达给客户,并与客户和合作伙伴共同发现潜在的合作机会,以改善对患者旅程的影响,实现患者最终获益。

您的机会：
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士(HCP)观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

计划管理
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2.了解医生观念、需求、会议安排;制定会议及覆盖计划;执行会议计划;回访收集反馈

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变,实现规范化诊疗

jobs.title: Team Lead, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz

titleByLocale.it: Capo Team, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee-facing products, services, and experiences within RDT, delivering digital tools and support to empower our workforce globally. Within WE, the Onsite Enablement organization acts as the heartbeat of our physical presence, serving as the bridge between digital strategy and local execution. We ensure that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. Our ultimate mission is to provide a frictionless workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
As the Team Lead for RDT Onsite Services in Rotkreuz (Engineering Manager), a role requiring your presence five days a week on-site, you will be accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high-quality offering for our employees. You will focus on developing your team members' capabilities, encouraging them to self-define their career journeys while supporting them by removing roadblocks and setting clear performance goals. By fostering healthy dynamics, a sustainable pace, and the right skill sets, you will oversee a team of individual contributors to lead software and service delivery, manage stakeholders, and create efficiencies in collaboration to ensure onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and an optimal user experience.

The Opportunity

• Team Development & Culture: Proactively identify future-focused capabilities, oversee technical and soft skill development (including emotional intelligence), and mentor team members on their career paths while fostering a culture of radical candor, accountability, and psychological safety.

• Health, Sustainability & Change Leadership: Establish team health metrics, design initiatives to improve collaboration, resolve complex systemic impediments, and guide distributed, multi-time-zone teams through organizational shifts, site transitions, or critical system failures while maintaining morale and operational consistency.

• Product Vision & Service Delivery: Co-create the long-term technical vision for the product portfolio, ensure successful delivery and feature shipment, manage technical priorities and dependencies, and ensure deliverables align with both local business needs and global standards.

• Performance & Process Optimization: Define success metrics, lead significant process re-engineering efforts spanning multiple development teams to create step-change improvements, and present technical insights and optimization strategies to senior leadership.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the team's budget, headcount planning, operational costs (OPEX), infrastructure upgrades (CAPEX), and vendor contracts to ensure maximum ROI, while supporting business cases for large initiatives and optimizing resource allocation across projects.

• Stakeholder Management & Influence: Manage relationships with senior-level stakeholders, translate complex IT requirements into business value for site heads, negotiate priorities, and tactically shield the team from scope creep while breaking down organizational silos.

• Cross-Functional Enablement: Empower teams to act autonomously, drive initiatives to improve engineering processes, manage the talent pipeline for future needs, and resolve cross-functional roadblocks blocking agile release trains or program teams.

Who You Are

• Experienced Leader: You bring 10+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：治疗领域经理 - 乳腺治疗领域 - 宁波

主要职责：
1、专业学术推广（核心）

- 精通产品药理、适应症、用法用量、不良反应、循证数据、临床指南、医保政策，合规传递产品临床价值
- 日常科室拜访、组织科室会/区域学术会/病例分享，提升医生认知与处方量
- 解答临床用药疑问，跟进用药反馈，提供全流程学术支持

2、区域市场&客户管理

- 负责指定医院/科室开发、进院上量、库存与处方管控，维护主任、主治、药师关键客情
- 建立完善客户档案，规划高频拜访，深耕重点专家，拓展潜力客户
- 跟进药品准入、招标、集采、院端政策落地

3、销售目标达成

- 拆解年度/月度销量、覆盖率、增长指标，制定区域推广计划，闭环追单上量
- 监控处方走势、竞品冲击，及时调整策略，保障业绩达标
- 协同供应链保障供货，处理断货、退换货、临床突发问题

4、市场情报&合规风控

- 收集竞品价格、打法、销量、政策变动、医保集采动态，定期上报分析报告
- 严格遵守医药备案制、反不正当竞争、两票制、集采合规，杜绝带金、夸大宣传
- 及时上报药品不良反应，规范CRM录入、费用核销、拜访留痕，全程合规可追溯

5、内部协同与复盘

- 配合大区、医学、市场部落地全国策略、学术活动与培训考核
- 定期周报/月报复盘业绩、问题、动作，协同上级协同拜访、新人带教
- 持续参加产品、合规、学术培训，保持专业能力更新

任职要求

1. 学历：大专及以上，医学、药学、临床、生物相关优先
2. 经验：1–3年医院RX医药销售经验，熟悉本地医院/科室生态优先
3. 能力：临床沟通、学术表达、客情维护、数据复盘、抗压执行力强
4. 素养：极强合规意识、责任心强、自律、能长期外勤出差
5. 持证：医药代表备案优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Luxembourg
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Belgium & Luxembourg is seeking an individual to join the Customer Engagement Chapter as a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) for LUXEMBOURG (GDL) to drive value for patients, the ecosystem and Roche. In this role, you'll generate actionable customer insights and position Roche’s products to deliver better patient outcomes.

We are offering an incredible opportunity for an experienced, strategic and patient-centric professional to join our team as a Patient Journey Partner in Oncology. This is a field-based role where you will actively engage with stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to generate insights and position Roche’s products to drive value for patients, healthcare professionals and Roche.

If you are passionate about patient care, reaching ambitious goals and being at the heart of innovation in healthcare, join us to make a meaningful impact !

Your impact

As a PJP in Oncology for LUXEMBOURG, you will be the catalyst for change in the oncology patient journey, bridging the gap between Roche’s innovative treatments and the evolving needs of patients and healthcare professionals.

Your key responsibilities:

• Gather and share stakeholder insights and advocate the appropriate use of Roche’s products

• Influence strategy and tactical omnichannel engagement plans based on customer insights

• Ensure compliance with the Roche Code of Conduct and local regulations

Who you are
Mindset :

• Competitive mindset, embracing an entrepreneurial spirit, we seize opportunities, adapt swiftly and continuously improve to achieve commercial excellence with pride in who we are.

• Collaboration mindset, which shows valorisation of diverse perspectives and mutual respect while challenging each other and leveraging complementary skills with clear accountability.

• Customer-Centric mindset, putting customers and the patients at the heart of everything we do, and at the core of our strategic decision making.

• Curiosity mindset, being intentional learners fueled by curiosity to grow and adapt. We take purposeful actions to drive meaningful change aligned with Roche business outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills & Qualifications :

• Deep understanding of patient journeys and treatments in oncology

• Broad understanding of Roche's portfolio

• Strong communication and consultative persuasion skills

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and partnership abilities

• Fluent in French and proficient in English

• Connections and knowledge of the market in LUXEMBOURG

• Display integrity in everything they do

We expect you to live close to or in Luxembourg (GDL).

Why Roche ?

We are an open and inclusive organization undergoing continuous development. This creates an exciting dynamic full of opportunities. We invest in the growth and development of our colleagues, including you. We do not define your career path; instead, we recognize that it varies for each individual. We encourage you to actively shape your development, and we will support and guide you in this journey.

Discover more about Roche in Belgium and follow us on LinkedIn .

What we offer

• A dynamic and market-leading company with national and international opportunities

• A great place to work, have fun, and make a meaningful impact on patient lives

• A people-centered agile work environment where autonomy and decision-making are valued

• A culture of diversity and inclusion, where you can be your authentic self

• Opportunities for personal and professional development

Who we are
A healthier future drive

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

jobs.title: Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il gruppo di analisi e flussi di lavoro all'interno del Centro di eccellenza (CoE) è dedicato a trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili che anticipano la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Ci avvaliamo di tecnologie all'avanguardia ad alto rendimento e modelli di machine learning multimodali fondamentali per analizzare i dati chimici e biologici su larga scala, consentendo una comprensione più approfondita del comportamento molecolare e l'identificazione di nuove opportunità terapeutiche. Nonostante i progressi in questi campi, tuttavia, la trasformazione dei dati grezzi e dei modelli computazionali in insight significativi rimane una sfida chiave. In questo ruolo, lavorerai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della chimica medica e dell'ingegneria per costruire strumenti analitici innovativi che colmano il divario tra la generazione dei dati e l'interpretazione, aiutando a sbloccare nuovi viali per la scoperta scientifica e l'impatto. L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) per progettare e costruire strumenti interattivi per la scoperta della droga di piccole molecole, con una particolare attenzione ai dati chimici, ai flussi di lavoro di progettazione molecolare e all'interpretazione del modello. Potrai modellare la direzione tecnica e del prodotto di piattaforme che permettono ai chimici medicinali e computazionali di esplorare i dati, le ipotesi di test e progettare farmaci migliori. Questo ruolo è fullstack, con una forte enfasi sulla visualizzazione dei dati scientifici, la progettazione del flusso di lavoro e l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali. Il successo sarà misurato non solo dalla consegna tecnica, ma dall'impatto su come gli scienziati progettano e valutano i candidati alla piccola molecola. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà:
• Collaborare direttamente con chimici medicinali, cheminformatici e scienziati dell'IA per comprendere i flussi di lavoro di progettazione e analisi molecolari del mondo reale, comprese le esigenze ambigue o in evoluzione.
• Progettazione e costruzione di piattaforme end-to-end: interfaccia front-end, servizi backend e integrazioni dei dati, che permettono agli scienziati di eseguire analisi, esplorare i dati e interpretare le uscite dei modelli.
• Conducendo lo sviluppo di esperienze utente intuitive ed estensibili per complessi flussi di lavoro scientifici, con un focus sulla visualizzazione interattiva, l'usabilità e la fedeltà scientifica.
• Architettare e implementare API, modelli di dati e servizi che supportano applicazioni scalabili, ad alta intensità di dati, tra cui l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali e sistemi di machine learning.
• Valutazione e applicazione delle tecnologie emergenti (inclusi gli strumenti di sviluppo assistiti dall'IA) per accelerare l'iterazione, esplorando nuovi approcci allo scient
