descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerischen Wissenschaften verwandeln die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das neue Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, diese transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern in pRED und GRED zu helfen, innovativere und transformative Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Die Gruppe Analytics und Workflows im Center of Excellence (CoE) widmet sich dem Umsetzen komplexer Daten in handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse, die die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Wir nutzen modernste High-Throughput-Technologien und grundlegende multimodale maschinelle Lernmodelle, um groß angelegte chemische und biologische Daten zu analysieren, um ein tieferes Verständnis des molekularen Verhaltens und die Identifizierung neuer therapeutischer Möglichkeiten zu ermöglichen. Trotz Fortschritten in diesen Bereichen bleibt jedoch die Umwandlung von Rohdaten und Rechenmodellen in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse eine zentrale Herausforderung. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Datenwissenschaft, medizinischer Chemie und Ingenieurwissenschaften, um innovative analytische Werkzeuge zu bauen, die die Lücke zwischen Datenerzeugung und Interpretation überbrücken und neue Wege für wissenschaftliche Entdeckung und Wirkung entsperren. Die Chance Wir suchen einen Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack), um interaktive Werkzeuge für die Entdeckung von Kleinmolekülen zu entwerfen und zu bauen, mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf chemischen Daten, molekularen Design-Workflows und Modellinterpretationsfähigkeit. Sie werden die technische und Produktrichtung von Plattformen prägen, die es medizinischen und rechnerischen Chemikern ermöglichen, Daten zu erforschen, Hypothesen zu testen und bessere Medikamente zu entwickeln. Diese Rolle steht in vollem Zusammenhang mit der wissenschaftlichen Datenvisualisierung, dem Workflow-Design und der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines. Der Erfolg wird nicht nur durch technische Lieferung gemessen, sondern durch die Auswirkungen auf die Gestaltung und Bewertung von Kleinmolekülkandidaten. Ihre Arbeit beinhaltet:
• direkt mit medizinischen Chemikern, Cheminformatikern und KI-Wissenschaftlern zusammenarbeiten, um reale molekulare Design- und Analyse-Workflows zu verstehen, einschließlich mehrdeutiger oder sich entwickelnder Bedürfnisse.
• Entwicklung und Aufbau von End-to-End-Plattformen – die sich über Frontend-Schnittstellen, Backend-Dienste und Datenintegrationen erstrecken – die es Wissenschaftlern ermöglichen, Analysen durchzuführen, Daten zu erforschen und Modellausgänge zu interpretieren.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung intuitiver, erweiterbarer Benutzererlebnisse für komplexe wissenschaftliche Workflows, mit Fokus auf interaktive Visualisierung, Usability und wissenschaftliche Treue.
• Erstellung und Implementierung von APIs, Datenmodellen und Dienstleistungen, die skalierbare, datenintensive Anwendungen unterstützen, einschließlich der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines und maschinellen Lernsystemen.
• Bewertung und Anwendung von aufstrebenden Technologien (einschließlich AI-gestützter Entwicklungstools) zur Beschleunigung der Iteration und Erkundung neuer Ansätze für Scient
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès dans l'IA, les données et les sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, en tirant parti des données et des nouveaux modèles de calcul pour stimuler l'impact. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le nouveau Centre d'Excellence des Sciences Computationnelles (CdE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est de tirer parti de cette puissance transformatrice de données et d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques en pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et transformatifs pour les patients du monde entier. Le groupe Analytics and Workflows au sein du Centre d'excellence (CdE) se consacre à transformer des données complexes en idées concrètes qui favorisent la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Nous mettons à profit des technologies de pointe à haut débit et des modèles d'apprentissage de machines multimodales fondamentales pour analyser les données chimiques et biologiques à grande échelle, permettant une meilleure compréhension du comportement moléculaire et l'identification de nouvelles opportunités thérapeutiques. Toutefois, malgré les progrès réalisés dans ces domaines, la transformation des données brutes et des modèles de calcul en données probantes demeure un défi majeur. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la chimie médicinale et de l'ingénierie pour construire des outils analytiques novateurs qui comblent l'écart entre la production de données et l'interprétation, aidant à débloquer de nouvelles pistes de découverte scientifique et d'impact. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur scientifique principal (Fullstack) pour concevoir et construire des outils interactifs pour la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en mettant l'accent sur les données chimiques, les workflows de conception moléculaire et l'interprétation des modèles. Vous façonnerez la direction technique et produit des plates-formes qui permettent aux chimistes médicaux et calculateurs d'explorer les données, de tester les hypothèses et de concevoir de meilleurs médicaments. Ce rôle est complet, l'accent étant mis sur la visualisation des données scientifiques, la conception des flux de travail et l'intégration avec les pipelines informatiques. Le succès sera mesuré non seulement par l'exécution technique, mais aussi par l'impact sur la façon dont les scientifiques conçoivent et évaluent les candidats aux petites molécules. Votre travail comprendra :
• Établir des partenariats directs avec des chimistes, des chimistes et des scientifiques de l'IA pour comprendre les processus de conception moléculaire et d'analyse du monde réel, y compris les besoins ambigus ou en évolution.
• Concevoir et construire des plates-formes de bout en bout, des interfaces front-end, des services de backend et des intégrations de données, qui permettent aux scientifiques d'effectuer des analyses, d'explorer des données et d'interpréter les résultats des modèles.
• Diriger le développement d'expériences utilisateur intuitives et extensibles pour des workflows scientifiques complexes, en mettant l'accent sur la visualisation interactive, la convivialité et la fidélité scientifique.
• Architecte et mise en œuvre d'API, de modèles de données et de services qui prennent en charge des applications évolutives et à forte intensité de données, y compris l'intégration avec des pipelines de calcul et des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique.
• Évaluer et appliquer les nouvelles technologies (y compris les outils de développement assistés par l'IA) pour accélérer l'itération, tout en explorant de nouvelles approches de la science

jobs.title: Medical Monitor (MD)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Our Clinical Development team has a fantastic opportunity for a (Lead) Clinical Director to join the neurology franchise to support late-stage clinical studies.

This position offers a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in advancing the clinical development of Trontinemab , the first anti-amyloid antibody in trials to use brain-shuttle technology to treat Alzheimer’s disease.

In this role you will:

• Supports the clinical development strategy for one or more late-stage (Phase II–III) trials in Alzheimer’s disease

• Drive clinical trial design and execution, ensuring scientific rigor, ethical integrity, and clear regulatory alignment

• Provide medical monitoring for ongoing studies and ensure patient safety and data quality

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including regulatory, clinical operations, safety, biomarkers, biostats, and early research

• Mentor and coach Clinical Scientists within the team

• Engage with external stakeholders such as advisory boards, key investigators, and health authorities

• Contribute to scientific publications and lead Roche’s presence in neurology through key conferences and community engagement

• Provide clinical input to earlier-stage programs to strengthen Roche’s neuroscience pipeline

Who You Are

You are a mission-driven medical leader who combines scientific expertise with strategic thinking. You bring:

• An MD or MD/PhD , with clinical training in neurology or dementia, preferably with deep expertise in Alzheimer’s disease

• Solid clinical research experience , including leadership in trial design and execution (preferably in the pharmaceutical industry)

• A solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle , from early-phase studies to post-marketing

• A proven track record of scientific impact , demonstrated through publications, presentations, or advisory contributions

• Exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence across a matrixed, cross-functional environment

• A passion for innovation and collaborative problem-solving , always with the patient at the centre

If you're excited by the opportunity to contribute to pioneering science with a direct impact on patients, apply now and help us to do now what patients need next!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Lt

• Fornire un monitoraggio medico per gli studi in corso e garantire la sicurezza e la qualità dei dati dei pazienti
• Collaborare con team interfunzionali tra cui le operazioni normative, cliniche, sicurezza, biomarcatori, biostat e ricerca precoce
• Mentore e allenatore Scienziati Clinici all'interno del team
• Impegnarsi con parti interessate esterne come consiglieri, investigatori chiave e autorità sanitarie
• Contribuire alle pubblicazioni scientifiche e condurre la presenza di Roche in neurologia attraverso conferenze chiave e impegno comunitario
• Fornire input clinici ai programmi precedenti per rafforzare la pipeline di neuroscienze di Roche Chi sei Sei un leader medico guidato dalla missione che combina competenze scientifiche con il pensiero strategico. Tu porti:
• Un MD o MD/PhD , con formazione clinica in neurologia o demenza, preferibilmente con profonda esperienza nella malattia di Alzheimer
• Solida esperienza di ricerca clinica, compresa la leadership nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di prove (preferibilmente nell'industria farmaceutica)
• Una solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del farmaco, dagli studi di prima fase al post-marketing
• Un comprovato record di impatto scientifico, dimostrato attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni o contributi consultivi
• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di influenzare in un ambiente matrixed e cross-functional
• Una passione per l'innovazione e la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi, sempre con il paziente al centro Se sei emozionato dall'opportunità di contribuire alla scienza pionieristica con un impatto diretto sui pazienti, applica ora e aiutaci a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Le dichiarazioni di cui sopra sono destinate a descrivere la natura generale e il livello di lavoro che vengono eseguiti dai dipendenti, e non devono essere interpretate come un elenco esaustivo di responsabilità, doveri e competenze richieste dal personale così classificato. Inoltre, essi non stabiliscono un contratto di lavoro e sono soggetti a modifiche a discrezione di Roche Products Lt

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Chance Unser Klinisches Entwicklungsteam hat eine fantastische Gelegenheit für einen (Lead-)Klinischen Direktor, sich der Neurologie-Franchise anzuschließen, um klinische Studien in der Spätphase zu unterstützen. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung der klinischen Entwicklung von Trontinemab zu spielen, der erste Anti-Amyloid-Antikörper in Versuchen, um Gehirn-Shuttle-Technologie zur Behandlung der Alzheimer-Krankheit zu verwenden. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Unterstützt die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie für eine oder mehrere Spätstadien (Phase II–III)-Studien bei der Alzheimer-Krankheit
• Führen Sie die klinische Studienplanung und -durchführung aus, um wissenschaftliche Strenge, ethische Integrität und klare regulatorische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten
• Bereitstellung einer medizinischen Überwachung für laufende Studien und Sicherstellung der Patientensicherheit und Datenqualität
• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, einschließlich regulatorischer, klinischer Operationen, Sicherheit, Biomarker, Biostaten und Frühforschung
• Mentor und Coach Klinische Wissenschaftler im Team
• Mit externen Akteuren wie Beratungsräten, zentralen Ermittlern und Gesundheitsbehörden vertraut zu machen
• Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und führender Roche-Präsenz in der Neurologie durch wichtige Konferenzen und Gemeinschaftsengagements
• Bereitstellung von klinischen Input für frühere Programme zur Stärkung der Neurowissenschaften-Pipeline von Roche Wer bist du? Sie sind ein missionsgetriebener medizinischer Leiter, der wissenschaftliche Expertise mit strategischem Denken verbindet. Sie bringen:
• Ein MD oder MD/PhD mit klinischer Ausbildung in der Neurologie oder Demenz, vorzugsweise mit tiefem Know-how in der Alzheimer-Krankheit
• Solide klinische Forschungserfahrung, einschließlich Führung in der Versuchsplanung und -durchführung (vorzugsweise in der Pharmaindustrie)
• Ein solides Verständnis des Lebenszyklus für die Drogenentwicklung, von Studien in der Frühphase bis zur Nachvermarktung
• Erprobter Überblick über wissenschaftliche Auswirkungen, der durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen oder beratende Beiträge nachgewiesen wird
• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einer Matrix zu beeinflussen, funktionsübergreifende Umgebung
• Leidenschaft für Innovation und kollaborative Problemlösung, immer mit dem Patienten im Zentrum Wenn Sie von der Möglichkeit begeistert sind, mit direktem Einfluss auf die Patienten zur Pionier-Wissenschaft beizutragen, wenden Sie sich jetzt an und helfen uns, jetzt zu tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Welwyn. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Die hier dargelegten Aussagen sollen die allgemeine Art und das Ausmaß der Arbeit beschreiben, die von den Arbeitnehmern geleistet wird, und sind nicht als eine vollständige Liste von Verantwortlichkeiten, Pflichten und Fähigkeiten zu verstehen, die von den so klassifizierten Mitarbeitern benötigt werden. Darüber hinaus stellen sie keinen Arbeitsvertrag fest und können sich nach Ermessen von Roche Products Lt ändern

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position At Roche, we believe that it is urgently necessary to provide medical solutions immediately – while at the same time we are researching innovations for the future. We are passionate about improving the lives of patients, and we are brave in our decisions and actions. We are convinced that good business means a better world. Responsibilities You're expecting
• The management and support of regulatory strategies for global IVD/MD instrument & software approvals, in particular in the field of multi-labor automation.
• Ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements and standards.
• Cooperation with cross-functional teams (such as R&E, Quality and Clinical Research) to promote regulatory initiatives.
• Providing expert advice to support product development and lifecycle management.
• The continuous monitoring of regulatory trends and updates as well as the implementation of best practices. Qualifications | That brings you
• A successfully completed Bachelor degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs or a related field.
• 5 to 10 years of professional experience in Regulatory Affairs (Regulatorics, R&E, Quality and/or Clinical Research), ideally with first experience in healthcare.
• Knowledge of global regulatory requirements, guidelines and procedures, in particular for IVD instruments & software.
• Strong organizational skills and communication skills.
• The ability to effectively control several projects at the same time.
• A self-motivated procedure that allows you to act in a responsible environment.
• Experience in the development of IVD instruments and/or software, ideally in the field of laboratory automation. So good? It's better. Here our TOP 5 BENEFITS for you at Mannheim location
• Long-term account (in the case of an indefinite contract): Roche offers you the opportunity to add a part of your fee to a long-term account in order to be able to use it to finance exemptions during the working life (e.g. for a period of time, training, etc.) or for a moving transition to retirement.
• Precautionary Plan 2007: With the “Precautionary Plan 2007” Roche offers an additional income in old age in addition to statutory pension insurance. From the 62nd birthday you can choose free when you want to receive your old-age pension.
• Work-Life Balance: As a leading healthcare company, we know that a culture that writes Work Life Balance and Health is the key to success.
• Language courses, risk protection, childcare facilities, childcare allowance and internal training opportunities are just some of the many other benefits that will await you.
• Attractiveness of the location: Mannheim is the second largest city in Baden-Württemberg and in the heart of the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan region. Attractive cultural and leisure activities, a variety of international restaurants, numerous cafés and parks and green areas are waiting to be explored by you! Please also look at our Benefits brochure. Further information about us as an employer and your development opportunities can be found on our career page Your contact to us! With people. For people. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Data Center Network Engineer (d/f/m)
Introduction At Roche, we believe that every voice matters, and we invite you to bring your unique perspective to our team. As a Senior Data Center Network Engineer, you will join a culture of technical excellence, architecting resilient, high-performance infrastructures that empower our global mission. You will act as a technical expert, leveraging advanced automation to solve critical business challenges and drive our digital evolution.
The Opportunity:

• Architect Scalable Networks: Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of "first-time-right" network solutions, specifically focusing on Spine-Leaf topologies and L2/L3 fabrics.

• Drive Technical Leadership: Act as a Solution Architect for large initiatives, managing resource estimation, dependencies, and risk mitigation across technical teams.

• Implement Network as Code: Modernize operations by developing and maintaining Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments.

• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose complex network incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Maximize System Reliability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry and streaming analytics to ensure "five-nines" availability.

• Influence Strategic Roadmaps: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations to align with long-term strategy.

• Lead Seamless Migrations: Oversee high-stakes brownfield-to-greenfield migrations with a focus on hitless cutovers and zero-downtime execution.

• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proactively refine fabric performance and mentor junior engineers, contributing to a workplace culture of continuous learning.

Who you are:

• Experienced Architect: You bring deep mastery of Arista EOS and EVPN-VXLAN architectures, with a proven track record of designing large-scale fabrics.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and bring years of relevant industry experience; CCIE-level expertise is highly desirable.

• Automation Expert: You are proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically using Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines for network automation.

• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to translate complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Resilient Problem Solver: You demonstrate expert-level troubleshooting skills and remain decisive in high-pressure, complex technical scenarios.

• Project Leader: You have significant experience leading technical teams through complex project dependencies and risk management.

• Visionary Engineer: You are a proactive learner who stays ahead of industry trends to maintain architectural excellence in modern fabric environments.

Call to Action: Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possi

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the role

Are you a tech enthusiast eager to bridge the gap between traditional Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our development squads.
In this role, you will be part of the team designing cutting-edge solutions for the future Core Laboratory. Your mission will be to help the department explore and implement AI use cases, directly contributing to projects that impact patient lives while developing your skills in a professional, high-tech environment.

Main responsibilities

• AI Integration: Participate in initiatives to explore, prototype, and implement AI-driven features within our software ecosystem.

• Development: Support the squad in developing software components using C# and .NET , while leveraging Python for AI-specific implementations.

• Modern Tooling: Work with cutting-edge developer tools like GitHub Copilot and contribute to integrations with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers .

• Collaboration: Work within an Agile squad, participating in ceremonies (Daily, Sprint Planning) and contributing to the team's goals.

• Quality: Produce clean, maintainable code and participate in testing activities to ensure the reliability of our medical instrumentation software.

How would your day-to-day look like?

You will start your day synced with your squad, discussing progress and tackling challenges. Under the guidance of an assigned mentor , you will transition from your initial onboarding to making real contributions to our codebase. You will spend part of your time investigating how AI can optimize our projects and the other part implementing those solutions within our C#/.NET architecture. It is a balance of autonomous learning, creative exploration of AI, and structured teamwork.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Director - CVM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• • M.D. richiesto
• Conoscenze terapeutiche all’interno del metabolismo, dell’obesità e del diabete con un’esperienza clinica, scientifica e clinica di sperimentazione/sviluppo necessaria
• Lo sfondo accademico/insegnante è un plus
• Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica
• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito
• Normativa: La conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito
• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea
• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale Abilità e comportamenti chiave
• Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche
• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• Business Acumen: Ha la conoscenza del settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga. Regolarmente conduce lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia
• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget
• Competenze interpersonali: buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità
• Scrittura: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta
• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
• Competenze di negoziazione: Buone competenze di negoziazione: sa come completare i materiali di consegna lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente
• Decision Making: Sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso, bilanciando etica ed efficacia
• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra DUTI SPECIFICHE E RESPONSABILITÀ: Strategia e pianificazione CDP
• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per molecola/indicazioni assegnate
• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD
• Funziona con altri membri del CST e sub-team rilevanti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)
• Funziona con CST e altri team rilevanti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/risorse necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD
• Rimangono al di fuori degli sviluppi interni ed esterni, delle tendenze e di altre dinamiche pertinenti al lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali di influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e malattia assegnata(i)
• Come opportuno, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione e/o di intelligence competitiva e/o di altri mercati/industria
• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nella specifica area terapeutica e malattia di assegnazione
• Collabora con una varietà di partner e stakeholder interni ed esterni, come investigatori clinici, clinici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), nonché gruppi interni multidisciplinari, tra cui altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo aziendale, commerciale

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsplaner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst der zentraler Partner für die unterschiedlichsten Funktionen: von Group Functions über Forschung, Entwicklung bis zu Produktion und Versand. Wir erbringen Services die unseren Standort pulsierend und attraktiv machen, die zeigen, dass wir das inspirierendste Unternehmen in der Schweiz sind. Wir gestalten massgeschneiderte Lösungen und betreiben Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Anlagen und halten diese Instand.

Wir haben diese Services in Kreisen (Circles) organisiert. Der Circle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » gestaltet am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst das Umfeld für eine maximale Wertschöpfung von Anlagen mit dem Ziel eine möglichst hohe „Anlagenrendite“ zu erwirtschaften.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Betreiber und dem Projekt Engineering Instandhaltungsstrategien, -konzepte und bildest diese in unseren Systemen SAP S/4 Hana ab.

Du bist maßgeblich für die Standardisierung, Einhaltung von Methoden und die Pflege von Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrier-Stammdaten zuständig. Du sicherst und förderst eine hohe Datenqualität, behebst Probleme mit Daten und ihren Quellen.

Die Möglichkeit:

• Du agierst als Key User und Hauptverantwortlicher für die Stammdaten. Du pflegst und genehmigst Anlagenstammdaten im SAP S/4 Hana (inklusive Tasklisten und Prüfplänen) und prüfst als letzte Instanz die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Standards und Naming Conventions.

• Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrierprozesse und berätst mit Deiner Fachexpertise für Instandhaltung und Datenmanagement die unterschiedlichen Kundengruppen in Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst.

• Du prüfst die Qualität der Daten und behebst Datenintegritäts- oder -konsistenzprobleme gezielt in den Workflows.

• Du analysierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zur Datenqualität ab. So schaffst Du die Basis verlässlicher Daten, um lokale und globale Asset Lifecycle Management Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Du entwickelst Instandhaltungsstrategien, legst diese fest und bildest sie in den Systemen ab.

• Du hinterfragst den Status Quo sachlich-kritisch und gehst neue Wege in der Instandhaltung.

Wer Du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und Can-Do Einstellung bestimmt dein tägliches Handeln und stellt den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner und Experte für Stammdaten hast Du bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung mit der Instandhaltung von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Packaged Units sammeln können, idealerweise in der pharmazeutischen (GxP-regulierten) oder einer ähnlich streng regulierten Industrie..

Du verstehst die Konzepte der Datenmodellierung, gehst sicher mit mit dem Data Warehouse um und hast gute technische Dokumentationsfähigkeiten. Die hohe Qualität von Daten ist das Fundament robuster Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrierprozesse. Du lebst kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Erfahrung mit SAP S/4 Hana runden Dein Profil ab.

Im Umgang mit globalen Schnittstellen

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma è il partner centrale per un'ampia gamma di funzioni presso la sede di Basilea/Kaiseraugst: dalle funzioni di gruppo alla ricerca e sviluppo fino alla produzione e spedizione. Forniamo servizi che rendono la nostra sede vivace e attraente e dimostriamo che siamo l'azienda più stimolante in Svizzera. Progettiamo soluzioni su misura, gestiamo edifici, infrastrutture, sistemi e ne facciamo la manutenzione. Abbiamo organizzato questi servizi in circoli. Il circolo “Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies” crea nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst l'ambiente per la massima creazione di valore dagli investimenti con l'obiettivo di generare il massimo “ritorno sugli investimenti” possibile. In qualità di pianificatore della manutenzione, sviluppi strategie e concetti di manutenzione insieme all'operatore e all'ingegneria di progetto e li mapperai nei nostri sistemi SAP S/4 Hana. Sei in gran parte responsabile della standardizzazione, del rispetto dei metodi e del mantenimento dei dati anagrafici di manutenzione e calibrazione. Garantisci e promuovi un'elevata qualità dei dati e risolvi i problemi con i dati e le loro fonti. La possibilità:
• Agire come key user e principale responsabile dei dati anagrafici. Mantieni e approvi i dati anagrafici dell'impianto in SAP S/4 Hana (inclusi elenchi di attività e piani di ispezione) e, come ultima istanza, controlli la conformità agli standard concordati e alle convenzioni di denominazione.
• Siete l'interlocutore principale per i processi di manutenzione e calibrazione e utilizzate la vostra competenza tecnica nella manutenzione e nella gestione dei dati per consigliare i diversi gruppi di clienti nella produzione, nella ricerca e nelle infrastrutture nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst.
• Controllare la qualità dei dati e risolvere in modo specifico i problemi di integrità o coerenza dei dati nei flussi di lavoro.
• Analizzi i dati provenienti da diverse fonti e ricavi misure di miglioramento continuo per la qualità dei dati. In questo modo, crei la base di dati affidabili per guidare iniziative di gestione del ciclo di vita delle risorse locali e globali.
• Sviluppare strategie di manutenzione, definirle e mapparle nei sistemi.
• Metti in discussione lo status quo in modo obiettivo e critico e intraprendi nuovi percorsi nel mantenimento. Chi sei Sei una personalità dal pensiero positivo, basata sull'integrità e autoriflessiva con forti capacità di squadra. In questo senso, hai un atteggiamento e un modo di pensare aperti e collaborativi, necessari per un lavoro di successo nel tuo team e tra i reparti. Hai fiducia in te stesso e negli altri, ti assumi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta, aperta alla parola e priva di errori. Il tuo atteggiamento orientato alla soluzione e il tuo atteggiamento positivo determinano le tue azioni quotidiane e mettono il cliente al centro. In qualità di pianificatore di manutenzione ed esperto di dati anagrafici, hai già acquisito un'esperienza professionale approfondita nella manutenzione di impianti di ingegneria di processo e unità confezionate, idealmente nel settore farmaceutico (regolamentato GxP) o in un settore altrettanto rigorosamente regolamentato. Comprendi i concetti di modellazione dei dati, sei sicuro nell'utilizzo del data warehouse e hai buone capacità di documentazione tecnica. L'elevata qualità dei dati è il fondamento di robusti processi di manutenzione e calibrazione. Vivi il miglioramento continuo, l'esperienza con SAP S/4 Hana completa il tuo profilo. Quando si ha a che fare con interfacce globali

• Lead a Key Market: Directly oversee Patient Safety in Saudi Arabia, a strategically vital and high-growth market, ensuring alignment with national healthcare transformation.

• Drive Innovation: Move beyond compliance-only models toward integrated safety risk management that directly impacts clinical practice and patient care.

• Influence Externally: Represent Roche in key regulatory and industry forums, strengthening our position as a trusted partner with health authorities.

• Empower Talent: Lead and mentor a high-performing team of safety professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Simplify & Optimize: Contribute regional insights to evolve Roche's global safety systems, balancing global consistency with essential local relevance.

Who You Are

• You are a visionary leader who thrives in complex, evolving environments and possesses the strategic mindset needed to translate safety insights into meaningful patient impact. You are a collaborator at heart, capable of influencing senior stakeholders and health authorities.

• Experienced Leader: You bring significant leadership experience in Patient Safety, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Affairs, with a proven track record of managing regional or complex cross-country teams.

• Strategic Navigator: You have a deep understanding of healthcare systems within the GCC; experience navigating the regulatory landscape in Saudi Arabia is highly valued.

• Relationship Builder: You excel at engaging with external stakeholders and health authorities to build long-term regulatory confidence.

• Transformation Catalyst: You are comfortable driving change, building team capabilities beyond traditional compliance, and integrating safety into broader clinical and medical decision-making.

• Effective Communicator: You possess strong executive presence and the ability to communicate complex safety strategies to diverse audiences.

Ready to make a difference?
Together, we'll create a healthier, brighter future for all. Apply today to help us shape the future of patient safety in the GCC.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Logistics Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Logistics Engineer / Project Manager leads the technical evolution and modernization of our 10,000m2 self-operated distribution center. This role is the strategic architect responsible for transforming a complex, legacy-automated environment into a flexible, next-generation fulfillment hub using AMR and advanced robotics.
You will bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital systems, managing the transition from a legacy software stack (WMS/WCS/MFC) to a modern SAP eWM environment. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, you will own the technical roadmap, from ROI analysis and vendor selection participation to on-site project execution lead, ensuring our automation strategy aligns with future business scalability.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Creation of holistic view of warehouse operations in terms of automation technology, system landscape and warehouse operator needs. Full understanding & documentation of current bottlenecks in terms of throughput and storage capacity. Create suitable measurements (KPIs) where needed in order to translate requirements and current capacities.

• Automation Transformation & Strategy: Assess and lead the transition from rigid legacy automation to flexible technologies (AMRs, Humanoids, etc.) where required. Take full stock of existing hardware capabilities and map them against future business requirements and market-leading solutions.

• Systems Architecture & Integration: Fully master the current system landscape (WMS, WCS, MFC). Design the integration strategy to link the physical world with the digital world, acting as the lead for the upcoming SAP eWM implementation.

• Financial Stewardship & ROI: Drive rigorous ROI analysis for all automation projects collaborating with finance and site management. Have clear visibility for throughput, storage density, and FTE optimization.

• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.

• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with site management to assess new vendors and technologies. Navigate the complex relationship between legacy hardware providers and modern robotics OEMs, ensuring system interoperability.

• Technical Communication: Adapt complex technical concepts for different audiences (“zoom in & out”). Clearly articulate the "why" behind automation shifts to senior leadership while providing granular technical direction to on-site maintenance and IT teams.

• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for automated systems, including uptime, cycle times, and error rates. Lead corrective actions when performance gaps occur in the automated flow.

Who You Are

• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.

• A Strategic Executor: You can design a 3-year automation roadmap but are equally willing to be on the warehouse floor during a "Go-Live" to troubleshoot o

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Bangalore)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Edge Defense
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area
The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats.
The core stack of this team includes:

• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation

• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services

• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP

​
Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").

• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.

• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).

• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes.

Who You Are

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset

• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset

• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams

​
Education

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience

• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM)

​
Technical Skills

• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions

• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus

• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies

• Automation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Als Mitglied des PDG Country Study Start-Up Teams liegt dein Hauptaugenmerk darauf, einen reibungslosen und hocheffizienten Studienstart sicherzustellen, um so die Bereitstellung klinischer Studien für Patient:innen zu unterstützen. Du bringst klinische Studien innovativ auf den Weg: Du deckst den spezifischen Bedarf in der Start-up-Phase über verschiedene Therapiegebiete hinweg und garantierst einen reibungslosen Ablauf für Patient:innen und Prüfzentren. In dieser Schlüsselrolle vernetzt du dich intensiv mit lokalen und globalen Teams sowie unseren CRO Partnern (Auftragsforschungsinstituten).

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle konzentrierst du dich auf die effiziente und rechtskonforme Initiierung von Roche-gesponserten klinischen Studien. Du entwickelst effektive Start-up-Strategien, steuerst die operativen Abläufe und treibst Prozessverbesserungen auf Länder- und Zentren-Ebene voran – immer unter Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben.Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

• Strategische Leitung: Du leitest Teams bei der strategischen Planung der operativen Durchführung des Studienstarts, wobei Du die Verantwortung für Risikomanagement, regulatorische Compliance sowie die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern trägst.

• Operative Exzellenz: Du managst die Start-up-Aktivitäten und stellst eine termingerechte Aktivierung der Prüfzentren sowie die regulatorische Compliance sicher. Du verantwortest und steuerst den gesamten Budget- und Vertragsprozess – von der Erstellung der Budgets über die Vertragsverhandlung und Versicherungsdokumente bis hin zur systemseitigen Datenpflege, um die finanzielle und rechtliche Konformität sowie eine präzise Planung zu gewährleisten.

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Salem)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Salem , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Salem territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explo
