titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la qualité des données (m/m/j)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst der zentraler Partner für die unterschiedlichsten Funktionen: von Group Functions über Forschung, Entwicklung bis zu Produktion und Versand. Wir erbringen Services die unseren Standort pulsierend und attraktiv machen, die zeigen, dass wir das inspirierendste Unternehmen in der Schweiz sind. Wir gestalten massgeschneiderte Lösungen und betreiben Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Anlagen und halten diese Instand.

Wir haben diese Services in Kreisen (Circles) organisiert. Der Circle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » gestaltet am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst das Umfeld für eine maximale Wertschöpfung von Anlagen mit dem Ziel eine möglichst hohe „Anlagenrendite“ zu erwirtschaften.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Betreiber und dem Projekt Engineering Instandhaltungsstrategien, -konzepte und bildest diese in unseren Systemen SAP S/4 Hana ab.

Als Master Data Quality Steward liegt Deine Hauptverantwortung im Bereich der Kalibrierung. Du bist maßgeblich für die Standardisierung, Einhaltung von Methoden und die prozessuale Qualitätssicherung der Kalibrierstammdaten zuständig. Du sicherst und förderst eine hohe Datenqualität, behebst Probleme mit Daten und ihren Quellen und gewährleistest effiziente, standardisierte sowie integrative Prozesse für kalibrierrelevante Stammdaten (Master Data Management).

Die Möglichkeit:

• Du agierst als Key User und Hauptverantwortlicher für die Kalibrierstammdaten. Du pflegst und genehmigst Anlagenstammdaten im SAP S/4 Hana (inklusive Kalibrier-Tasklisten und Prüfplänen) und prüfst als letzte Instanz die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Standards und Naming Conventions.

• Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Kalibrierprozesse und berätst mit Deiner Fachexpertise für Kalibrieren und Datenmanagement die unterschiedlichen Kundengruppen in Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst.

• Du stellst die systemtechnische Abgrenzung im Kalibrierbereich sicher, identifizierst Datenquellen, prüfst die Qualität der Daten und behebst Datenintegritäts- oder -konsistenzprobleme gezielt in den Kalibrier-Workflows.

• Du dokumentierst Datenquellen, verknüpfst Informationen, betreibst dediziertes Qualitätsreporting für den Kalibrierbereich und pflegst relevante KPIs.

• Du analysierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zur Datenqualität ab. So schaffst Du die Basis verlässlicher Daten, um lokale und globale Asset Lifecycle Management Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Du entwickelst Kalibrierstrategien, legst diese fest und bildest sie in den Systemen ab.

• Du hinterfragst den Status Quo sachlich-kritisch und gehst neue Wege in der Kalibrierung.

Wer Du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und Can-Do Einstellung bestimmt dein tägliches Handeln und stellt den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner und Experte für Stammdaten hast Du bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung mit der Instandhaltung und Kalibrierung von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Packaged Uni

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma è il partner centrale per un'ampia gamma di funzioni presso la sede di Basilea/Kaiseraugst: dalle funzioni di gruppo alla ricerca e sviluppo fino alla produzione e spedizione. Forniamo servizi che rendono la nostra sede vivace e attraente e dimostriamo che siamo l'azienda più stimolante in Svizzera. Progettiamo soluzioni su misura, gestiamo edifici, infrastrutture, sistemi e ne facciamo la manutenzione. Abbiamo organizzato questi servizi in circoli. Il circolo “Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies” crea nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst l'ambiente per la massima creazione di valore dagli investimenti con l'obiettivo di generare il massimo “ritorno sugli investimenti” possibile. In qualità di pianificatore della manutenzione, sviluppi strategie e concetti di manutenzione insieme all'operatore e all'ingegneria di progetto e li mapperai nei nostri sistemi SAP S/4 Hana. In qualità di Master Data Quality Steward, la tua responsabilità principale risiede nell'area della calibrazione. Sei in gran parte responsabile della standardizzazione, del rispetto dei metodi e della garanzia della qualità procedurale dei dati anagrafici di calibrazione. Garantite e promuovete un'elevata qualità dei dati, risolvete i problemi con i dati e le loro fonti e assicurate processi efficienti, standardizzati e integrativi per i dati anagrafici rilevanti per la calibrazione (Master Data Management). La possibilità:
• Agire come utente chiave e persona principale responsabile dei dati anagrafici di calibrazione. Mantieni e approvi i dati anagrafici dell'impianto in SAP S/4 Hana (inclusi elenchi di attività di calibrazione e piani di test) e, come ultima istanza, controlli la conformità agli standard concordati e alle convenzioni di denominazione.
• Siete l'interlocutore principale per i processi di calibrazione e utilizzate la vostra competenza specialistica nella calibrazione e nella gestione dei dati per consigliare i diversi gruppi di clienti nella produzione, nella ricerca e nelle infrastrutture nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst.
• Garantite la delimitazione tecnica del sistema nell'area di calibrazione, identificate le fonti dei dati, verificate la qualità dei dati e risolvete in modo specifico i problemi di integrità o coerenza dei dati nei flussi di lavoro di calibrazione.
• Documentare le fonti dei dati, collegare le informazioni, gestire report di qualità dedicati per l'area di calibrazione e mantenere KPI pertinenti.
• Analizzi i dati provenienti da diverse fonti e ricavi misure di miglioramento continuo per la qualità dei dati. In questo modo, crei la base di dati affidabili per guidare iniziative di gestione del ciclo di vita delle risorse locali e globali.
• Sviluppi strategie di calibrazione, le definisci e le mappe nei sistemi.
• Metti in discussione lo status quo in modo obiettivo e critico e intraprendi nuovi percorsi di calibrazione. Chi sei Sei una personalità dal pensiero positivo, basata sull'integrità e autoriflessiva con forti capacità di squadra. In questo senso, hai un atteggiamento e un modo di pensare aperti e collaborativi, necessari per un lavoro di successo nel tuo team e tra i reparti. Hai fiducia in te stesso e negli altri, ti assumi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta, aperta alla parola e priva di errori. Il tuo atteggiamento orientato alla soluzione e il tuo atteggiamento positivo determinano le tue azioni quotidiane e mettono il cliente al centro. In qualità di pianificatore di manutenzione ed esperto di dati anagrafici hai già un'esperienza professionale approfondita nella manutenzione e calibrazione di sistemi di ingegneria di processo e università confezionate

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Marketing Lead who will report to the Marketing and Customer Engagement Head and be responsible for the Lung portfolio.

As a Marketing Lead, your mission is to create value through meaningful benefits for patients, the business, external stakeholders, and health systems. By working with patient journey partners (PJPs) and healthcare system partners (HSPs), and other cross-functional enablers, value can be added in various ways, such as product innovation, treatment pathway design, a new patient service, technologies/capabilities that improve operational efficiency, global knowledge sharing, or external collaboration.

Responsibilities:

• Develop specific marketing strategies for therapeutic areas within the organization, working together cross-functionally with Medical and Access Leads.

• Build and implement an effective plan for Omnichannel engagement via leveraging different channels and tools. Focus on building Omnichannel capabilities internally and externally to provide meaningful customer experiences that add value to patients, collaborating closely with the Digital team.

• Manage P&L to ensure resources are utilized effectively and in accordance with the business outcomes

• Ensure continuous sales and logistics forecasting, working closely with the PJPs and Finance team.

• Interpret and translate scientific data into commercial implications, analyze data, and make strategic recommendations.

• In case of new launches, build and propose a suitable Go-to-Market Strategy via defining pricing, distribution channels, and sales strategies, working with Access and Launch Excellence Leads.

• Provide marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches and monitor budget and expenditures.

• Participate in national and international congresses, scientific meetings, and global implementation/update meetings to keep the knowledge updated for commercialization strategies.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, act as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and contribute to creating value to the patient journey through supporting and enabling the PJPs in implementing successful projects for the ecosystem in line with Roche Code of Conduct and principles.

• Working beyond the local organization, align and collaborate with broader networks, provide support to global networks and other affiliates, and be accountable for ensuring collaboration with the networks and local leads to identify new opportunities, initiatives, and solutions to answer stakeholder needs and to drive value for the patients.

• Prepare and update the training materials and provide internal education and training programs to the customer engagement teams and other lead roles in the affiliate when necessary.

• Generate mar-com strategies working together with the communication department. Support the PJPs in setting the Therapeutic Area or other communication strategy and creation/adaptation of local Therapeutic Area messages, materials, and communication content for digital platforms.

Mindset and Behaviours:

• We Before Me Mindset: Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• System thinker, self-managed and self-directed - altru

• Build and implement an effective plan for Omnichannel engagement via leveraging different channels and tools. Focus on building Omnichannel capabilities internally and externally to provide meaningful customer experiences that add value to patients, collaborating closely with the Digital team.
• Manage P&L to ensure resources are utilized effectively and in accordance with the business outcomes
• Ensure continuous sales and logistics forecasting, working closely with the PJPs and Finance team.
• Interpret and translate scientific data into commercial implications, analyze data, and make strategic recommendations.
• In case of new launches, build and propose a suitable Go-to-Market Strategy via defining pricing, distribution channels, and sales strategies, working with Access and Launch Excellence Leads.
• Provide marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches and monitor budget and expenditures.
• Participate in national and international congresses, scientific meetings, and global implementation/update meetings to keep the knowledge updated for commercialization strategies.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, act as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and contribute to creating value to the patient journey through supporting and enabling the PJPs in implementing successful projects for the ecosystem in line with Roche Code of Conduct and principles.
• Working beyond the local organization, align and collaborate with broader networks, provide support to global networks and other affiliates, and be accountable for ensuring collaboration with the networks and local leads to identify new opportunities, initiatives, and solutions to answer stakeholder needs and to drive value for the patients.
• Prepare and update the training materials and provide internal education and training programs to the customer engagement teams and other lead roles in the affiliate when necessary.
• Generate mar-com strategies working together with the communication department. Support the PJPs in setting the Therapeutic Area or other communication strategy and creation/adaptation of local Therapeutic Area messages, materials, and communication content for digital platforms. Mindset and Behaviours:
• We Before Me Mindset: Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand)
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• System thinker, self-managed and self-directed - altru

jobs.title: Manufacturing Support Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Plomb de soutien à la fabrication

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit seinen rund 1.500 (PTM) Mitarbeitenden garantiert das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst eine lückenlose Patientenversorgung auf höchstem Qualitätsniveau. Als grösstes und modernstes Verpackungszentrum von Roche bedient Kaiseraugst mehr als 120 Länder und steht weltweit für exzellente Standards in der pharmazeutischen Produktion.

Die Möglichkeit

• Leading Leader und Gesamtverantwortung für rund 40 Mitarbeitende (inkl. Contractor) sowie Coaching und Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden

• Verantwortung für das Facility Excellence Team mit Asset Excellence Managern, Facility Excellence Managern und der Partnering Systems Change Specialist Rolle; zudem rapportieren das Swisslog Maintenance Team und die Disposition an den Manufacturing Support Head

• Sicherstellung einer vorausschauenden Ressourcenplanung und Steuerung nach SQDEC (Safety / Quality / Delivery / Engagement / Cost) als Teil des Central Logistics Services Leitungsteams

• Anwendung von LEAN-Methoden zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung sowie Einsatz von Visual Management zur Prozesssteuerung anhand von KPIs; Förderung daten- und faktenbasierter Entscheidungen sowie geschickter Einsatz von Digitalisierung

• Verantwortung für die logistische Investitionsplanung für CLS, die Koordination der Logistik-Roadmap sowie die Logistik-Konfiguration für neue Pharma-Produkte am Standort Kaiseraugst

• Sicherstellung und Priorisierung von Systemanpassungen in Abstimmung mit lokalen und globalen Zielen sowie Sicherstellung aller GMP-, Betriebssicherheits-, Umwelt- und Prozessanforderungen

• SME für Standort- und Netzwerk-Logistikprojekte mit Hauptverantwortung für die Durchführung von CAPEX-Projekten und weiteren Investments zur Weiterentwicklung der Logistik-Infrastruktur

• Automation Business Owner der Logistikanlagen in drei verschiedenen Gebäuden in Kaiseraugst und Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Infrastruktur- und Verbesserungsprojekten unter Berücksichtigung der logistischen Anforderungen der Manufacturing Units und der Global Supply Chain Organisation

Wer du bist

• Positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit Leidenschaft für Führung und einer ausgeprägten lösungsorientierten „Can-Do-Einstellung“

• Fähigkeit, Vertrauen im Team durch Transparenz, Verantwortungsübergabe sowie eine offene Speak-up- und Fehlerkultur zu stärken

• Unternehmerische Denkweise mit Blick auf den Gesamtprozess („End to End“) sowie Fähigkeit, in einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld konstant hohe Leistung zu erbringen

• Höhere Berufsausbildung, Studium oder Masterabschluss

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung, idealerweise im Pharma- und/oder Logistikumfeld

• Erfahrung mit GMP-Audits und Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörden

• Gekonnter Einsatz von Technologie, hohe Zahlenaffinität sowie sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solution

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi circa 1.500 dipendenti (PTM), il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst garantisce una cura completa dei pazienti al massimo livello qualitativo. Come il più grande e moderno centro di confezionamento di Roche, Kaiseraugst serve più di 120 paesi e si trova in tutto il mondo per standard eccellenti nella produzione farmaceutica. La possibilità
• Leader leader e responsabilità complessiva per circa 40 dipendenti (compreso il contraente) nonché coaching e sviluppo dei dipendenti
• Responsabilità per il Facility Excellence Team con Asset Excellence Manager, Facility Excellence Manager e il ruolo di Partnering Systems Change Specialist; lo Swisslog Maintenance Team e il MRP per il Manufacturing Support Head
• Garantire la pianificazione e il controllo delle risorse predittive secondo SQDEC (Safety / Quality / Delivery / Engagement / Cost) come parte del team di gestione dei Servizi di Logistica Centrale
• Applicazione dei metodi LEAN per il miglioramento continuo e l'utilizzo della gestione visiva per il controllo dei processi tramite KPI;
• Responsabilità per la pianificazione degli investimenti logistici per CLS, coordinamento della roadmap logistica e configurazione logistica per nuovi prodotti farmaceutici presso il sito Kaiseraugst
• Garantire e privilegiare gli adeguamenti del sistema in coordinamento con gli obiettivi locali e globali e garantire tutti i requisiti GMP, sicurezza operativa, ambiente e processo
• PMI per progetti di logistica di siti e di rete, con la massima responsabilità per l'attuazione di progetti CAPEX e altri investimenti per sviluppare ulteriormente l'infrastruttura logistica
• Automation Business Owner of Logistics Plants in Three Different Buildings in Kaiseraugst and Responsibility for the Implementation of Infrastructure and Improvement Projects Considerando i requisiti logistici delle unità di produzione e dell'organizzazione globale della catena di approvvigionamento Chi sei
• Il pensiero positivo, la personalità integree e auto-riflettente con passione per la leadership e una pronunciata impostazione “Can-Do”
• Capacità di rafforzare la fiducia nel team attraverso la trasparenza, il trasferimento di responsabilità e l'apertura Speak-up e la cultura degli errori
• Il pensiero imprenditoriale in vista del processo complessivo (fine alla fine), così come la capacità di fornire prestazioni costantemente elevate in un ambiente in continua evoluzione
• Formazione professionale superiore, studio o master
• Esperienza di leadership pluriennale, idealmente nell'ambiente farmaceutico e/o logistico
• Esperienza con audit GMP e ispezioni da parte delle autorità sanitarie
• Conveniente uso della tecnologia, alta affinità di numero e ottime capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Iscriviti ora per scoprire questa entusiasmante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere il nostro alto ambizioso, in modo da poter offrire una soluzione sanitaria che cambi la vita

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. En tant que centre d'emballage le plus grand et le plus moderne de Roche, Kaiseraugst dessert plus de 120 pays et est synonyme d'excellentes normes dans la production pharmaceutique. La possibilité
• Leader principal et responsabilité globale pour une quarantaine d'employés (y compris l'entrepreneur) ainsi que coaching et perfectionnement des employés
• Responsabilité de l'équipe d'excellence de l'installation avec les gestionnaires d'excellence de l'actif, les gestionnaires d'excellence de l'installation et le rôle de spécialiste du changement des systèmes de partenariat; l'équipe de maintenance de Swisslog et le MRP au responsable du soutien à la fabrication
• Assurer la planification et le contrôle prédictifs des ressources selon SQDEC (Sécurité / Qualité / Livraison / Engagement / Coût) dans le cadre de l'équipe de gestion des Services centraux de logistique
• Application de méthodes LEAN pour l'amélioration continue et l'utilisation de la gestion visuelle pour le contrôle des processus à l'aide des KPI;
• Responsable de la planification des investissements logistiques pour le CLS, de la coordination de la feuille de route logistique et de la configuration logistique des nouveaux produits pharmaceutiques sur le site de Kaiseraugst
• Assurer et hiérarchiser les ajustements des systèmes en coordination avec les objectifs locaux et mondiaux et garantir toutes les exigences en matière de BPF, de sécurité opérationnelle, d'environnement et de processus;
• PME pour les projets de logistique de site et de réseau dont la responsabilité principale est la mise en œuvre des projets CAPEX et d'autres investissements visant à développer l'infrastructure logistique
• Automatisation Propriétaire d'usines de logistique dans trois bâtiments différents à Kaiseraugst et responsabilité de la mise en œuvre des projets d'infrastructure et d'amélioration compte tenu des exigences logistiques des unités manufacturières et de l'Organisation mondiale de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Qui vous êtes
• La pensée positive, l'ingéniosité et la personnalité auto-réfléchissante avec passion pour le leadership et un cadre prononcé axé sur la solution
• Capacité à renforcer la confiance dans l'équipe par la transparence, le transfert de responsabilité et la culture ouverte de la parole et de l'erreur
• La réflexion entrepreneuriale en vue du processus global (fin à fin), ainsi que la capacité à fournir des performances constamment élevées dans un environnement en constante évolution
• Formation professionnelle supérieure, études ou maîtrise
• Expérience de leadership pluriannuelle, idéalement dans l'environnement pharmaceutique et/ou logistique

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe cybersecurity plays a critical role in protecting innovation, safeguarding patient trust, and enabling healthcare transformation globally. As part of our Informatics organization, you will contribute to strengthening Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities in a highly collaborative, global, and complex environment.

Your Opportunity
As a Cybersecurity Analyst within the Monitoring & Incident Response team, you will lead and support strategic cybersecurity initiatives while partnering with global stakeholders across multiple business and technology domains. You will help drive security best practices, contribute to complex security programs, and support the continuous evolution of Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities.

In this role, you will:

• Lead and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives and strategic programs across global and cross-functional environments

• Provide expert guidance and advisory support on complex cybersecurity challenges, incident response activities, and security-related risk considerations

• Partner with stakeholders across Informatics and business teams to align cybersecurity priorities with organizational objectives

• Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security processes, standards, and best practices

• Analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and recommend effective and scalable security solutions

• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive alignment, decision-making, and execution across initiatives

• Mentor and support team members while contributing to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence

• Stay informed on industry trends, emerging threats, and evolving cybersecurity practices to help strengthen Roche’s overall security posture

Who you are
You are a strategic and collaborative cybersecurity professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments, influencing stakeholders, and balancing technical depth with business impact. You are able to work effectively across global teams while bringing a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.

You bring:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university

• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, or related cybersecurity domains within complex enterprise environments

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and global teams in matrix organizations

• Good understanding of cybersecurity principles, security frameworks, risk management, and enterprise security practices

• The ability to analyze complex technical and business problems and translate them into actionable solutions

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships

• Experience contributing to large-scale initiatives, process improvements, or transformation programs within cybersecurity or technology organizations

• A continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, and innovation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted usin

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner, Oncology (Sumatra)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) acts as a trusted partner and key point of contact for stakeholders involved in the Oncology patient journey across Sumatera. As the local face of Roche, the PJP works closely with healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions, and cross-functional Roche teams to better understand patient and healthcare system needs and improve patient outcomes.

In this role, you will:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals and relevant stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to better understand patient and healthcare system needs

• Develop a deep understanding of the patient journey, including key challenges, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve patient care and access within the assigned therapeutic area

• Collaborate with cross-functional Roche teams to identify, develop, and implement solutions that create meaningful value for patients, stakeholders, and the broader healthcare community

• Support the appropriate and compliant use of Roche products by sharing scientific and product information in a truthful, balanced, and patient-focused manner

• Lead stakeholder engagement planning and execution based on customer insights, healthcare landscape understanding, and evolving patient needs

• Identify opportunities for collaboration that help address barriers within the healthcare system and improve patient outcomes and experiences

• Coordinate and mobilize the appropriate internal expertise, resources, and support to respond effectively to stakeholder needs while ensuring a positive experience with Roche’s people, products, and services

Who you are
You are passionate about improving patient outcomes and building meaningful partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem. You bring a collaborative mindset, strong stakeholder engagement capabilities, and the ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving healthcare environment.
You bring:

• A university degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus

• Experience in stakeholder engagement within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or related industry, with the ability to build trusted long-term partnerships

• Good understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the broader healthcare ecosystem

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry regulations, ethical standards, and compliance requirements in Indonesia

• Understanding of patient journeys, treatment pathways, and stakeholder dynamics within the Oncology area

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and functions

• Strategic thinking, learning agility, and an interest in innovation and healthcare transformation to help improve patient outcomes

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Safety Development & Processes (SDP) team within Product Development Safety, you will lead the evolution of global processes that enable world-class safety and vigilance activities across Roche’s drug and device development portfolio.. In this influential role, you will operate as a Global Process Owner or senior subject-matter expert, shaping the frameworks that underpin our safety activities for medicines, devices, and digital health solutions. You will drive strategic innovation and process excellence to ensure Roche remains at the forefront of patient safety and regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

As the Safety Process Director / Senior Director, you will design and govern the global operating models that translate complex safety requirements into scalable, high-impact clinical and post-marketing practices. This role is internally known as Safety Process Director/Senior Director.

• Lead the design and continuous improvement of global safety processes, ensuring they remain robust, agile, and aligned with industry-leading standards.

• Act as a Global Process Owner or senior expert for complex safety and vigilance activities, providing strategic direction across the organization.

• Partner with key stakeholders , including Safety Science Leaders, the QPPV/PRRC offices, and cross-functional global teams to harmonize safety initiatives.

• Drive process innovation by identifying opportunities to strengthen Roche’s safety capabilities and participating in external industry collaborations.

• Translate scientific and regulatory foundations of Signal Management and Risk Management into effective global safety practices.

• Influence internal governance discussions to ensure safety and vigilance practices support the safe development of innovative medicines and digital health solutions.

Who you are

You are a strategic leader who thrives in a global matrix environment, combining deep technical expertise in Safety Science with the ability to coach and catalyze change across organizational boundaries.

• You hold a degree in Medicine, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• You have a proven track record of leading complex initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders to drive strategic improvement.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Du verstärkst unseren Bereich Vertrieb Service in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen aus dem Verkauf und anderen Vertriebseinheiten verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine langfristige Kundenbindung sicherzustellen und den Verkauf unserer Roche-Systeme aktiv zu unterstützen. Dabei verantworten wir den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice unter anderem für Analysensysteme und Reagenzien der Molekularen/Gewebediagnostik und IT-Lösungen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Junior Systembetreuer (m/w/d) bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort. Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Roche-Standardgeräte sicher und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:

• Du führst fachgerechte technische Fehlerdiagnosen durch und reparierst Roche-Standardgeräte – meist vor Ort beim Kunden, teilweise auch per Remote-Support. Dabei übernimmst du auch die sorgfältige Dokumentation im CRM-System, um nachhaltige Problemlösungen sicherzustellen und die Fakturierung.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Installation neuer Systeme, führst Testläufe durch und übergibst die Geräte betriebsbereit an den Kunden.

• Du erledigst Wartungen und Modifikationen termingerecht und unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher Aspekte, basierend auf Serviceverträgen oder Einzelaufträgen.

• Als technischer Ansprechpartner vor Ort erkennst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden frühzeitig. Du weist Kunden technisch ein, berätst zu Serviceverträgen oder präventiven Maßnahmen und arbeitest eng mit dem Vertrieb zusammen, um Verkaufschancen für Systemgeschäfte oder Dienstleistungen zu identifizieren.

• Du organisierst deine Einsätze in der Region effizient und eigenverantwortlich. Um die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten sicherzustellen

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Neben einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in oder ein Studium (z.B. FH) in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung bringst Du idealerweise erste praktische Berufserfahrung (z.B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine technische Ausbildung) im Umgang mit komplexen technischen Systemen mit. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:

• Aufgrund der regionalen Einsatzplanung und der Fahrzeiten lebst Du im idealerweise in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Zudem besitzt du einen gültigen Führerschein und bringst eine hohe Reisebereitschaft mit, um unsere Kund:innen in der Region zu betreuen.

• Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Systemen mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hydraulik, Elektronik und Messtechnik.

• Du besitzt Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware, verstehst die IT-Anbindung moderner IT-Anbindungen und hast idealerweise chemisches Basiswissen.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt gute fach- und allgemeinsprachliche Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Niveau B1/B2).

• Du arbeitest eigenständig, ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvorgaben und bringst eine hohe Kundenorientierung mit. Als Teil eines deutschlandweiten Teams schätzt du den kollegialen Austausch und bist bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

• Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvereinbarungen und bist bereit, Verantwortung im Rahmen von Not- und Bereitschaftsdiensten zu übernehmen.

Deine Bewerbung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally

• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results

• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione SUMMARIO DI POSIZIONE GENERALE E PURPOSE: L’organizzazione di sviluppo clinico di Roche è strutturata dall’area terapeutica ed è responsabile dello sviluppo e dell’esecuzione delle strategie cliniche di sviluppo tardivo (Phase II – III) e dei piani che forniscono terapie medicalmente differenziate che forniscono un significativo miglioramento ai pazienti. Il Direttore Medico di Piombo conduce o apporta importanti contributi allo sviluppo della strategia e del piano di sviluppo clinico (CD) ed è responsabile dell'esecuzione efficace ed efficiente per le molecole/indicazioni assegnate. I direttori medici di piombo sono tenuti a svolgere le loro responsabilità con più indipendenza rispetto ai direttori medici. ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. richiesto
• Esperienza di sperimentazione/sviluppo clinico, scientifico o clinico rilevante nella stessa area terapeutica
• Lo sfondo accademico/insegnante è un plus
• Esperienza significativa che funziona con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica
• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito
• Significativa esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica O è un esperto riconosciuto nel settore
• Esperienza significativa progettazione e conduzione di studi clinici (cioè uno o più studi)
• L'esperienza che autorizza un piano di sviluppo globale è preferita
• Comprensione della fase II – III sviluppo della droga
• La conoscenza e la comprensione dello sviluppo della fase I & IV della droga è un plus
• Comprensione dei profili di prodotto e di sicurezza
• Normativa: conoscenza degli aspetti medici del GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è richiesto
• 4 o più anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica O è un esperto locale riconosciuto nel settore (ad esempio Professore aggiunto o equivalente)
• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale Abilità e comportamenti chiave
• Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche
• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• È considerato conoscibile nel suo campo, è rispettato da altri, può contribuire efficacemente allo sviluppo di farmaci a più lungo raggio, e può condurre squadre interfunzionali a risultati di successo
• Business Acumen: ha una solida conoscenza dell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica, delle molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga.
• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget
• Competenze interpersonali: forte comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità e ha dimostrato esperienza costruendo e coltivando relazioni con partner chiave e stakeholder, sia internamente che esternamente
• Scrittura: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte
• Capacità di presentazione: Forte capacità di presentazione aziendale: efficace nel riassumere e presentare le considerazioni chiave e i punti di decisione. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
• Competenze di negoziazione: forti capacità di negoziazione: in grado di guidare efficacemente discussioni e decisioni verso i risultati finali desiderati
• Decision Making: Prende buone decisioni aziendali ed esercita un giudizio positivo. Saldo decisioni con imperativi per l'etica e l'efficacia. Able a mak

• Prise de décision: prend de bonnes décisions commerciales et exerce un bon jugement. Équilibre les décisions avec les impératifs d'éthique et d'efficacité. Peut être mak

Roche Pharma India is a fully fledged Roche Country Organization headed by a General Manager, operating across India in a unique cluster-based operating model. Roche India envisions a future role to truly serve patients in India and help uplift and transform the health system. Roche prides itself on bringing first-in-class/ best-in-class products to the market, and India is one of the most important markets to bring its gold-standard portfolio to. Roche India is an organization with just over 300 employees and has yearly sales of approximately CHF 160 million with an aspiration to serve 10x the number of patients by 2035. Every employee at Roche India strives to achieve a triple win (for patients, for the health system, and for Roche) and truly lives up to the ethos of “Doing Now What Patients Need Next”.

Roche India is part of Roche Group with more than 100,000 employees across the globe dedicated to advanced science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products globally. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

As the People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner for Roche Pharma India, you will:
Act as the vital catalyst, rallying all other P&C chapters around the business priorities and P&C strategy. While this is an individual contributor role, it requires the mindset of a strong and highly influential business leader and entrepreneur. You will thrive by accomplishing things through others and living agility in all its facets.

Key Responsibilities

• Influence & Trust: You must have the ability to influence with courageous authenticity, build trust with individuals at all levels, and challenge the status quo when appropriate without relying on formal reporting lines.

• Coaching: You will act as a trusted strategic partner, a credible activist, and a coach to creative leadership and the country leadership team. You will engage in honest, authentic, and open dialogue at all levels to unlock the greatness in our people and organization.

• Strategic Alignment: You will translate business strategy into P&C strategies for the leadership areas and drive fit-for-purpose implementation and pull-through.

• Organizational Transformation: You will be a key enabler of organizational transformation, advancing organizational design and effectiveness, including driving shifts in mindset, behaviors, and ways of working.

• Data-Driven Culture: You will focus on data-driven insights to inform your actions and the overall P&C strategy, aiming to create a high-performance, integrity-driven culture where employees can thrive.

Who You Are

• Experienced Professional: You bring 10+ years of broad, progressive HR management or consulting experience in international business environments, recognized for best-in-class HR practices.

• Handles complexity well, can handle multiple tasks and initiatives at the same time - can prioritise and organise your own and the P&C team's time and energy into the most important topics in service of our outcomes. You are someone who can stay calm in chaos and approach charged topics with maturity and objectivity, and propose

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 销售策略与业务计划制定执行
根据公司整体品牌策略，制定并落地非目标医院、基层医疗等广阔市场的年度销售策略计划、区域分解与行动方案。
规划渠道销售模式，因地制宜，探索并制定适合不同市场类型的商业化模式
结合各地基药、医保、集采等政策，制定针对性销售策略，保障销售稳定增长。
2、 渠道与外部合作伙伴管理
负责CSO及合作商业客户的筛选、评估、签约与日常管理和赋能，建立长期稳定和共赢的合作关系。
搭建外部合作团队的管理、考核与激励机制，提升合作方执行力、覆盖能力与推广效率。
定期走访关键渠道客户与合作伙伴，解决市场问题，推动终端覆盖与销量持续提升。
3、 销售团队（BPM）管理与赋能
负责拓展渠道销售团队（BPM）的日常管理、目标拆解、过程追踪与绩效评估。
定期协访一线市场，指导区域销售拓展、客户开发与上量动作，提升团队实战能力。
联合市场、培训部门搭建销售能力体系，开展产品知识、学术推广、渠道开发等专项培训。
4、 客户开发与学术销售联动
推动非核心医院、基层医疗机构等关键客户开发与关系维护。
联动市场部落地学术推广活动，将医学内容转化为销售动作，提升客户认可与处方转化。
根据一线市场信息、竞品动态与客户需求，制定策略并优化执行。
5、销售项目管理与业绩达成
策划、落地各类销售提升项目，针对不同省份特点设计差异化上量方案。
监控销售数据、渠道库存、终端覆盖与投入产出，及时调整动作确保目标达成。
跨部门协同市场、医学、商务、供应链等部门，打通流程、解决障碍，保障业务高效运转。

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验

• 教育背景

Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 资格证书
・ 大学本科及以上学历
・ 医学、药学、市场营销及相关专业优先

• Leadership Competencies 领导者胜任力

・ 聚焦结果交付，高效驱动团队达成核心目标
・ 具备较强的人际敏锐度和学习敏锐度，拥抱不确定性，具备创新能力
・ 极强的目标感、结果导向、执行力与抗压能力
・优秀的团队辅导、跨部门协同及人际沟通能力

• Job Required Competencies 岗位核心胜任力

・ 10年以上医药行业销售管理/渠道拓展经验，有基层医疗、广阔市场、院外渠道经验
・ 具备商业政策设计与规划能力，尤其是0到1的落地经验； 经销商 / CSO 管理、商业渠道运作、基药 / 非公医疗开发经验者优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head, PV Regional Center EMEA
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment.
Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.

• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.

• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.

• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.

• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.

• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.

• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.

• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).

• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.

• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.

• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.

• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).

• You are an exceptional communicator , able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English.

• You have a growth mindset , eager to experiment with new technologies and take smart risks to improve operational efficiency.

Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Stell Dir vor, Du bist der entscheidende Kompass, der uns hilft, die Talente von morgen heute schon zu finden. Bei Roche geht es nicht nur darum, Positionen zu besetzen – es geht darum, die Talente aus unterschiedlichen Professionen für unsere Vision zu gewinnen: Das Leben von Patient:innen weltweit nachhaltig zu verbessern. Als Talent Acquisition Partner:in (“TAP”) bist Du kein Recruiter im klassischen Sinne; Du bist strategische:r Berater:in, Data-Enthusiast:in und Botschafter:in in einem. Du gestaltest die Transformation unserer Arbeitswelt aktiv mit und stellst sicher, dass wir genau die Future Skills an Bord holen, die wir für die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft benötigen.

Dein neues Team:
Wir verstehen uns als Sparringpartner auf Augenhöhe für das Business und agieren als eingespieltes Team, das Wissen teilt und gemeinsam wächst. Bei uns triffst Du auf Expert:innen, die moderne Recruiting-Ansätze leben und Raum für neue Ideen bieten.
Du wirst Teil des oneREC Germany Teams bestehend aus mehr als 40 TAPs aufgeteilt auf unsere deutschen Standorte in Mannheim, Grenzach und Penzberg, sowie unsere Kolleg:innen in Budapest und berichtest an unsere REC Lead für R&D, Commercial, Group Functions & New Business.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Deine strategische Rolle

• Strategic Partner & Marktexpertise: Du bist der vertrauensvolle Strategic Partner des Business und verantwortest die Talentstrategie Deiner Fachbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Vertragsverhandlung.

• Gestalter der Transformation: Du begleitest die Transformation der Organisation, indem Du Führungskräfte proaktiv zu Future Skills und Mindset-Themen berätst und die "Must-haves" kritisch hinterfragst.

• Datenbasierte Talentakquise: Als Data-Enthusiast:in identifizierst Du Top-Talente proaktiv durch den Einsatz modernster Sourcing-Tools und KI-gestützter Ansätze, um unsere Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.

• Excellence in Candidate Experience: Du sorgst für Candidate Experience Excellence und begleitest Bewerber:innen wertschätzend bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss, wobei Du stets faire und attraktive Angebote aushandelst.

• Innovationsmotor & Agile Workflows: Du treibst innovative Projekte voran. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Reduktion von Komplexität und der Gestaltung agiler, schlanker Workflows durch die Implementierung neuester Recruiting-Trends.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du bist eine:r passionierte:r TAP — für Dich ist diese Rolle eine Berufung, nicht nur der nächste Karriereschritt. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einer modernen, agilen TA-Organisation mit. Dein Talent und Dein Mindset sind uns dabei wichtiger als jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast bereits aktiv in den strategischen Säulen der Talentakquise gearbeitet: Alignment, proaktives Sourcing und Data-Driven Decisions.

• Du bist versiert im Umgang mit modernen Technologien (z. B. Workday, Phenom People, AI-Chatbots) und nutzt Künstliche Intelligenz als strategischen Hebel.

• Du verbindest Daten und Empathie meisterhaft: Du triffst Entscheidungen fundiert, verlierst dabei aber nie den Menschen aus dem Blick.

• Du verfügst über, idealerweise profunde, Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und hast Berührungspunkte mit organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen.

• Durch regelmäßige Anwesenheit vor Ort in Penzberg arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg:innen und Stakeholdern zusammen und positionierst Dich so als strategischer Partner

• Du kommunizierst stark und klar auf Deutsch und

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant que Spécialiste IT et Workflow (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur des missions essentielles pour garantir l'autonomie et la satisfaction de nos clients pour une large gamme de nos solutions de laboratoire.

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités

• Installer nos solutions informatiques et de workflow et former les clients à l’utilisation du Middleware.

• Assurer le suivi et l’amélioration continue des solutions Roche.

• Apporter votre expertise en avant-vente si nécessaire.

• Réaliser la préparation et la mise à jour des installations Middleware Roche.

• Installer les nouvelles connexions automates validées.

• Installer les e-solutions IT et établir le paramétrage péri-analytique (Pré et post).

• Assurer un reporting exact de votre activité et maîtriser les règles et procédures Qualité Sécurité Environnement impactant votre domaine.

Quoi vous êtes:

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou équivalent en spécialisation informatique et réseaux.

• Double compétence « biologie / informatique médicale » ou une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement du laboratoire d’analyses médicales ou d’un éditeur de logiciel SIL (Système Informatique de Laboratoire), Middleware, Application médicale est un atout.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (systèmes d’exploitation, réseaux, applicatif) des infrastructures informatiques.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, de l'écoute, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Ingénieur(e) Réseau Terrain -Région Ouest (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant qu' Ingénieur Réseau Terrain (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à collaborer avec les équipes supports et IT sur des missions liées à l'installation et à la maintenance des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d'analyses médicales (privés et hospitaliers).

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités :

• Concevoir les schémas réseau, les matrices de flux et assurer leur déploiement. Gestion de son parc informatique et mise à jour des documents clients (Document d’Architecture Technique, Document d’Exploitation)

• Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Spécialiste IT et Workflow.

• Garantir les plans d'actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. Agir rapidement lors d’élaboration de PRI (Plan de Réponse aux Incidents)

• Effectuer les rétrofits hardware / software IT réseau Roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions chez nos clients.

• Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche.

• Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting précis de vos interventions et des mises à niveau .

Votre profil :

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou Master spécialisé en informatique et réseaux.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (réseaux, pare-feu, accès) des infrastructures informatiques clients.

• Aisance à l’oral, levée d’objection étant identifié comme Interlocuteur privilégié des Directions des Services Informatiques (DSI) pour expliquer les pré requis d’installation des solutions digitales Roche et échanger sur les besoins clients.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Scienziato - Salute e prestazioni dei reagenti/Sorveglianza

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Scientist - Reagent Health and Performance/Surveillance

Department Summary
This is a role in Reagent Health and Performance/Surveillance in the Oncology Assay Development organization.

Responsible for reagent product monitoring and risk based testing, including real time stability testing to support expiration dating of Ventana reagents. Work closely across Ventana functions, including: Life Cycle, Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, and Global Organizations.
Individual Contributor role: This individual will support commercialization of new products and post-launch monitoring of on-market products, risk evaluation of the on market portfolio, designing fit for purpose testing to assess product risks, drive failure investigations.

This role is based in Tucson, AZ, on site .

The Opportunity

• Research & Innovation: Executes R&D activities to develop new products or processes, identifying technical challenges and creating potentially patentable components.

• Project Execution: Plans and conducts experiments using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to meet defined project goals.

• Data Analysis & Improvement: Evaluates experimental results to form conclusions, implementing process improvements and ensuring "Quality First Time" standards.

• Collaboration & Communication: Participates in cross-functional teams, shares expertise with colleagues, and delivers technical presentations to various stakeholders.

• Strategic Support: Contributes to project planning and experimental design under the guidance of senior leadership while suggesting ways to optimize workflows.

Who You Are (Required)

• Ph.D. in Biology or related field or

• Master's Degree in Biology or related field + 3 years related experience or

• Bachelor's Degree in Biology or related field + 8 years related experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Demonstrates potential for technical proficiency, scientific creativity, collaboration with others and independent thought.

• Strong understanding of scientific principles and concepts.

• Applies advanced technical writing skills to produce reports and documents.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on Arizona is 82 700,00 - 153 700,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

jobs.title: R&D AI Transformation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview

Are you interested in how software R&D organizations evolve to integrate AI and stay ahead in a changing technological landscape? We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team.
You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation."

Key Responsibilities

• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.

• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.

• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.

• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.

• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools.

What We’re Looking For

• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.

• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.

• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!

• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.

• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

This isn't your typical administrative internship. You will gain a "bird's-eye view" of how a software R&D organization operates at scale and learn the methodologies used to drive meaningful change in the age of AI.
If you're a problem-solver who loves to see the big picture in a high-tech environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea (한국로슈진단)
Division: Core Lab & POC (진단검사 사업부)
Location: 서울
Position: Sales Representative (영업)

Your key responsibilities
Job Summary
한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

Who you are

• 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 학력 (신입 ~ 경력 7년 이하 선호)

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호

• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
