jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como parte de la cadena de suministro local de Roche Diagnostics, el especialista, la planificación y optimización de la cadena de suministro desempeña un papel importante en la entrega al garantizar a nuestros clientes niveles superiores de disponibilidad de productos y, al mismo tiempo, cumplir con los objetivos financieros de Roche (inventario, niveles de cancelación y costos de logística).

Entiende los requisitos del cliente dentro de un entorno de mercado en constante cambio y, en consecuencia, crea o redefine procesos mediante la incorporación de soluciones innovadoras de cadena de suministro, con el fin de ofrecer una ventaja competitiva y ejecutar los diversos planes de acción con base en los requerimientos comerciales y de mercadotecnia así como en las políticas locales y globales con el objetivo de facilitar el abastecimiento del producto y la toma de decisiones a la coordinación y áreas relacionadas de las divisiones Diagnóstica. (IVD)

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Proporcionar el estimado de la demanda de los reactivos y consumibles planeados por logística en conjunto con el área comercial y mercadotecnia, analizando los reportes estadísticos previos del comportamiento de ventas.

• Crear el forecast para el área comercial y mercadotecnia previamente planeado en meses anteriores, analizando mensualmente reportes DP Light forecast accuracy por producto

• Actualizar el ERP (SAP) Maestro de Materiales módulo de planificación (MPS/MRP), analizando cada 4 o 6 meses los reportes para los productos mediante DP Light, revisando los atributos de ABC code, reorder point, safety stock, rounding value, quantity per tray.

• Ejecutar las estrategias de abastecimiento realizadas por el área, elaborando la requisición de compra y dando seguimiento al embarque con el área de compras hasta su llegada al almacén.

• Programar la Demanda de Instrumentos de acuerdo al programa anual de Instrument Placement, así como la coordinación de rutas de entrega a nivel nacional a usuarios finales.

• Liderar la gestión de la demanda de estándares, introducción/salida, lanzamientos/discontinuaciones, instalaciones/desinstalaciones.

• Optimizar la disponibilidad del producto (parte del cálculo de OTIF), la precisión de las previsiones, el inventario y los niveles de cancelación.

• Asegurar una información constante y transparente flujo entre las áreas comerciales locales y la cadena de suministro global

• Investiga continuamente las tendencias y las causas raíz de los problemas de suministro por área comercial, centro de ganancias y nivel de producto.

• Identifica soluciones, brinda recomendaciones e inicia iniciativas de mejora.

• Asegurar la configuración óptima de los parámetros de planificación.

Tu perfil:

• Licenciatura en carreras de logística / planeación o Ingeniero Industrial

• Experiencia en Planeación de Demanda y Gestión de Materiales dentro de la industria de IVD (In Vitro Diagnostica), BOMs Maquilas

• Conocimientos básicos en compras, procesos de importación, trato con almacén, conocimiento en estratégias de abastecimiento, conocimiento de S & OP.

• Conocimiento en altas y mantenimientos de Datos maestros de Materiales.

• Conocimiento avanzado de SAP.

• Manejo avanzado del idioma Inglés.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

• Proporcionar el estimado de la demanda de los reactivos y consumibles planeados por logística en conjunto con el área comercial y mercadotecnia, analizando los reportes estadísticos previos del comportamiento de ventas.
• Crear el forecast para el área comercial y mercadotecnia previamente planeado en meses anteriores, analizando mensualmente reportes DP Light forecast accuracy por producto
• Actualizar el ERP (SAP) Maestro de Materiales módulo de planificación (MPS/MRP), analizando cada 4 o 6 meses los reportes para los productos mediante DP Light, revisando los atributos de ABC code, reorder point, safety stock, rounding value, quantity per tray.
• Ejecutar las estrategias de abastecimiento realizadas por el área, elaborando la requisición de compra y dando seguimiento al embarque con el área de compras hasta su llegada al almacén.
• Programar la Demanda de Instrumentos de acuerdo al programa anual de Instrument Placement, así como la coordinación de rutas de entrega a nivel nacional a usuarios finales.
• Liderar la gestión de la demanda de estándares, introducción/salida, lanzamientos/discontinuaciones, instalaciones/desinstalaciones.
• Optimizar la disponibilidad del producto (parte del cálculo de OTIF), la precisión de las previsiones, el inventario y los niveles de cancelación.

• Investiga continuamente las tendencias y las causas raíz de los problemas de suministro por área comercial, centro de ganancias y nivel de producto.
• Identifica soluciones, brinda recomendaciones e inicia iniciativas de mejora.
• Asegurar la configuración óptima de los parámetros de planificación. Tu perfil:
• Licenciatura en carreras de logística / planeación o Ingeniero Industrial
• Experiencia en Planeación de Demanda y Gestión de Materiales dentro de la industria de IVD (In Vitro Diagnostica), BOMs Maquilas
• Conocimientos básicos en compras, procesos de importación, trato con almacén, conocimiento en estratégias de abastecimiento, conocimiento de S & OP.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Molecular Account Executive - GenMark - South Texas, Utah, New Mexico, Colorado, and Northern Arizona

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.
As an Account Executive - GenMark, you will:

• be responsible for promoting GenMark’s products and services.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory is South Texas, Utah, New Mexico, Colorado, and Northern Arizona. Our Ideal candidate would live in Denver, Colorado.

Travel expectation: 50% Overnight

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Texas is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensat

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Mit dieser Vision im Blick leistet Roche Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Dabei gründet sich unser Erfolg auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt – und darauf, dass wir unsere Unterschiede als Vorteil betrachten, um das Gesundheitswesen durch Innovationen voranzutreiben. Als globale Funktion schaffen wir eine Kultur und ein Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung fördert und den Fokus auf das Wesentliche richtet. Dafür arbeiten wir auf lokaler und globaler Ebene eng mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unseren Kunden aus der gesamten Roche Wertschöpfungskette sowie anderen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit ihnen stellen wir sicher, dass sowohl Unternehmens- als auch Mitarbeitendeninteressen gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Mit unseren vielfältigen Themen und Projekten bieten wir ausgewogene Perspektiven und proaktive Lösungen in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen, um Geschäfts- und Personalstrategien erfolgreich voranzubringen.

In der dynamischen Rolle bei Roche begleitest und gestaltest Du Veränderungsprozesse. Du bringst Deine Expertise im Arbeitsrecht ein, agierst vermittelnd als (strategischer) Partner und treibst Projekte voran. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. Con questa visione, Roche sta fornendo un lavoro pionieristico nella sanità. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità – e guardiamo le nostre differenze come un vantaggio per far progredire la salute attraverso l'innovazione. Viviamo anche nella zona delle persone relazioni - per ancorarle insieme con noi nelle opere di tutta l'organizzazione, stiamo cercando voi. Come parte del People & Culture Team di Roche, il nostro obiettivo è quello di sviluppare il potenziale dei nostri dipendenti. Come funzione globale, creiamo una cultura e un ambiente che promuove l'auto-responsabilità e si concentra sugli elementi essenziali. A questo scopo, lavoriamo a stretto contatto con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti, i nostri clienti dall'intera catena di valore Roche e altri partner interni ed esterni. Insieme a loro, ci assicuriamo che sia gli affari che i dipendenti siano sostenuti allo stesso modo. Con i nostri diversi argomenti e progetti, offriamo prospettive equilibrate e soluzioni proattive in materia di diritto del lavoro per migliorare con successo le strategie aziendali e del personale. Responsabilità Questo è ciò che vi aspetta nel ruolo dinamico di Roche e modellate i processi di cambiamento. Porti la tua esperienza nel diritto del lavoro, mediando come partner (strategico) e promuovendo progetti. Per contribuire in modo significativo al successo e al miglioramento continuo di Roche, si prenderanno i seguenti compiti:
• Si svolgono complessi progetti P&C-relevant, tra cui ristrutturazioni e negoziati con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti, tenendo conto delle condizioni quadro globali e dei requisiti di diritto del lavoro locale. Hai una buona idea di fidarti dei rapporti con i rappresentanti dei lavoratori in tutte le nostre sedi tedesche e garantire il successo aziendale con approcci orientati alla soluzione. L'utente agisce come esperto: in e consulente: in caso di problemi individuali e collettivi di diritto del lavoro e sostiene l'organizzazione nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di strategie che soddisfano gli standard legali e i valori aziendali.
• Scegli processi e soluzioni nel tuo campo per aumentare l'efficienza organizzativa e garantire il rispetto delle normative vigenti.
• Costruisci una rete professionale all'interno e all'esterno e sei in grado di valutare nuove tendenze e incorporarle nella progettazione dei processi per aumentare la pertinenza e l'efficacia delle iniziative P&C.
• Si consiglia e supporta il livello di leadership con analisi sonore e raccomandazioni per l'azione su questioni critiche P&C e quindi contribuire al processo decisionale strategico. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta con
• Dopo aver completato i tuoi studi legali o (personali) economici e almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante Hai l'anzianità e l'empatia necessarie. Hai competenze complete nella riuscita realizzazione di progetti in ambienti di trasformazione.
• Hai esperienza nella collaborazione con le rappresentazioni dei dipendenti, che ti guiderà con la progettazione e la cura delle relazioni.
• La vostra conoscenza versatile del diritto del lavoro (sia individualmente che collettivamente) e la gestione del progetto sono la base per la consulenza e lo sviluppo strategico
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position A healthier future. With this vision, Roche is providing pioneering work in healthcare. Our success is based on innovation, curiosity and diversity – and we look at our differences as an advantage to advance healthcare through innovation. We also live in the area of people relations - in order to anchor them together with us in the workings of the entire organization, we are looking for you. Your new team As part of the People & Culture team at Roche, our aim is to develop the potential of our employees. As a global function, we create a culture and an environment that promotes self-responsibility and focuses on the essentials. For this purpose, we work closely with employee representatives, our customers from the entire Roche value chain and other internal and external partners. Together with them, we ensure that both business and employees are supported equally. With our diverse topics and projects, we offer balanced perspectives and proactive solutions in labour law issues to successfully advance business and personnel strategies. Responsibilities You're expecting In the dynamic role at Roche, you accompany and shape change processes. You bring your expertise in labour law, mediating as a (strategic) partner and driving projects forward. To contribute significantly to Roche's success and continuous improvement, You have the following tasks:
• You conduct complex P&C-relevant projects, including restructurings and negotiations with employee representatives, taking into account global framework conditions and local labour law requirements.
• You have a good idea of trusting relationships with workers' representatives at all our German locations and ensure business success with solution-oriented approaches.
• You act as an expert:in and consultant:in case of individual and collective labour law issues and support the organisation in the development and implementation of strategies that meet legal standards and corporate values.
• You opt for processes and solutions in your field to increase organizational efficiency and ensure compliance with current regulations.
• You build a professional network inside and outside and are able to evaluate new trends and incorporate them into process design to increase the relevance and effectiveness of P&C initiatives.
• You advise and support the leadership level with sound analyses and recommendations for action on critical P&C issues and thus contribute to strategic decision-making. Qualifications | That brings you
• After completing your legal or (personal) economic studies and at least 5 years of relevant professional experience You have the necessary seniority and empathy. You have comprehensive skills in the successful implementation of projects in transformation environments.
• You have expertise in collaborating with employee representations, which will guide you with the design and care of relationships.
• Your versatile knowledge of labour law (both individually and collectively) and project management are the foundation for consulting and strategy development

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. Avec cette vision, Roche fournit un travail de pionnier dans les soins de santé. Notre succès repose sur l'innovation, la curiosité et la diversité – et nous considérons nos différences comme un avantage pour faire progresser les soins de santé par l'innovation. Nous vivons également dans le domaine des relations humaines - afin de les ancrer avec nous dans le fonctionnement de toute l'organisation, nous vous cherchons. Votre nouvelle équipe Dans le cadre de l'équipe People & Culture de Roche, notre objectif est de développer le potentiel de nos collaborateurs. En tant que fonction mondiale, nous créons une culture et un environnement qui favorisent l'autoresponsabilité et qui se concentrent sur l'essentiel. À cette fin, nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les représentants des salariés, nos clients de toute la chaîne de valeur Roche et d'autres partenaires internes et externes. Avec eux, nous veillons à ce que les entreprises et les employés bénéficient d'un soutien égal. Avec nos divers sujets et projets, nous offrons des perspectives équilibrées et des solutions proactives en matière de droit du travail pour faire progresser avec succès les stratégies d'affaires et de personnel. Responsabilités Vous vous attendez Dans le rôle dynamique de Roche, vous accompagnez et façonnez les processus de changement. Vous apportez votre expertise en droit du travail, la médiation en tant que partenaire (stratégique) et les projets à l'avenir. Pour contribuer de manière significative au succès et à l'amélioration continue de Roche, vous avez les tâches suivantes :
• Vous réalisez des projets complexes, y compris des restructurations et des négociations avec les représentants des travailleurs, en tenant compte des conditions-cadres globales et des exigences du droit du travail local.
• Vous avez une bonne idée de faire confiance aux représentants des travailleurs dans tous nos sites allemands et d'assurer le succès des entreprises avec des approches orientées vers la solution.
• Vous agissez en tant qu'expert:en et consultant: en cas de questions de droit du travail individuel et collectif et aidez l'organisation à élaborer et à mettre en œuvre des stratégies qui répondent aux normes juridiques et aux valeurs de l'entreprise.
• Vous optez pour des processus et des solutions dans votre domaine pour accroître l'efficacité organisationnelle et assurer le respect des règlements en vigueur.
• Vous créez un réseau professionnel à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur et vous êtes en mesure d'évaluer les nouvelles tendances et de les intégrer à la conception des processus pour accroître la pertinence et l'efficacité des initiatives de P&C.
• Vous conseillez et soutenez le niveau de leadership avec de solides analyses et des recommandations d'action sur des questions critiques de P&C et contribuez ainsi à la prise de décisions stratégiques. Qualités Ça t'amène.
• Après avoir terminé vos études juridiques ou économiques (personnelles) et au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente Vous avez l'ancienneté et l'empathie nécessaires. Vous avez des compétences complètes dans la mise en œuvre réussie de projets dans des environnements de transformation.
• Vous avez une expertise dans la collaboration avec les représentations des employés, qui vous guidera dans la conception et le soin des relations.
• Votre connaissance polyvalente du droit du travail (individuellement et collectivement) et de la gestion de projets est la base de la consultation et de l'élaboration de stratégies

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology (East Java)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology (East Java)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity

• The PJP acts as a trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche involved in the patient journey. As the local face of Roche, PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• The PJP is responsible for creating exponential impacts for patients and the community and bringing us closer to our vision. Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Resource Planning, the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. PJP is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally (affiliate) and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs, HSPs and enabling functions.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Owner of the customer engagement strategy based on the customer insights (planning until implementation) together with other PJPs.

Who you are

• You should hold a university degree (scientific, economic, or business degree) or an advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies as well as deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.

• You should have broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions and robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research

• You should have an in-depth understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the role of multiple stakeholders within this. Also, In-depth knowledge of Indonesia Pharmaceutical Code of Conduct and other relevant standards and guidelines

• You should have excellent experience in customer and stakeholder engagement in healthcare system.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:

The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Der globale Studienleiter ist dafür verantwortlich, sicherzustellen, dass alle Studien innerhalb des geplanten Zeitrahmens und der geplanten Kosten angemessen konzipiert, geplant, durchgeführt, überwacht, abgeschlossen und dokumentiert werden. Sicherstellen, dass die Verantwortlichkeiten des Sponsors erfüllt werden und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung aller geltenden gesetzlichen Anforderungen sichergestellt wird. Verantwortlich für die Zeit- und Budgetplanung sowie die Durchführung von Studien. Weist bestimmte Aufgaben anderen Mitgliedern des Studienteams zu und stellt diese sicher. Bietet die Aufsicht über externe Unterstützung, einschließlich CROs, Berater und/oder medizinische Berater. Die Gelegenheit: Zu den Hauptverantwortungsbereichen dieser Position gehören unter anderem:
• Leitet das globale Studienteam mit voller Verantwortung für die Studienergebnisse in Bezug auf Qualität, Budget und Zeitpläne in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Studienteam und stellt die Entwicklung hochwertiger Studiendesigns für gesponserte Studien in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Experten sicher.
• Bereitet in Zusammenarbeit mit der Programmleitung verschiedene Szenarien für die Evidenzgenerierung vor (z. B. Studie, reale Beweise) in funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit (z. B. mit Regulatory Affairs, F&E, CDMA-Projektteams), um globale Strategien und die Planung von Zeitrahmen und Kosten zu unterstützen.
• Entwickelt wichtige Studiendokumente (d. h. Design-Validierungsplan, Protokoll, Studienschulungsmaterialien, Studienformulare und -vorlagen, Studienbericht).
• Überwacht die Planung und operativen Aspekte von Companion Diagnostics-Studien, die von Pharmapartnern gesponsert werden.
• Verantwortlich für das Budget der zugewiesenen Studien auf Studienebene.
• Einhaltung von Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Standardarbeitsanweisungen und Gewährleistung der Audit-/Inspektionsbereitschaft.
• Durchführung geförderter Studien für zugewiesene Schwerpunktbereiche für zulassungs- und/oder nichtzulassungsrelevante Zwecke in allen Studienphasen (Planung, Anlauf, Durchführung und Abschluss). Beaufsichtigt Studienaktivitäten, die an einen Dienstleister (z. B. CRO) ausgelagert werden.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Studienergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Publikationsteam veröffentlicht werden.
• Beaufsichtigt Projekte, um sicherzustellen, dass sie pünktlich, innerhalb des Umfangs und des Budgets abgeschlossen werden; und verfolgt die Projektleistung, um die Erreichung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele zu analysieren.
• Aufbau und Pflege starker, kooperativer Beziehungen mit funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften, wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern und anderen Allianzpartnern, einschließlich CROs, um Geschäftsziele zu erreichen und operative Exzellenz sicherzustellen. Wer Sie sind:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Biowissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Sie verfügen über mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung des gesamten Lebenszyklus geförderter Studien und stellen sicher, dass Projekte die Leistungsziele innerhalb von Umfang, Qualität, Budget und Zeitrahmen erreichen.
• Sie verfügen über umfassende Erfahrung darin, sicherzustellen, dass Studienergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Publikationsteam veröffentlicht werden.
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Rolle des Clinical Operations in der Produktentwicklung; sind sich der Stellung von Roche auf dem Markt und unseres Wertversprechens gegenüber Patienten und Kunden bewusst.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit PHCS- und Companion Diagnostic-Studien, insbesondere in den Bereichen Pathologie und Kernlaborindikationen.
• Sie haben Erfahrung im Management komplexer Projekte, indem Sie analytisches Urteilsvermögen und innovatives Denken zur Bewertung von Risiken und Risiken einsetzen

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Un avenir plus sain. C’est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous passons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C’est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le responsable de l'étude mondiale est chargé de veiller à ce que toutes les études soient conçues, planifiées, exécutées, surveillées, clôturées et documentées de manière appropriée dans les délais et les coûts prévus ; s'assurer que les responsabilités du sponsor sont remplies, tout en assurant le respect de toutes les exigences réglementaires applicables. Responsable de la planification du calendrier et du budget et de l'exécution des études. Attribue et assure l'exécution de tâches spécifiques vers/depuis les autres membres de l'équipe d'étude. Assure la supervision du soutien externe, y compris les CRO, les consultants et/ou les conseillers médicaux. L'opportunité : Les principales responsabilités pour ce poste comprennent, sans s'y limiter :
• Diriger l'équipe d'étude mondiale avec l'entière responsabilité des livrables de l'étude en ce qui concerne la qualité, le budget et les délais, en collaboration avec l'équipe d'étude et assurer le développement de conceptions d'étude de haute qualité pour les études sponsorisées en collaboration avec des experts internes et externes.
• En collaboration avec la direction du programme, prépare différents scénarios pour la génération de preuves (par exemple, étude, monde réel). preuves) en collaboration interfonctionnelle (par exemple avec les affaires réglementaires, la R&D, les équipes de projet CDMA) pour soutenir les stratégies mondiales et la planification du calendrier et des coûts.
• Élabore les documents d'étude clés (c'est-à-dire le plan de validation de la conception, le protocole, le matériel de formation à l'étude, les formulaires et modèles d'étude, le rapport d'étude).
• Respect des réglementations, des lignes directrices et des procédures opérationnelles standard, et garantie de la préparation aux audits/inspections.
• Exécution d'études sponsorisées pour des domaines d'intérêt assignés à des fins d'inscription et/ou non-inscription à travers toutes les phases de l'étude (planification, démarrage, conduite et clôture). Supervise les activités d’étude externalisées à un fournisseur de services (c’est-à-dire CRO).
• Veiller à ce que les résultats de l'étude soient publiés en collaboration avec l'équipe de publication.
• Supervise les projets pour garantir leur achèvement à temps, dans les limites de la portée et du budget ; et suit les performances du projet pour analyser la réalisation des objectifs à court et à long terme.
• Établir et entretenir des relations de collaboration solides avec les dirigeants interfonctionnels, les principales parties prenantes internes et externes et d'autres partenaires de l'alliance, y compris les CRO, pour atteindre les objectifs commerciaux et garantir l'excellence opérationnelle. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Vous avez plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion du cycle de vie complet des études sponsorisées, garantissant que les projets atteignent les objectifs de performance en termes de portée, de qualité, de budget et de calendrier.
• Vous possédez une vaste expérience dans la garantie que les résultats des études sont publiés en collaboration avec l'équipe de publication.
• Vous possédez des connaissances et une expérience approfondies dans le rôle des opérations cliniques dans le développement de produits ; sommes conscients de la place de Roche sur le marché et de notre proposition de valeur aux patients et aux clients.
• Vous avez de l'expérience avec les essais PHCS et Companion Diagnostic, en particulier dans le domaine de la pathologie et des indications de laboratoire de base.
• Vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion de projets complexes en utilisant le jugement analytique et la pensée innovante pour évaluer les risques et les risques.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

For the Bratislava location the salary starts from 1 600 EUR gross / month. For the Prague location, the salary starts from 48 300 CZK / month. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Ce rôle est basé dans le Centre Régional d'Assistance à la Clientèle qui se consacre à fournir l'excellence tout en aidant le personnel de laboratoire à utiliser nos produits. Nous travaillons avec une approche holistique, ce qui signifie que nous prenons soin de notre portefeuille de produits, de l'idée jusqu'au développement et au lancement du marché jusqu'à l'élimination progressive. La grande variété de technologies appliquées dans ce domaine vous offre d'excellentes possibilités d'apprentissage. Spécialiste du soutien technique (Slovaque et tchèque) Emplacements: Varsovie, Prague ou Bratislava (Votre choix!) Êtes-vous prêt à passer de l'expertise technique à l'impact qui change la vie? Notre Centre régional d'assistance à la clientèle (RCSC) est le moteur intellectuel derrière l'excellence du laboratoire en Europe centrale. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un talent tchèque et/ou slovaque qui a faim de savoir, aime la résolution de problèmes et est prêt à maîtriser les technologies de diagnostic les plus avancées du monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La possibilité : Plus que juste soutenir Ce n'est pas un rôle typique d'assistance. Il s'agit d'une position de conseil en ingénierie et en application où vous devenez le "gardien" de la précision diagnostique.
• Maîtriser la complexité: Vous travaillerez avec des systèmes de diagnostic IVD haut de gamme (In-Vitro Diagnostics) qui combinent la robotique, la biochimie complexe et l'informatique avancée.
• Croissance continue : Nous proposons un programme de formation intensif de calibre mondial. Nous ne nous attendons pas à ce que vous sachiez tout au premier jour, mais nous nous attendons à ce que vous soyez celui qui ne cesse de demander "pourquoi?".
• Impact Agile: Rejoignez une équipe où votre proactivité n'est pas seulement bienvenue – c'est nécessaire. Vous éviterez les problèmes avant qu'ils ne se produisent, en utilisant des jumelles numériques et des outils de diagnostic à distance. Qui vous êtes :
• Éducation: Vous avez un diplôme en ingénierie, IT, biochimie, diagnostic de laboratoire ou équivalent. Plus important encore, vous avez un "esprit détecteur" pour le dépannage.
• Pouvoir linguistique: Vous êtes un natif ou C1/C2 locuteur de tchèque et/ou slovaque. Votre anglais est assez fort pour vous guider à travers des formations internationales et des forums techniques mondiaux.
• Le pont "Lab-to-Office" : Si vous avez travaillé dans un laboratoire clinique et que vous vous sentez dépassé vos murs actuels, nous voulons votre logique diagnostique. Nous allons vous enseigner l'ingénierie; vous apportez la passion pour la science.
• Résilience & Ambition: Vous êtes quelqu'un qui voit une erreur technique complexe non pas comme un problème, mais comme un défi à conquérir. Ce que Roche vous offre :
• Autonomie : un modèle de travail hybride à Varsovie, Prague ou Bratislava.
• Portfolio inégalé : accès aux technologies qui établissent la norme pour la prochaine décennie de soins de santé. Il s'agit d'un contrat de 18 mois passé par une agence externe. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming facilities operations to support cutting-edge science and patient care? Join Roche Diagnostics as the Director of Facilities & Engineering for our Bay Area sites, where you'll take charge of shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence of our Pleasanton and Santa Clara campuses. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee large-scale capital projects, optimize site master plans, and drive continuous improvements in reliability, safety, and efficiency. As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, you will inspire and develop a high-performing team, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure our facilities meet the highest standards of compliance and performance—empowering Roche’s mission to deliver extraordinary outcomes for patients around the world.

This role is responsible for the strategic leadership of all Facilities & Engineering initiatives across the Bay Area sites ( Pleasanton and Santa Clara ). This includes directing operations and maintenance, campus master planning, capital investment strategies and execution, asset lifecycle management, and reliability engineering. The Director is ultimately accountable for ensuring facilities operations are compliant, reliable, fiscally responsible and directly support the organization's overarching business objectives. This leader inspires and empowers a culture of operational excellence where every employee can achieve extraordinary outcomes for customers and patients every day.

The Opportunity
Responsibilities

• Oversees the curation and management of the Facilities CAPEX portfolio for Roche Diagnostics Sites in the Bay Area. Directs all facility related capital projects in support of the Facility Master Plan. Capital projects range from 100,000 USD to 100,000,000 USD with the following responsibilities: project scope, cost and schedule development, funding documentation development and presentation to senior management, construction, move coordination and project close-out. May direct capital project planning and execution for sites outside the Bay Area based on need and available resources.

• Develops and executes annual and long range strategic Facility Master Plans based on Site Business Plans. Plan development and execution requires interaction across all functional areas of the business and senior management, with strong negotiation skills to solve complex problems affecting nearly all employees at Roche sites.

• Direct facility operations and maintenance programs performance measurement, service provider management, and resource planning as well as developing, sharing and adopting technical innovations, life cycle costing models, best practices, KPIs and benchmarking information with the global Facilities community.

• Direct engineering services which include life cycle costing, energy conservation, asset management, reliability engineering, performance measurement and resource planning.

• Directs and leads efforts to ensure engineering-related policies, procedures, and practices are effective, efficient and consistent. Provides regular, consistent updates on facilities and engineering matters to support ongoing awareness and continuity of business operations.

• Interacts at a high level with internal and external resources to ensure the Company is in compliance with local, state, federal, and corporate regulations as well as internal Quality System and regulatory compliance programs.

Unisciti a Roche Diagnostics come Direttore di Strutture e Ingegneria per i nostri siti di Bay Area, dove ti occuperai di modellare la direzione strategica e l'eccellenza operativa dei nostri campus di Pleasanton e Santa Clara. Questo ruolo fondamentale offre l'opportunità di supervisionare progetti di capitale su larga scala, ottimizzare i piani di master del sito e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità, la sicurezza e l'efficienza. In qualità di membro chiave del team di Leadership del sito, ispirerete e svilupperete un team di alto livello, promuovere una cultura dell’innovazione, e garantire che le nostre strutture soddisfino i più elevati standard di conformità e prestazioni, potenziando la missione di Roche per fornire risultati straordinari per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo è responsabile della leadership strategica di tutte le iniziative di Strutture e Ingegneria nei siti Bay Area ( Pleasanton e Santa Clara). Il Direttore è in ultima analisi responsabile per garantire che le operazioni delle strutture siano conformi, affidabili, responsabile fiscale e sostengano direttamente gli obiettivi aziendali di supervisione dell'organizzazione. Questo leader ispira e potenzia una cultura di eccellenza operativa dove ogni dipendente può ottenere risultati straordinari per clienti e pazienti ogni giorno. L'opportunità responsabilità
• supervisiona la cura e la gestione del portafoglio Servizi CAPEX per i Siti diagnostici Roche nell'area della baia. Dirige tutti i progetti di capitale relativi alla struttura a sostegno del Facility Master Plan. I progetti di capitale variano da 100.000 USD a 100,000,000 USD con le seguenti responsabilità: portata di progetto, sviluppo dei costi e dei programmi, sviluppo della documentazione di finanziamento e presentazione alla gestione senior, costruzione, coordinamento del movimento e chiusura del progetto. Può la pianificazione e l'esecuzione del progetto di capitale diretto per i siti al di fuori della Bay Area in base alle necessità e alle risorse disponibili.
• Sviluppa ed esegue piani strategici di Facility Master annuali e a lungo raggio basati su Piani di business del sito. Lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione del piano richiedono l'interazione in tutte le aree funzionali del business e della gestione senior, con forti capacità di negoziazione per risolvere problemi complessi che interessano quasi tutti i dipendenti dei siti Roche.
• Misura diretta delle prestazioni delle operazioni di impianti e dei programmi di manutenzione, gestione dei fornitori di servizi e pianificazione delle risorse, nonché sviluppo, condivisione e adozione di innovazioni tecniche, modelli di costo del ciclo di vita, best practice, KPI e informazioni di benchmarking con la comunità globale delle strutture.
• Servizi di ingegneria diretta che includono il costo del ciclo di vita, la conservazione dell'energia, la gestione degli asset, l'ingegneria dell'affidabilità, la misurazione delle prestazioni e la pianificazione delle risorse.
• Diretti e conduce gli sforzi per garantire politiche, procedure e pratiche connesse all'ingegneria sono efficaci, efficienti e coerenti. Fornisce aggiornamenti regolari e coerenti su strutture e questioni ingegneristiche per supportare la consapevolezza e la continuità in corso delle operazioni aziendali.
• Interagisce ad alto livello con risorse interne ed esterne per garantire che la Società sia conforme alle normative locali, statali, federali e societarie, nonché al sistema di qualità interno e ai programmi di conformità alle normative.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Sind Sie ein visionärer Führer mit einer Leidenschaft für die Transformation von Anlagen, um Spitzenforschung und Patientenversorgung zu unterstützen? Besuchen Sie Roche Diagnostics als Director of Facilities & Engineering für unsere Standorte in Bay Area, wo Sie die strategische Ausrichtung und operative Exzellenz unserer Lagerstätten Pleasanton und Santa Clara prägen. Diese zentrale Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, Großkapitalprojekte zu überwachen, Standort-Masterpläne zu optimieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Effizienz zu erzielen. Als zentrales Mitglied des Site Leadership Teams werden Sie ein hochperformierendes Team begeistern und entwickeln, eine Innovationskultur fördern und sicherstellen, dass unsere Einrichtungen den höchsten Standards der Compliance und Leistung entsprechen – und Roches Mission, außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse für Patienten auf der ganzen Welt zu liefern. Diese Rolle ist für die strategische Führung aller Einrichtungen und Engineering-Initiativen in den Bay Area-Sites ( Pleasanton und Santa Clara) verantwortlich. Dazu gehören die Leitung von Betrieben und Wartung, Campus-Masterplanung, Kapitalanlagestrategien und Ausführung, Asset Lifecycle Management und Zuverlässigkeits Engineering. Der Direktor ist letztlich verantwortlich dafür, dass Anlagengeschäfte konform, zuverlässig, steuerlich verantwortlich sind und die übergeordneten Geschäftsziele der Organisation direkt unterstützen. Dieser Führer inspiriert und fördert eine Kultur der operativen Exzellenz, in der jeder Mitarbeiter jeden Tag außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse für Kunden und Patienten erzielen kann. Die Chance Aufgaben
• Überprüft die Heilung und Verwaltung des CAPEX-Portfolios für Roche Diagnostics Sites im Bay Area. Richtet alle standortbezogenen Kapitalprojekte zur Unterstützung des Facility Master Plan. Die Investitionsprojekte reichen von 100.000 USD bis 100.000.000 USD mit folgenden Aufgaben: Projektumfang, Kosten- und Zeitplanentwicklung, Finanzierung der Dokumentationsentwicklung und Präsentation bis hin zu Senior Management, Konstruktion, Bewegung Koordination und Projektabwicklung. Kann direkte Investitionsprojektplanung und Ausführung für Standorte außerhalb des Bay Area basierend auf Bedarf und verfügbaren Ressourcen.
• Entwicklung und Durchführung von jährlichen und langen strategischen Facility Master Plans auf Basis von Site Business Plans. Die Entwicklung und Durchführung von Plänen erfordert Interaktion in allen funktionellen Bereichen des Unternehmens und des Senior Managements, mit starken Verhandlungskompetenzen, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen, die fast alle Mitarbeiter an Roche-Standorten betreffen.
• Direkte Anlagenbetriebe und Wartungsprogramme Leistungsmessung, Service-Provider-Management und Ressourcenplanung sowie Entwicklung, Austausch und Übernahme technischer Innovationen, Life Cycle Costing-Modelle, Best Practices, KPIs und Benchmarking-Informationen mit der globalen Einrichtungen-Community.
• Direkte Engineering-Dienste, die Lebenszyklus-Kosten, Energieeinsparung, Asset Management, Zuverlässigkeit Engineering, Leistungsmessung und Ressourcenplanung umfassen.
• Direkte und führende Anstrengungen zur Gewährleistung ingenieurtechnischer Strategien, Verfahren und Praktiken sind wirksam, effizient und konsistent. Bietet regelmäßige, konsequente Updates zu Einrichtungen und Ingenieursfragen, um das kontinuierliche Bewusstsein und die Kontinuität des Geschäftsbetriebs zu unterstützen.
• Interagiert auf hohem Niveau mit internen und externen Ressourcen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen in Übereinstimmung mit lokalen, staatlichen, Bundes- und Unternehmensvorschriften sowie internen Qualitätssystem und regulatorischen Compliance-Programmen ist.

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Expert, particularly with eDiscovery expertise, to join our Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Group Functions eDiscovery and Forensics team. In this critical role, you will act as the primary technical bridge between the RDT infrastructure team and the Business Product Owners in Legal and Compliance.

Your primary focus will support the technical aspects of eDiscovery and privacy processes, specializing in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium) and ensuring the defensible identification, collection, and preservation of electronically stored information (ESI) across a wide range of corporate systems and hardware, with a strong emphasis on Apple mobile ecosystems and mixed-OS laptop environments (macOS and Windows).

The Opportunity:
You will act as a subject matter expert, ensuring that all data is acquired in a legally defensible and forensically sound manner and maintaining a strict chain of custody to support litigation, internal investigations, and regulatory requests. You will also proactively drive and implement prioritized projects that align with business needs.

jobs.title: Coordenador Importação e Exportação
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Coordenador de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por gerenciar e supervisionar todas as operações relacionadas ao comércio exterior da Roche, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações aduaneiras e fiscais, além de otimizar custos e prazos de entrega. Você também irá atuar na gestão de fornecedores, transportadoras, despachantes aduaneiros e órgãos regulatórios para garantir eficiência e qualidade nos processos logísticos internacionais.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Gerenciar operações de importação e exportação, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e custos otimizados.

• Assegurar conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais, incluindo normas da Receita Federal, Anvisa, MAPA e demais órgãos reguladores.

• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para redução de custos logísticos e tributários, como utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).

• Negociar com fornecedores, agentes de carga, transportadoras e despachantes aduaneiros para obter melhores condições de frete e serviços em conjunto com a área de procurement, estabelecendo SLAs, indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação para garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e eficiência nos serviços prestados.

• Acompanhar processos de desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo agilidade na liberação de mercadorias.

• Monitorar Performance e KPIs de comércio exterior, como lead time, On time, custos de importação/exportação e eficiência logística, implementando metodologias de melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares) para acompanhamento contínuo e identificação de oportunidades de otimização.

• Coordenar auditorias e controles internos para garantir conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentos externos.

• Interagir com áreas internas, como Supply Chain, Finanças, Compras, Vendas, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Jurídica e Tributária para alinhar estratégias e demandas operacionais.

• Gerenciar a logística de transporte internacional, garantindo a integridade dos produtos e a eficiência dos modais utilizados (aéreo, marítimo, rodoviário), com foco em estruturação de processos e eliminação de gargalos operacionais.

• Liderar a estruturação e redesenho de processos da área de Comex através de mapeamento de fluxos, implementação de melhorias operacionais e adoção de tecnologias/sistemas que tragam maior eficiência e rastreabilidade às operações.

• Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe de Comex, definindo objetivos de performance alinhados à estratégia da empresa, acompanhando indicadores individuais e coletivos, promovendo capacitação contínua e fomentando uma cultura de excelência operacional e melhoria contínua.

Quem é você:

• Graduação completa em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência na implementação e utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).

• Experiência sólida em operações de importação e exportação, incluindo desembaraço aduaneiro e regimes especiais.

• Conhecimento avançado em legislação aduaneira, classificação fiscal, Incoterms e tributação de comércio exterior.

• Experiência na negociação com fornecedores logísticos e prestadores de serviços.

• Inglês fluente.

• Habilidade de análise de dados e tomada de decisão estratégica.

• Desejável Certificações em Comércio Exterior e/ou Certificação Lean Six Sigma

• Experiência em empresas do setor de produtos para saúde, farmacêutico ou químico.

• Conhecimento em ge

• Gerenciar operações de importação e exportação, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e custos otimizados.
• Assegurar conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais, incluindo normas da Receita Federal, Anvisa, MAPA e demais órgãos reguladores.
• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para redução de custos logísticos e tributários, como utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).
• Negociar com fornecedores, agentes de carga, transportadoras e despachantes aduaneiros para obter melhores condições de frete e serviços em conjunto com a área de procurement, estabelecendo SLAs, indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação para garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e eficiência nos serviços prestados.
• Acompanhar processos de desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo agilidade na liberação de mercadorias.
• Monitorar Performance e KPIs de comércio exterior, como lead time, On time, custos de importação/exportação e eficiência logística, implementando metodologias de melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares) para acompanhamento contínuo e identificação de oportunidades de otimização.
• Coordenar auditorias e controles internos para garantir conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentos externos.
• Interagir com áreas internas, como Supply Chain, Finanças, Compras, Vendas, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Jurídica e Tributária para alinhar estratégias e demandas operacionais.
• Gerenciar a logística de transporte internacional, garantindo a integridade dos produtos e a eficiência dos modais utilizados (aéreo, marítimo, rodoviário), com foco em estruturação de processos e eliminação de gargalos operacionais.
• Liderar a estruturação e redesenho de processos da área de Comex através de mapeamento de fluxos, implementação de melhorias operacionais e adoção de tecnologias/sistemas que tragam maior eficiência e rastreabilidade às operações.
• Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe de Comex, definindo objetivos de performance alinhados à estratégia da empresa, acompanhando indicadores individuais e coletivos, promovendo capacitação contínua e fomentando uma cultura de excelência operacional e melhoria contínua. Quem é você:
• Graduação completa em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.
• Experiência na implementação e utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).
• Experiência sólida em operações de importação e exportação, incluindo desembaraço aduaneiro e regimes especiais.
• Conhecimento avançado em legislação aduaneira, classificação fiscal, Incoterms e tributação de comércio exterior.
• Experiência na negociação com fornecedores logísticos e prestadores de serviços.
• Inglês fluente.
• Habilidade de análise de dados e tomada de decisão estratégica.
• Desejável Certificações em Comércio Exterior e/ou Certificação Lean Six Sigma
• Experiência em empresas do setor de produtos para saúde, farmacêutico ou químico.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - RDT Pharma R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution Architect - Pharma R&D
Preferred Location: Pune

The Opportunity

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical guidance to the assigned product team, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt. You will collaborate closely with the Senior Architect for the area to ensure alignment with broader architecture direction, standards, and roadmaps.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and applies agreed architecture standards and seeks input from the Senior Architect or architecture governance where required.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned solution, in alignment with the Senior Architect for the area. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Applies and contributes to reference architectures and patterns, in collaboration with the Senior Architect where broader alignment is needed, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded..

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical guidance and consultation on specific technologies for the assigned product or solution team. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and supports the adoption of new technologies in alignment with the Senior Architect and agreed technology direction. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within an assigned solution context, with clear accountability for solution architecture in that scope..

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Shares architecture knowledge, supports good design practices, and mentors colleagues where relevant.

Who you are

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within an assigned product or solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions a

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

职位职责：
• （1）协助在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2）协助进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3）协助开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4）协助及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理

• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

jobs.title: Project Manager (contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

1 year contract
Mississsauga, ON

The Project Manager is accountable for the end-to-end strategy, planning, execution, monitoring, and change management of Patient Support Programs (PSPs) between our partners, ensuring business continuity and an uninterrupted, high-quality patient experience.

In this role, the Project Manager will be a key partner to cross-functional teams, responsible for translating Therapeutic Area/Brand strategies into a comprehensive change management strategy that prioritizes patient continuity and operational excellence. This accountability spans the full transition lifecycle, from transition design and vendor onboarding to execution, stabilization, and optimization. The Program Manager will proactively manage risks, timelines, and dependencies while ensuring seamless coordination between outgoing and incoming vendors.

The Opportunity:

Program & Transition Management

• Lead end-to-end planning and execution of the Patient Support Program transition between vendor

• Develop and manage detailed transition roadmaps, timelines, milestones, and deliverables

• Identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies to ensure uninterrupted patient services

• Coordinate with internal teams (commercial, medical, compliance, finance, legal) and external vendors

• Monitor program performance, track KPIs, and ensure adherence to scope, budget, and timelines

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement :

• Design and implement a structured change management approach to support the transition

• Engage and align key stakeholders, including leadership, vendors, and cross-functional teams

• Develop communication strategies to ensure transparency and clarity throughout the transition

Patient Centric Design & Continuous Improvement:

• Apply design thinking principles to optimize patient experience during and after the transition

• Ensure continuity of care by minimizing disruption to patient services and support programs

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or related field; Master’s degree is an asset

• You possess 5+ years of relevant program management, large-scale transition, or related experience and you have 7+ years of experience in Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, or Patient Services environments

• Strong program management and change management capabilities, with experience leading complex transitions

• Experience managing vendor transitions, outsourcing, or operational transformations preferred

• PSP or patient services is an asset

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing, negotiation, and navigating complex environments

• Ability to translate strategy into execution with strong business and operational acumen

• Ability to work cross-functionally and align internal teams and external partners (including vendors)

• Experience with digital tools, automation, or AI-enabled solutions is an asset

• Bilingual (English/French) is an asset

Relocation assistance is not available for this job posting.
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (Contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

The Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care.

Major Accountabilities

• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping.

Details:

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient
