jobs.title: Product IT Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Product IT Specialist is responsible for installing and maintaining Roche Diagnostics IT Products and Roche Instruments’ operating software and workflow at Customer sites. You will play an important role in planning, implementing, creating, organizing and monitoring the activities of workflow & IT Solutions products.

Your Responsibilities

• Work with business stakeholders, IT partners and customers to design and build workflow & IT solutions for our customers.

• Install, maintain and troubleshooting Roche IT products at Customer sites.

• Install, maintain, and secure Windows-based environments (physical and virtual) and physical Firewalls to ensure seamless connectivity between devices and servers.

• Lead comprehensive troubleshooting of complex IT ecosystems—including servers, middleware, and integrations.

• Partner with customers' IT and Information Security teams to define access protocols, ensure secure communication, and verify compliance with organizational cybersecurity requirements.

• Provides consultation on connectivity solutions, regulatory compliance, security and virus protection concerns and the implementation of our products.

• Supports first implementation and subsequent implementations or modifications of the designed solutions at customer's sites.

• Supports relevant business opportunities for the assigned portfolio by helping to define tailored solutions based on customers' needs and objectives.

• Ensure activity planning/reporting on the CRM software, keeping data updated.

Who You Are

• Hold a diploma in IT, Automation or Networking

• Experience with HL7/ASTM protocols- advantage

• Work experience in data security, IT support, networking or IT product support – advantage

• Work experience in medical laboratories – advantage

• Strong in problem solving and troubleshooting

• Excellent communications and presentation skills, proactive, dynamic, independent, autodidact and able to work under pressure

• Customer focused and a strong team player

• Fluent in English and Hebrew (both oral and written)

• Driving license

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche Diagnostics is seeking a Global Customer Support (GCS) - Molecular Labs Senior Specialist to join our team in either Cape Town, South Africa or St Cugat, Spain.

As a GCS Molecular Labs Senior Specialist you will be the technical linchpin for a new era of diagnostic ecosystems. Your primary focus will be the global rollout and support of the Roche new sequencer (AXELIOS) platform and the Avenio Connect cloud-integration suite.

This role is designed for a high-level IT professional who thrives at the intersection of high-performance computing (HPC), advanced networking, and medical hardware. While you will provide sustaining support for legacy NIPT (AcfS) solutions, your core mission is to architect and troubleshoot the high-speed data pathways that power the future of personalized medicine.

Key Responsibilities

1. High-Performance Infrastructure (SBX/AXELIOS Focus)

• Data Pipeline Optimization: Support the IT and network architecture for the Roche AXELIOS (SBX) platform across the EMEA region.

• Bottleneck Troubleshooting: Optimize high-speed data pathways from bandwidth management to compute clusters and storage nodes.

• System Administration: Manage environment-specific OS requirements, including Roche Linux (RLX) and Windows Server for the Unified Gateway.

2. Cloud & Digital Connectivity (Avenio Connect)

• Connectivity Architecture: Oversee Avenio Connect integrations, ensuring seamless instrument-to-Cloud and instrument-to-LIMS communication.

• Security & Compliance: Configure and manage FortiGate 60F Firewalls , ensuring security certificates and firewall rules align with global medical data standards.

• Remote Ecosystems: Implement and support remote user interfaces and service access protocols (SSH, RDP, VNC).

3. Advanced Networking & Support

• Topology Design: Troubleshoot and optimize complex network topologies, including VLANs, VPNs, and SD-WAN , within high-output clinical environments.

• Escalation Leadership: Serve as the Tier-2/3 escalation point for regional field teams, performing deep-dive analysis into packet loss, latency, and system crashes.

• Legacy Maintenance (NIPT/AcfS): Provide secondary sustaining support for the AcfS (Ariosa cell-free DNA System) and associated partner hardware as it phases out over the coming years.

Who You Are as an Ideal Candidate
Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Professional Experience: 7+ years in IT/Networking and Hardware support, ideally managing integrated systems in a regulated or clinical environment.

• Networking Expertise: Advanced proficiency in firewalls, routing/switching, and security protocols (CCNP level preferred).

• Travel Flexibility: Ability to travel up to 30% for site audits and installations. Travel flexibility to Schengen states is preferred .

​
Preferred Skills (Bioinformatics, Cloud & Documentation):

• Knowledge Management: Demonstrated experience in authoring high-quality technical files (SOPs, site preparation guides, network diagrams) and delivering technical training to global field teams and customer IT departments.

• Bioinformatics (BFX): Familiarity with NGS pipelines, data storage (NAS/SAN), and genomic file formats like FASTQ and VCF .

• Hybrid Cloud: Experience with AWS or Google Cloud hybrid deployments for diagnostic data.

• Infrastructure Knowledge: Understanding of high-speed data requ

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics sta cercando un Global Customer Support (GCS) - Molecular Labs Senior Specialist per unirsi al nostro team in Città del Capo, Sud Africa o St Cugat, Spagna. In qualità di GCS Molecular Labs Senior Specialist sarai il supporto tecnico per una nuova era di ecosistemi diagnostici. Il vostro focus principale sarà il lancio globale e il supporto della piattaforma Roche new sequencer (AXELIOS) e della suite di integrazione cloud Avenio Connect. Questo ruolo è progettato per un professionista IT di alto livello che prospera all'incrocio di calcolo ad alte prestazioni (HPC), networking avanzato e hardware medico. Mentre fornirete supporto per le soluzioni legacy NIPT (AcfS), la vostra missione principale è di progettare e risolvere i percorsi dati ad alta velocità che alimentano il futuro della medicina personalizzata. Principali responsabilità 1. Infrastruttura ad alta efficienza (SBX/AXELIOS Focus)
• Ottimizzazione della linea dati: supporta l'architettura IT e di rete per la piattaforma Roche AXELIOS (SBX) in tutta la regione EMEA.
• Risoluzione dei problemi del collo di bottiglia: ottimizzare i percorsi di dati ad alta velocità dalla gestione della larghezza di banda ai cluster di calcolo e ai nodi di archiviazione.
• Amministrazione di sistema: Gestisci i requisiti operativi specifici per l'ambiente, tra cui Roche Linux (RLX) e Windows Server per il gateway unificato. 2. Connettività digitale e cloud (Avenio Connect)
• Connettività Architettura: supervisionare le integrazioni Avenio Connect, assicurando una comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità tra strumento e strumento-to-LIMS.
• Sicurezza e conformità: Configurare e gestire FortiGate 60F Firewalls , assicurando che i certificati di sicurezza e le regole firewall si allineano con gli standard globali di dati medici.
• Ecosistemi remoti: implementare e supportare interfacce utente remote e protocolli di accesso ai servizi (SSH, RDP, VNC). 3. Rete avanzata e supporto
• Topology Design: Risoluzione dei problemi e ottimizzare le topologie di rete complesse, tra cui VLAN, VPN e SD-WAN , in ambienti clinici ad alto rendimento.
• Escalation Leadership: servire come punto di escalation Tier-2/3 per le squadre di campo regionali, eseguendo analisi approfondite in perdita di pacchetti, latenza e crash di sistema.
• Manutenzione Legacy (NIPT/AcfS): Fornire supporto secondario per l'AcfS (Ariosa Cell-free DNA System) e l'hardware partner associato che si esaurisce nei prossimi anni. Chi sei come candidato ideale Qualifiche e esperienza Requisiti minimi:
• Istruzione: Bachelor o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria di rete, Ingegneria elettronica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Esperienza professionale: 7+ anni di supporto IT/Networking e Hardware, gestione ideale dei sistemi integrati in un ambiente regolamentato o clinico.
• Networking Expertise: competenza avanzata in firewall, routing/switching e protocolli di sicurezza (preferito il livello CCNP).
• Flessibilità di viaggio: Capacità di viaggiare fino al 30% per audit e installazioni del sito. La flessibilità di viaggio per gli Stati Schengen è preferita. Competenze Preferite (Bioinformatics, Cloud & Documentation):
• Gestione della conoscenza: Esperienza dimostrata nell'autorizzazione di file tecnici di alta qualità (SOP, guide di preparazione del sito, diagrammi di rete) e nella fornitura di formazione tecnica a team di campo globali e dipartimenti IT del cliente.
• Bioinformatics (BFX): Familiarity with NGS pipelines, data storage (NAS/SAN), e formati di file genomici come FASTQ e VCF .
• cloud ibrido: esperienza con le implementazioni ibride AWS o Google Cloud per i dati diagnostici.
• Conoscenza delle infrastrutture: comprensione della richiesta di dati ad alta velocità

Als GCS Molecular Labs Senior Specialist werden Sie der technische Linchpin für eine neue Ära der diagnostischen Ökosysteme sein. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf dem globalen Rollout und der Unterstützung der Roche neuen Sequenzer (AXELIOS) Plattform und der Avenio Connect Cloud-Integration Suite. Diese Rolle ist für einen hochrangigen IT-Profi konzipiert, der an der Schnittstelle von High-Performance Computing (HPC), fortschrittlicher Vernetzung und medizinischer Hardware strebt. Während Sie nachhaltige Unterstützung für ältere NIPT (AcfS)-Lösungen bieten, ist Ihre Kernaufgabe, den Architekten und die schnelle Datenwege zu beheben, die die Zukunft der personalisierten Medizin antreiben. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten 1. Hochleistungsinfrastruktur (SBX/AXELIOS Focus)
• Data Pipeline Optimization: Unterstützung der IT- und Netzwerkarchitektur für die Roche AXELIOS (SBX)-Plattform in der gesamten Region EMEA.
• Bottleneck Troubleshooting: Optimieren Sie High-Speed-Datenpfade vom Bandbreitenmanagement bis hin zur Berechnung von Clustern und Speicherknoten.
• Systemverwaltung: Verwalten von umgebungsspezifischen OS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Roche Linux (RLX) und Windows Server für das Unified Gateway. 2. Cloud & Digital Connectivity (Avenio Connect)
• Konnektivitätsarchitektur: Übersehen Sie Avenio Connect-Integrationen, um eine nahtlose Instrument-zu-Cloud- und Instrument-zu-LIMS-Kommunikation zu gewährleisten.
• Sicherheit & Compliance: Konfigurieren und verwalten FortiGate 60F Firewalls , so dass Sicherheitszertifikate und Firewall-Regeln mit globalen medizinischen Datenstandards übereinstimmen.
• Remote Ecosystems: Implementierung und Unterstützung von Remote-Benutzeroberflächen und Service Access Protokollen (SSH, RDP, VNC). 3. Fortgeschrittene Vernetzung und Unterstützung
• Topologie-Design: Fehlerbehebung und Optimierung komplexer Netzwerktopologien, einschließlich VLANs, VPNs und SD-WAN, in hochleistungsfähigen klinischen Umgebungen.
• Eskalationsführerschaft: Als Tier-2/3-Eskalationspunkt für regionale Feldteams dienen und tiefgehende Analysen in Paketverlust, Latenz und Systemabstürzen durchführen.
• Legacy Maintenance (NIPT/AcfS): Bietet sekundäre Unterstützung für das AcfS (Ariosa zellfreies DNA System) und assoziierte Partnerhardware, wie es in den kommenden Jahren ausläuft. Wer Sie als idealer Kandidaten sind Qualifikationen & Erfahrungen Mindestanforderungen:
• Ausbildung: Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Informatik, Netzwerktechnik, Elektronik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Berufserfahrung: 7+ Jahre IT/Networking und Hardware-Unterstützung, ideal verwaltet integrierte Systeme in einer regulierten oder klinischen Umgebung.
• Networking Expertise: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Firewalls, Routing/Switching und Sicherheitsprotokollen (CCNP-Ebene bevorzugt).
• Reiseflexibilität: Möglichkeit, bis zu 30% für Standortprüfungen und Installationen zu reisen. Reiseflexibilität für Schengen-Staaten ist bevorzugt. Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten (Bioinformatik, Cloud & Dokumentation):
• Wissensmanagement: Demonstrierte Erfahrung in der Autorisierung hochwertiger technischer Dateien (SOPs, Site Preparation Guides, Netzwerkdiagramme) und Bereitstellung technischer Schulungen an globale Feldteams und Kunden-IT-Abteilungen.
• Bioinformatik (BFX): Vertrautheit mit NGS Pipelines, Datenspeicher (NAS/SAN) und genomische Dateiformate wie FASTQ und VCF .
• Hybrid Cloud: Erfahrung mit AWS oder Google Cloud-Hybrid-Bereitstellungen für Diagnosedaten.
• Infrastrukturwissen: Verständnis der Hochgeschwindigkeitsdatenfolge

Alors que vous apporterez un soutien durable aux solutions NIPT (AcfS) existantes, votre mission principale est d'architecter et de dépanner les voies de données à grande vitesse qui alimentent l'avenir de la médecine personnalisée. • Expertise en réseau: Compétences avancées en pare-feu, routage/interrupteur et protocoles de sécurité (niveau CCNP préféré).

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Title: Commercial Business Partner
Job Location: Delhi

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Commercial Business Partner to Head- Customer Engagement serves as a strategic partner and "force multiplier," responsible for driving the commercial agenda, overseeing high-stakes initiatives, and ensuring the leadership team operates at peak efficiency. This role bridges the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution across clusters to drive marketing, sales, market access, and strategy adoption.

Your Opportunity

• Integrated Planning: Support the CE Head in the annual, cycle and monthly business review cycles.

• Rhythm of the Business: Design and manage the cadence of Monthly and cycle Business Reviews

• Decision Support: Synthesize complex commercial analytics into concise executive briefings for rapid decision-making.

• Financial Liaison: Partner with BISV (Finance) team to monitor the commercial P&L and optimise resource allocation across the portfolio.

• Commercial Readiness: Act as the central coordinator for DA strategy and commercial excellence, ensuring to achieve cross-functional milestones

• Special Projects: Spearhead high-priority projects to achieve annual business plan

• Stakeholder Management: Represent the Commercial Leader in internal forums; manage relationships across the matrix model

• Internal Messaging: Ensure the commercial vision is clearly communicated to the field force and internal stakeholders.

KPIs:

• Strategy Execution Rate: % of strategic milestones met for top-tier commercial initiatives.
Decision Velocity: Measurable reduction in time from problem identification to finalized executive decision.
Organizational Alignment: Qualitative and quantitative scores on how well the commercial strategy is understood across the field and home office.

Who you are

• Education: Bachelors degree in Life Sciences and Business; MBA, PharmD, or PhD strongly preferred.

• Experience: 7-10+ years of progressive experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotech industry.

• Background: Proven track record in Brand Management, Commercial Excellence, or Management Consulting.

• Skills: Exceptional emotional intelligence (EQ), political savvy, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Facilities Management und SHE Abteilung von Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing ermöglicht den einzigartigen Einblick in die Produktionsabläufe biotechnologisch hergestellter Arzneimittel im Gebäude 95 und Gebäude 91. Unser dynamisches Team ist verantwortlich für das Building Management, Gowning, Reinstmedien, Environmental Monitoring und das Aseptic Handling in diesen Bereichen.
Sie lernen, anhand der Roche Produkte die aktuellen Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Anforderungen im Alltag umzusetzen. Wir bieten ein Praktikum innerhalb des Bereichs Facility Management/Mikrobiologisches Monitoring an.

Die Möglichkeit

Nach einer Einarbeitungszeit umfasst Ihr Praktikum unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

• Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung von Verbesserungsprojekten (LEAN) sowie in diversen Projekten u.a. Umwelt- und Verbesserungsprojekten

• Mithilfe bei der Erstellung und Dokumentation von Risikoanalysen, Datenanalysen und Interpretation sowie Erstellung der dazugehörigen Reports

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Dokumenten (z.B.: Standard Operating Procedures)

• Mitarbeit bei der Bearbeitung von Abweichungen und technischen Änderungen bei Anlagen

• Datenanalyse und Interpretation sowie Erstellung der dazugehörigen Reports

• Kommunikation und Interaktion mit den verschiedenen internen und externen Schnittstellen

Wer du bist

Du hast dein Studium (Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss) im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z.B. Biotechnologie, Pharmatechnik, Verfahrenstechnik) oder Naturwissenschaften (z.B. Pharmazie, Biologie, Mikrobiologie, Chemie) oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate abgeschlossen. Du bist daran interessiert, dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld anzuwenden und während eines mindestens 9-monatigen Praktikums die Pharmaindustrie kennenzulernen.

Darüber hinaus bringen Sie die folgenden Fähigkeiten mit:

• Sehr selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kenntnisse in Office- und Google-Applikationen

• Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Entscheidungsfreudigkeit sowie die Bereitschaft selbständig zu arbeiten

• Freude an der konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern

• Vorerfahrung mit GMP-gerechtem Arbeiten im Pharma-Umfeld

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Wort und Schrift), Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Mindestdauer des Praktikums 9 Monate.

Diese Position ist nicht geeignet für das Verfassen einer Bachelor- oder Masterarbeit.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Ophthalmology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Local customer facing role unlocking value along patient journeys

Roche is a company with a 125 year history and our ongoing success is based on our strong focus on delivering meaningful value for our customers and society, and we will need to evolve our offering and approach in order to do so.
In response to the increasingly volatile world we live in, Roche Pharma International began a wide scale transformation process - changing our ways of working to be more agile, less hierarchical, highly collaborative. Now we take the next STEP in our journey focusing on how we can deliver the greatest value and make a meaningful difference to our customers, patients and society.

Mission and responsibilities:
As the Patient Journey Partner (PJP) for Ophthalmology , you will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.

As the Patient Journey Partner (PJP) for Ophthalmology , you will be locally embedded and integrated in the healthcare ecosystem in a functionally agnostic way (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives.

As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:

• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritizing and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who are you:
You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem.
You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand).

In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network

• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds

• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to partners when the value is not predictable/foreseen.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required. Experience partnering with Patient Advocacy Groups (PGAs) is highly desired.

• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrati

As the Patient Journey Partner (PJP) for Ophthalmology , you will be locally embedded and integrated in the healthcare ecosystem in a functionally agnostic way (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives. As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:
• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritizing and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who are you: You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem. You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand). In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network
• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds
• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to partners when the value is not predictable/foreseen.
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required. Experience partnering with Patient Advocacy Groups (PGAs) is highly desired.
• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrati

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
工作职责

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。

• 运用专业知识，传递诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升。

• 拜访临床及病理医生，维护客户关系，按时按质的完成相关客户洞见，尤其重点专家对于疾病领域洞见的收集并进行总结/分析/反馈。

• 组织/协调/整合各类疾病领域学术会议，推动建立疾病领域治疗规范。

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力要求

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力和业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• ​3年以上医药行业工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Payroll Process Owner, you will be a key driver in streamlining and optimizing the delivery of payroll, time, and benefits (PTB) services across the EMEA region. Reporting to the Global PTB Lead, you will act as a strategic bridge between regional operational teams and global product management to ensure our solutions are both efficient and scalable.

• Act as a strategic partner and regional representative for PTB operational teams, ensuring alignment with Global Best Practices.

• Define end-to-end processes in collaboration with local PTB leads and cross-functional partners in Finance, Treasury, and IT.

• Prioritize regional requirements by collecting business needs and balancing them against global priorities and roadmap planning.

• Drive harmonization and simplification of processes and practices across the region to foster a "OneRoche" approach.

• Collaborate with Product Owners (specifically Workday Time & Absence) to support technical discussions and system round tables.

• Manage vendor relationships alongside global leadership, interfacing with key partners such as Workday, ADP, and Deloitte.

• Support service governance by overseeing regional KPIs, Service Catalogs, and compliance audits (e.g., ICFR and SOD controls).

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker with deep technical expertise in payroll and time management. You thrive in matrix environments and possess the influence needed to manage diverse stakeholders while maintaining a strong focus on end-to-end accountability and process excellence.

• Experienced Professional: You bring 3+ years of experience in Payroll, Time/Absence, and Benefits administration, preferably in a complex shared services environment.

• Technical Savvy: You have a solid working knowledge of Workday and experience managing relationships with external payroll vendors.

• Stakeholder Expert: You possess the ability to engage and influence diverse partners beyond the HR function, including Finance and IT.

• Process Oriented: You have an ideal background in managing business processes and a proven track record of leading continuous improvement initiatives.

• Project Leader: You bring strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize competing requirements in a rapidly changing environment.

• Accountable & Analytical: You demonstrate end-to-end accountability, utilizing critical thinking and problem-solving to ensure high-quality service delivery.

• Fluent Communicator: You possess excellent English skills (written and spoken) and embrace working within a multicultural, global organization.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, ma

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità In qualità di proprietario del processo Payroll, sarai un driver chiave nella semplificazione e nell'ottimizzazione della fornitura di servizi payroll, time e benefit (PTB) in tutta la regione EMEA. Segnalando al Global PTB Lead, agirai come un ponte strategico tra i team operativi regionali e la gestione globale dei prodotti per garantire che le nostre soluzioni siano efficienti e scalabili.
• Agire come partner strategico e rappresentante regionale per i team operativi PTB, assicurando l'allineamento con le best practice globali.
• Definire processi end-to-end in collaborazione con i lead PTB locali e partner interfunzionali in Finanza, Tesoro e IT.
• Priorizzare i requisiti regionali raccogliendo le esigenze aziendali e bilanciandoli contro le priorità globali e la pianificazione della roadmap.
• Guidare l'armonizzazione e la semplificazione dei processi e delle pratiche in tutta la regione per promuovere un approccio "OneRoche".
• Collaborare con i Proprietari del Prodotto (in particolare Workday Time & Absence) per sostenere discussioni tecniche e tavole rotonde del sistema.
• Gestire le relazioni dei fornitori insieme alla leadership globale, interfacciandosi con partner chiave come Workday, ADP e Deloitte.
• Sostenere la governance dei servizi supervisionando KPI regionali, cataloghi di servizi e audit di conformità (ad esempio, controlli ICFR e SOD). Chi sei Sei un pensatore strategico con profonda competenza tecnica nel libro paga e nella gestione del tempo. Tu prosperi in ambienti matrici e possiedi l'influenza necessaria per gestire diversi stakeholder, mantenendo un forte focus sulla responsabilità end-to-end e l'eccellenza di processo.
• Professionista esperto: Porti 3+ anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione Payroll, Time/Absence e Benefits, preferibilmente in un complesso ambiente di servizi condivisi.
• Technical Savvy: Hai una solida conoscenza di lavoro di Workday e esperienza di gestire le relazioni con i fornitori di payroll esterni.
• Esperto Stakeholder: Possiedi la capacità di coinvolgere e influenzare partner diversi oltre la funzione HR, tra cui Finanza e IT.
• Process Oriented: Hai uno sfondo ideale nella gestione dei processi aziendali e una comprovata traccia delle principali iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• Leader del progetto: si portano forti competenze di gestione del progetto e la capacità di priorità requisiti concorrenti in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.
• Contabile & analitico: Lei dimostra la responsabilità end-to-end, utilizzando il pensiero critico e problem-solving per garantire la consegna di servizio di alta qualità.
• Communicatore fluente: Possiedi eccellenti competenze in inglese (scritto e parlato) e abbracci il lavoro all'interno di un'organizzazione multiculturale e globale. In Exchange vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, opportunità di coaching / mentoring, programma amico, edifici di squadra, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità inclusiva globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche collaboriamo, dibattiamo, ma

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a senior team member within the Talent Acquisition group, you will foster a team environment and demonstrate collaborative leadership. You will partner with TA colleagues, Human Resource Business Partners, clients and Talent Acquisition Management to develop and implement staffing plans and strategies.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Talent Partner, you will partner with hiring managers and senior management in the full lifecycle recruitment of talent in the Americas- individually managing a portfolio of requisitions and focusing on meeting and exceeding hiring manager's expectations and ensuring a positive candidate experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Strategic Recruitment: Drive hiring processes and develop complex recruiting strategies within assigned requisitions and organizations.

• Full Lifecycle Execution: Recruit talent by sourcing, reviewing applications, screening candidates, and processing offers within Workday.

• Consultative Coaching: Manage stakeholder expectations and coach managers on providing feedback, developing offers, and determining competencies.

• Process Innovation: Contribute to staffing process improvements and ensure recruiting solutions remain consistent with Corporate Talent Acquisition objectives.

• Data & Compliance: Act as the point person for staffing reports and metrics while ensuring strict adherence to internal processes and maintaining the ATS/CRM.

• Talent Management: Partner with client groups on internal talent management, including succession planning, talent reviews, and internal candidate movement.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Educate business leaders on relocation/immigration processes and attend networking events to proactively manage the recruitment escalation process.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science, or equivalent work experience.

• You bring 5+ years of recruiting experience in a corporate or Shared Services environment; Pharma/Biotech industry experience is a plus.

• You are Bilingual , with required fluency in English and Spanish- Portuguese, French are a plus.

• You possess a high level of social competence and the ability to thrive in a multicultural, matrixed environment across borders.

• You are characterized by a growth mindset, end-to-end accountability, and a customer-centric approach to problem-solving.

• You are well known for your independent, yet collaborative working style and your ability to challenge the status quo for continuous improvement.

• Experience with United States, and Canada processes. (experience with pharma companies is a plus)

Preferred:

• Demonstrated expertise in progressive sourcing (Direct Sourcing, Web 2.0, networking) and experience recruiting for different regions (US, Canada, LATAM).

• Technical proficiency in Workday or similar enterprise-level recruiting software.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English, Arabic is advantage

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

jobs.title: Innovation & Sustainability Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in Innovation & Sustainability

For students in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences fields

Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world.

Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within?

The Position

As an intern, you will contribute to a project focused on research on assessing & reducing the environmental impact of synthetic polymer excipients in the Pharmaceutical Industry by identifying and evaluating safer biodegradable alternatives. The project explores how polymers used in pharmaceutical formulations may contribute to microplastic pollution in municipal water systems and aims to support more sustainable product design in light of evolving regulatory expectations such as EU REACH 2026. Within your first 3 months, you are expected to assess target polymers, research promising biodegradable substitute materials, analyze supplier and production feasibility, and contribute to a final technical report and strategic roadmap. Your work will support Roche’s sustainability ambitions by addressing biodiversity and water-related impacts, advancing sustainable products, and encouraging the use of more environmentally responsible raw materials. This internship offers a high-impact opportunity to work on an innovative topic at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, sustainability, and environmental protection.

The Opportunity

• Conduct a product-based preliminary analysis of target polymers

• Research and evaluate potential biodegradable alternatives for relevant synthetic polymer excipients

• Assess production feasibility and supply landscape for alternative materials, including scalability, supplier availability, quality standards, and regulatory considerations

• Compare synthetic and biodegradable options across environmental impact, ecotoxicity, pharmaceutical performance, and compliance criteria

• Explore how polymer choice influences product life cycle sustainability, from raw material sourcing through use and disposal

• Support the development of a strategic roadmap for improving or replacing selected synthetic polymers with more sustainable alternatives

• Prepare a final technical report and presentation summarizing findings, trade-offs, and recommendations

• Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to gather input and support a multidisciplinary evaluation process

Who You Are

You are enrolled or have completed your Master’s or PhD studies at a university, preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences within the last 12 months and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of at least 3 months.

Preferred Qualifications Are

• Familiar with bioprocesses, biochemical or biological

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The RiSE program (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) is a highly competitive student research program at Roche. It offers the most talented graduate and medical degree students the opportunity to be fully integrated into our interdisciplinary and international industry R&D environment. As a RiSE student you will enhance your competencies, gain valuable work experience with us, and eventually become part of a world-wide network of RiSE Alumni.

The Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) is developing medicines for a range of serious neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, autism, spinal muscular atrophy, and Huntington’s disease.

As RiSE student in the NRD DTA you will join the Brain Delivery group at the Roche Innovation Center Basel, Switzerland, to perform omics data analysis and experimental in vitro work to map the regulatory landscape of Alzheimer’s Disease targets. You will be hosted and mentored by a Roche scientist who will guide you through your research and provide you with the needed work infrastructure and collaborative network.

The Opportunity

• Collaborate closely with computational scientists to analyze sequencing datasets to drive biological insights.

• Design rigorous in vitro experiments informed by your expertise in transcriptomic data interpretation.

• Apply a comprehensive set of molecular cell biology methods in stem-cell derived models to test specific biological hypothesis

• Present and discuss your work in internal meetings.

• Synthesize experimental data for the preparation and submission of high-impact manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication.

Who You Are

• You graduated from a Master's program within the last year

• Or you are enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university

• You are looking to expand your experience with an industry internship

• Extensive experience in the generation and analysis of scRNAseq data

• Hands-on experience with engineering iPSC-based models of brain cell types for functional genomic approaches (e.g. CRISPR)

• A broad skill set with cell and molecular biology assays

Additional Information

The preferred start date of the internship is 11/2026 or upon availability.

Application Process

Applications need to include a CV and a cover letter, as well as a letter from your current or former academic supervisor supporting your application to the RiSE Program. Reference letters are also welcome.
Please note that due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens have to be enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university and provide a certificate from the university stating that an industry internship is mandatory as part of the university training.

Curious, motivated, and ready to learn? Apply now for our RiSE Internship.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione Il programma RiSE (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) è un programma di ricerca studentesca altamente competitivo a Roche. Offre agli studenti di laurea e di laurea più talentuosi la possibilità di essere pienamente integrato nel nostro ambiente R&D interdisciplinare e internazionale del settore. Come studente di RiSE aumenterai le tue competenze, acquisirai una preziosa esperienza lavorativa con noi, e alla fine diventerai parte di una rete mondiale di RiSE Alumni. La Neuroscienza e Malattie Rare Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) sta sviluppando farmaci per una serie di gravi malattie neurologiche, tra cui sclerosi multipla, malattia di Alzheimer, malattia di Parkinson, autismo, atrofia muscolare spinale, e la malattia di Huntington. Come studente di RiSE nel NRD DTA si unirà al gruppo Brain Delivery presso il Roche Innovation Center di Basilea, Svizzera, per eseguire l’analisi dei dati omics e il lavoro sperimentale in vitro per mappare il paesaggio normativo degli obiettivi di morbo di Alzheimer. Sarete ospitati e guidati da uno scienziato Roche che vi guiderà attraverso la vostra ricerca e vi fornirà l'infrastruttura di lavoro necessaria e la rete collaborativa. L'opportunità
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati computazionali per analizzare i set di dati di sequenziamento per guidare intuizioni biologiche.
• Progettazione di rigorosi esperimenti in vitro informati dalla vostra esperienza nell'interpretazione transcriptomica dei dati.
• Applicare un insieme completo di metodi di biologia cellulare molecolare nei modelli derivati da cellule staminali per testare ipotesi biologiche specifiche
• Presentare e discutere il vostro lavoro in riunioni interne.
• Synthesize dati sperimentali per la preparazione e la presentazione di manoscritti ad alto impatto per la pubblicazione peer-reviewed. Chi sei
• Ti sei laureato in un Master nell'ultimo anno
• O sei iscritto a un dottorato o un corso di laurea in un'università
• Stai cercando di espandere la tua esperienza con uno stage nel settore
• Ampia esperienza nella generazione e nell'analisi dei dati scRNAseq
• Esperienza pratica con modelli ingegneristici basati su iPSC di tipi di cellule cerebrali per approcci genomici funzionali (ad es. CRISPR)
• Un ampio set di competenze con saggi di biologia cellulare e molecolare Informazioni aggiuntive La data di inizio preferita dello stage è 11/2026 o su disponibilità. Processo di applicazione Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di copertura, così come una lettera del vostro attuale o ex supervisore accademico che supporta la vostra applicazione al programma RiSE. Le lettere di riferimento sono anche benvenuti. Si prega di notare che a causa di regolamenti cittadini non UE/EFTA devono essere iscritti in un dottorato o un corso di laurea in un'università e fornire un certificato dall'università che afferma che uno stage di settore è obbligatorio come parte della formazione universitaria. Curioso, motivato e pronto ad imparare? Richiedi ora il nostro tirocinio RiSE. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The RiSE program (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) is a highly competitive student research program at Roche. It offers the most talented graduate and medical degree students the opportunity to be fully integrated into our interdisciplinary and international industry R&D environment. As a RiSE student you will enhance your competencies, gain valuable work experience with us, and eventually become part of a world-wide network of RiSE Alumni. The Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) is developing medicines for a range of serious neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, autism, spinal muscular atrophy, and Huntington’s disease. As RiSE student in the NRD DTA you will join the Brain Delivery group at the Roche Innovation Center Basel, Switzerland, to perform omics data analysis and experimental in vitro work to map the regulatory landscape of Alzheimer’s Disease targets. You will be hosted and mentored by a Roche scientist who will guide you through your research and provide you with the needed work infrastructure and collaborative network. The Opportunity
• Collaborate closely with computational scientists to analyze sequencing datasets to drive biological insights.
• Design rigorous in vitro experiments informed by your expertise in transcriptomic data interpretation.
• Apply a comprehensive set of molecular cell biology methods in stem-cell derived models to test specific biological hypothesis
• Present and discuss your work in internal meetings.
• Synthesize experimental data for the preparation and submission of high-impact manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication. Who You Are
• You graduated from a Master's program within the last year
• Or you are enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university
• You are looking to expand your experience with an industry internship
• Extensive experience in the generation and analysis of scRNAseq data
• Hands-on experience with engineering iPSC-based models of brain cell types for functional genomic approaches (e.g. CRISPR)
• A broad skill set with cell and molecular biology assays Additional Information The preferred start date of the internship is 11/2026 or upon availability. Application Process Applications need to include a CV and a cover letter, as well as a letter from your current or former academic supervisor supporting your application to the RiSE Program. Reference letters are also welcome. Please note that due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens have to be enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university and provide a certificate from the university stating that an industry internship is mandatory as part of the university training. Curious, motivated, and ready to learn? Apply now for our RiSE Internship. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit iPSC-basierten Modellen von Gehirnzellentypen für funktionelle genomische Ansätze (z.B. CRISPR)
• Ein breites Geschick mit Zell- und Molekularbiologie-Assays Weitere Informationen Das bevorzugte Startdatum des Praktikums beträgt 11/2026 oder nach Verfügbarkeit. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le programme RiSE (Roche Stages for Scientific Exchange) est un programme de recherche étudiant hautement compétitif à Roche. Il offre aux étudiants diplômés et aux étudiants en médecine les plus talentueux la possibilité d'être pleinement intégrés dans notre environnement de R-D interdisciplinaire et international. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE, vous améliorerez vos compétences, gagnerez une expérience de travail précieuse avec nous et finirez par faire partie d'un réseau mondial d'anciens RiSE. La zone de découverte et de traduction des neurosciences et des maladies rares (DNT) met au point des médicaments pour diverses maladies neurologiques graves, dont la sclérose en plaques, la maladie d'Alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, l'autisme, l'atrophie musculaire de la colonne vertébrale et la maladie de Huntington. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE au NRD DTA, vous rejoindrez le groupe Brain Delivery au Roche Innovation Center Basel, en Suisse, pour effectuer des analyses de données omiques et des travaux expérimentaux in vitro pour cartographier le paysage réglementaire des cibles de la maladie d'Alzheimer. Vous serez accueilli et encadré par un scientifique de Roche qui vous guidera dans vos recherches et vous fournira l'infrastructure de travail et le réseau de collaboration nécessaires. L'opportunité
• Collaborer étroitement avec les chercheurs en calcul pour analyser les ensembles de données séquentielles afin de générer des données biologiques.
• Concevoir des expériences in vitro rigoureuses en fonction de votre expertise en interprétation des données transcriptomiques.
• Appliquer un ensemble complet de méthodes de biologie cellulaire moléculaire dans des modèles dérivés de cellules souches pour tester des hypothèses biologiques spécifiques
• Présentez et discutez de votre travail lors de réunions internes.
• Synthétiser les données expérimentales pour la préparation et la soumission de manuscrits à fort impact pour publication par des pairs. Qui vous êtes
• Vous avez obtenu votre diplôme de maîtrise au cours de la dernière année
• Ou vous êtes inscrit à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme médical dans une université
• Vous cherchez à développer votre expérience avec un stage dans l'industrie
• Expérience approfondie dans la production et l'analyse de données scRNAseq
• Expérience pratique des modèles iPSC d'ingénierie des types de cellules cérébrales pour les approches génomiques fonctionnelles (par exemple CRISPR)
• Un vaste ensemble de compétences avec des tests de biologie cellulaire et moléculaire Informations complémentaires La date de début préférée du stage est 11/2026 ou selon disponibilité. Processus de demande Les demandes doivent comprendre un CV et une lettre d'accompagnement, ainsi qu'une lettre de votre superviseur scolaire actuel ou ancien appuyant votre demande au Programme RiSE. Les lettres de référence sont également les bienvenues. Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation des citoyens non membres de l'UE ou de l'AELE doivent être inscrits à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme en médecine dans une université et fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage dans l'industrie est obligatoire dans le cadre de la formation universitaire. Curieux, motivé et prêt à apprendre? Faites votre demande pour notre stage RiSE. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: IVD Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics.

What will you do?

• Identify market opportunities and customer needs in order to create value for the customers and patients

• Define an overarching business strategy for the current and future product portfolio

• Develop specific marketing plans for the product portfolio

• Represent marketing group on local and global cross-functional teams driving innovation and market penetration

• Manage resources and budget to target all assigned programs and initiatives

• Organize training programs for the sales team about product specifications, product marketing strategies, and competition

• Co-create and implement customized solutions to meet defined outcomes

• Drive process improvements to deliver higher productivity

• Work in cross-functional teams for the success of projects

• Work closely with Healthcare Consultants, Product Managers and global teams for required projects

Who are you?

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Science or Business in the related field

• Previous experience in Marketing is highly preferred

• Ability to build relationships and work in the project team, trust and influence with internal members and other key stakeholders

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent written and oral communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects

• At least an upper-intermediate level of English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise

• Having a driving license and being willing to travel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a Finance or Business student looking to gain hands-on experience in a global corporate environment? We are looking for a motivated Intern to join our Global Procurement Finance team.
This is a unique opportunity to see the "inner workings" of a global finance function. You will gain exposure to complex stakeholder management and international reporting standards-all while being part of a supportive, expert team.

The opportunity
In this role, you won’t just be crunching numbers; you’ll be a key part of a team operating across a global scale. You will work directly under the Finance Functional Partner to support global operations and strategic procurement.
As our Intern you will:

• Drive Financial Insights: Assist in preparing monthly financial reports

• Master the Tools: Take ownership of our procurement savings tracking tool (SpendHQ) - validating business cases and savings entered by the procurement organization.

• Business Partnering: Collaborate directly with one function/team to provide financial support.

• Support & Innovate: Help Procurement Finance Business Partners with insight generation, SMC planning, and organizational training.

Who you are
You are enrolled in or have completed your studies within the last 12 months with a degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

• Skills: A solid foundation in financial controlling and reporting.

• Communication: Fluent in English; you’re comfortable working in a diverse, international environment.

• Mindset: Proactive, detail-oriented, and ready to take ownership of projects.

• You come with the ability/interest to automate reports and improve processes

Additional information
Start Date: August 2026
Workload: 100%
Duration: 12 months

Application process
Please submit your complete application, including your CV and a motivation letter.
A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR recent graduates are also eligible to start an internship with us within 12 months of their graduation date.
For non-EU/EFTA citizens: Certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory (required due to regulations)

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Finanza, Procurement & Performance Management Tirocinante (On en Roche Graduate Program)
titleByLocale.en: Finance, Procurement & Performance Management Intern (On en Roche Graduate Program)
titleByLocale.de: Finanzen, Procurement & Performance Management Praktikant (On en Roche Graduate Program)
titleByLocale.fr: Finance, Procurement & Performance Management Stagiaire (On en Roche Graduate Program)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Drive business performance through financial insight, strategic sourcing, and data-driven decision-making.
Rotations may include:

• Customer Finance

• Controlling & Reporting

• Procurement & Strategic Sourcing

The Position

• Analyze financial and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities

• Support pricing, cost, and margin optimization initiatives

• Contribute to procurement and sourcing strategies

• Participate in forecasting, business planning, and performance management

• Monitor customer profitability and performance

• Support cross-functional transformation initiative

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Data Science , or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 7th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
