The Position
On en Roche

Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one?
Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale.

What is it?

• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.

• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.

• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.

• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning.

Why join?

• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges

• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale

• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations

• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams

• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback

• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche

The Opportunity

Optimize real-world operations by improving efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation in industrial environments.

Rotations may include:

• Site Operations

• Warehouse operations & material flow

• Customer Fulfillment & Service Operations

• Direct Procurement

The Position

• Support site capacity planning and growth readiness

• Improve warehouse layout, material flow, and productivity

• Analyze operational flows to identify improvement opportunities

• Contribute to automation, analytics, and process redesign projects

• Translate operational data into actionable insights

Who you are

We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations - focused profiles , or related fields

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)

• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments

• Full availability for a 24-month program

Timelines & further information

• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)

• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

• Start date: September 2026

• Assessment Center: July 7th

• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Junior DevOps Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Junior DevOps Engineer is focused on learning and execution. You will fulfil given tasks within deadlines, raise problems when they appear, and solve straightforward technical problems with guidance. Your focus will be on understanding immediate project goals, applying foundational programming skills, and demonstrating an eagerness to learn and grow within the organization.

The opportunity:

• Design, implement, maintain and manage multiple highly available solutions and platforms with thousands of users for supporting software engineers and DevOps engineers at Roche.

• Develop and maintain technical specifications, diagrams and supporting system documentation and system architecture documentation.

• Continuously learn and upskill on relevant technology products and methodologies, leveraging and training resources provided.

• Participate in technical peer reviews (design reviews, code walkthroughs, test reviews and root cause analysis sessions).

• Champion automation and evangelize lean development.

Who you are:

• Eager to learn and grow within the software engineering field, with a focus on executing tasks based on established procedures.

• Basic understanding of DevOps principles.

• Understanding of software validation and regulatory requirements.

• Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

• Proficient in English.

Nice to have:

• Experience with repository managers like Artifactory.

• Experience with SCM tools (Git) and project management tools.

• Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions and Gitlab.

• Experience in container technologies (e.g. Docker, LXC) and container platforms (e.g. Kubernetes, Rancher).

• Experience automating using infrastructure as code (e.g. Packer, Vagrant, Terraform) and configuration management (e.g. Ansible, Puppet, Chef) tools and ability to understand and implement immutable infrastructure.

• Experience with Public (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) and Private clouds (e.g. VMWare, OpenStack).

• Experience in mainstream programming languages (Java, Python) and scripting languages (Bash, Python).

What you get:

• Salary range 7 525-13 975 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (pos

The Position
Field Service Engineer – Medical Diagnostics (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham)
A Healthier Future. It’s What Drives Us.
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate, to continuously advance science, and to ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Together, we’re creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Roche Diagnostics presents an exceptional opportunity for you to leverage your technical expertise while providing vital, life-saving support to our valued customers.
As an integral member of the Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team in the UK, this role offers the possibility of field-based assignments across Stoke and surrounding areas or focusing on a designated customer base. (North Wales, Shropshire, and Staffordshire)

The Opportunity: Technical Excellence in the Field
Ideal Location: Based out of Stoke or the surrounding areas to the west, with excellent access to motorway networks.
As a Field Service Engineer, your focus is to ensure the seamless operation and maximum uptime of Roche’s innovative Systems/Products, ranging from serum work area, pre/post analytics and our digital portfolio.
You will utilise a combination of on-site support and remote diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex electro-mechanical faults efficiently. Additionally, you will perform preventive maintenance and generate insightful reports to enhance operational efficiency across assigned customer sites.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver Essential Support: Deliver electro-mechanical hardware support, including routine proactive and reactive tasks and technical training.

• Resolve Complex Faults: Perform troubleshooting and fault resolution, conduct preventive maintenance, and generate reports to enhance operational efficiency.

• Customer Training: Provide technical training and guidance to customers, enabling them to excel in the use of Roche diagnostic systems.

• Compliance & Administration: Maintain rigorous administration and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance and efficient service delivery.

• Stakeholder Management: Build productive relationships with peers and key stakeholders to align service and sales objectives seamlessly.

• Service Excellence: Attend internal review meetings to showcase progress, discuss objectives, and ensure service excellence.

Who you are
We are seeking resilient, adaptable, and customer-focused individuals who thrive on solving technical challenges and exceeding expectations. Ideally, you will bring:

• Educational Qualifications: A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Candidates with equivalent experience at the HNC/HND level with a proven track record are also encouraged to apply.

• Experience: Extensive experience within the IVD industry, with a history of delivering exceptional technical support.

• Skills: Excellent analytical ability, self-motivation, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.

• Attributes: Resilience, tenacity, motivation to exceed customer expectations, and the ability to grow and mentor others through training, coaching, and continuous development.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Formation à la clientèle : fournir une formation technique et des conseils aux clients, leur permettant d'exceller dans l'utilisation des systèmes de diagnostic Roche.

• Gestion des parties prenantes : établir des relations productives avec les pairs et les principales parties prenantes afin d'harmoniser les objectifs de service et de vente de façon transparente.
• Excellence en matière de services : Assister à des réunions d'examen interne pour présenter les progrès accomplis, discuter des objectifs et assurer l'excellence en matière de services. • Qualifications scolaires: Un diplôme ou une qualification équivalente en génie électrique/mécanique est préféré. Les candidats ayant une expérience équivalente au niveau HNC/HND et ayant fait leurs preuves sont également encouragés à postuler.
• Expérience: Expérience étendue dans l'industrie IVD, avec une histoire de fournir un soutien technique exceptionnel.
• Compétences : Excellente capacité d'analyse, automotivation, expertise avancée en dépannage et capacité de travailler efficacement sous pression dans un environnement d'équipe collaborative.
• Attributs: Résilience, ténacité, motivation pour dépasser les attentes des clients, et capacité de grandir et de guider les autres par la formation, le coaching et le développement continu. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System.

In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche.

Description of the area:
Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.

• Background in logistics or supply chain.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation.

Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.
• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.
• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams. • Background in logistics or supply chain.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation. Technical Skills
• SAP EWM certifications.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a) 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b) 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c) 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点
3. 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育
4. 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

Years of Working Experience工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
•在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

AI Full-Stack Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. Potrai sviluppare esperienze frontend moderne e integrarli con servizi backend, piattaforme di dati e sistemi AI agentic. Sarete responsabili di: Responsabilità chiave:
• Sviluppo di applicazioni frontend (AI-Powered Experiences):
• Progettare e costruire interfacce utente moderne e reattive utilizzando React (preferito) o OutSystems per supportare casi di utilizzo basati su AI come dashboard, chatbot e assistenti AI.
• Sviluppare esperienze interattive e in tempo reale, tra cui risposte in streaming e visualizzazioni dinamiche dei dati.
• Backend Integration & API Development:
• Sviluppare e gestire servizi di backend e API (ad esempio FastAPI) per collegare le applicazioni di frontend con piattaforme di dati, sistemi di AI agentic e servizi aziendali.
• Assicurare scalabilità, affidabilità e prestazioni delle integrazioni delle applicazioni.
• Integrazione AI/Agent:
• Integrare applicazioni frontend con sistemi AI agentici alimentati da framework come LangGraph.
• Abilitare l'interazione senza soluzione di continuità tra gli utenti e gli agenti dell'IA, tra cui l'orchestrazione di flussi di lavoro multi-step e le intuizioni guidate dall'IA.
• Integrazione dei dati e dei sistemi:
• Collegare le applicazioni a fonti di dati interne ed esterne tramite API, consentendo l'ingestione di nuovi dati e la visualizzazione delle uscite del modello AI.
• Assicurare una gestione efficiente dei dati strutturati e non strutturati in tutti i sistemi
• Sviluppo di applicazioni cloud-Native:
• Costruire e distribuire applicazioni utilizzando servizi AWS come ECS e Lambda.
• Assicurare soluzioni scalabili, sicure e allineate agli standard di architettura aziendale
• Integrazione delle imprese (Sicurezza e identità):
• Integrare i meccanismi di autenticazione e autorizzazione dell'impresa, tra cui la gestione dell'identità basata su Active Directory e il controllo di accesso basato sul ruolo (RBAC).
• Assicurare l'implementazione sicura di SSO e il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza Roche.
• Progettazione Utente-Centric & Product Thinking:
• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali in flussi di lavoro applicativi intuitivi e esperienze utente. Partner con gli stakeholder per progettare soluzioni che consentano l'analisi self-service e massimizzano l'usabilità e l'adozione.
• Monitoraggio e Ottimizzazione delle prestazioni:
• Attuazione delle pratiche di monitoraggio, registrazione e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni per garantire il riassorbimento

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ingénieur IA - Fusions et acquisitions À propos de notre équipe: Partenaires Solutions numériques Rejoignez notre équipe de Solutions numériques partenaires, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact du partenariat grâce aux écosystèmes numériques et à l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de Partenariats Pharma et DIA. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'innovation - construire une infrastructure de données évolutive, appliquer des pratiques avancées en matière d'ingénierie des données et intégrer des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décisions et débloquer la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend à de multiples initiatives à impact élevé, depuis le développement de produits de données intelligents jusqu'aux flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu'il s'agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des institutions de recherche externes, il s'agit d'une occasion unique de contribuer à façonner l'avenir des données et de l'IA à Roche en appuyant directement les décisions stratégiques clés de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant qu'ingénieur d'IA Full-Stack, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la conception et la construction d'applications d'IA orientées vers les utilisateurs qui permettent l'analyse en libre-service et la prise de décisions intelligentes. Vous développerez des expériences de frontend modernes et les intégrerez aux services de backend, aux plateformes de données et aux systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les ingénieurs des données, les ingénieurs de l'IA/ML et les intervenants commerciaux pour fournir des applications évolutives, sécurisées et intuitives qui apportent des capacités d'IA aux utilisateurs finaux. Vous serez responsable : Principales responsabilités :
• Mise au point d'applications frontales (expérience de l'IA):
• Concevoir et construire des interfaces utilisateur modernes et réactives en utilisant React (préféré) ou OutSystems pour prendre en charge les cas d'utilisation liés à l'IA tels que les tableaux de bord, les chatbots et les assistants d'IA.
• Développer des expériences interactives en temps réel, y compris des réponses en streaming et des visualisations dynamiques de données.
• Intégration backend & développement d'API:
• Développer et gérer les services et les API (par exemple FastAPI) pour connecter les applications frontend aux plateformes de données, aux systèmes d'intelligence artificielle et aux services d'entreprise.
• Assurer l'évolutivité, la fiabilité et la performance des intégrations d'applications.
• Intégration AI/Agent:
• Intégrer les applications frontend avec des systèmes d'IA agents alimentés par des cadres tels que LangGraph.
• Permettre une interaction transparente entre les utilisateurs et les agents de l'IA, y compris l'orchestration de flux de travail en plusieurs étapes et des informations basées sur l'IA.
• Intégration de données et de systèmes :
• Connectez les applications aux sources de données internes et externes via les API, permettant l'ingestion de nouvelles données et la visualisation des sorties des modèles d'IA.
• Assurer un traitement efficace des données structurées et non structurées entre les systèmes
• Développement d'applications Cloud-Native :
• Construisez et déployez des applications en utilisant des services AWS comme ECS et Lambda.
• Veiller à ce que les solutions soient évolutives, sécurisées et alignées sur les normes d'architecture d'entreprise
• Intégration des entreprises (sécurité et identité):
• Intégrer les mécanismes d'authentification et d'autorisation des entreprises, y compris la gestion active de l'identité par répertoire et le contrôle d'accès par rôle (RBAC).
• Assurer la mise en œuvre sûre de la SSO et le respect des normes de sécurité Roche.
• Conception et réflexion des produits :
• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en flux de travail d'application intuitifs et les expériences des utilisateurs. Faites équipe avec les intervenants pour concevoir des solutions qui permettent l'analyse en libre-service et maximisent la convivialité et l'adoption.
• Surveillance et optimisation des performances :
• Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de surveillance, d'enregistrement et d'optimisation des performances pour assurer le respect des règles

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Cria r um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que a mamos. É isso que nos faz Roch e.

Como um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Serviços , você será responsável por realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar os clientes na adequação do local onde serão instalados os equipamentos Roche. Você conduzirá manutenções preventivas e corretivas, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento anual e assegurando o menor impacto possível na rotina laboratorial do cliente. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a excelência técnica e a disponibilidade das soluções Roche no campo.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

• Realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar clientes na adequação técnica de infraestrutura para instalação de equipamentos.

• Conduzir manutenções preventivas técnicas, desde o agendamento e conferência de kits até o registro detalhado em sistema CRM.

• Executar manutenções corretivas de forma eficaz e eficiente para minimizar o downtime e manter a rotina operacional do cliente.

• Efetuar upgrades de hardware e software nos equipamentos instalados conforme orientações dos Especialistas Técnicos.

• Identificar situações críticas em clientes e reportá-las ao Coordenador Regional de Serviços, propondo respostas rápidas e resolutivas.

• Apoiar as equipes de Assessoria Científica na resolução de problemas de operação e aplicações, sempre que necessário.

• Colaborar com o Repair Shop nas revisões de equipamentos seguindo rigorosamente os procedimentos técnicos existentes.

• Garantir o fluxo de informações estratégicas do campo para a equipe de Vendas e dar suporte ao desenvolvimento técnico do time.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa.

• Experiência comprovada em assistência técnica, manutenções e serviços relacionados a equipamentos de análises clínicas ou informática.

• Conhecimento intermediário de Inglês (leitura técnica e comunicação básica).

• Habilidade em organização e autogestão para cumprimento de cronogramas de manutenção e chamados técnicos.

• Facilidade em estabelecer bom relacionamento interpessoal e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

• Perfil proativo com foco na resolução de problemas e excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

• Capacidade de comunicação clara para orientar clientes e reportar situações críticas internamente.

• Habilidades de liderança e suporte técnico para auxiliar no desenvolvimento de colegas e parceiros.

• Disponibilidade para viagens em território nacional.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers. Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As an Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics, you will:

• be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory is Massachusetts, Connecticut, Vermont, and Eastern NY. Up to 50% overnight travel expected.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience in diagnostics sales is strongly preferred

• Good oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Massachusetts, is $84,100.00-$156,300.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Sei un professionista esperto di vendite con un talento per risolvere sfide complesse? In questo ruolo, userai la tua esperienza per navigare diversi problemi e prendere decisioni strategiche che spingono il successo. Potrai gestire conti di medie e grandi dimensioni, superando gli obiettivi di vendita durante la costruzione di relazioni durature con i decisori chiave. Il vostro obiettivo sarà quello di espandere la vostra rete, identificare nuove opportunità e presentare proposte di valore convincenti. Con una profonda comprensione della nostra linea di prodotti, servirai come consulente affidabile, migliorando continuamente il nostro sistema di qualità attraverso le tue azioni quotidiane. Come amministratore del conto - Diagnostica molecolare, Lei:
• essere responsabile della promozione di test diagnostici molecolari, tra cui malattia infettiva, respiratoria e trapianto.
• contattare i clienti nuovi e esistenti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati, sviluppando nuovi business, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e risolvendo i problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche, il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere le vendite.
• generare domanda e massimizzare la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti.
• implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• lavorare con altri, se necessario o richiesto, per preparare proposte per conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• condurre e organizzare la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessario per l'efficienza. Conduce l'analisi aziendale e la pianificazione.
• comunica le informazioni sul mercato competitivo internamente.
• reti e interfacce con i colleghi interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente coinvolti in organizzazioni di settore/clienti che influiscono sul business. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo - il territorio è Massachusetts, Connecticut, Vermont e Eastern NY. Fino al 50% di viaggio notturno previsto. Chi sei?
• Corso di laurea o esperienza equivalente
• 3+ anni di vendite rilevanti o di esperienza equivalente
• La partecipazione a uno sviluppo accelerato approvato, la comunione o il programma rotazionale possono essere considerati al posto dell'esperienza. Preferiti Requisiti:
• L'esperienza nelle vendite diagnostiche è fortemente preferita
• Buone capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, tra cui fare presentazioni d'impatto
• Prove capacità di leadership
• Negoziazione, contrattazione e problem solving competenze
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente regolamentato
• Pianificazione strategica e competenze organizzative I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questo lavoro L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione, in base alla posizione principale del Massachusetts, è $ 84,100.00-$156,300.00. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Questa posizione è ammissibile per ottenere un indennizzo incentivo calcolato

• Erzeugung der Nachfrage und Maximierung des Produktbewusstseins durch die Zusammenarbeit und Bereitstellung von Bildung und Information an die Kunden.
• Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen und Pläne zur Erleichterung des Verkaufsprozesses und der Produktivität.
• Arbeiten Sie bei Bedarf mit anderen zusammen, um Vorschläge für zugewiesene Konten vorzubereiten. Stellt alle Vertragsvorschläge an Kunden vor, um das Gesamtgeschäft und die Rentabilität zu maximieren, was einige Verhandlungen erfordern kann.
• die notwendige Raumplanung und -führung für die Effizienz durchführen und organisieren. Durchführung der Geschäftsanalyse und -planung.

En tant que responsable de compte - diagnostic moléculaire, vous:
• promouvoir les tests de diagnostic moléculaire, y compris les maladies infectieuses, respiratoires et les transplantations.
• contacter des clients nouveaux et existants pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente dans des comptes ciblés, en développant de nouvelles activités, en développant des activités existantes, en maintenant des relations avec les clients et en dépannant les problèmes des clients. Il s'agit notamment d'identifier et d'élaborer des plans de comptes stratégiques, d'élaborer et de transmettre un message de différenciation et une valeur économique quantifiable pour les produits et services, de vendre la différenciation primaire des produits Roche, de surmonter et de gérer les objections et de négocier pour obtenir des ventes.
• générer la demande et maximiser la sensibilisation aux produits en travaillant avec et en fournissant de l'éducation et de l'information aux clients.
• met en oeuvre des initiatives et des plans stratégiques pour faciliter le processus de vente et la productivité.
• travailler avec d'autres, selon les besoins ou les besoins, à l'élaboration de propositions de comptes attribués. Présente toutes les propositions de contrats aux clients afin de maximiser l'ensemble des activités et de la rentabilité, ce qui peut nécessiter des négociations.
• réaliser et organiser la planification et l'acheminement du territoire nécessaires à l'efficacité. Effectuer des analyses et des plans opérationnels.
• communique en interne des informations sur le marché concurrentiel.
• des réseaux et des interfaces avec des collègues internes afin d'échanger des informations et des pratiques exemplaires tout en continuant à participer activement aux activités de l'industrie et des organisations de clients qui ont une incidence sur les entreprises. C'est un rôle de terrain - le territoire est le Massachusetts, le Connecticut, le Vermont et l'Est de NY. Jusqu'à 50 % de la nuit prévue. Qui vous êtes :
• Licence ou expérience équivalente
• 3+ ans de ventes pertinentes ou expérience équivalente
• La participation à un programme de développement accéléré, de bourses ou de rotation approuvé peut être envisagée au lieu de l'expérience. Exigences préférées :
• L'expérience dans les ventes de diagnostic est fortement préférée
• Bonnes aptitudes à la communication orale et écrite, y compris des présentations utiles
• Capacités éprouvées de leadership
• Compétences en négociation, négociation et résolution de problèmes
• Capacité de travailler dans un environnement réglementé
• Planification stratégique et compétences organisationnelles Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste, basée sur l'emplacement principal du Massachusetts, est de 84 100,00 $ à 156 300,00 $. jobs.title: Pricing Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Title: Pricing Partner
Job Location: Delhi

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

• A unique patient focused opportunity in the Market Access function

• Support Pan India Pricing Strategy initiatives

• Supportive team and work environment

As a Pricing Partner (Lead) you will co-create pan India sustainable and scalable ARI interventions for payor Ecosystems with State Cluster teams, provide innovative pricing, alternate payor funding, commercial contracting and tender inclusion strategy. Through interventions that address ability to pay challenges of patients, you will provide competitive beyond price solutions for private accounts and inclusion strategies in national formularies

Key Responsibilities: The Pricing Partner will:

• Provide pricing solutions to key brands based on validated access barriers whilst maintaining floor price as well as 100% compliance to regulations

• Develop and Implement commercial contracting framework to address needs of different account segments

• Evaluate and create brand and payor specific alternative funding & innovative financing solutions

• Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to create solutions to enable Personalised Healthcare (PHC) ecosystem development and sustainable pricing strategies for FMI (Foundation Medicine Transition).

• Develop Patient Navigation strategies in the Select Public ecosystem by identifying patient hurdles to Roche innovation through Patient journey mapping

• Identify bottlenecks and challenges in the Formulary Inclusion process and plan Interventions for Select Public ecosystems

• Cluster challenges to ARI updation and plan state teams to develop solutions for Select Public ecosystems (e.g. Defense and Railways)

• To negotiate with potential vendors on creating solutions and with hospitals to enable commercial contracting

• Provide insights & inputs to Launch excellence team on Formulary inclusions process of various reimbursement bodies, inclusion timelines, Documents needed as well as preparation of Value dossier to be awarded to relevant authorities for select public ecosystem

• Create continuous monitoring and control mechanisms for pricing for core and new products

• Enable networks with global function to proactively advocate for approvals required for core products and new launches

• Create short & long term sustainable channels and pricing strategies for new products along with the launch squad and be audit ready at any time

• Ensure operational pricing and government submissions and contribute to shaping a conducive pricing environment in India

Who you are
With a growth mindset, and experience in agile ways of working you are able to demonstrate patient centricity in decision making, strong collaboration and networking skills, inspiring and influencing.
You have

• Post graduation: MBA or equivalent

• 10+ years experience in pharma industry including at Least 5-10 years experience in pricing and/or public accounts

• Knowledge & Experience of Payers Ecosystem & Budget allocation Process

• Thorough understanding of Procurement processes of different public accounts & processes, Pricing process, regulations and value framework

• Good In insighting & analytical Skills

• Value Demonstration to Payers & Decision Makers

You are

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Titolo del lavoro: Partner dei prezzi Luogo di lavoro: Delhi Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.
• Un’opportunità unica per il paziente focalizzata nella funzione Market Access
• Support Pan India Pricing Iniziative di strategia
• Team di supporto e ambiente di lavoro In qualità di Partner di Prezzo (Lead) co-creare pan India interventi ARI sostenibili e scalabili per i dipendenti Ecosistemi con i team di Cluster di Stato, fornire prezzi innovativi, finanziamenti a pagamento alternativi, contratti commerciali e strategia di inclusione tenera. Attraverso interventi che affrontano la capacità di pagare le sfide dei pazienti, fornirete soluzioni competitive oltre i prezzi per i conti privati e le strategie di inclusione nelle formule nazionali Responsabilità chiave: Il Partner di Prezzo sarà:
• Fornire soluzioni tariffarie ai marchi chiave basate su barriere di accesso convalidate, mantenendo il prezzo del pavimento e la conformità al 100% delle normative
• Sviluppare e implementare il quadro di contratto commerciale per soddisfare le esigenze di diversi segmenti di account
• Valutare e creare brand e payor specifici finanziamenti alternativi e soluzioni di finanziamento innovative
• Collaborare con le parti interessate per creare soluzioni per consentire lo sviluppo dell'ecosistema Personalised Healthcare (PHC) e strategie di prezzi sostenibili per FMI (Foundation Medicine Transition).
• Sviluppare le strategie di Navigazione Paziente nell'ecosistema Select Public identificando gli ostacoli dei pazienti all'innovazione Roche attraverso la mappatura del viaggio paziente
• Identificare strozzature e sfide nel processo di inclusione della Formularia e pianificare Interventi per Select Public ecosistemi
• Sfide di cluster per l'aggiornamento di ARI e pianificare i team di stato per sviluppare soluzioni per Select Public ecosistemi (ad esempio Difesa e Ferrovie)
• Negoziare con potenziali fornitori sulla creazione di soluzioni e con gli ospedali per consentire contratti commerciali
• Fornire intuizioni e ingressi per lanciare team di eccellenza sul processo di inclusione di formule di vari enti di rimborso, timeline di inclusione, documenti necessari e preparazione del dossier di valore da assegnare alle autorità competenti per selezionare ecosistema pubblico
• Creare meccanismi di monitoraggio e controllo continui per i prezzi dei prodotti core e nuovi
• Attivare reti con funzione globale per sostenere proattivamente le approvazioni richieste per i prodotti core e i nuovi lanci
• Creare canali sostenibili a breve e lungo termine e strategie di prezzi per i nuovi prodotti insieme alla squadra di lancio e essere audit pronto in qualsiasi momento
• Assicurare i prezzi operativi e le sottomissioni del governo e contribuire a modellare un ambiente favorevole dei prezzi in India Chi sei Con una mentalità di crescita, e l'esperienza in modi agili di lavoro si è in grado di dimostrare la centricità del paziente nel processo decisionale, forte collaborazione e competenze di networking, ispirare e influenzare. Tu hai
• Laurea post: MBA o equivalente
• 10+ anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica, tra cui 5-10 anni di esperienza nel settore dei prezzi e/o dei conti pubblici
• Conoscenza e esperienza dei finanziatori Ecosystem & Budget
• Una comprensione approfondita dei processi di approvvigionamento di diversi account e processi pubblici, processo di prezzi, regolamenti e quadro di valore
• Buona conoscenza e competenze analitiche
• Dimostrazione del valore ai finanziatori e ai decisori Tu sei

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Stellenwert: Pricing Partner Standort: Delhi Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche.
• Eine einzigartige, patientenorientierte Gelegenheit in der Market Access Funktion
• Unterstützung Pan India Pricing Strategieinitiativen
• Unterstützte Team- und Arbeitsumgebung Als Pricing Partner (Lead) werden Sie mit State Cluster Teams nachhaltige und skalierbare ARI-Interventionen für Payor Ecosystems schaffen, innovative Preise, alternative Payor-Finanzierung, kommerzielle Vergabe und Ausschreibungsinklusion bieten. Durch Interventionen, die sich mit der Fähigkeit beschäftigen, Herausforderungen von Patienten zu bezahlen, werden Sie über Preislösungen für Privatkonten und Inklusionsstrategien in nationalen Formeln wettbewerbsfähig sein Hauptverantwortlichkeiten: Der Pricing Partner wird:
• Bereitstellung von Preislösungen für Schlüsselmarken, die auf validierten Zugangsbarrieren basieren, unter Beibehaltung des Bodenpreises sowie 100% Einhaltung von Vorschriften
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung des kommerziellen Vertragsrahmens, um die Bedürfnisse verschiedener Kontosegmente anzusprechen
• Bewertung und Erstellung von Marken- und Payor-spezifischen alternativen Finanzierungslösungen & innovative Finanzierungslösungen
• Mit relevanten Akteuren zusammenarbeiten, um Lösungen zu schaffen, um die Entwicklung von personalisierten Gesundheitssystemen (PHC) und nachhaltige Preisstrategien für FMI (Foundation Medicine Transition) zu ermöglichen.
• Entwicklung von Strategien zur Patientennavigation im Select Public Ökosystem durch Identifizierung von Patientenhürden für Roche-Innovation durch Patienten-Reise-Mapping
• Engpässe und Herausforderungen im Formulary Inclusion-Prozess identifizieren und Interventionen für ausgewählte öffentliche Ökosysteme planen
• Cluster-Herausforderungen für die ARI updation und die Planung staatlicher Teams zur Entwicklung von Lösungen für ausgewählte öffentliche Ökosysteme (z.B. Verteidigung und Eisenbahnen)
• Verhandeln mit potenziellen Anbietern über die Schaffung von Lösungen und mit Krankenhäusern, um kommerzielle Kontraktion zu ermöglichen
• Stellen Sie Einblicke und Inputs zur Einführung von Exzellenz-Team über Formulary-Inklusions-Prozess von verschiedenen Rückerstattungsstellen, Inklusions-Timelines, Dokumente erforderlich sowie die Vorbereitung von Value Dossier, die an die zuständigen Behörden für ausgewählte öffentliche Ökosysteme vergeben werden
• Erstellen Sie kontinuierliche Überwachungs- und Kontrollmechanismen für die Preisgestaltung für Kern- und Neuprodukte
• Netzwerke mit globaler Funktion aktivieren, um sich proaktiv für die für Kernprodukte und neue Starts erforderlichen Genehmigungen einzusetzen
• Erstellen Sie kurz- und langfristig nachhaltige Kanäle und Preisstrategien für neue Produkte zusammen mit dem Start-Quadrat und sind jederzeit ein Audit bereit
• Gewährleistung der operativen Preise und der Regierungsbeiträge und Beitrag zur Gestaltung eines förderlichen Preises in Indien Wer bist du? Mit einem Wachstumsgeist, und Erfahrung in agilen Arbeitsmethoden können Sie die Patientenzentrizität in Entscheidungsfindung, starke Zusammenarbeit und Netzwerkfähigkeiten, inspirierend und beeinflussen. Sie haben
• Postgraduierung: MBA oder gleichwertig
• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie, einschließlich der 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Preisgestaltung und/oder öffentlichen Konten
• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen der Payers Ecosystem & Budget Zuteilungsprozess
• gründliches Verständnis der Beschaffungsprozesse verschiedener öffentlicher Konten & Prozesse, Preisgestaltung, Vorschriften und Wertrahmen
• Gute Einblicke und analytische Fähigkeiten
• Wertvorstellung an Zahler & Entscheidungsträger Du bist

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Titre de l'emploi: Partenaire de tarification Lieu de travail: Delhi Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.
• Une opportunité unique pour les patients dans la fonction Accès au marché
• Soutenir les initiatives de la stratégie de tarification pan-Inde
• Équipe de soutien et environnement de travail En tant que partenaire de tarification (lead), vous co-créerez des interventions ARI durables et évolutives en Inde pour les écosystèmes payeurs avec des équipes de clusters d'État, fournirez des prix innovants, un financement alternatif, des contrats commerciaux et une stratégie d'inclusion des appels d'offres. Grâce à des interventions qui répondent aux défis de la capacité de payer des patients, vous offrirez des solutions compétitives au-delà des prix pour les comptes privés et les stratégies d'inclusion dans les formules nationales Principales responsabilités : Le partenaire de tarification :
• Fournir des solutions de tarification aux marques clés sur la base d'obstacles d'accès validés tout en maintenant le prix plancher ainsi que le respect intégral de la réglementation
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre un cadre de passation de marchés commerciaux pour répondre aux besoins des différents segments de compte
• Évaluer et créer des solutions de financement alternatives spécifiques à la marque et au payeur
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes concernées pour créer des solutions permettant le développement d'écosystèmes de soins de santé personnalisés et des stratégies de tarification durable pour l'IMF (Foundation Medicine Transition).
• Élaborer des stratégies de navigation des patients dans l'écosystème Select Public en identifiant les obstacles à l'innovation Roche grâce à la cartographie des parcours des patients
• Recenser les goulets d'étranglement et les défis dans le processus d'inclusion de formulation et planifier des interventions pour certains écosystèmes publics
• Défis en grappe pour la mise à niveau de l'ARI et planification des équipes d'État pour développer des solutions pour certains écosystèmes publics (par exemple, Défense et Chemins de fer)
• négocier avec les fournisseurs potentiels sur la création de solutions et avec les hôpitaux pour permettre des contrats commerciaux;
• Fournir des informations et des contributions pour lancer l'équipe d'excellence sur le processus d'inclusion des formulaires de divers organismes de remboursement, les délais d'inclusion, les documents nécessaires ainsi que la préparation du dossier Value à attribuer aux autorités compétentes pour certains écosystèmes publics
• Créer des mécanismes de surveillance et de contrôle continus pour la tarification des produits de base et des nouveaux produits
• Permettre aux réseaux ayant une fonction mondiale de promouvoir activement les approbations requises pour les produits de base et les nouveaux lancements
• Créer des canaux durables à court et à long terme et des stratégies de tarification pour les nouveaux produits avec l'équipe de lancement et être prêt à tout moment
• Veiller à ce que les prix opérationnels et les communications gouvernementales soient établis et contribuer à l'instauration d'un environnement de tarification favorable en Inde; Qui vous êtes Avec un état d'esprit en croissance, et l'expérience dans des façons agiles de travailler, vous êtes en mesure de démontrer la concentration des patients dans la prise de décision, une forte collaboration et des compétences de réseautage, inspirant et influençant. Vous avez
• Post graduation: MBA ou équivalent
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris au moins 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en matière de prix et/ou de comptes publics
• Connaissance et expérience des payeurs Processus d'allocation des écosystèmes et du budget
• Compréhension approfondie des processus d'approvisionnement des différents comptes et processus publics, du processus de tarification, des règlements et du cadre de valeurs
• Bonne connaissance et compétences analytiques
• Démonstration de valeur aux payeurs et décideurs Vous êtes

jobs.title: Head of Site Services & SHE
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Imagine working for an organisation that focuses on putting people at the heart of what they do. Where every single person within the organisation is aligned to one main motivating force, that at the center of everything they do, and their number one priority; patients. Imagine you are at Roche.

We're looking for a dynamic and strategic leader for the position of Head of Site Services and SHE to define and drive the strategy, performance, and continuous development of our sites and workplaces. This role is essential in shaping the future of our facilities and ensuring optimal safety, sustainability, and operational excellence. You will lead all aspects of facilities, Sustainability, Safety, Health & Environment (SHE). By fostering a culture of collaboration and customer-centric service, you will create an environment that anticipates future needs and enhances the employee and customer experience.

The Opportunity

• Lead Your Team : Develop and lead a high-performing team by fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will also provide coaching and mentorship, and support professional development.

• Lead Strategy & Innovation : Define and drive local workplace strategy in alignment with local and global ambitions. You will also participate in the International Real Estate/Facilities Management (RE/FM) portfolio and support corporate initiatives.

• Ensure Compliance : Collaborate closely with colleagues to ensure business continuity including local emergency plans. You'll ensure compliance with all local and global regulations and maintain necessary ISO registrations, such as Environment (14001), Health and Safety (45001).

• Manage Operations & Maintenance : Plan and control repairs and maintenance to ensure high availability of site infrastructure. You will also implement Lifecycle Asset Management and define KPIs to measure success.

• ​ Engage Stakeholders : Drive close communication and collaboration with all site stakeholders, following a "customer first" principle. You'll advocate for Roche's position within external industry and government entities.

• Oversee Security & Safety: Develop, implement, and maintain security measures related to physical, personnel, and information security.

Who are you

We are looking for a leader who is passionate about sustainability, safety, and creating exceptional workplaces. Your profile should include:

• Leadership & Behavioral Qualities : You must be a strategic thinker with proven experience leading a diverse team and driving a culture of accountability. You should be an active listener who fosters collaborative problem-solving, trusting and empowering your team to take ownership. We need a leader who is objective-driven, adaptable, and has strong communication, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills. We are looking for a leader who is a true Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach (VACC).

• Technical Skills : A solid grasp of the technical aspects of facilities management, including building systems, HVAC, electrical, and plumbing is also critical. Experience in energy management, project management, vendor management, and budget management is required.

• Qualifications & Experience : A degree or equivalent, relevant & established experience. Advanced IWFM qualification or comparable certification preferred. You should have a proven track record of leading large projects in facilities and SHE, managing budgets, and driving innovation.

jobs.title: Praktikum im Bereich Qualitätskontrolle (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.it: Tirocinio nel settore del controllo qualità (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, um Einblicke in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu bekommen? Bei uns erhältst Du die spannende Möglichkeit dazu.
In Deinem Praktikum lernst Du den Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle umfassend kennen. Es erwartet Dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit im Bereich der Analytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen. Du erhältst ebenfalls die Möglichkeit, Einblicke in andere Bereiche wie z.B. Biotech Produktion oder Qualitätssicherung zu gewinnen. Während des gesamten Praktikums steht Dir ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du unterstützt die proteinchemische Analytik und Freigabeanalytik von immunologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

• Du bearbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte zur Optimierung der Qualitätskontrolle, beispielsweise durch Datenrecherche bei Abweichungen oder die Zentralisierung von Analysemethoden

• Du wirkst aktiv an Compliance-Themen mit, indem Du beispielsweise bei der Erstellung und Anpassung von Dokumenten nach internen Vorschriften und geltenden Standards unterstützt

• Du erhältst Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche wie die Vorbereitung von Audits und Inspektionen sowie in den gesamten Lebenszyklus diagnostischer Tests (Neuentwicklung, Produktion und Verpackung)

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (z.B. B.Sc . / M.Sc . Chemie, Biochemie, Biotechnologie, Biologie, etc.) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year

• Du bringst eine hohe Motivation und Neugierde für die Arbeit in der Qualitätskontrolle mit.

• Idealerweise verfügst Du über Vorkenntnisse in der proteinchemischen Analytik.

• Solide Deutsch-Kenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

jobs.title: ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

titleByLocale.fr: Consultant en solutions ERP - SAP EWM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level.

The Opportunity

• Design & Implementation : Develop and implement complex enhancements to our SAP EWM solution, including MFS and WebDynpro user interfaces

• Independent Problem-Solving : Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions; troubleshoot issues at the code level without requiring constant guidance

• Technical Deep-Dive : Investigate complex technical challenges, debug code, and optimize system performance

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with business teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and communicate technical constraints and timelines

• Validated Environment Management : Execute changes in compliance with our regulated environment, including documentation, test cases, and validation requirements

• Knowledge Transfer : Document solutions and share expertise with team members to build organizational capability

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Required Qualifications

• Extensive SAP EWM Experience : Minimum 5+ years working with SAP EWM in production environments, including complex configurations and customizations

• MFS Expertise : Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SAP MFS

• ABAP Development Skills : Solid programming background with ability to debug, and optimize ABAP code

• Validated Environment Experience : Demonstrated familiarity with regulated environments, change management processes, and compliance documentation

• SAFe Framework Knowledge : Working understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices

• Fluent English : Strong verbal and written communication skills (essential)

• German Language (Preferred) : Fluency in German is a significant plus

Who you are:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM Stiamo cercando un esperto senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer con esperienza MFS per unire il nostro team e prendere la proprietà di una soluzione di gestione del magazzino altamente complessa e validata. Questo magazzino è uno dei più grandi della divisione Roche Pharma con un alto grado di automazione. Guida team di prodotti, responsabilità dei campioni e comunica efficacemente con tutti gli stakeholder. Si risolverà problemi complessi, prendere decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica, e rapporto a livello di prodotto. L'opportunità
• Progettazione e attuazione: sviluppare e implementare miglioramenti complessi alla nostra soluzione SAP EWM, comprese le interfacce utente MFS e WebDynpro
• Indipendente Problem-Solving: analizzare i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche; risolvere i problemi a livello di codice senza richiedere una guida costante
• Deep-Dive tecnico: individuare complesse sfide tecniche, debug code e ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali per comprendere i requisiti, gestire le aspettative e comunicare vincoli tecnici e tempistiche
• Gestione dell'ambiente convalidata: Eseguire le modifiche nel rispetto del nostro ambiente regolamentato, inclusi i requisiti di documentazione, casi di test e convalida
• Knowledge Transfer: soluzioni di documenti e competenze con i membri del team per costruire capacità organizzative
• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti Qualificazioni richieste
• Ampia esperienza SAP EWM: minimo 5+ anni di lavoro con SAP EWM in ambienti produttivi, comprese configurazioni complesse e personalizzazioni
• Competenza MFS: comprovata esperienza di attuazione e mantenimento di SAP MFS
• ABAP Development Skills: Solid background di programmazione con capacità di debug e ottimizzare il codice ABAP
• Esperienza ambientale convalidata: familiarità dimostrata con ambienti regolamentati, processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e documentazione di conformità
• Conoscenza quadro SAFe: comprensione di lavoro dei principi e delle pratiche di Agile Framework (SAFe)
• Inglese fluente: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta (essenziale)
• Lingua tedesca (preferita) : La fluenza in tedesco è un vantaggio significativo Chi sei:
• Campo d'insalatura 14.175 - 26.325 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 15%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! Dieses Lager ist eines der größten der Division Roche Pharma mit einem hohen Automatisierungsgrad. Sie führen Produktteams, Champion-Rechenbarkeit und kommunizieren effektiv mit allen Stakeholdern. Sie werden komplexe Probleme lösen, unabhängige Entscheidungen auf Produktebene treffen, technische Aufsicht und auf Produktebene berichten. Die Chance
• Design & Implementierung: Entwickeln und implementieren Sie komplexe Erweiterungen unserer SAP EWM-Lösung, einschließlich MFS und WebDynpro-Benutzeroberflächen

• Validiertes Umweltmanagement: Erarbeitung von Änderungen in Übereinstimmung mit unserer geregelten Umgebung, einschließlich Dokumentation, Testfälle und Validierungsanforderungen
• Wissenstransfer : Dokumentenlösungen und Erfahrungsaustausch mit Teammitgliedern, um organisatorische Fähigkeiten aufzubauen
• Reisen in die Schweiz nach Bedarf für Unterstützung vor Ort, Workshops und Kundenbindung Erforderliche Qualifikationen
