descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef d'équipe et le gestionnaire des produits sont responsables de tout le cycle de vie du produit, depuis l'idée initiale et la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à l'échelle et à la retraite. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de diriger les équipes d'ingénierie et de service en construisant des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Description de la zone Dans le cadre des opérations techniques de RDT Pharma et plus particulièrement dans le contexte des technologies de fabrication , les données de processus de l'équipe supervisent un portefeuille stratégique d'équipes et de solutions axées sur le cycle de vie des données de fabrication pharmaceutique. Cette zone fait partie de l'épine dorsale numérique de notre environnement de production, assurant que les processus scientifiques complexes sont traduits en formats numériques fiables, exécutables et à déclaration. Notre portée comprend :
• Définition et suivi du paramètre process : assurer la précision et l'intégrité des données qui définissent nos étapes de fabrication. . Gestion de la recette d'entreprise : orchestrer les "empreintes bleues" pour nos médicaments sur différents sites afin d'assurer la cohérence et l'évolutivité. Data Historian Solutions: Gestion des flux de données en temps réel à haute fréquence depuis l'atelier pour permettre une analyse approfondie, le dépannage et l'amélioration continue des processus. Accessibility Shop-Floor Data : Simplification de l'extraction et de la disponibilité des données brutes de fabrication pour s'assurer qu'elles sont facilement accessibles pour les systèmes de niveau supérieur, les analyses et la prise de décisions opérationnelles. Vous serez :
• Stratégie & Vision : Responsable de définir l'orientation d'un produit et de veiller à ce qu'il atteigne des résultats définis et des objectifs financiers. Définit la stratégie, la feuille de route et les caractéristiques des produits en fonction des objectifs opérationnels, des besoins des utilisateurs et des politiques organisationnelles. Intégrer de manière proactive les capacités d'IA pertinentes dans la feuille de route des produits. Définir, suivre et communiquer les ICR pertinents pour le produit afin de mesurer son rendement et sa contribution aux objectifs et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Client-Centricité : Recueillir, comprendre et prioriser activement les besoins des utilisateurs internes. Agir en tant que propriétaire principal du problème du client et être responsable de définir et de fournir une solution qui fournit une valeur tangible. Définir et suivre les mesures clés liées à la satisfaction des utilisateurs, à l'engagement et à la livraison de valeur, et utiliser ces données pour éclairer les itérations de produits.
• Cycle de vie du produit Mgmt. Posséder le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, orienter son développement et gérer sa croissance et éventuellement son déclin en fonction de l'étude de marché, de la rétroaction des clients et des objectifs commerciaux. Gérer le produit conformément aux nouveaux règlements.
• Collaboration avec les parties prenantes : étendre la collaboration à un ensemble plus large d'équipes interfonctionnelles et être responsable de l'alignement de ces équipes sur la feuille de route des produits. Communiquer clairement la feuille de route du produit, les échéanciers et les compromis possibles à divers intervenants pour gérer efficacement leurs attentes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Global Patient Network (GPN) team within Roche's Product Development Medical Affairs (PDMA) department, the Content & Chapter Excellence Lead is a strategic role focused on elevating the GPN brand and professionalizing the function’s operational standards. You will serve as the primary architect for how GPN communicates its value and ensures global consistency through standardized training, onboarding, and procedural excellence. By driving the GPN congress strategy, Global Patient Week, and the ongoing maintenance of our functional narrative, you will ensure that the voice of the patient is communicated effectively across the organization. You will also play a critical role in fostering a culture of excellence by equipping patient-facing roles with the tools, training, and governance necessary to succeed.

The Opportunity

• GPN Congress & Global Patient Week Strategy: Design and implement a global congress strategy for Patient Partnership at Roche, including content development and speaker preparation, while leading the execution of Global Patient Week to drive internal and external engagement.

• Digital Ecosystem & SME Support: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for For Patients and Emerald/WebXO, ensuring these platforms effectively serve our patient communities and internal stakeholders.

• Annual Report & Narrative Development: Partner with GPN and WPPN to develop high-impact content for the Annual Report and maintain the GPN "message house" and "nutshell deck" to support affiliates in localizing functional narratives.

• Training & Onboarding Excellence: Design and deploy the GPN Training Program and provide oversight for the global onboarding approach to ensure new hires in patient-facing roles are equipped for success.

• Operational Governance: Oversee the management of the PP Hub and lead the refresh and maintenance of GPN Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), providing critical input into company-wide SOPs related to the function.

• Stakeholder & Affiliate Support: Provide ongoing guidance to local affiliates to ensure alignment with global functional narratives and operational standards, fostering a unified "One Roche" approach to patient engagement.

Who You Are

• 5+ years of experience in strategic communications and/or organizational excellence within a complex, matrixed global organization.

• High proficiency in narrative building, message house development, and executive-level content creation.

• Proven ability to design global training programs and manage complex operational frameworks, including SOP maintenance and onboarding strategies.

• Strong experience in large-scale event strategy (e.g., congresses, awareness weeks) and digital platform management.

• Exceptional ability to partner with diverse stakeholders across GPN, WPPN, and local affiliates to drive alignment and functional excellence.

• Skilled at navigating organizational complexity to drive adoption of new standards, building trust, and influencing without direct authority.

• Applicants must have native or near-native fluency in professional business English (written and spoken)

• The job requires minimal travel (10-15%) and schedule flexibility to serve global time zone

• Alta competenza nella costruzione narrativa, nello sviluppo della casa dei messaggi e nella creazione di contenuti a livello esecutivo.
• Prova capacità di progettare programmi di formazione globale e gestire complessi quadri operativi, tra cui la manutenzione SOP e le strategie di bordo.
• Una forte esperienza nella strategia degli eventi su larga scala (ad esempio, congressi, settimane di consapevolezza) e nella gestione delle piattaforme digitali.
• Eccezionale capacità di collaborare con diversi stakeholder attraverso GPN, WPPN e affiliati locali per guidare l'allineamento e l'eccellenza funzionale.
• Abilitato a navigare nella complessità organizzativa per guidare l'adozione di nuovi standard, costruire la fiducia e influenzare senza autorità diretta.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Global Patient Network (GPN) team within Roche's Product Development Medical Affairs (PDMA) department, the Patient Insights & Analytics Lead is a pivotal role that serves across the full Pharma value chain from R&D through commercialisation. As a core member of the Network Enablement Team in GPN, you will serve as the foundational engine for managing patient insights and measuring their impact on key business decisions by delivering the essential systems, frameworks, and insight management principles required for GPN to achieve impactful results globally. By ensuring that patient insights are FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable), quantified, understood, and integrated into Roche’s business processes, you will facilitate meaningful, cross-functional partnerships that will deliver tangible impact for patients, while enabling success for our business.

The Position

• KPI Framework & Value Narrative: implement a KPI measurement framework, collect data, and develop a strong narrative demonstrating the tangible value and impact of integrating patient insights into key business decisions across the company

• Affiliate Metric Alignment: input and shape affiliate KPI frameworks, successfully connecting global and local metrics, wherever possible

• Insights & CRM Infrastructure: design, deploy, and manage internal tools that enable streamlined stakeholder and insight management to enable efficiencies in how key business functions access and apply patient insights into their work

• Tool Integration: integrate and manage insight collection/management tools utilized by GPN into enterprise-wide solutions, aligning the approach with broader PDMA approaches/principles

• External Benchmarking: maintain oversight of external benchmarking initiatives and platforms to ensure Roche is appropriately represented, generating impact data that can be integrated into internal frameworks to tell a complete story of Roche’s impact on and reputation with patients

• Strategic Stakeholder Management: navigate a complex, matrixed environment to integrate patient insight management tools across the company, bringing global and local infrastructures together to deliver a ‘One Roche’ approach

Who You Are

• 5+ years of proven experience in delivering complex insights/analytics solutions across a matrixed organisation with global and regional presence (experience working with patient data and insights highly valued)

• High proficiency in developing validated metrics and narratives that prove the business value of patient inclusivity from end to end.

• Proven expertise in designing, implementing, and managing platforms and solutions across a global network.

• Strong ability to interface with internal leaders and collaborate effectively with Legal, Compliance, Communications, Market Insights, and other business functions.

• Ability to lead projects/initiatives that go beyond insights and analytics to help drive team priorities, where needed.

• Emotional intelligence and effective influencing skills to align stakeholders, build trust, and drive mutually valuable solutions forward.

• Applicants must have native or near-native fluency in professional business English (written and spoken)

• The job requires minimal travel (10-15%) and schedule flexibility to serve global time zones

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additio

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come membro del team Global Paziente Network (GPN) all'interno del dipartimento Affari medici per lo sviluppo del prodotto di Roche (PDMA), il Paziente Insights & Analytics Lead è un ruolo fondamentale che serve attraverso l'intera catena di valore di Pharma da R&D attraverso la commercializzazione. Come membro di base del Network Enablement Team in GPN, servirai come motore di base per la gestione delle intuizioni dei pazienti e la misura del loro impatto sulle decisioni aziendali chiave, fornendo i sistemi essenziali, le strutture e i principi di gestione delle intuizioni necessari per GPN per raggiungere i risultati di impatto a livello globale. Assicurando che le intuizioni dei pazienti siano FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable), quantificati, compresi e integrati nei processi aziendali di Roche, faciliterai collaborazioni significative e interfunzionali che garantiranno un impatto tangibile per i pazienti, consentendo al contempo il successo per la nostra attività. La posizione
• KPI Framework & Value Narrative: implementare un framework di misura KPI, raccogliere i dati e sviluppare una forte narrazione dimostrando il valore tangibile e l'impatto di integrare le intuizioni dei pazienti nelle decisioni aziendali chiave in tutta l'azienda
• Allineamento metrico dell'affiliato: quadri di affiliazione di input e forma KPI, collegando con successo metriche globali e locali, ovunque possibile
• Insights & CRM Infrastructure: progettazione, distribuzione e gestione di strumenti interni che consentono una gestione semplificata degli stakeholder e degli insight per consentire alle efficienze di come le funzioni aziendali chiave accedono e applichino informazioni sul loro lavoro
• Integrazione degli strumenti: integrare e gestire strumenti di raccolta/gestione approfonditi utilizzati da GPN in soluzioni a livello aziendale, allineando l'approccio con approcci/principi PDMA più ampi
• Benchmarking esterno: mantenere la supervisione di iniziative e piattaforme di benchmarking esterne per garantire che Roche sia adeguatamente rappresentata, generando dati di impatto che possono essere integrati in quadri interni per raccontare una storia completa dell’impatto di Roche e della reputazione con i pazienti
• Strategic Stakeholder Management: navigare in un ambiente complesso e a matrice per integrare gli strumenti di gestione delle informazioni dei pazienti in tutta l'azienda, unendo le infrastrutture globali e locali per fornire un approccio 'One Roche' Chi sei
• 5+ anni di comprovata esperienza nel fornire soluzioni complesse di analisi/analisi in un'organizzazione matrice con presenza globale e regionale (esperienza di lavoro con dati e approfondimenti del paziente altamente apprezzati)
• Alta competenza nello sviluppo di metriche e narrazioni convalidate che dimostrano il valore aziendale dell'inclusione dei pazienti dalla fine alla fine.
• Prove competenze nella progettazione, realizzazione e gestione di piattaforme e soluzioni in una rete globale.
• Forte capacità di interfacciarsi con i leader interni e collaborare efficacemente con Legal, Compliance, Communications, Market Insights e altre funzioni aziendali.
• Capacità di guidare progetti / iniziative che vanno oltre intuizioni e analisi per aiutare a guidare le priorità del team, dove necessario.
• Intelligenza emotiva e capacità di influenzare efficacemente le capacità di allineare gli stakeholder, costruire la fiducia e guidare soluzioni reciprocamente preziose in avanti.
• I candidati devono avere influenza nativo o quasi nativo in inglese professionale (scritto e parlato)
• Il lavoro richiede viaggi minimi (10-15%) e la flessibilità di pianificazione per servire fusi orari globali Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati ad additio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Diagnostics Solution Implementation Manager leads a high-performing technical solution team to implement and install complex diagnostic systems. The mission is to bridge the gap between the plan and the reality of installation, ensuring every deployment is executed with precision, minimal downtime, and maximum client satisfaction. They are the guardian of the "first impression," transforming a sold contract into a functional, life-saving clinical tool.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

• Recruit, mentor, and technically upskill a field engineering team to handle evolving diagnostic hardware and software middleware

• Conduct performance coaching, including "ride-alongs" and technical audits to provide real-time feedback to engineers in clinical environments

Operational Management

• Act as the single point of contact for resource management on installation projects

• Map out technical experts' deployments across multiple geographic territories based on site readiness and technician expertise

• Monitor KPIs such as Mean Time to Install (MTTI), first-time-fix rates, and customer effort scores

• Manage travel, expense budgets, and specialised tool inventory for the field team

Technical & Compliance Oversight

• Ensures site readiness assessments by reviewing facility blueprints, network requirements, and power specifications

• Audit installation logs and validation protocols to ensure compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements

• Consolidate field data on component failures to provide the organisation with actionable insights for product improvements

Strategic Collaboration

• Act as the primary liaison between project management, the field teams and customers

• Contribute to defining the Laboratory Transformation Leadership team strategy and oversee project prioritisation

• Serve as the final point of technical and operational escalation for complex site issues

Who You Are

Experience & Credentials

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related field (MBA or Master's in Project Management highly preferred)

• Proven experience in a people-management or team-lead role within an engineering environment

• Proven experience managing a portfolio of projects with cross-functional teams of 10+ people

• Demonstrated success in implementing new organisational processes or migrating teams to new project management methodologies

• Valid driving licence

Core Competencies

• Strategic Agility : Focus on high-value activities and ensure your team has the support and tools needed to meet organizational objectives

• Decision Making : Push decision-making to appropriate levels, take accountability, and make sound judgments even with incomplete information

• Managing Change : Articulate long-term objectives, effectively manage change, and build the emotional and rational case for transformation

• Inspiring & Influencing : Foster idea exchange, gain buy-in for proposals, and create a learning environment that promotes professional development

• Teamwork & Collaboration : Make people feel heard, encourage open discussions, tell the truth, and build diverse teams to deliver exceptional results

• Systems Thinking : Identify how delays cascade across the organization and forecast human capital needs to prevent burnout

• Emotional Intelligence (EQ) : High levels of empathy and situational awareness to mentor diverse personalities and maintain team mora

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond.

The Opportunity

As part of the Translational DMPK-PD and Clinical Pharmacology chapter, you will focus on providing the right drug at the right dose to patients safely with an efficacious benefit. You will collaborate closely with therapeutic areas to convert hypotheses into innovative medicines, driving nonclinical strategies to bring forward the best clinical candidates for specific indications.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategy & Design: Lead drug design and optimization strategies and compound profiling for all Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) aspects, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.

• Translational Evaluation: Provide support to early discovery teams in the development of translational strategies for the clinical evaluation of target modulation through the application of biochemical and pharmacological considerations.

• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimization (LO) through Entry into Human (EIH).

• Regulatory Support: Prepare and deliver high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK information for internal program reviews and external regulatory submissions (e.g., Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).

• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.

• Collaboration: Facilitate transparent, data-driven decision-making processes within project teams and squads while cultivating and maintaining trustful professional relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

Please note that this position is a 2-year temporary contract.

Who you are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, or Bioengineering, paired with over 5 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related field.

• You possess deep expertise in discovery, early PK characterization, distribution, and PKPD across various modalities, backed by a solid foundation in pharmacology and physiology.

• You demonstrate hands-on experience with modeling and simulation, proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning (ML) to DMPK strategy, and a strong drive to master tools like Phoenix, Ber

• Supporto normativo: Preparare e fornire valutazioni scientifiche di alta qualità di informazioni DMPK non cliniche per le recensioni dei programmi interni e le sottomissioni normative esterne (ad esempio, Investigational New Drug (IND), Brochure dell'investigatore (IB), Applicazione clinica di prova (CTA), Nuova applicazione della droga (NDA), Applicazione della licenza di Biologics (BLA)).

The Opportunity As part of the Translational DMPK-PD and Clinical Pharmacology chapter, you will focus on providing the right drug at the right dose to patients safely with an efficacious benefit. You will collaborate closely with therapeutic areas to convert hypotheses into innovative medicines, driving nonclinical strategies to bring forward the best clinical candidates for specific indications. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategy & Design: Lead drug design and optimization strategies and compound profiling for all Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) aspects, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.
• Translational Evaluation: Provide support to early discovery teams in the development of translational strategies for the clinical evaluation of target modulation through the application of biochemical and pharmacological considerations.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimization (LO) through Entry into Human (EIH).
• Regulatory Support: Prepare and deliver high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK information for internal program reviews and external regulatory submissions (e.g., Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).
• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.
• Collaboration: Facilitate transparent, data-driven decision-making processes within project teams and squads while cultivating and maintaining trustful professional relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Please note that this position is a 2-year temporary contract. Who you are
• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, or Bioengineering, paired with over 5 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related field.
• You possess deep expertise in discovery, early PK characterization, distribution, and PKPD across various modalities, backed by a solid foundation in pharmacology and physiology.
• You demonstrate hands-on experience with modeling and simulation, proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning (ML) to DMPK strategy, and a strong drive to master tools like Phoenix, Ber

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité Dans le cadre du chapitre sur la DMPK-PD et la pharmacologie clinique, vous vous concentrerez sur la fourniture du bon médicament à la bonne dose aux patients en toute sécurité avec un bénéfice efficace. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les domaines thérapeutiques pour convertir les hypothèses en médicaments innovants, en conduisant des stratégies non cliniques pour présenter les meilleurs candidats cliniques pour des indications spécifiques. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Stratégie et conception : Les stratégies de conception et d'optimisation des médicaments et le profilage des composés pour tous les aspects du métabolisme et de la pharmacocinétique des médicaments (DMPK), l'accent étant mis sur la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/Pharmacodynamique translationnelle (PD).
• Évaluation translationnelle: fournir un soutien aux équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible par l'application de considérations biochimiques et pharmacologiques.
• Modélisation et simulation (M&S): Exécuter des activités fondamentales de M&S, y compris la PKPD, la Pharmacocinétique physiologique (PBPK), l'interaction médicament-drogue (DDI) et la prédiction de la dose humaine/régime, afin de fournir un soutien essentiel aux projets allant de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) à l'entrée dans l'humain (EIH).
• Soutien réglementaire : Préparer et fournir des évaluations scientifiques de haute qualité de l'information DMPK non clinique pour les examens internes des programmes et les présentations de règlements externes (p. ex., les nouveaux médicaments expérimentaux (IND), la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB), la demande d'essai clinique (CTA), la demande de drogue nouvelle (NDA), la demande de licence de produits biologiques (BLA).
• Mise en oeuvre : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de biomarqueur et de bioanalyse en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires clés afin d'assurer à la fois la sécurité des patients et l'obtention d'avantages thérapeutiques significatifs.
• Collaboration : Faciliter des processus décisionnels transparents et axés sur les données au sein des équipes et des équipes de projet tout en cultivant et en maintenant des relations professionnelles de confiance avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Veuillez noter que ce poste est un contrat temporaire de 2 ans. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie ou bioingénierie, jumelé à plus de 5 ans d'expérience industrielle dans un domaine lié à la pharmacocinétique.
• Vous disposez d'une expertise approfondie en découverte, caractérisation précoce de la PK, distribution et PKPD sur différentes modalités, soutenue par une base solide en pharmacologie et en physiologie.
• Vous démontrez l'expérience pratique de la modélisation et de la simulation, la compétence dans l'application de l'intelligence artificielle (AI) Machine Learning (ML) à la stratégie DMPK, et une forte volonté de maîtriser des outils comme Phoenix, Ber

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) vereint die Portfolios Point of Care und Diabetes Care von Roche. Mit unserer Leidenschaft bringen wir Tests näher an Patienten und befähigen Menschen, ihre eigene Gesundheit besser zu überwachen. Innerhalb von NPC Operations sind wir global für die End-to-End-Produktion von Lösungen für die kontinuierliche Glukose-Überwachung (CGM), die Blutzuckermessung (BGM) und Insulin Delivery (IDS) sowie für Point-of-Care (POC)-Produkte verantwortlich. Unsere wichtigsten internen Produktionsstätten sind Mannheim in Deutschland und Indianapolis in den USA.

Das Umfeld
Als CxM Finished Goods sind wir mit rund 25 Kolleg:innen in Mannheim und Rotkreuz Teil von Manufacturing Science and Technology im Bereich NPC Operations. Für unser CGM Accu-Check SmartGuide verantworten wir den globalen Auf- und Ausbau sowie das Betreiben der externen Fertigungsstufe. Zusammen mit unseren strategischen Equipment- und Produktionspartnern entwickeln wir robuste Prozesse und Anlagen. Durch eine hohe Standardisierung sichern wir wettbewerbsfähige Herstellungskosten und eine zuverlässige Produktion. Wir stellen damit die Versorgung mit konformen Produkten in Qualität, Zeit und Kosten für die aktuellen und zukünftigen Produktgenerationen sicher und pflegen das Produkt über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

Die Position
Als Head of CxM Finished Goods - Projects leiten Sie ein globales Team von technischen Projektleiter:innen. Ihr Team verantwortet die Industrialisierung von R&D-Konzepten in standardisierte und robust skalierbare Anlagendesigns, die für die globale Massenproduktion geeignet sind und gewährleisten herstellbares Produktdesign (Design for Manufacturability). Dabei agieren Sie an den Schnittstelle zwischen Equipmentherstellern, externen Betreiber (Contract Manufacturer) und internen Fachbereichen (z.B. R&D, Einkauf, Quality, interne Produktion) und verantworten Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte speziell für Spritzgussteile und die finale Assemblierung unserer CGM-Produkte. Sie sind massgeblich am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Lieferantenökosystems beteiligt, pflegen aktiv ein externes Netzwerk aus Technologiepartnern und sind mit den relevanten industriellen Standards und Trends bestens vertraut. Zudem setzt Ihr Team Product Care Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam zur Proudukt-, Prozess und Kostenoptimierungen. Sie definieren effiziente Ablaufprozesse und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter, um zuverlässig und effizient Projektinhalte abzuliefern und die Fähigkeiten der Zulieferindustrie optimal zu nutzen.

Deine Aufgabe

• Teamführung und lokale Ansprechperson: Du leitest das Teams „CxM Finished Goods - Projects“ diziplinarisch und fachlich. Durch eine vorausschauende Bedarfsplanung formst du eine leistungsstarke Einheit, identifizierst und förderst Talente gezielt und stellst durch eine kontinuierliche Qualifizierung der Mitarbeitenden sicher, dass die Kompetenzen im Team stetig mit den technologischen Anforderungen wachsen. Als lokale Ansprechperson in Mannheim schaffst du ein vertrauensvolles und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld und pflegst ein Netzwerk mit den lokalen Schnittstellen.

• Exzellenz in der Projektabwicklung: Du verantwortest die professionelle Steuerung des gesamten Projektportfolios von CxM Finished Goods. Dabei stellst du eine transparente Planung und zuverlässige Einhaltung der Qualität der Inhalte und Timelines sicher. Durch effizientes Risiko- und Ressourcenmanagement stellst du die Kosteneffizienz üb

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a highly skilled expert responsible for solving complex business problems using advanced technologies within their specialized infrastructure area. In this role, you will technically lead challenging projects, make critical technical decisions, and architect resilient solutions across multiple domains. This position requires excellent problem-solving capabilities, strategic stakeholder management, and the ability to influence technical strategy, vendor relationships, and inter-organizational initiatives.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Highly skilled in a specific infrastructure solution area, adept at solving a variety of complex business problems through the practical and ingenious application of technologies. Contributes to and technically leads challenging projects requiring deep technical knowledge. Architect (acting as a solution architect), design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable first-time deployments in multiple solution areas. Accountable for decision-making in technical design, build, and testing.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises sound judgment, balanced with effective consultative engagement of key stakeholders, to resolve complex problems. Works on complex issues where analysis requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors, including inter-organizational impact. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions and maintains component standards. Evaluates promising solutions via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies across multiple areas, and provides internal escalation support for major incidents.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information and potential solutions to cross-functional teams and the business in non-technical terms. Represents the organization as a prime contact on initiatives and interacts with senior internal and external personnel. Uses depth of knowledge to influence IT Infrastructure vendor product evaluations and collaborates with multiple IT partners (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Solution Owners) to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Leads small-to-medium sized technical teams to achieve objectives in medium-sized initiatives (projects, lifecycle work, PoCs). Ensures solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that designs adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) policies and directions. Assists in planning technology projects, estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines for successful delivery.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex issues and variable factors spanning across different organizational boundaries. Coordinates multiple moving parts, dependencies, and inter-organizational impacts to deliver reliable infrastructure on medium-to-large initiatives.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies extensive technical expertise, providing depth and breadth across many areas while acting as a recognized expert in one specific area. Maintains in-depth knowledge in at least two technology areas (e.g., Platform, Compute and Storage, Network Management, ERP Technology Management, High Performance Computing, Datacenter Management, or Database Management). Demonstrates a detailed understanding of how IT infrastructure impacts respective Roche business processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience in technically leading challenging proje

jobs.title: QC Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea
Cluster: Access & Policy
Work Location: Hanam City, Gyeonggi-do
Worker Type: Regular
Your key responsibilities

• Advanced QC Testing: Perform QC testing for biological/chemical drug products utilizing various compendial and in-house validated methods (e.g., ID/Purity by CE, HPLC & UPLC, Content by UV/Vis, Cell-based Assays), ensuring strict adherence to SOPs and test protocols.

• QC Material & Cell Bank Management: Manage and maintain critical QC materials including QC/retention samples, critical reagents, and cell banking.

• Method Transfer (SME): Lead or support internal/external analytical method transfer activities, providing technical expertise on key analytical methods as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Investigation & Quality Management: Handling of deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, change controls, CAPA, and risk assessments, identifying root causes and implementing effective actions.

• Audit & QMR Leadership: Act as an internal or external GxP auditor/co-auditor and represent the QC function as a member of the local QMR (Quality Management Review) Meeting.

• Data Integrity & Review: Conduct technical review of QC raw data and analytical results, adhering strictly to the current GxP good documentation practices and data integrity requirements.

• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Execute and coordinate qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance of QC equipment ensuring intended use.

• Documentation & Regulatory Collaboration: Draft, review, and revise various QC SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and reports. Collaborate closely with RA for the preparation of specifications and test methods for drug product registration.

Who you are

• Basic qualification: Bachelor of Science majoring in biotechnology or related science.

• A minimum of 4 years experience in developing and executing quality control operation, and laboratory experience in pharmaceutical company.

• A strong background and in-depth knowledge in Instrumental analysis (HPLC, UV, CE, Spectrophotometer, Plate Reader, etc.) and cell-based assays.

• Good English written and communication skill.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Betriebsingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Lass uns gemeinsam an einer gesünderen Zukunft arbeiten. Bei Roche ist Dein Einsatz als Betriebsingenieur:in weit mehr als nur technische Instandhaltung; Du bist der Herzschlag unserer Anlagen am Standort Penzberg – einem der größten Biotech-Zentren Europas. Stell Dir vor, Deine Arbeit ist das Fundament, auf dem lebensverändernde medizinische Durchbrüche entstehen, weil Du für die technische Verfügbarkeit und Effizienz unserer hochkomplexen Systeme sorgst. In einem Umfeld, das technologische Innovation und menschliches Wohlergehen vereint, trägst Du direkt dazu bei, die Lebensqualität von Patient:innen weltweit zu verbessern.

Dein neues Team
Du wirst Teil der Abteilung Operational Solutions & Services (OSS R&D) . Wir sind ein Team aus Expert:innen, das mit Leidenschaft daran arbeitet, die Infrastruktur für unsere Spitzenforschung und Produktion auf Top-Niveau zu halten. In Penzberg triffst Du auf eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der Zusammenarbeit, in der Deine Ideen zur Optimierung von Gebäuden und Anlagen nicht nur gehört, sondern aktiv gefördert werden. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unser Standort ein Ort bleibt, an dem Innovation fließen kann.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Betriebsingenieur:in bist Du die treibende Kraft hinter der Zuverlässigkeit unserer prozess- und gebäudetechnischen Anlagen. Du agierst wie ein Dirigent, der die verschiedenen technischen Gewerke zu einem harmonischen und effizienten Gesamtbild zusammenführt.
Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Anlagenverfügbarkeit: Du stellst die Funktionstüchtigkeit und technische Verfügbarkeit sicher und steuerst effiziente Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen unter wirtschaftlichen Aspekten.

• Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Anlagenverantwortung für Gebäude sowie prozesstechnische Nebenanlagen und stellst deren Betrieb unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards (GMP, GEP) sicher.

• Projektleitung: Du planst und steuerst technische Maßnahmen sowie Projekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fachgerechten Realisierung nach dem Stand der Technik.

• Optimierung: Du verbesserst unsere Prozesse durch Zuverlässigkeitsstudien und Energiemonitoring, um einen nachhaltigen und kosteneffizienten Betrieb zu gewährleisten.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern und stellst eine lückenlose technische Dokumentation im SAP-System sicher.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst Technik als Enabler für Fortschritt und bringst die nötige Expertise mit, um komplexe Systeme am Laufen zu halten.

• Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Dipl.-Ing. FH / Bachelor / Master) im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Versorgungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Anlagenbau, in der Betreuung technischer Anlagen oder im Gebäudebetrieb mit.

• Know-how: Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in der Instandhaltung technischer Anlagen sowie Wissen in den Bereichen GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) und GEP (Good Engineering Practice).

• Skills: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit EDV-Systemen (idealerweise SAP) und verfügst über verfahrenstechnisches Verständnis sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

• Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit aus, komplexe Projekte sicher zu steuern.

Dauer: Diese Stelle ist unbefristet zu besetzen.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser

The Position
The Purpose

The Disease Level Partner (DLP) is at the centre of implementation of the strategy and objectives within our therapy areas balanced with truly focusing on patient outcomes. The DLP understands their business as if it were their own. Through deep understanding of patient pathways, our medicines across the portfolio and customer needs, the DLP aligns their objectives to both the disease area strategy and regional objectives across their local health economy. By effective utilisation of all available resources, they will be successful in securing appropriate access to key customers to deliver better outcomes for more patients, faster. As an expert of the region, the DLP will enjoy developing deep customer knowledge and generating insights that support our strategies and bring new customer partnerships to Roche.

Your Opportunity

• Have strong communication skills where you listen, partner and educate

• Gather actionable insights and elicit partnering opportunities that improve patient outcomes.

• Construct, present and agree with the Therapy Area Team and Disease Community Leads the objectives, strategy and goals for the region.

• Be fully accountable for the delivery of the goals within the Roche portfolio of products through effective engagement with customers, driving positive customer experience.

• Leverage support for products, ideas and projects across a local health economy and to contribute to the development and mobilisation of local and national brand advocates

• Maintain a detailed knowledge of national policy objectives and drivers and apply this to identify opportunities for growing the business at a National and Regional level in collaboration with the cross functional extended Roche Teams

• Use agile methodology (e.g. sprint methodology, MVP and iterative approach) to deliver disease level projects and non-disease level projects with internal/external expertise

• Ensure that all knowledge management and CRM systems are maintained in accordance with Roche standards, possess a thorough understanding of the provisions of the ABPI Code of Practice, remaining compliant with Roche SOPs and policies.

• Act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the center of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.

• Increasingly demonstrate a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) approach, to develop personal skills and capabilities, to positively support colleagues

Who you are

• University degree educated

• Multi-stakeholder engagement - Clinical and all stakeholders relevant to the commissioning of local services

• Specialised medicines sales and market access experience beneficial but not essential

• Advanced business acumen skills

• Superior prioritisation skills, with the capacity to manage multiple indications within a portfolio

• Competitive mindset

• Ability to demonstrate a growth mindset

• Valid driving licence

jobs.title: Cluster Section Lead - E2E Finance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts.
As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization.
You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business.
You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.

• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.

• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.

• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.

• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.

• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies.

Who you are

• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.

• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.

• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.

• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.

• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is initially for a fixed-term contract 12 months. The employment contract will be concluded by our vendor/third party for outsourcing services.

We have a fantastic and challenging opportunity to fully combine your recruiting and consulting skills to seek, attract, and bring in the very best talent into Roche. This is with a focus on supporting the demand for talent within our Roche EMEA region.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are hiring the best talent to meet our business ambitions. Make Your Mark. Improve Lives.
You will be part of the Roche EMEA Recruiting team, a group of highly skilled professionals in our Integrated Workforce Strategies organization.

The geographic focus will be Extended Eastern Europe (EEE) & CIS countries, however you will also be collaborating closely within the Region EMEA where we swarm our capacities to achieve our region’s goals as one team, and also within our global network.
This position reports to the Recruiting Lead EEE & CIS countries.

Your Impact

• Be a professional and consultative partner for our business leaders regarding all talent acquisition aspects

• Expertly drive end-to-end recruiting processes and provide customized talent acquisition strategies and solutions, including active candidate sourcing & pipelining, talent marketing, talent selection, candidate experience, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

• Manage the offer process with all necessary stakeholders (create an offer proposal following our Roche compensation and benefits framework and pay equity considerations, obtain approvals, extend offers, and negotiate with the candidate if required)

• Closely collaborate with the other People and Culture colleagues in-country, particularly the Business Partners to have insight about the coming business priorities, and the People Relations Partners to ensure a high confidentiality of recruitment-related topics

• May lead recruitment transformation projects across functions/countries

Who You Are

• University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, Economics, Marketing, Finance is preferred

• You are fluent in English but also having additional language skills are an advantage

• You are preferably working in the Life Science/Tech industry and have a high passion for People and Culture, particularly for Talent Acquisition with proven success as a recruiter or head-hunter

• You are well-versed in talent attraction, sourcing, and assessing across multiple geographies and varied levels of complexity and expert in applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, LinkedIn

• You excel at building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across all levels, both within our business and the People and Culture team, leveraging excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills to collaborate, negotiate, and innovate effectively

• You have excellent coaching and advising skills, and thus are a trusted partner to your business clients and enable them in their hiring decisions

• You can work in a multinational matrix organization with the dexterity to participate in or lead recruiting squads across regions or globally
Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of experience and skills.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Hinweise

• Aufgrund technischer Anforderungen in Workday ist Penzberg als Hauptstandort hinterlegt. Wir möchten jedoch ausdrücklich darauf hinweisen, dass beide Standorte – Mannheim und Penzberg – gleichermaßen berücksichtigt werden. Ziel ist es, die am besten geeignete Person für die Rolle zu finden, unabhängig vom Arbeitsort.

Wir in EFG
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg - wo wir die Zukunft aktiv gestalten.

Die neue Organisationsstruktur
In dieser Funktion bist Du Teil von Site Operations und gehörst dem Team Soft Services an. Die neue Organisationsstruktur findest Du auch auf der GSite .

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung und operative Steuerung unserer Fahrzeugflotte. Du treibst die Transformation hin zu nachhaltigen Mobilitätslösungen voran, stellst Kosteneffizienz sicher und agierst als Fachexperte für interne Stakeholder und externe Partner. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Strategische Flottenentwicklung: Du gestaltest die Zukunft unserer Mobilität, indem Du die Elektrifizierung der Flotte vorantreibst und innovative, nachhaltige Konzepte implementierst. Die dazu gehörende Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern und Partnern treibst du aktiv voran, um das Flottenmanagement zu optimieren.

• Lifecycle Management: Du steuerst eigenverantwortlich den gesamten Fahrzeugzyklus – von der strategischen Beschaffung über das Leasingmanagement bis zur Aussteuerung.

• Kosten- & Datenanalyse: Du triffst Daten-basierte Entscheidungen. Es bereitet Dir Freude, komplexe Daten (z.B. TCO, Nutzungsprofile) zu analysieren übersetzt diese in strategische Roadmaps und leitest Maßnahmen zur Kostenoptimierung ab.

• Provider Management: Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpartner für Leasinggeber und OEMs, verhandelst Rahmenbedingungen und pflegst ein belastbares Netzwerk in der E-Mobilitätsbranche.Veränderungen am Markt beobachtest du kontinuierlich und kannst Trends frühzeitig erkennen.

• Policy & Compliance: Du entwickelst die Car Policy (Dienstwagenrichtlinie) weiter, stellst die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben sicher und berätst interne Stakeholder in komplexen Fragestellungen.

• Projektleitung: Du leitest übergreifende Projekte zur Optimierung der Mobilitätsinfrastruktur und begeisterst Stakeholder für notwendige Veränderungsprozesse.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Hochschulstudium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) oder eine einschlägige kaufmännische/technische Ausbildung mit langjähriger spezialisierter Weiterbildung im Fuhrparkmanagement erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst umfangreiche einschlägige Berufserfahrung (Richtwert: 3–5 Jahre mit Master, 4–6 Jahre mit Bachelor) in der Logistik oder im Flottenmanagement mit.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Expertise im Management von Leasing- und Fuhrparkprozessen sowie idealerweise ein tiefes Netzwerk in der E-Mobilitätsbranche.

• Du zeichnest Dich durch ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis, strategisches Denken und eine echte Leidenschaft für nachhaltige Mobilität aus.

• Du sprichst

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Note
• A causa dei requisiti tecnici in Workday, Penzberg è una posizione principale. Tuttavia, vorremmo sottolineare che entrambe le località – Mannheim e Penzberg – sono prese in considerazione allo stesso modo. L'obiettivo è quello di trovare la persona più adatta per il ruolo, indipendentemente dal luogo di lavoro. Siamo in EFG Nel sito Management Mannheim/Penzberg, siamo ben 1300 specialisti per una vasta gamma di infrastrutture e servizi professionali che li forniscono per i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo una cooperazione senza soluzione di continuità tra aree e funzioni aziendali, offriamo soluzioni innovative e migliorare l'ambiente di lavoro dei dipendenti nelle sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg - dove formiamo attivamente il futuro. La nuova struttura organizzativa In questa funzione fai parte delle Operazioni del Sito e appartieni ai Servizi Morbidi del Team. La nuova struttura organizzativa si trova anche sul GSite . responsabilità Ti aspetti Nel ruolo Tu sei responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e della gestione operativa della nostra flotta. Stai guidando la trasformazione verso soluzioni di mobilità sostenibile, garantendo efficienza dei costi e fungendo da specialista per gli stakeholder interni e i partner esterni. Inoltre, si prenderanno il sopravvento delle seguenti attività eccitanti:
• Sviluppo strategico della flotta: modellate il futuro della nostra mobilità guidando l'elettrificazione della flotta e implementando concetti innovativi e sostenibili. Promuovi attivamente la comunicazione con gli stakeholder e i partner per ottimizzare la gestione della flotta.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita: Si controlla l'intero ciclo del veicolo in modo indipendente – dall'approvvigionamento strategico alla gestione del leasing alla tassazione.
• Analisi dei costi e dei dati: si incontrano decisioni basate sui dati. Ti dà il piacere di analizzare i dati complessi (ad esempio TCO, profili di utilizzo), lo traduce in roadmap strategiche e guida misure per l'ottimizzazione dei costi.
• Gestione del Fornitore: Lei agisce come un contatto centrale per il leasing e gli OEM, negozia le condizioni quadro e fornisce una rete resiliente nel settore e-mobility.
• Politica & Compliance: Sviluppi la Politica dell'Auto (Politica di Termine), garantisca il rispetto dei requisiti legali e consiglia gli stakeholder interni su questioni complesse.
• Gestione dei progetti: conduce progetti transfrontalieri per ottimizzare le infrastrutture di mobilità e ispirare le parti interessate ai processi di cambiamento necessari. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Hai completato con successo una laurea (ad esempio BWL, ingegneria economica) o una formazione commerciale/tecnica rilevante con molti anni di formazione specializzata nella gestione della flotta.
• Si porta una vasta esperienza professionale (Richtwert: 3–5 anni con Master, 4–6 anni con Bachelor) in logistica o gestione della flotta.
• Hai una vasta esperienza nella gestione dei processi di leasing e flotta e idealmente una rete profonda nel settore della mobilità elettronica.
• Sei caratterizzato da una chiara comprensione dei numeri, del pensiero strategico e da una vera passione per la mobilità sostenibile.
• Parli

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Remarques
• En raison des exigences techniques dans Workday, Penzberg est un emplacement principal. Cependant, nous tenons à souligner que les deux sites – Mannheim et Penzberg – sont pris en compte de manière égale. L'objectif est de trouver la personne la plus appropriée pour le rôle, quel que soit le lieu de travail. Nous en EFG Sur le site Management Mannheim/Penzberg, nous sommes bien 1'300 spécialistes pour une large gamme d'infrastructures et de services professionnels qui les fournissent pour les sites Mannheim et Penzberg. Dans un environnement dynamique, nous promouvons une coopération transparente entre les secteurs d'activité et les fonctions, proposons des solutions innovantes et améliorons l'environnement de travail des employés des lieux de Mannheim et de Penzberg, où nous façonnons activement l'avenir. La nouvelle structure organisationnelle Dans cette fonction, vous faites partie des Opérations du Site et appartenez à Team Soft Services. La nouvelle structure organisationnelle se trouve également sur le site GSite . Responsabilités Vous vous attendez Dans le rôle Vous êtes responsable du développement stratégique et de la gestion opérationnelle de notre flotte. Vous conduisez la transformation vers des solutions de mobilité durables, assurant une rentabilité et agissant comme un spécialiste pour les acteurs internes et les partenaires externes. De plus, vous assumerez les tâches passionnantes suivantes :
• Développement stratégique de la flotte: Vous façonnez l'avenir de notre mobilité en conduisant l'électrification de la flotte et en mettant en œuvre des concepts innovants et durables. Vous encouragez activement la communication avec les intervenants et les partenaires afin d'optimiser la gestion de la flotte.
• Gestion du cycle de vie: Vous contrôlez indépendamment l'ensemble du cycle du véhicule – de l'approvisionnement stratégique à la gestion de la location à la fiscalité.
• Analyse des coûts et des données : Vous répondez aux décisions fondées sur les données. Il vous donne le plaisir d'analyser des données complexes (p. ex. TCO, profils d'utilisation), de les traduire en feuilles de route stratégiques et de guider les mesures d'optimisation des coûts.
• Gestion des fournisseurs: Vous agissez comme un contact central pour le leasing et les OEM, négociez les conditions-cadres et fournissez un réseau résilient dans l'industrie de la mobilité électronique.
• Politique et conformité : Vous élaborez la Politique sur les voitures (Politique sur les conditions), vous assurez la conformité aux exigences légales et vous conseillez les intervenants internes sur des questions complexes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.
In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH Risk Management & SHE Compliance, explizit des Teams Environmental Safety. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und verwalten daher nicht nur, sondern gestalten aktiv eine zukunftsorientierte umweltrechtliche Compliance. Werde jetzt Teil eines Teams werden, dass sich wie folgt auszeichnet:

• Zwei Standorte, ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.

• Gesetzliche Fachexpertise: Wir übernehmen die zentralen Rollen der gesetzlichen Betriebsbeauftragten für Umweltschutz und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Innovationen & Assets stets auf einem rechtssicheren Fundament stehen.

• Vom Berater zum Gestalter: Wir verstehen uns nicht als „Bedenkenträger“, sondern als lösungsorientierte Gestalter. Wir handeln business-orientiert und unterstützen die operativen Einheiten dabei, Nachhaltigkeit und Effizienz in Einklang zu bringen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung und die operativen Einheiten bei der Sicherstellung der technischen Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit. Mit Deiner Expertise im Boden- und Gewässerschutz agierst Du am Standort Mannheim als zentrale Instanz für die Überwachung und fachliche Beratung zur Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen. Du stellst sicher, dass die Betreiberverantwortung durch fundierte Expertise und proaktive Begutachtung gestärkt wird, und übernimmst darüber hinaus folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du überprüfst sicherheitstechnische Konzepte und stellst sicher, dass diese den gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen im Bereich Gewässerschutz entsprechen.

• Du übernimmst die fachliche Überprüfung und auditierst die Umsetzung von Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorgaben für Gewässer- und Bodenschutz, um die Einhaltung der Standards nachhaltig zu sichern.

• Durch die Bestellung zum Gewässerschutzbeauftragten und die fachliche Beratung der Verantwortlichen minimierst du proaktiv Risiken und sicherst die Compliance ab.

• Bei umweltrelevanten Vorfällen führst du fundierte Ursachenanalysen durch und verantwortest das Reporting gemäß gesetzlichen und Roche-internen Standards in Deinem Fachgebiet. Bei Bedarf unterstützt du intern im Rahmen der Gefahrenabwehr und im Notfallmanagement.

• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für die Fachbereiche, indem du Du komplexe Vorschriften wie das WHG oder die AwSV analysierst und in klare, praxisnahe Handlungsanweisungen für unsere Business Units übersetzt.

• Du agierst als Schnittstelle zu Genehmigungs- und Aufsichtsbehörden in Deinem Fachgebiet und begleitest die Fachbereiche proaktiv bei externen Audits und Inspektionen.

• Du beteiligst dich aktiv in internen (z.B. Communities of Practice) und externen (z.B. VCI) Gremien und und trägst mit Deinem Fachwissen zu pragmatischen und wirtschaftlichen Lösungsfindungen bei.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
