descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position SW Technical Lead - Datenplattformen Als Custom Software Developer fungieren Sie als strategischer Führer und Innovator. Sie werden Aufgaben für andere definieren, Großinitiativen und Mentorkollegen zur Förderung des Wachstums antreiben. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Bereitstellung globaler Unterstützung für technische Initiativen, das Teilen von Wissen international und die Gestaltung der technischen Richtung der Organisation. Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen, setzen hohe Standards für die Codequalität und Sicherheit, und entfernen Hindernisse für Teams, kontinuierlich die Produktivität der Entwickler und den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Softwareentwicklung. Die Gelegenheit:
• Anwendungsbereich: Strategische technische Beratung bereitstellen und die Richtung für die digitale Produktentwicklung in Abstimmung mit Geschäftszielen und Prioritäten festlegen.
• Architektonische Evolution: Führen Sie den strategischen Übergang von einem modularen Monolith zu Mikroservices, um sicherzustellen, dass Domaingrenzen eingehalten werden und die Leistung bleibt hoch. Nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Entwicklung neuer Komponenten und Ideen, während Sie mit einem multidisziplinären Team zusammenarbeiten, um End-to-End-Erfahrungen an die Endbenutzer zu liefern.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Aufgaben für andere definieren und auf der Ebene der Produkt- oder Produktlinie erfolgreiche Initiativen mit mittlerer bis großer (M/L) vorantreiben. Fordern Sie andere auf wachstumssteigernde Weise heraus, hebeln Sie Teamstärken effektiv und fungieren als Trainer und/oder führen Sie für andere.
• Stakeholder Management: Besteht ein starkes Verständnis der Stakeholder-Ökosysteme und deren Bedürfnisse, die sich in Verhandlungen und Partnerschaften für gegenseitige Vorteile auszeichnen. Richten Sie Richtung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele und Ziele.
• Impact/Strategy: Globale Unterstützung für innovative und technologische Initiativen. Sprechen Sie an lokalen/internationalen Veranstaltungen und Wissensaustauschinitiativen und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an RDT Data Domain/Site-bezogenen Aktivitäten.
• Komplexität/ (Produktgröße): Betrieb auf der Produkt-/Domain-/Site-Ebene.
• Business/Technische Fähigkeit: Aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des technischen Wissens im Feld durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen und Mentorship (z.B. als Leistungsinhaber). Inspirieren Sie Innovation, treiben Sie innovative Lösungen im Einklang mit Technologietrends und setzen Sie auf die Entwicklung neuer Ansätze für bestehende Probleme. Wer du bist:
• 10+ Jahre bewährte Erfahrung, die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit vorantreibt, um organisatorische technische Probleme zu lösen und unterschiedliche technische Anstrengungen zu gemeinsamen Zielen auszurichten.
• Ein tiefes Verständnis der Datenverarbeitungsprinzipien und des Bedarfs an AI-Readiness-Daten. Erfahrung in Gebäudelösungen für Datenexperten halten (z.B. Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners und Digital Asset Management).
• Erwarten Sie tiefes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen und die Fähigkeit, geeignete Technologien zur Lösung komplexer Probleme auszuwählen und anzuwenden.
• Erhalten Sie Kenntnisse in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-getriebene Architektur oder ähnliche Technologien.
• Demonstrieren Sie ein starkes Verständnis von Software-Entwicklungs-Lebenszyklus-Praktiken, einschließlich Leistungsabstimmung und Skalierbarkeit.
• Vermitteln Sie hervorragende Kenntnisse über marktübliche Software-Entwicklungstools, um die Einführung in den aktuellen Roche-Toolset vorzuschlagen, die Entwicklerproduktivität und Erfahrung Roche-weit kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
• Kompetenz in der Cybersicherheit Best Practices anwenden, um sicherzustellen, dass Softwarelösungen Sicherheitsstandards in Abstimmung mit einem geeigneten Roche-Experten erfüllen

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team
Als Applikationsspezialist (m/w/d) im Außendienst in der Region Münster / Bielefeld / Dortmund wirst Du Teil von Roche Diagnostics Deutschland, einem weltweit führenden Unternehmen in den Bereichen Pharma und Diagnostik. Wir entwickeln und vertreiben hochmoderne diagnostische Systeme für Labore und Kliniken. Deine Aufgabe ist es, mit Leidenschaft und Know-how vor Ort dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig laufen, unsere Kund:innen unterstützt werden und exzellenten Service erleben.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

Als Applikationsspezialist (m/w/d) im Außendienst bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:

• Umfassende Betreuung und Schulung der Kunden:innen an Roche-Systemlinien (Pathologie und/oder molekulare Diagnostik/PCR) mit den Schwerpunkten Applikation, Bedienung und Nachbetreuung.

• Sicherstellung der Systemverfügbarkeit und der Ergebnisqualität beim Kunden.

• Eigenverantwortliche Analyse und Behebung von Fehlern auf Applikationsebene in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Expert:innen.

• Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen (vor Ort und telefonisch) mit Fokus auf die optimale Lösungsfindung.

• Anwendungstechnische Beratung der Kunden:innen zur optimalen Nutzung der Systeme.

• Aktive Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams und der regionalen Systemleitung mit Fach- und Anwendungswissen.

• Durchführung von Systeminstallationen, Inbetriebnahmen und Software-Modifikationen ausgewählter Systeme sowie Dokumentation der Einsätze im CRM-System.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTA/BTA mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss).

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im diagnostischen Labor oder als Applikationsspezialist:in, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Pathologie und/oder molekulare Diagnostik (PCR).

• Gute Applikations- und Qualitätssicherungskenntnisse diagnostischer Analysesysteme sowie vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Humandiagnostik.

• IT-Grundwissen (Netzwerke) und sicherer Umgang mit MS Office/Google Suite; idealerweise CRM-Erfahrung.

• Hohe Lösungsfindungskompetenz, methodische Herangehensweise bei kniffligen Problemen und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.

• Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke sowie eine ergebnisorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise.

• Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (ca. B1/B2-Niveau), um technische Dokumentationen zu verstehen und dich im Team auszutauschen.

• Für die optimale Betreuung der Region besitzt du einen gültigen Führerschein und wohnst idealerweise in der Region Münster / Bielefeld / Dortmund und bringst eine hohe Reisebereitschaft mit, um unsere Kunden:innen in der Region zu betreuen.

Deine Bewerbung

jobs.title: Team Lead Reagents Operations (QC Lab)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity.

The Team Lead QC Reagents role at the Roche Rotkreuz S&C (Sensor & Cartridge Manufacturing) site is a central leadership position responsible for the quality control of reagents, ensuring product quality and compliance with regulatory requirements. This includes assuming technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production, and supporting all production processes to drive improvement in collaboration with the respective Team Leaders (Peers)

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 8 specialists, fostering talent and managing the team’s training matrix and status using adult learning methods.

• Take responsibility for all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) roles within the team, implementing risk reduction measures and ensuring full compliance with GMP, GSP, and mQMS.

• Translate S&C Operations Strategy into measurable team objectives and KPIs, while optimizing manufacturing and personnel costs through performance analysis.

• Ensure supply according to long-term resource planning (12 months) and optimize the production plan in collaboration with the supply chain.

• Assume technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production and lead the Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) to increase quality and efficiency standards.

• Act as the central interface to departments like Supply Chain, R&D, and MSAT to ensure cross-functional order coordination and planning optimization.

• Monitor Quality-KPIs such as Right-First-Time (RFT) and Statistical-Process-Control (SPC), and contribute to department-wide improvements as a member of the S&C Manufacturing Rotkreuz Leadership Team.

Who You Are

• You hold a higher natural science education (BSc, MSc, PhD), ideally as a Chemist, Biochemist, Process Engineer, or Materials Scientist.

• You have proven experience in employee leadership with an empathetic style and a genuine passion for coaching and empowering a diverse team in a production environment.

• You possess profound experience with GMP in highly regulated environments, a strong quality awareness, and a very good command of written and spoken German and English.

• You have strong analytical thinking skills, an understanding of complex contexts, and an interest in Shopfloor Management and data-based decision-making.

• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, high self-reflection, and the ability to represent the department’s interests effectively.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application documents (cover letter, CV, references, diplomas, etc.).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. The Team Lead QC Reagents role at the Roche Rotkreuz S&C (Sensor & Cartridge Manufacturing) site is a central leadership position responsible for the quality control of reagents, ensuring product quality and compliance with regulatory requirements. This includes assuming technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production, and supporting all production processes to drive improvement in collaboration with the respective Team Leaders (Peers) The Opportunity
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 8 specialists, fostering talent and managing the team’s training matrix and status using adult learning methods.
• Take responsibility for all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) roles within the team, implementing risk reduction measures and ensuring full compliance with GMP, GSP, and mQMS.
• Translate S&C Operations Strategy into measurable team objectives and KPIs, while optimizing manufacturing and personnel costs through performance analysis.
• Ensure supply according to long-term resource planning (12 months) and optimize the production plan in collaboration with the supply chain.
• Assume technical responsibility for compounding in reagent production and lead the Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) to increase quality and efficiency standards.
• Act as the central interface to departments like Supply Chain, R&D, and MSAT to ensure cross-functional order coordination and planning optimization.
• Monitor Quality-KPIs such as Right-First-Time (RFT) and Statistical-Process-Control (SPC), and contribute to department-wide improvements as a member of the S&C Manufacturing Rotkreuz Leadership Team. Who You Are
• You hold a higher natural science education (BSc, MSc, PhD), ideally as a Chemist, Biochemist, Process Engineer, or Materials Scientist.
• You have proven experience in employee leadership with an empathetic style and a genuine passion for coaching and empowering a diverse team in a production environment.
• You possess profound experience with GMP in highly regulated environments, a strong quality awareness, and a very good command of written and spoken German and English.
• You have strong analytical thinking skills, an understanding of complex contexts, and an interest in Shopfloor Management and data-based decision-making.
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, high self-reflection, and the ability to represent the department’s interests effectively. Have we sparked your interest? jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location

• Pune, India

• Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia

Job description

• As a Senior Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex and ambiguous business problems. Applying a deep understanding of the Manufacturing Business domain and IT infrastructure, you will translate site-specific requirements into strategic implementation plans, ensuring solutions are fit-for-purpose and meet site-specific needs for operational efficiency.

• In this role, you will be accountable for active partnering, managing and prioritizing infrastructure demand, and coordinating the end-to-end delivery of new product implementations and complex requests. You will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, resolving conflicts, and contributing significantly to solution design.

Description of the area
Within RDT Pharma Technical Operations and specifically in the context of Manufacturing Technologies, this IT Business Analyst for Infrastructure ensures the seamless fit of our manufacturing business solutions into the Roche ecosystem. Maximizing manufacturing ROI requires stable, robust, and high-performance infrastructure solutions.

Our scope includes:

• All Pharma and DIA Manufacturing Sites

• RDT Standard technologies to be adopted as core solutions for the infrastructure

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability / Problem Solving : Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size) : Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of the Manufacturing Business domain and IT infrastructure technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor or advanced degree

• 5+ years of Business Analysis / Consultancy experience, with at least 3&

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Immerse yourself in the fascinating everyday working life at Roche Diagnostics surrounded by beautiful mountains, not far from the scenic Lake Zug and yet close to the cities of Zug, Zurich and Lucerne. Here, where we have been rooted for over 50 years, we develop and produce diagnostic solutions and help to find answers to health questions. The Rotkreuz site, where a wide variety of disciplines work hand in hand, is a meeting place for over 2,700 talented employees from 70 different nations. Our campus invites people to work together, be creative and realise their full potential. We believe that a positive work environment, employee satisfaction, inclusion and sustainability are key to growing together and improving the lives of patients around the world. Welcome to Roche in Rotkreuz.
Embark on a transformative learning experience with Roche Diagnostics in Rotkreuz. Designed to nurture emerging talent, this program offers a dynamic and immersive opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the field of diagnostics, fostering personal and professional growth.
The Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team within Sensor and Cartridge Operations ensures the efficient and high-quality production of electrochemical sensors and cartridges, reagents and fluid packs by bridging the gap between product development and full-scale manufacturing.

The Opportunity

• You transform raw manufacturing data into actionable intelligence to ensure high-quality product consumable assemblies.

• Your role involves evaluating and deploying a microscopy-based optical stage to inspect and analyze product components.

• You apply Machine Learning algorithms for automated feature extraction and classification to establish accept/reject criteria before final assembly.

• Data analysis guides your work as you leverage classical statistics and predictive modeling to correlate imaging features with process parameters and quality.

• Collaboration and presentation are key as you present analytical findings to multidisciplinary teams (Operations, R&D) to drive data-backed mitigations for in-field quality issues.

• Your work focuses on a critical, high-priority product care project, solving real-life issues that occur at the customer site to bring solutions to the market.

• The position offers a supportive culture with professional growth, mentorship, and a modern work-life balance including on-site perks and work-from-home options.

Who You Are

• You have completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within the last 12 months, or are currently enrolled in a Master’s program, specializing in Biomedical, Mechanical, or Process Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.

• You are a tech-enthusiast who loves to see code come to life in physical products and has a genuine interest in how cutting-edge technology meets modern manufacturing

• You possess a strong analytical and troubleshooter mindset, acting as an independent worker who is also a dedicated team player.

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Coimbatore)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Coimbatore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Coimbatore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each othe

jobs.title: Business Developer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Business Developer , serás responsable de desarrollar e implementar nuevos negocios, mercados y estrategias comerciales en colaboración con el Infectious Diseases Disease Management Squad para Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia . En este rol, actuarás como el nexo clave con el mercado, capturando oportunidades estratégicas con agilidad para aportar valor a los clientes, impulsar el portafolio de Roche y elevar el estándar de cuidado de los pacientes .

The Opportunity

• Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con la estrategia del Disease Management Squad .

• Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios, brindando soporte científico y técnico integral a los clientes .

• Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno .

• Co-crear y ejecutar los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración estrecha con los Key Account Managers (KAMs) y los clientes .

• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas y efectivas con clientes y stakeholders clave del sector científico y técnico para influir en la estrategia de negocio .

• Colaborar con el Healthcare Manager y el equipo multidisciplinar para integrar los aportes del mercado en la estrategia general de la enfermedad .

• Actuar como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto para los clientes dentro de tu área de especialidad .

Who you are

• Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica o carreras afines.

• Experiencia comercial dentro de la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica es deseable.

• Conocimientos técnicos críticos y trayectoria demostrable en biología molecular.

• Dominio del idioma inglés para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global y corporativo .

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, manejo de objeciones y una fuerte capacidad para influir en múltiples stakeholders .

• Mentalidad orientada al pensamiento sistémico, con alta capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas de negocio .

• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para viajar de forma frecuente a través de la red de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia .

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Business Developer , serás responsable de desarrollar e implementar nuevos negocios, mercados y estrategias comerciales en colaboración con el Infectious Diseases Disease Management Squad para Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia . En este rol, actuarás como el nexo clave con el mercado, capturando oportunidades estratégicas con agilidad para aportar valor a los clientes, impulsar el portafolio de Roche y elevar el estándar de cuidado de los pacientes . The Opportunity
• Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con la estrategia del Disease Management Squad .
• Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios, brindando soporte científico y técnico integral a los clientes .
• Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno .
• Co-crear y ejecutar los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración estrecha con los Key Account Managers (KAMs) y los clientes .
• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas y efectivas con clientes y stakeholders clave del sector científico y técnico para influir en la estrategia de negocio .
• Colaborar con el Healthcare Manager y el equipo multidisciplinar para integrar los aportes del mercado en la estrategia general de la enfermedad .
• Actuar como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto para los clientes dentro de tu área de especialidad . Who you are
• Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica o carreras afines.
• Experiencia comercial dentro de la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica es deseable.
• Conocimientos técnicos críticos y trayectoria demostrable en biología molecular.
• Dominio del idioma inglés para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global y corporativo .
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, manejo de objeciones y una fuerte capacidad para influir en múltiples stakeholders .
• Mentalidad orientada al pensamiento sistémico, con alta capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas de negocio .
• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para viajar de forma frecuente a través de la red de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia . Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Network Analyst - Global Supply Chain Planning

titleByLocale.it: Network Analista - Global Supply Chain Planning
titleByLocale.en: Network Analyst - Global Supply Chain Planning
titleByLocale.fr: Network Analyste - Global Chaîne d'approvisionnement Planning

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, our mission is clear: we deliver answers to patients. We ensure our complex portfolio of life-saving diagnostic products is delivered to customers efficiently, on time, and complete. Achieving this requires a world-class, resilient global supply chain.

As a Network Analyst , you won't just maintain a system—you will be the architect of its optimization. This is a unique, high-impact fixed-term opportunity running through December 2028 , designed for a forward-thinking supply chain professional looking to lead massive digital transformations on a global stage.

The Opportunity
Operating within our global 3-hub matrix network, you will drive the continuous evolution of a flexible and resilient end-to-end supply chain. You will wear two critical hats: serving as the Technical Expert managing complex, cloud-based network optimizers, and acting as the Agile Product Owner for a cross-functional data product team.
If you want to spend the next few years working with absolute state-of-the-art technology to build a resume-defining portfolio, this is your sandbox.

Your Impact

• Network Optimization: Drive the end-to-end configuration of our multi-hub global network. You’ll manage and fine-tune complex, parameter-heavy cloud solvers (OMP) to make data-driven decisions on shipping routes, transport modes, replenishment quantities, and global safety stocks.

• Agile Product Ownership: Lead a global, cross-functional data product team as Product Owner. Utilizing agile methodologies and Data Mesh principles, you will design and deliver complex analytics solutions that provide real value to the business.

• Data Automation & Governance: Build an unshakeable master data foundation. You will pioneer automation solutions across systems, driving data quality and implementing robust data governance frameworks.

• Technological Innovation: Stay at the absolute cutting edge. You will integrate mathematical and heuristic optimization logics, advanced solvers, and modern data tech into our daily operations.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a core consultant and Subject Matter Expert (SME). You will bridge the gap between technical data teams and senior leadership, leading global initiatives that align with Roche’s strategic priorities.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Operations Research, or a related field.

• You bring 3+ years of experience in supply chain planning, network optimization, or data analytics with a distinct international focus.

• You possess strong, data-driven decision-making capabilities and thrive when turning complex, chaotic data into elegant supply chain solutions.

Preferred Technical Toolkit

• Planning Suites: Deep proficiency with integrated planning suites like OMP (including its data and optimization modules) and a strong working knowledge of SAP ERP.

• Data Quality & Automation: Experience with master data automation tools (e.g., OMP Data Genie, ADM rules) and data quality platforms like Ataccama.

• Analytics & ETL: Solid know-how in data preparation, ETL, and visualization using platforms like Snowflake, Alteryx, and Tableau, alongside SAP analytics environments (SAC, BoA, BW).

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis, IN is $78,900 - $146,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location,

Moreover, Roche is one of the highest spender on research and development (R&D) among global pharmaceuticals, spending more than 20% of revenue. This substantial investment has resulted in products that have advanced the understanding of disease and transformed the practice of medicine.

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a deep-dive investigator: You will analyze cases, log files and source code to determine the root cause or causal factor of a software malfunction/issue. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

Main tasks :

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You will consult with senior technical experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed

• You are the critical interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Requirements:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential

• Work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Automatio

Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità . Con oltre 100 iniziative di tecnologia digitale e dati già in corso, Roche sta lavorando con aziende innovative nei campi dei dati, analisi e software per trasformare la fornitura di assistenza sanitaria attraverso soluzioni digitali. In qualità di Ingegnere del Software nella Qualità del Mercato Postale (PMQ), sarete in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle Soluzioni Digitali di Roche, la gestione delle lamentele relative ai Sistemi Informativi Ospedalieri/Laboratori (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware, comunicazione dei dati, app e algoritmi. Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche sind wir leidenschaftlich daran, das Leben der Patienten zu transformieren, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Tat - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unerklärlicher Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun das heute, um morgen besser zu werden. Unser Erfolg basiert auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Mit mehr als 100 digitalen Technologie- und Dateninitiativen arbeitet Roche mit innovativen Unternehmen in den Daten-, Analyse- und Softwarebereichen zusammen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung durch digitale Lösungen zu transformieren. Darüber hinaus ist Roche einer der höchsten Ausgaben für Forschung und Entwicklung (FuE) unter globalen Arzneimitteln, die mehr als 20 % des Umsatzes ausmachen. Diese beträchtliche Investition hat zu Produkten geführt, die das Verständnis der Krankheit vorangebracht haben und die Praxis der Medizin transformiert haben. Als Software-Ingenieur in Post Market Quality (PMQ) sind Sie an der Spitze der Sicherstellung der Qualität und Leistung von Roche’s Digital Solutions, Behandlung von Beschwerden im Zusammenhang mit Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medizinische Datennetze, Middleware-Lösungen, Datenkommunikation, Apps und Algorithmen. Mit dem Digital Solutions Chapter arbeiten Sie in einem hochtransversalen Software-Umfeld und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich mit modernsten Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen sowohl für On-Premise als auch für Cloud-basierte Software zu engagieren. Ihre Kernaufgabe wird es sein, als tiefgreifender Ermittler zu fungieren: Sie analysieren Fälle, Log-Dateien und Quellcode, um die Ursache oder den Kausalfaktor einer Software-Fehler/Problem zu bestimmen. Während Ihr Fokus auf der Wurzelursanalyse liegt, werden Sie nicht für die letzten Fehlerbehebungen verantwortlich sein. Diese Rolle ist in einer Agile-Umgebung festgelegt, in der Ihre innovativen Ideen und Vorschläge hoch geschätzt werden und direkt zu einem Team beitragen, das sich auf eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert.
• Mansioni principali - Sie sind verantwortlich für die Behandlung von komplexen medizinischen Softwarebeschwerden, Sicherheitsfragen und Produktanfragen für Softwareprodukte (auf Prämisse, Cloud, Mobile, Apps,...). - Sie verwalten den gesamten Fall-Lebenszyklus, von der ersten Erstellung und Klassifizierung bis zur eingehenden Untersuchung, Zusammenarbeit mit dem fehlerbefreienden Team vor Ort, Dokumentation und abschließende Auflösung. Für Fälle, die nicht direkt gelöst werden können, nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Eskalation an der Entwicklungsabteilung. - Sie fungieren als technischer Experte für Fallauflösung, indem Sie Ihre Fähigkeit verwenden, Quellcode zu lesen und zu verstehen, um die Ursache/Kausalfaktor von Softwarestörungen zu identifizieren. Sie werden bei Bedarf mit hochrangigen technischen Experten zu technischen und verfahrensbezogenen Aspekten beraten. - Sie sind die kritische Schnittstelle zu Affiliates und Country Organizations. Sie werden für die rechtzeitige Kommunikation wesentlicher qualitätsbezogener Informationen und unterstützende Initiativen verantwortlich sein, die unsere regionalen Partnerschaften verbessern. - Sie nutzen Ihre Automatisierungs- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten, um den Fallbearbeitungsprozess zu verbessern und Produktleistungsdaten proaktiv zu überwachen Voraussetzungen - Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder ein IT-bezogenes Feld. - Starke IT-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere die Fähigkeit, Quellcode verschiedener Programmiersprachen zu lesen und zu debuggen, um die Hauptursache gemeldeter Probleme zu verstehen - Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) sind essentiell - Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Softwaretechnik oder IT-Unterstützung sind erwünscht - Automatisierung

Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients, et nous sommes audacieux tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler tous les jours. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès à des innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Notre succès repose sur l'innovation, la curiosité et la diversité. Avec plus de 100 initiatives de technologie numérique et de données déjà en cours, Roche travaille avec des entreprises innovantes dans les domaines des données, de l'analyse et des logiciels pour transformer la prestation des soins de santé par des solutions numériques. De plus, Roche est l'un des plus grands investisseurs en recherche et développement (R-D) parmi les produits pharmaceutiques mondiaux, dépensant plus de 20 % des revenus. Cet investissement important a permis d'obtenir des produits qui ont permis de mieux comprendre la maladie et transformé la pratique de la médecine. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel en qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous serez à l'avant-garde de la qualité et des performances des solutions numériques de Roches, du traitement des plaintes liées aux systèmes d'information hospitaliers/laboratoires (HIS/LIS), aux réseaux de données médicales, aux solutions intermédiaires, à la communication de données, aux applications et aux algorithmes. Rejoindre le chapitre Solutions numériques signifie travailler dans un environnement logiciel hautement transversal, vous donnant la possibilité de vous engager avec des technologies de pointe et divers langages de programmation pour les logiciels sur site et cloud.
• Votre mission principale sera d'agir en tant qu'enquêteur en profondeur : Vous analyserez les cas, les fichiers log et le code source pour déterminer la cause fondamentale ou le facteur causal d'un dysfonctionnement ou problème logiciel. Bien que votre attention soit sur l'analyse de la cause racine, vous ne serez pas responsable de la correction finale du bug. Ce rôle est établi dans un environnement agile où vos idées et propositions innovantes sont très appréciées, contribuant directement à une équipe axée sur l'amélioration continue. Autres - Vous êtes responsable du traitement des plaintes complexes concernant les logiciels médicaux, des problèmes de sécurité et des demandes de renseignements sur les produits logiciels (sur place, cloud, mobile, applications,...). - Vous gérerez tout le cycle de vie de l'affaire, de la création et de la classification initiales à l'enquête approfondie, la collaboration avec l'équipe de dépannage sur place, la documentation et la résolution finale. Pour les cas qui ne peuvent être résolus directement, vous prenez en main l'escalade vers le département du développement. - Vous agissez comme un expert technique pour la résolution de cas, en utilisant votre capacité à lire et comprendre le code source pour identifier la cause racine / facteur causal de dysfonctionnements logiciels. Vous consulterez des experts techniques de haut niveau sur les aspects techniques et liés aux processus au besoin. - Vous êtes l'interface critique avec les affiliés et les organisations de pays. Vous serez responsable de la communication en temps opportun de l'information essentielle liée à la qualité et des initiatives de soutien qui améliorent nos partenariats régionaux. - Vous utilisez vos compétences d'automatisation et d'analyse de données pour améliorer le processus de traitement des cas et surveiller de manière proactive les données de performance des produits
• Requisiti - Diplôme en informatique ou en informatique. - Fortes compétences en TI, en particulier la capacité de lire et de déboguer le code source des différents langages de programmation pour comprendre la cause profonde des problèmes signalés - De solides compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé) sont essentielles - Une expérience de travail dans le domaine de l'ingénierie logicielle ou des fonctions de support informatique est souhaitée - Automatisation

jobs.title: Country Study Start-Up Team Leader (cSTL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a UK Country Study Start-Up Team Leader, you will drive the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials. You will play a key role in delivering clinical trials to patients by enabling innovative trial execution and ensuring a seamless experience for investigators and clinical site staff in the UK

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for leading the country's study start-up strategy, focusing on efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external partners. Your work will have a direct impact on the speed and quality of our clinical trials. This role is internally known as the Country Study Start-Up Team Leader (cSTL).

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Overseeing start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.

• Serve as a key member of the Country Leadership Team, contributing actionable insights and leadership influence to advance clinical study start-up environments.

• Build and maintain collaborative relationships with regional and global counterparts to standardise systems, improve study timelines, and implement innovations across study processes.

• Leading the development and oversight of clinical trial submissions and amendments, managing packages, and ensuring document maintenance.

• Identifying and driving opportunities for process automation, standardisation, and innovation at the country and site level.

• Providing strategic oversight for all aspects of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and negotiating contracts.

• Engaging with government and institutional bodies, such as Ethics Boards and Health Authorities, to align on and influence evolving clinical trial policies and practices.

• Driving department-wide engagement by fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and high performance while championing inclusion and belonging. Inspire, motivate, and develop talent within the team, ensuring a focus on individual growth and leadership development to build a strong, elevated talent pipeline aligned with organisational objectives.

• Leading by example in demonstrating and championing inclusive behaviours in your team, PDG, PD, and the Roche Enterprise. Provide opportunities for growth and development for all team members and address any barriers that may exist.

• People management-related administration (e.g. Workday People & Culture Management system tasks) and contact for employment-related matters.

You will also provide coaching, support, and leadership to a team of direct reports. You will champion inclusive behaviours and provide opportunities for growth and development for all team members.

Who you are

You are an experienced professional with a demonstrated background in clinical trial start-up, regulatory submissions, and cross-functional collaboration. You possess a strong understanding of ICH-GCP, MHRA CTA, and the UK regulatory environment.

The ideal candidate will also have:

• You bring proven experience and hold a degree in life sciences (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) or equivalent; a postgraduate or master’s degree is highly desirable.

• You have extensive experience in clinical trial start-up processes, including regulatory submissions, site activations, and amendments.

• Proven leadership or line management experience, with a track record of coaching, motivating, and driving teams toward shared goals.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in clinical systems such

jobs.title: Intern - Support to SHE Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
The SHE Intern will support the Safety, Health, Environment, and Security team in the continuous improvement of the SHE management system. This role provides hands-on SHE documentation, contributing to a strong safety culture across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

• Support with critical thinking the identification of occupational health and safety risks.

• Assist in the development, review, and documentation of Critical Tasks procedures, safe work instructions and chemical management

• Collaborate in the development of SHE related documentation.

• Assist in chemical documentation processes, including inventories, labeling SGA, safety data sheets (SDS), and storage compliance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote SHE awareness and best practices.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled student in Occupational Safety Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.

• Ability to critically identify, analyze, and anticipate occupational safety hazards and risks.

• Understanding of critical tasks, safe work procedures and chemical management.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively.

• Intermediate level of Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

Preferred Skills

• Basic knowledge of SHE standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 45001, ISO 14001, NFPA).

• Experience with documentation control or process mapping

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Learning Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team:

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice, and its conditions can be tailored for employees according to needs (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share y

jobs.description:
The Position
Who We Are

Global Product Strategy (GPS) drives Roche’s strategy and portfolio of products - from research and development through to patients. As a member of GPS, you will be part of a truly international group that collaborates with functions and affiliates worldwide, across the Roche enterprise, to shape the future of medicine.
As the Global Therapeutic Area Head (TAH), Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases, you will lead large-scale, multidisciplinary teams, composed of direct and indirect reports, with considerable influence on the company’s overall strategic, financial and operational performance. You will directly lead a team of senior leaders who are accountable for coordinating and managing the early pipeline and the lifecycle of late-stage and on-market products; providing global, cross-functional leadership for all development, technical, and commercial activities for all molecules/products across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases.
You will be a standing member of the GPS Leadership Team and make significant contributions to the long-range vision, strategy and plans for GPS and Roche Pharma overall. You will be a co-chair for relevant Therapeutic Area (TA) governance boards (business and development boards / TAH meetings) and a standing member of various global decision-making committees, such as the Late-Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC).

Who You Are

We're looking for a leader with VACC attributes (Visionaire, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) who is committed to our new ways of working. You're authentic and self-aware, passionate about the big picture, cutting-edge science and achieving results while creating a diverse and inclusive environment that brings out the best in the people.

Key Responsibilities

In this position, you will be primarily accountable for effectively:

• Defining, setting, aligning and overseeing implementation/adoption of the long-range vision and global strategy for the diverse therapeutic areas of Neurology and Immunology.

• Leading development and execution of a robust, integrated and cohesive vision and Therapeutic Area Strategic Plan, which includes individual global pipeline, disease area and lifecycle strategies and plans (including integrated solutions, if appropriate), for all assets/indications/disease areas across Neurology, Immunology and Infectious Diseases.

• Optimizing resource allocation to ensure strategic portfolio and financial outcomes are achieved, both within Neurology and Immunology and across GPS.

• Ensuring rigorous commercial assessments of Phase I – III results and provision of expert insights, strategic options and recommendations to executives and Strategic Portfolio Committees regarding therapeutic area assets and their market potential.

• Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCTs), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DATs), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLTs), and Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, to coordinate activities across Roche to assure global and affiliate alignment.

• Ensuring Neurology and Immunology teams provide asset leadership guidance, relevant commercial insights and rigorous analytical support for licensing and other business development activities.

• Accountable for partnering with the Immunology Pharma Portfolio Team (IPPT) and Neurology Pharma Portfolio Team (NPPT) leaders to ensure the realisation of our TA and DA strategies including supporting strategic portfolio considerations, opportunity assessments, and trade-offs, while fostering end-to-end TA collaboration and community.

• Co-chair Business and Development Boards and TAH meetings to ensure robust and rigorous asset and program level decision making. As a co-chair across the Development and Business Boards, the TAH plays a vital role in steering assets through their end-to-end lifecycle by bridging technical execution with commercial strategy. At the development board, you ensure programs meet the "Bar" criteria. A

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione Chi siamo Global Product Strategy (GPS) guida la strategia di Roche e il portafoglio di prodotti - dalla ricerca e sviluppo fino ai pazienti. Come membro del GPS, sarete parte di un gruppo veramente internazionale che collabora con funzioni e affiliati in tutto il mondo, attraverso l'impresa Roche, per plasmare il futuro della medicina. In qualità di Responsabile Area Terapeutica Globale (TAH), Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive, guiderai team multidisciplinari su larga scala, composti da rapporti diretti e indiretti, con notevole influenza sulle prestazioni strategiche, finanziarie e operative dell’azienda. Potrai dirigere direttamente un team di leader senior che sono responsabili per il coordinamento e la gestione della pipeline precoce e del ciclo di vita dei prodotti in fase avanzata e sul mercato; fornire leadership globale, interfunzionale per tutte le attività di sviluppo, tecnico e commerciale per tutte le molecole / prodotti in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. Sarete un membro in piedi del GPS Leadership Team e dare contributi significativi alla visione a lungo raggio, strategia e piani per GPS e Roche Pharma generale. Sarete una co-presidente per i comitati di governance dell'Area Terapeutica (TA) pertinenti (commissioni di business e sviluppo / riunioni TAH) e un membro in piedi di vari comitati decisionali globali, come il Comitato Portfolio di Late-Stage (LSPC). Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un leader con attributi VACC (Visionaire, Architetto, Coach, Catalyst) che si impegna per i nostri nuovi modi di lavorare. Sei autentico e consapevole di te stesso, appassionato del grande quadro, della scienza all'avanguardia e del raggiungimento dei risultati, creando un ambiente diversificato e inclusivo che esalta il meglio della gente. Principali responsabilità In questa posizione, sarai principalmente responsabile per in modo efficace: - Definire, impostare, allineare e supervisionare l'implementazione/adozione della visione a lungo raggio e della strategia globale per le diverse aree terapeutiche della neurologia e dell'immunologia. - Sviluppo e realizzazione di una visione robusta, integrata e coesa e Piano Strategico Area terapeutica, che comprende singole strategie globali di pipeline, area malattia e ciclo di vita (comprese le soluzioni integrate, se del caso), per tutte le aree di attività/indicazioni/disease in Neurologia, Immunologia e Malattie Infettive. - Ottimizzazione dell'allocazione delle risorse per garantire il portafoglio strategico e i risultati finanziari sono raggiunti, sia all'interno di Neurologia e Immunologia che attraverso GPS. - Garantire rigorose valutazioni commerciali dei risultati della Fase I – III e fornire approfondimenti di esperti, opzioni strategiche e raccomandazioni ai comitati executive e Portfolio Strategici relativi alle attività terapeutiche e al loro potenziale di mercato. - Catalyzing Lifecycle Teams (LCT), Disease Area Strategy Teams (DAT), Commercialization Leadership Teams (CLT), e Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning (IDCP) Teams, per coordinare le attività attraverso Roche per assicurare l'allineamento globale e affiliato. - Assicurare che i team di Neurologia e Immunologia forniscano una guida di asset leadership, approfondimenti commerciali rilevanti e un rigoroso supporto analitico per le licenze e altre attività di sviluppo aziendale. - Contabile per collaborare con i leader del team Portfolio di Immunology Pharma (IPPT) e del team di neurologia Pharma (NPPT) per garantire la realizzazione delle nostre strategie TA e DA, tra cui sostenere considerazioni strategiche di portafoglio, valutazioni di opportunità e trade-off, promuovendo la collaborazione e la comunità TA end-to-end. - Co-chair Business and Development Boards e TAH meeting per garantire un asset e un processo decisionale a livello di programma robusto e rigoroso. In qualità di co-presidente attraverso i Bordi di Sviluppo e Business, il TAH svolge un ruolo vitale nel sterzare le attività attraverso il loro ciclo di vita end-to-end attraverso il collegamento di esecuzione tecnica con la strategia commerciale. Nella scheda di sviluppo, si assicura che i programmi soddisfino i criteri "Bar". A
