• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: agire come collegamento commerciale alla corrispondente Business Area, Pharma e Rete Area Malattia, che rappresenta la voce del cliente dei mercati internazionali per dare priorità alla roadmap del portafoglio prodotti.
• Supporto affiliato & Market Expansion: Steer the business, supporto affiliati con diverse esigenze aziendali, guidare la riuscita implementazione dei prodotti FMI, identificare nuove opportunità di mercato / corsi, e gestire i rischi di mercato come definito nel Business Plan e P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliati in riunioni di clienti di alto livello / C (ad esempio, ospedali di alto livello, laboratori, paganti), fornire risorse centrali per trattative di contratto / clienti, e accelerare sinergie trasversali attraverso FMI IBT, iKAMs e Pharma.
• Integrazione della gestione delle malattie: assicurare l'integrazione della vostra area di attenzione in un approccio globale di gestione delle malattie, ove applicabile, collaborando strettamente con gli Affari medici e governativi / MAx e il capitolo della strategia regionale e innovazione.
• Change & Risk Management: Guidare cambiamenti organizzativi, sviluppare concetti di rete regionale, anticipare scenari di rischio, e stabilire adeguate strategie di gestione del rischio e mitigazione.
• Pianificazione finanziaria: collaborare con altri leader commerciali e finanza per preparare, tracciare e regolare il budget e la pianificazione aziendale internazionale in risposta alle influenze interne ed esterne. Chi sei
• Leader commerciale esperto: possiede un minimo di un diploma di laurea (o equivalente) con almeno 7 anni di esperienza in settori IVD o correlati, un forte record di decisioni commerciali strategiche, e l'esperienza preferita in un ruolo orientato al cliente o sul campo.
• Acume Strategico & Business: Dimostra l'agilità strategica comprovata per tradurre ampi piani concettuali in azioni semplificate, forte acume aziendale, e una solida comprensione del mercato clinico/prescrittivo (ad esempio, cura Oncologia) e sistemi sanitari.
• Progetto e cambiamento C
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine Institute, you will work within an innovative ecosystem led by Foundation Medicine, a pioneer with over 15 years of leadership in combining scientific and technology advancement with transformative treatment strategies. At Roche, we are committed to transforming healthcare and making a positive impact on patients' lives. Joining our team means contributing to driving healthcare transformation on a global scale within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and excellence. In this high-impact role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of Precision Medicine on a global scale and ensure that our innovative solutions translate into life-changing benefits for patients across the globe. As a core member of the International Business Team (IBT), you will represent the International Commercial Business Unit, serving as the strategic bridge between global functions and regional/local execution. In this capacity, you will act as the primary Commercial Liaison to the FMI Business Area, bringing the "Voice of the Customer" to the forefront of the organization to inform product requirements and shape portfolio priorities. The Opportunity
• Commercial Strategy & Execution: Drive the design, execution, and prioritization of commercial strategies, operating models, and key strategic projects (e.g., squads, communities of practice) for International Markets in collaboration with the regions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the corresponding Business Area, Pharma, and Disease Area Network, representing the customer voice of International Markets to prioritize the product portfolio roadmap.
• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Steer the business, support affiliates with diverse business needs, drive the successful implementation of FMI products, identify new market opportunities/trends, and manage market risks as defined in the Business Plan and P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliates in high-stakes/C-level customer meetings (e.g., top hospitals, labs, payers), provide central resources for contract negotiations/tenders, and accelerate cross-functional synergies across FMI IBTs, iKAMs, and Pharma.
• Disease Management Integration: Ensure the integration of your focus area into an overall disease management approach where applicable, collaborating closely with Medical & Government Affairs / MAx and the regional strategy and innovation chapter.
• Change & Risk Management: Drive organizational changes, develop regional networking concepts, anticipate risk scenarios, and establish suitable risk management and mitigation strategies.
• Financial Planning: Collaborate with other commercial business leaders and finance to prepare, track, and adjust the International Business budget and business planning in response to internal and external influences. Who You Are
• Experienced Commercial Leader: Holds a minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with at least 7 years of experience in IVD or related sectors, a strong track record of strategic commercial decision-making, and preferred experience in a customer-facing or field-based role.
• Strategic & Business Acumen: Demonstrates proven strategic agility to translate broad conceptual plans into simplified actions, strong business acumen, and a robust understanding of the clinical/prescriber market (e.g., Oncology care) and healthcare systems.
• Project & Change C
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine Institute arbeiten Sie in einem innovativen Ökosystem unter der Leitung von Foundation Medicine, einem Pionier mit über 15 Jahren Führungskraft bei der Kombination von wissenschaftlichen und technologischen Fortschritten mit transformativen Behandlungsstrategien. Bei Roche sind wir verpflichtet, die Gesundheitsversorgung zu transformieren und positive Auswirkungen auf das Leben der Patienten zu haben. Das Mitmachen unseres Teams bedeutet, in einem dynamischen Umfeld, das die Zusammenarbeit und Exzellenz fördert, einen Beitrag zur weltweiten Gesundheitstransformation zu leisten. In dieser wirkungsstarken Rolle haben Sie die einzigartige Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der Präzisionsmedizin global zu gestalten und sicherzustellen, dass unsere innovativen Lösungen weltweit zu lebensverändernden Vorteilen für Patienten übergehen. Als zentrales Mitglied des International Business Teams (IBT) vertreten Sie die International Commercial Business Unit, die als strategische Brücke zwischen globalen Funktionen und regionaler/lokaler Ausführung dient. In dieser Funktion fungieren Sie als primäre kommerzielle Verbindung zum FMI Business Area und bringen die "Voice of the Customer" an die Spitze der Organisation, um Produktanforderungen zu informieren und Portfolioprioritäten zu formen. Die Chance
• Kommerzielle Strategie & Ausführung: Fahren Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit den Regionen mit der Gestaltung, Durchführung und Priorisierung von Handelsstrategien, Betriebsmodellen und strategischen Schlüsselprojekten (z.B. Quads, Praxisgemeinschaften) für den internationalen Markt.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the entsprechenden Business Area, Pharma und Disease Area Network, die die Kundenstimme von International Markets zur Priorisierung der Produktportfolio Roadmap darstellt.
• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Geschäftsführung, Support-Partner mit unterschiedlichen Geschäftsanforderungen, die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von FMI-Produkten, die Identifizierung neuer Marktchancen/Trends und die Bewältigung von Marktrisiken im Geschäftsplan und P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support-Partner bei High-Stakes/C-Level-Kundensitzungen (z.B. Top-Krankenhäuser, Labore, Zahler), bieten zentrale Ressourcen für Vertragsverhandlungen/Tender und beschleunigen funktionsübergreifende Synergien über FMI IBTs, iKAMs und Pharma.
• Integration des Krankheitsmanagements: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr Schwerpunktgebiet in einen Gesamtansatz des Krankheitsmanagements eingebunden wird, der eng mit Medical & Government Affairs / MAx und dem regionalen Strategie- und Innovationskapitel zusammenarbeitet.
• Change & Risk Management: Organisationsänderungen antreiben, regionale Netzwerkkonzepte entwickeln, Risikoszenarien antizipieren und geeignete Risikomanagement- und Minderungsstrategien etablieren.
• Finanzplanung: Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Führungskräften und Finanzen für die Vorbereitung, Verfolgung und Anpassung des International Business Budgets und der Geschäftsplanung in Reaktion auf interne und externe Einflüsse. Wer bist du?
• Erfahrener Handelsführer: Erhält ein Minimum eines Bachelor-Abschlusses (oder gleichwertig) mit mindestens 7 Jahren Erfahrung in IVD oder verwandten Sektoren, eine starke Erfolgsbilanz der strategischen kommerziellen Entscheidungsfindung und bevorzugte Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten oder feldbasierten Rolle.
• Strategische & Business-Acumen: Demonstrate bewährte strategische Agilität, um breite konzeptionelle Pläne in vereinfachte Aktionen, starkes Business-Acumen und ein robustes Verständnis des klinischen/Präscriber-Marktes (z.B. Oncology Care) und Gesundheitssysteme zu übersetzen.
• Projekt und Wandel C
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que chef commercial (CBL) de la Fondation Medicine Institute, vous travaillerez au sein d'un écosystème novateur dirigé par Foundation Medicine, un pionnier de plus de 15 ans de leadership dans la combinaison des progrès scientifiques et technologiques avec des stratégies de traitement transformatrices. Chez Roche, nous nous engageons à transformer les soins de santé et à avoir un impact positif sur la vie des patients. Rejoindre notre équipe signifie contribuer à la transformation des soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise la collaboration et l'excellence. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous aurez l'occasion unique de façonner l'avenir de la médecine de précision à l'échelle mondiale et de veiller à ce que nos solutions innovantes se traduisent par des avantages qui changent la vie des patients à travers le monde. En tant que membre principal de l'International Business Team (IBT), vous représenterez l'International Commercial Business Unit, servant de pont stratégique entre les fonctions mondiales et l'exécution régionale/locale. À ce titre, vous agirez en tant que principale liaison commerciale avec le secteur d'activité de l'IMF, en mettant la « voix du client » au premier plan de l'organisation pour informer les exigences du produit et façonner les priorités du portefeuille. L'opportunité
• Stratégie commerciale et exécution: Diriger la conception, l'exécution et la hiérarchisation des stratégies commerciales, des modèles opérationnels et des projets stratégiques clés (par exemple, les équipes, les communautés de pratique) pour les marchés internationaux en collaboration avec les régions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Agir comme la liaison commerciale avec le Business Area, Pharma, et le réseau correspondant, représentant la voix des clients des marchés internationaux pour prioriser la feuille de route du portefeuille de produits.
• Soutien aux filiales et expansion du marché : dirigez l'entreprise, soutenez les filiales ayant des besoins d'affaires variés, dirigez la mise en oeuvre réussie des produits de l'IMF, identifiez de nouvelles opportunités/tendances du marché et gérez les risques du marché tels que définis dans le plan d'affaires et P&L.
• Hautes étapes et gestion des parties prenantes: soutenir les filiales dans les réunions de clients de haut niveau/C (p. ex., les hôpitaux de haut niveau, les laboratoires, les payeurs), fournir des ressources centrales pour les négociations contractuelles/appels d'offres, et accélérer les synergies interfonctionnelles entre les IBT de l'IMF, les iKAM et les Pharma.
• Intégration de la gestion des maladies : assurez l'intégration de votre domaine d'intervention dans une approche globale de gestion des maladies, le cas échéant, en collaborant étroitement avec les Affaires médicales et gouvernementales/MAx et le chapitre sur la stratégie régionale et l'innovation.
• Changement et gestion des risques: Diriger les changements organisationnels, élaborer des concepts de réseautage régional, anticiper les scénarios de risque et établir des stratégies appropriées de gestion et d'atténuation des risques.
• Planification financière: Collaborer avec d'autres chefs d'entreprise et de finance pour préparer, suivre et ajuster le budget des affaires internationales et la planification des affaires en réponse aux influences internes et externes. Qui vous êtes
• Leader commercial expérimenté : est titulaire d'un baccalauréat (ou d'un équivalent) d'au moins 7 ans d'expérience en DIV ou dans des secteurs connexes, d'une solide expérience en matière de prise de décisions commerciales stratégiques et d'une expérience privilégiée dans un rôle axé sur le client ou sur le terrain.
• Œuvre stratégique et d'affaires : Démontre une agilité stratégique éprouvée pour traduire des plans conceptuels généraux en actions simplifiées, un Œuvre forte d'affaires et une solide compréhension du marché clinique/prescripteur (par exemple, les soins oncologiques) et des systèmes de santé.
• Projet & Changement C

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager (North Region)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Customer Account Manager for our Managed Service Contracts in the North region, you will act as the vital link between Roche and our healthcare partners. You will ensure our customers receive a superior experience while bringing their voice directly into our organization to shape the future of diagnostics.

• Build meaningful partnerships: Develop and maintain long-term commercial relationships across all levels of your assigned customer base.

• Drive strategic value: Connect customer business goals with Roche’s product and service suite to support their success during periods of healthcare transformation.

• Lead service delivery: Co-create Strategic account plans and coordinate cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services) to ensure seamless execution.

• Manage the lifecycle: Oversee the full customer experience for our Optimall branded Managed Services, serving as the primary point of escalation for Roche and third-party partners.

• Foster a culture of excellence: Champion the "voice of the customer" internally to ensure we continue to "do now what patients need next."

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a passionate customer advocate who thrives on delivering value and building resilient commercial relationships.

• Experienced Account Manager: You bring a proven track record in contract management and commercial engagement within the healthcare sector.

• Strategic & Analytical: You possess the ability to interrogate large datasets to draw meaningful insights (Advanced Excel) and understand complex business workflows.

• Collaborative Leader: You are skilled at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while working alongside experts in technical support, finance, and marketing.

• Effective Communicator: You are a strong listener who can identify pain points and develop clear solutions, maintaining a professional demeanor under pressure.

• Education: You are educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant field.

Together, we’ll create a healthier, brighter future for all.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability or age. We recognise the importance of flexible working and will review all applicants’ requests with care. At Ro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Technical Product Owner for Web Experience, you will be a key driver in evolving Roche Diagnostics' global and regional digital ecosystem. You will enable scalable, customer-centric digital experiences that support healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients worldwide. This role sits at the heart of our digital transformation, bridging the gap between ambitious business needs and high-quality technical execution.

Your Responsibilities

• Own the Digital Backlog: You will prioritize and manage the backlog for Web Experience and Web Analytics platforms, translating business requirements into clear, actionable technical stories.

• Drive Global Delivery: Collaborate closely with engineering teams and external partners to drive sprint planning, testing, and successful releases.

• Shape Platform Capabilities: Support the continuous improvement of global websites, content publishing workflows, search discoverability, and personalization.

• Lead Technical Integrations: Coordinate activities across major platforms like Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), content repositories (DAM), and Marketing Automation ecosystems.

• Ensure Excellence & Compliance: Guarantee that all web solutions are secure, accessible, and compliant with global regulations such as GDPR.

• Facilitate Global Collaboration: Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, UX/UI specialists, and regional teams to ensure delivery consistency across the globe.

Who You Are

• You are a proactive technical leader who thrives in complex environments and possesses a deep understanding of how to build and scale global web platforms. You bring a collaborative mindset and the ability to influence both technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact.

• Experienced Product Professional: You bring 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner or Digital Product Manager, specifically delivering enterprise-level web platforms or portals.

• Agile Expert: You have a proven track record working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFE.

• Technical Strategist: You possess a strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and connected digital architectures (e.g., CMS, DAM, and Analytics ecosystems).

• Skilled Communicator: You excel at managing stakeholders across diverse business and technical teams, simplifying complex technical concepts into clear priorities.

• Analytical Problem Solver: You have a natural ability to identify delivery risks and technical dependencies while maintaining a focus on quality and platform stability.

Ready to make a difference?
At Roche, you’re empowered to design your own learning path. With access to training, job rotations, and leadership development, we support your unique growth journey.

#RDT2026

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico per la Web Experience, sarai un driver chiave nell'evoluzione dell'ecosistema digitale globale e regionale di Roche Diagnostics. Potrai attivare esperienze digitali scalabili e orientate al cliente che supportano professionisti sanitari, laboratori e pazienti in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo si trova al centro della nostra trasformazione digitale, colmando il divario tra ambiziose esigenze aziendali ed esecuzione tecnica di alta qualità. Le tue responsabilità
• Possedere il Digital Backlog: priorità e gestione del backlog per le piattaforme Web Experience e Web Analytics, traducendo i requisiti aziendali in storie tecniche chiare e attuabili.
• Drive Global Delivery: Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneria e i partner esterni per guidare la pianificazione, il test e le versioni di successo.
• Capacità della piattaforma di forma: Sostenere il miglioramento continuo dei siti web globali, flussi di lavoro di pubblicazione dei contenuti, scoperta della ricerca e personalizzazione.
• Lead Technical Integrations: Coordinate attività su piattaforme principali come Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), repository di contenuti (DAM), e ecosistemi di Marketing Automation.
• Assicurare Eccellenza e conformità: garantire che tutte le soluzioni web siano sicure, accessibili e conformi alle normative globali come GDPR.
• Facilitate Global Collaboration: Agite come interfaccia primaria tra gli stakeholder aziendali, gli specialisti UX/UI e i team regionali per garantire la coerenza delle consegne in tutto il mondo. Chi sei
• Sei un leader tecnico proattivo che prospera in ambienti complessi e possiede una profonda comprensione di come costruire e scalare piattaforme web globali. Porti una mentalità collaborativa e la capacità di influenzare sia i team tecnici che gli stakeholder aziendali per fornire un impatto misurabile.
• Professionista del Prodotto Interessato: Porti 5+ anni di esperienza come Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico o Digital Product Manager, specificatamente fornendo piattaforme web di livello enterprise o portali.
• Agile Expert: Hai un record di traccia collaudato che funziona con metodologie Agile, tra cui Scrum e SAFE.
• Strategista Tecnico: Possiedi una forte comprensione di API, integrazioni e architetture digitali connesse (ad esempio, CMS, DAM e gli ecosistemi di Analytics).
• Communicatore esperto: Eccellente nella gestione delle parti interessate di diversi team aziendali e tecnici, semplificando i concetti tecnici complessi in chiare priorità.
• Risolvere dei problemi analitici: hai una capacità naturale di identificare i rischi di consegna e le dipendenze tecniche mantenendo un focus sulla qualità e sulla stabilità della piattaforma. Pronto a fare la differenza? A Roche, sei abilitato a progettare il tuo percorso di apprendimento. Con l'accesso alla formazione, alle rotazioni di lavoro e allo sviluppo della leadership, sosteniamo il vostro viaggio di crescita unico. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Madrid. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als technischer Product Owner für Web Experience sind Sie ein wichtiger Treiber für die Entwicklung des globalen und regionalen digitalen Ökosystems von Roche Diagnostics. Sie ermöglichen skalierbare, kundenzentrierte digitale Erfahrungen, die Gesundheitsexperten, Labors und Patienten weltweit unterstützen. Diese Rolle steht im Mittelpunkt unserer digitalen Transformation und überbrücket die Lücke zwischen ambitionierten Geschäftsanforderungen und hochwertiger technischer Ausführung. Ihre Aufgaben
• Eigenes digitales Backlog: Sie priorisieren und verwalten den Backlog für Web Experience und Web Analytics-Plattformen und übersetzen Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, handlungsfähige technische Geschichten.
• Drive Global Delivery: Mit Ingenieurteams und externen Partnern eng zusammenarbeiten, um Sprint-Planung, Testung und erfolgreiche Releases voranzutreiben.
• Shape Platform Capabilities: Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der globalen Webseiten, der Content Publishing Workflows, der Sucherkennung und der Personalisierung.
• Lead Technical Integrations: Koordination von Aktivitäten auf großen Plattformen wie Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Content Repositories (DAM) und Marketing Automation Ökosysteme.
• Vergewissern Sie sich, dass alle Web-Lösungen sicher, zugänglich und mit globalen Bestimmungen wie DSGVO konform sind.
• Globale Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Aktivieren Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen Wirtschaftsteilnehmern, UX/UI-Spezialisten und regionalen Teams, um die Lieferkonsistenz auf der ganzen Welt sicherzustellen. Wer bist du?
• Sie sind ein proaktiver technischer Führer, der in komplexen Umgebungen lebt und ein tiefes Verständnis dafür besitzt, wie man globale Web-Plattformen baut und skaliert. Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, sowohl technische Teams als auch Geschäftspartner zu beeinflussen, um messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.
• Erfahrener Product Professional: Sie bringen 5+ Jahre Erfahrung als Technischer Produktbesitzer oder Digital Product Manager, speziell für die Bereitstellung von Webplattformen oder Portalen auf Unternehmensebene.
• Agile Expert: Sie haben einen bewährten Track Record, der mit Agile-Methoden arbeitet, einschließlich Scrum und SAFE.
• Technischer Strategist: Sie besitzen ein starkes Verständnis von APIs, Integrationen und vernetzten digitalen Architekturen (z.B. CMS, DAM und Analytics Ökosysteme).
• Skilled Communicator: Sie zeichnen sich durch das Management von Stakeholdern in verschiedenen Geschäfts- und technischen Teams aus und vereinfachen komplexe technische Konzepte in klare Prioritäten.
• Analytisches Problem Solver: Sie haben eine natürliche Fähigkeit, Lieferrisiken und technische Abhängigkeiten zu identifizieren und dabei einen Fokus auf Qualität und Plattformstabilität zu halten. Bereit, einen Unterschied zu machen? Bei Roche sind Sie befugt, Ihren eigenen Lernpfad zu gestalten. Mit Zugang zu Schulungen, Jobrotationen und Führungsentwicklung unterstützen wir Ihre einzigartige Wachstumsreise. Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Madrid. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que propriétaire de produits techniques pour l'expérience Web, vous serez un moteur clé de l'évolution de l'écosystème numérique mondial et régional de Roche Diagnostics. Vous allez permettre des expériences numériques évolutives et centrées sur le client qui soutiennent les professionnels de la santé, les laboratoires et les patients du monde entier. Ce rôle est au cœur de notre transformation numérique, comblant le fossé entre les besoins commerciaux ambitieux et l'exécution technique de haute qualité. Vos responsabilités
• Posséder le backlog numérique : Vous prioriserez et gérerez l'arriéré des plateformes Web Experience et Web Analytics, traduisant les exigences commerciales en histoires techniques claires et exploitables.
• Drive Global Delivery: Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes d'ingénierie et les partenaires externes pour conduire la planification du sprint, les essais et les sorties réussies.
• Capacités de la plate-forme de forme: Soutenir l'amélioration continue des sites Web mondiaux, les flux de travail de publication de contenu, la recherche de découverte et la personnalisation.
• Intégrations techniques principales : Coordonner les activités sur les grandes plateformes comme Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), les dépôts de contenu (DAM) et les écosystèmes d'automatisation du marketing.
• Assurer l'excellence et la conformité : garantir que toutes les solutions web sont sécurisées, accessibles et conformes aux réglementations mondiales telles que le RGPD.
• Faciliter la collaboration mondiale : agir en tant que principale interface entre les acteurs économiques, les spécialistes des UX/UI et les équipes régionales pour assurer la cohérence des prestations dans le monde entier. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un leader technique proactif qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et possède une compréhension profonde de la façon de construire et d'étendre les plateformes web mondiales. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif et la capacité d'influencer à la fois les équipes techniques et les intervenants commerciaux pour obtenir un impact mesurable.
• Expérience professionnelle des produits: Vous apportez 5 ans d'expérience en tant que propriétaire de produits techniques ou gestionnaire de produits numériques, en fournissant spécifiquement des plateformes ou des portails Web au niveau de l'entreprise.
• Agile Expert: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail avec les méthodologies Agile, y compris Scrum et SAFE.
• Stratège technique: Vous avez une forte compréhension des API, des intégrations et des architectures numériques connectées (par exemple, les écosystèmes CMS, DAM et Analytics).
• Communicateur compétent: Vous excellez dans la gestion des parties prenantes à travers diverses équipes commerciales et techniques, simplifiant des concepts techniques complexes en priorités claires.
• Solution de problème analytique : Vous avez une capacité naturelle à identifier les risques de livraison et les dépendances techniques tout en maintenant un accent sur la qualité et la stabilité de la plateforme. Prêt à faire la différence ? Chez Roche, vous êtes habilité à concevoir votre propre parcours d'apprentissage. Avec l'accès à la formation, aux rotations d'emplois et au leadership, nous soutenons votre parcours de croissance unique. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Madrid. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining how we connect with customers globally. We are seeking a Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience to lead the technical evolution of our next-generation ecosystem. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities across global and local markets. You will work within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside product leads, engineers, and strategic partners to translate business capabilities into future-state architecture.

Your Responsibilities

• Shape Architecture Strategy: Define and maintain the target architecture, integration patterns, and technical guardrails for our Content Supply Chain and Web Experience capabilities.

• Design Scalable Solutions: Create reusable, secure, and compliant end-to-end architectures spanning content planning, creation, storage, activation, and real-time personalization.

• Lead Ecosystem Integration: Direct technical architecture across premiere platforms, including Adobe Experience Cloud (Sites, Assets, Workfront, GenStudio), Veeva Vault PromoMats, and advanced Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).

• Govern Technical Quality: Drive robust non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, and global compliance standards (such as GDPR).

• Collaborate and Guide: Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and engineering teams to validate technical designs, manage architectural dependencies, and ensure sustainable deliveries.

• Foster Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, championing proof-of-concepts in AI-enabled content operations, dynamic content assembly, and enterprise content intelligence.

Who You Are

• You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning complex digital ecosystem challenges into simplified, high-performing platform realities.

• You excel at bridging the gap between business vision and deep technical engineering, utilizing your exceptional stakeholder management skills to influence distributed global teams.

• Extensive Architecture Experience: 8+ years of proven success in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or complex digital platform engineering.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, and scaling enterprise web content management, digital asset management (DAM), and dynamic personalization technologies.

• Modern Engineering Mindset: Strong, practical understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first delivery, integration patterns, and composable platform ecosystems.

• Technical Governance & Compliance: Robust knowledge of navigating non-functional requirements like web security, accessibility, performance optimization, and international data privacy regulations.

• Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

• Nice-to-have highlights: Experience in regulated environments (such as life sciences or healthcare) or direct technical familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud and Veeva Vault platforms is highly valued.

At Roche, we embrace emerging innovations, like AI, to enhance the patient journey. If you’re passionate about new technology and thinking ahead, we want you to join us!

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst (PTM) die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung mit qualitativ hochwertigen Medikamenten sicher. PTM steht für die höchsten Standards der pharmazeutischen Herstellung, das grösste, innovativste Verpackungszentrum der Roche und die Versorgung von mehr als 120 Ländern.
In dieser Rolle bist du eine positiv denkende, integere und selbstreflektierende Führungspersönlichkeit mit starken kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die täglichen Herausforderungen deines Teams, unterstützt sie fachlich wie persönlich und trittst als leidenschaftlicher Coach auf. Durch Transparenz und eine offene Fehlerkultur stärkst du Vertrauen, förderst die Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden und schaffst eine Umgebung, in der dein Team eigenverantwortlich Aufträge bearbeiten kann.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Technical Asset Care Lead bist du verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der technischen Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen unter Einhaltung aller SGU und GMP Vorgaben.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Research Organizations (CROs)

titleByLocale.en: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Research Organizations (CROs)
titleByLocale.it: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Ricerca Organizations (CROs)
titleByLocale.de: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Forschung Organizations (CROs)
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Procurement Manager - Clinical Recherche Organizations (CROs)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. .

As a Senior Procurement Manager in Clinical Research Organizations (CROs), you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as Customer Excellence, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive category sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter expert in Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements and maximize the value for Roche.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and project management skills, and/or supporting team members by coaching them and enhancing their skills and knowledge.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing strategy into content and automated buying channels guidelines, best practices and communication materials that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline.

• You have 7+ years of procurement experience in strategic sourcing, global category management, complex procurement contracting, and operational category efficiency projects, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You have 10+ years of procurement experience in sourcing, simple contracting, category management, and operational efficiency projects or relevant related category experience.

• You possess strong and deep knowledge and have experience in the CRO Category, and other Research & Development categories such as Clinical Technologies, Laboratories, and other R&D commodity areas, strong knowledge of CRO and Research & Development adjacent commodities and overall understanding of other commodities.

• You also have deep knowledge and experience in supplier management, contract negotiations, cost optimization, market r

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. .

As a Senior Procurement Manager in Clinical Research Organizations (CROs), you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as Customer Excellence, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive category sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter expert in Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements and maximize the value for Roche.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and project management skills, and/or supporting team members by coaching them and enhancing their skills and knowledge.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing strategy into content and automated buying channels guidelines, best practices and communication materials that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline.

• You have 7+ years of procurement experience in strategic sourcing, global category management, complex procurement contracting, and operational category efficiency projects, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You have 10+ years of procurement experience in sourcing, simple contracting, category management, and operational efficiency projects or relevant related category experience.

• You possess strong and deep knowledge and have experience in the CRO Category, and other Research & Development categories such as Clinical Technologies, Laboratories, and other R&D commodity areas, strong knowledge of CRO and Research & Development adjacent commodities and overall understanding of other commodities.

• You also have deep knowledge and experience in supplier management, contract negotiations, cost optimization, market r

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Customer Logistics Managment Team for Direct Markets is part of the Global Supply Chain Operations & Logistics, a unit of Roche Pharma and thus a key partner for all 3rd party customers worldwide. We contribute to the timely delivery of safe, effective and high-quality medicine to external customers and patients while ensuring compliance with global quality and regulatory requirements.

Who You are

• Enrolled at a university, preferably in the field of supply chain management, business administration, life sciences (chemistry, biology, pharmacy), IT / computer science or another degree, or you completed your studies within the last 12 months prior to the start date.

• Interested in ERP and supply chain systems landscape

• Excited about supporting patients worldwide to get the medicine they need

• Capable to manage standard analysis and presentation software (Excel, PowerPoint, gSuite, lucid chart and smart sheet) with ability to organize and visualize data

• Open-minded and curious to learn new things

• You demonstrate the ability to build up a network or international relationship

• You have a high degree of self-management

• English language skills are mandatory and German language skills are a great plus

Moreover, You are:

• Excited about working in SAP and OMP (order entry, delivery creation, invoicing)

• Capable of working with Google tools and lucid chart for creating process flows

• Managing the internship cycle: Supporting the hiring process of new interns, Onboarding/Training and handover the tasks to the new internship

Technical Details:

Please upload your curriculum vitae and your motivation letter specific to this position.

Due to regulations, Non-Swiss/EU/EFTA citizens (m/f/n) must enclose a confirmation from the university with the application documents that a compulsory internship is part of the internship.

Start: 1st July/ August 2026 or according to agreement, ideally for 12 months in Kaiseraugst (CH).

This position is suitable for students looking for a full-time internship, however working in part-time (at least 32 hours a week) is also possible.

Preparing your final thesis during this internship could also be supported.

If you are proud of contributing and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an integral part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in seamlessly leading global Capex projects from planning through execution by providing strong project management, technical expertise and project performance on time and on budget. Proactive maintenance, facility fitness and equipment support for the manufacturing network are adding to the mandate of PTT being PT`s powerhouse for technical product health.
The Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead is a critical leadership role responsible for the end-to-end development, implementation, and operational management of standardized manufacturing systems across the Drug Product network. Reporting to the Global Fleet Program Owner, this role owns the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, ensuring the "design one, build many" philosophy is executed to drive cross-site equivalency and unparalleled efficiencies.

The Opportunity
You serve as the enterprise-wide single point of ownership for the Drug Product aspect of the Global Manufacturing Standardization Strategy, accountable for its success across the network, and you own and drive the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, establishing the specific standards for DP manufacturing systems to be deployed across the global network. Your main responsibilities are

• Define, own, and drive the multi-year global strategy and roadmap for the Drug Product Fleet concept and systems together with gMSAT Drug Product and the DP manufacturing sites and serve as the primary point of accountability for all DP-specific fleet systems, ensuring they meet the defined global standards for the production network. Hold ultimate accountability for ensuring and maintaining the equivalency of DP fleet equipment & systems throughout their entire lifecycle.

• Present the global operating budget (CAPEX and OPEX) and resource allocation for DP fleet system deployment and maintenance across the network.

• Lead and act as the primary point of contact (POC) for all outward-facing health authority interactions and inquiries (including leading Pre-Approval Inspections (PAIs) and major regulatory filings) that specifically concern Drug Product fleet systems.

• Ensure DP fleet equipment adheres strictly to global documents, including User Requirements Specifications (URS) and functional specifications. Own and maintain DP-specific lifecycle deliverables, including the Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs, and URS and lead the analysis of proposed changes on DP fleet equivalency, ensuring consistent implementation across all affected DP sites.

• Conduct and oversee side-by-side comparative analyses of GMP-critical and process-critical aspects for DP equipment. Oversee the continuous monitoring of DP fleet performance, tracking critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

• Ensure that unplanned events or discrepancies impacting DP equipment are assessed for network-wide impact in collaboration with key stakeholders.

Who you are
You have a strong track record of leading change management processes in a highly regulated environment with a focus on cross-site impact and you bring the following qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Bioengineering), Life Sciences, or a related technical field; PhD is strongly preferred.

• A minimum of 15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with a strong emphasis on D

Proactive maintenance, facility fitness and equipment support for the manufacturing network are adding to the mandate of PTT being PT`s powerhouse for technical product health.
The Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead is a critical leadership role responsible for the end-to-end development, implementation, and operational management of standardized manufacturing systems across the Drug Product network. Reporting to the Global Fleet Program Owner, this role owns the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, ensuring the "design one, build many" philosophy is executed to drive cross-site equivalency and unparalleled efficiencies.

The Opportunity
You serve as the enterprise-wide single point of ownership for the Drug Product aspect of the Global Manufacturing Standardization Strategy, accountable for its success across the network, and you own and drive the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, establishing the specific standards for DP manufacturing systems to be deployed across the global network. Your main responsibilities are

• Define, own, and drive the multi-year global strategy and roadmap for the Drug Product Fleet concept and systems together with gMSAT Drug Product and the DP manufacturing sites and serve as the primary point of accountability for all DP-specific fleet systems, ensuring they meet the defined global standards for the production network. Hold ultimate accountability for ensuring and maintaining the equivalency of DP fleet equipment & systems throughout their entire lifecycle.

• Present the global operating budget (CAPEX and OPEX) and resource allocation for DP fleet system deployment and maintenance across the network.

• Lead and act as the primary point of contact (POC) for all outward-facing health authority interactions and inquiries (including leading Pre-Approval Inspections (PAIs) and major regulatory filings) that specifically concern Drug Product fleet systems.

• Ensure DP fleet equipment adheres strictly to global documents, including User Requirements Specifications (URS) and functional specifications. Own and maintain DP-specific lifecycle deliverables, including the Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs, and URS and lead the analysis of proposed changes on DP fleet equivalency, ensuring consistent implementation across all affected DP sites.

• Conduct and oversee side-by-side comparative analyses of GMP-critical and process-critical aspects for DP equipment. Oversee the continuous monitoring of DP fleet performance, tracking critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

• Ensure that unplanned events or discrepancies impacting DP equipment are assessed for network-wide impact in collaboration with key stakeholders.

Who you are
You have a strong track record of leading change management processes in a highly regulated environment with a focus on cross-site impact and you bring the following qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Bioengineering), Life Sciences, or a related technical field; PhD is strongly preferred.

• A minimum of 15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with a strong emphasis on D

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Finance Business Partner for Roche Diagnostics (internally known as Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP)), you'll play a pivotal role in driving the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) journey. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial health of our business while delivering market-leading customer experiences. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to identify profitable commercial opportunities, improve contract performance, and ensure sustainable business outcomes.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the financial strategy, contract management, and performance insights within the network. You will collaborate across teams to ensure the success of our commercial pipeline and contribute to the development and execution of the annual business plan. By leveraging your expertise, you’ll ensure that our contracts are financially sustainable, competitive, and aligned with Roche Diagnostics' long-term goals.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) processes for a portfolio of contracts, ensuring financial sustainability. This includes modelling new tenders, extensions and amendments.

• Monitor and improve contract financial health in collaboration with customers

• Lead negotiations regarding complex contracts and dispute resolution.

• Contribute to the business planning process and actively participate in the regional network governance, aligning targets with the annual cycle.

• Support the commercial pipeline by balancing growth with profitability and timely cash generation, while driving sustainable commercial deals that consider risks, competitor assumptions, and pricing.

• Develop and partner key stakeholders, providing coaching and support, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and building trusted cross-functional partnerships to achieve shared objectives and co-lead critical affiliate business plan initiatives.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree (Upper Second Class or equivalent), a Master’s or MBA is preferred but not required.

• Strong, proven commercial finance experience, professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or international equivalent) is preferred

• Excellent excel skills and experience with financial modelling

• You're a customer-centric professional, adept at delivering solutions that meet both client and business objectives.

• Experience in navigating complex Customer Relationships and Negotiations

• You excel at navigating complex, matrix organizations, fostering strong collaborative networks, and translating complex financial ideas into easily understandable insights.

• You embrace change as an opportunity, thrive in both independent and team environments, and are driven by results and continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English, you're passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences that drive business success.

This role is based onsite at our Burgess Hill office in West Sussex, United Kingdom.

Please upload only your current compelling CV and / or Cover Letter.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, en

jobs.title: Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role:

The Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM will support affiliates with their product security needs by designing, coordinating, and governing a security network across our affiliates.

We are looking for someone with expertise in product security and direct experience working with customers in that field.

Your Responsibilities:

• Be an ambassador and evangelist for Roche Diagnostics product security to affiliates.

• Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders within the regions and around the global organization.

• Design, coordinate, and govern a product security network across our affiliates consisting of colleagues who interface with customers on product security topics.

• Gather intake from affiliates on customer needs and expectations (e.g. data localization, support topics, etc.) to drive global product security & privacy strategy improvements.

• Support affiliates with their product security needs, e.g. hosting training sessions, Q&A’s and other materials to meet customer needs, join affiliates for customer meetings, etc.

• Make relevant product security information on products, services and ecosystem accessible to affiliates.

• Build the bridge between affiliate and global teams, e.g. by facilitating knowledge sharing between those (within PSPO, product teams, etc.), leading cross-functional projects to establish processes, drive implementation of product security changes, etc.

• Create and maintain a knowledge base of the most common product security questions to allow affiliates to respond faster to tenders/questionnaires.

• Gather product security-related metrics and provide report-outs to affiliates and management.

• Strong collaboration within the chapter and other PSPO chapters to ensure affiliate needs are tracked and served. Is considered as a reference for stakeholders and actively shares ideas and expertise and leads/moderates discussions.

• Enable affiliate leaders and customer-facing roles including commercial and service to achieve greater promotion on topics of security with customers.

Your Experience & Skills:

• BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or relevant area of study, required.

• Expertise in working directly with customers in the product security field is required.

• Commercial mindset.

• Fluent in English on a business level with excellent verbal and written skills; other languages welcome, but not required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in communicating security and privacy strategy, products, and ecosystems.

• Exceptional demonstration, presentation, and interpersonal communication (written and verbal) skills are essential.

• Highly influential relationship builder.

• Experience with compliance standards and regulatory mandates, security and privacy laws, regulations and standards.

• Goal-oriented individual, with proven positive leading in the matrix ability, strong business acumen, strong focus motivating and developing teams.

• EU residence/citizenship preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Medical Affairs. We are transforming Medical practice together. We are accountable for the medical outside-in perspective at Roche and for ensuring that the science behind our products is communicated and understood amongst relevant HCPs at global scale, for whom we are a trusted partner. We collaborate across and strive in an integrated work environment with the affiliates, global development and global strategy. We help in driving the development, introduction, uptake and informed use of our innovative medicines and services in clinical practice and patient care worldwide. We create and evolve competencies, capabilities, and opportunities for our global Medical Network. We think ahead and leverage digital whenever possible.

The Opportunity

• You provide medical expertise to Breast Cancer and contribute to medical strategy components such as evidence generation, dissemination and medical insights as part of an integrated strategy.

• You contribute to or lead the planning and execution of evidence generation strategies relevant in the Breast Cancer area, based on medical and market access gaps, including clinical studies, Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), real-world data, and scientific research collaborations by building purposeful networks with healthcare stakeholders across multiple cultures and countries.

• You generate integrated medical insights to inform strategies and plans and you provide medical and functional expertise to market access strategies and related operational plans.

• You lead the collaboration with key academic and clinical specialists worldwide to secure scientific and strategic input to our clinical development programs and to spar with them on the interpretation of our clinical trial results so that these can potentially create value for HCPs and benefit patients.

Who You Are
You hold an MD degree which is a highly preferred or advanced life-science degree (e.g. PhD or PharmD). A specialization degree or industry experience in Breast Cancer is a must. In addition, you have robust medical affairs and/or pharmaceutical medicine experience. Further, you bring:

• High Ethical Standards: You demonstrate integrity and compliance in all professional activities.

• Strategic Agility: You have the ability to make informed, strategic decisions effectively.

• Patient-Centric Approach: You prioritize patients in clinical development and medical practice activities.

• Launch Experience: Your experience with the launch of medical products or indications will drive successful product introduction.

Your expertise in Breast Cancer can drive change. Take the next step and help us deliver innovative medicines to patients worldwide. Apply now.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As part of the Foundation Medicine (FMI) ecosystem, our team delivers immediate clinical impact for patients today while actively shaping the future of healthcare. We work within a highly collaborative and innovative environment to transform molecular diagnostics into a scalable precision oncology platform embedded within real-world healthcare systems globally.
We are seeking a Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Data & Digital to join the International Business Team (IBT). In this highly strategic role, you will shape the future of AI-enabled Precision Medicine globally, accelerate the adoption of digitally integrated oncology solutions across International Markets, and serve as the strategic bridge between global functions and regional/local execution.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Operating Models: Identify and prioritize digital and data-driven commercial opportunities to drive the design and execution of the International FMI commercial strategy, operating models, and business plans (including P&L and market risk management).

• Customer Experience Transformation: Drive the strategic evolution of the end-to-end customer experience across the FMI testing workflow by integrating digital, data-enabled tools, and workflow optimization platforms from ordering through reporting.

• Business Model Innovation: Shape innovative business models for data-enabled services, analytics offerings, and workflow optimization tools.

• Commercial Liaison & Portfolio Prioritization: Serve as an IBT member linking with the corresponding Business Area, Pharma, and Disease Area Network to represent the international customer voice in shaping the product portfolio roadmap.

• High-Stakes & Affiliate Support: Steer the business and support affiliates with diverse needs, including driving data/digital implementation and providing central resources or direct support for C-level customer meetings, tenders, and contract negotiations.

• Stakeholder Management & Integration: Foster strong, transversal integration across the ecosystem (FMI IBTs, Affiliates, iKAMs, Regions, Pharma) to accelerate cross-functional synergies and lead organizational change management.

• Financial & Risk Management: Partner with other commercial business leaders and finance to prepare, track, and adjust the International Business budget and business planning while proactively developing strategic risk mitigation measures.

Who You Are

• Experienced Commercial Leader: You bring a minimum of 7 years of experience in IVD or related sectors, with significant commercial experience in diagnostic, medical device, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions. Experience in a customer-facing or field-based role is preferred.

• Customer Experience & Strategy Expert: You possess a proven ability to translate customer and healthcare system needs into scalable commercial strategies, workflow optimizations, and digital enablement initiatives across complex environments.

• Cross-Functional Project & Change Manager: You have a demonstrated track record of making strategic commercial decisions, managing complex initiatives, navigating international matrix environments, and driving organizational transformation.

• Inspiring & Collaborative Leader: You exhibit excellent interpersonal and leadership qualities, including coaching, team-building, managing senior stakeholders, and fostering relationships across diverse cultural networks.
