jobs.title: Digital Solutions Analytics Lead - Freelancer
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

As a Digital Solutions Analytics Lead , you will act as a data analytics leader for product uptake and product usage, driving insights generation that fundamentally shape the development, product improvement and market adoption of our digital health, IVD, and medical device products. This is a high-impact, independent role requiring deep expertise and the ability to influence critical product and business decisions. Your work will involve strategically shaping analyses involving diverse data types (including usage data, market uptake data, app store data, and digital health data) in close alignment with product and business teams .

Your upcoming mission:

• Managing the Analytics around user engagement and product uptake

• Analytics for step-by-step in app customer journeys

• Support of communication and reporting: Reporting Template, Presentations, Data Automation, Dashboard generation

• Ad-hoc analytics for app features improvement

• Documentation and tools management

• Regular report updates and business review support

• Consulting the product teams on analytics and insights generation

Essential skills:

• 2-3 years of experience in business analytics

• Familiar with SQL and reporting tools Tableau or PowerBI, SQL.

• English fluent in reading, speaking and writing

• Education: Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Business Administration (BS, preferentially an advanced degree)

Bonus skills:

• Experience with product usage analytics (e.g., Countly, Amplitude, OpenTelemetry).

What to expect:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)

• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation

• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world!

Who we are and what we care about?

We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally.

As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that save

jobs.title: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU

titleByLocale.en: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU
titleByLocale.it: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU
titleByLocale.de: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU
titleByLocale.fr: PMO - Estimating and Benchmarking Lead EU

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes major CAPEX projects in Roche’s Pharma Division with focus mainly on Pharma Technical Operations (PT). The Project Estimating and Benchmarking Lead is a key member of the project management office, and is responsible for keeping relevant business processes up to date for estimating / forecasting the cost, time and resources required to complete a defined scope of work based on different levels of design through a project lifecycle.

You work closely with the project team and prepare estimates to be used to ultimately control a project via a defined work breakdown structure. The estimator should have knowledge from a basic understanding to subject matter expertise (based on experience) in the following : Cost estimating including benchmarking, Cost planning and forecasting, Planning and Scheduling, Risk Management, Value Engineering and Target Value Delivery

You also provide technical leadership in assigned functional areas and accountability for Project Estimating and Benchmarking in the delivery of capital projects and engineering services to support PT, CMO, and Affiliates. This includes projects that are single and multidisciplinary in nature. The Position reports to the Head of Project Management Office.

The Opportunity

You actively monitor the effectiveness and efficiency of the Estimating and Benchmarking business processes and identify areas for operational improvements; develop and deploy updates of the business processes accordingly. Responsibilities include:

• Establish, maintain, and conduct effective training in the business processes

• Work with the global Community of Practice for the areas of expertise; liaise with local/regional engineering organizations to spread knowledge and harmonize practices and represent Roche to consultants, service providers, and industry bodies

• Support initiatives to improve CAPEX Delivery processes and practices and support engaging senior business leaders in the development and continuous improvement of business strategies

• Develop, communicate, and champion the purpose and value of the business processes and engage the engineering community/network in applying the business processes for predictably achieving project objectives

• Support feasibility studies with conceptual cost and schedule estimates, and industry benchmarks, as well as support design and construction projects in the preparation and validation of funding estimates and cost forecasts; ensure estimate data is suitable for project planning and control

• Develop and deploy to the PTT community easy-to-use Estimating and Benchmarking tools

• Collect, analyze, and make available normalized cost and schedule data for future estimating; maintain and expand the CAPEX Benchmarking Database

Who you are

You have more than 10 - 15 years of experience in the controlling and management of CAPEX projects in the range of 50 - 1000m. CHF/USD, preferably in the pharmaceutical, diagnostics, and/or medical devices industry, and / or associated technology industries. In addition you will bring the following skills and experience:

• Experience developing and implementing Estimating and Benchmarking processes, systems, and training in a large cooperation, and have excellent knowledge of modern project management methods, as promoted by - for example – CII, LCI, PMI, AACEi, RICS, or IPA. You also have experience working in a complex global setting

• Very good communication skills to effectively communicate with senior management,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior porterà il ciclo di vita dell'algoritmo end-to-end - dallo sviluppo attraverso la validazione e l'implementazione di norma-ready - garantendo l'allineamento con GxP, SaMD e Imaging Governance framework. Essendo l'unico punto di responsabilità tra gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS, il ruolo fornirà funzionalità scalabili di piattaforma analitica, promuovere l'automazione e garantire la qualità, la documentazione e gli standard di conformità sono costantemente applicati. Questa posizione guida la visione, la strategia e l'esecuzione dell'ecosistema dell'algoritmo di imaging, consentendo uno sviluppo e una distribuzione più rapidi, riproducibili e conformi tra ricerca e ambiti clinici. Sarete responsabili della definizione dei compiti per gli altri e della guida di iniziative su larga scala su un prodotto. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio e lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica, ispirerai l'innovazione e guiderai la progettazione di soluzioni multi-servizio e multi-modali complesse. Grazie all'esperienza nell'architettura e nell'interoperabilità dei modelli AI/ML, ai framework applicativi avanzati di analisi e alle caratteristiche cloud, promuoverai la consistenza architettonica, guiderai la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti e gli ingegneri senior del mentore per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo di Senior Lead Engineer richiede l'impegno quotidiano con partner scientifici, normativi, clinici e informatici per allineare la strategia, la priorità e l'esecuzione per rafforzare la collaborazione e la visibilità tra i team globali, fornendo un ponte diretto tra Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development e Platform Operations. L'opportunità:
• Definire ed eseguire la strategia del prodotto e la roadmap per multi-modali (tra cui Radiologia e Patologia Digitale) Imaging Data & Insights all'interno della piattaforma di imaging globale (GIP).
• Priorizzare e fornire iniziative che migliorano la qualità dei dati, l'accessibilità e la riutilizzabilità per R&D, la ricerca traduttiva e lo sviluppo clinico.
• Agire come proprietario principale del prodotto per le applicazioni di analisi delle modalità di imaging, coordinando attraverso gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS.
• Il partner scientifico, clinico e tecnico porta a tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e conformi.
• Gestire le relazioni degli stakeholder e le collaborazioni esterne per garantire l'interoperabilità, la conformità e l'allineamento strategico.
• supervisionare il ciclo di vita end-to-end di applicazioni di analisi dei dati di imaging multi-modale, visualizzazione e analisi.
• Assicurare la consegna tempestiva dei miglioramenti del prodotto, flussi di lavoro standardizzati e l'integrazione di strumenti abilitati AI/ML.
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, qualità e regolamentazione per garantire l'adesione a standard GxP, FAIR e data-governance.
• Allineamento dell'unità attraverso le funzioni R&D, Diagnostics e Data Science per abilitare i dati condivisi e le pipeline di analisi e processi unificati.
• Gestire dipendenze, rischi e pietre miliari per tutti i materiali di patologia digitale e comunicare i progressi attraverso KPI e report sulle prestazioni.
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per aumentare la scalabilità, l'automazione e l'efficienza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di analisi.
• Monitorare l'industria e le tendenze tecnologiche nella patologia digitale, AI/ML e la salute digitale per guidare l'innovazione dei prodotti in corso.
• Identificare e introdurre il formato comune per la distribuzione, ridurre i costi di conversione e migliorare la velocità di inferenza attraverso l'arros

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Senior Lead Engineer wird den End-to-End-Algorithmus-Lebenszyklus – von der Entwicklung durch Validierung und regulatorisch-ready-Bereitstellung – führen, um die Ausrichtung mit GxP, SaMD und Imaging Governance-Frameworks zu gewährleisten. Als einziger Punkt der Rechenschaftspflicht über gRED, pRED, PD, RDT und RIS wird die Rolle skalierbare analytische Plattform-Fähigkeiten liefern, Automatisierung fördern und Qualität, Dokumentation und Compliance-Standards konsequent anwenden. Diese Position treibt die Vision, Strategie und Durchführung des Bildverarbeitungsalgorithmus-Ökosystems an und ermöglicht eine schnellere, reproduzierbare und konforme Entwicklung und Bereitstellung in Forschungs- und klinischen Bereichen. Sie werden dafür verantwortlich sein, Aufgaben für andere zu definieren und mittelgroße bis groß angelegte Initiativen über ein Produkt hinweg zu betreiben. In dieser strategischen Rolle werden Sie andere Ingenieure trainieren und leiten, die Stakeholder-Verhandlungen auszeichnen und Richtung für mittlere bis langfristige Ziele bieten. Sie werden aktiv zum technischen Wissen beitragen, Innovationen inspirieren und das Design komplexer multi-Service- und multimodaler Lösungen führen. Diese Senior Lead Engineer-Rolle erfordert tägliches Engagement mit wissenschaftlichen, regulatorischen, klinischen und informatischen Partnern, um Strategie, Priorisierung und Durchführung zu bündeln, um die Zusammenarbeit und Sichtbarkeit in globalen Teams zu stärken und eine direkte Brücke zwischen Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development und Platform Operations zu bieten. Die Gelegenheit:
• Definition und Durchführung der Produktstrategie und Roadmap für multimodale (einschließlich Radiologie und digitale Pathologie) Imaging Data & Insights innerhalb der Global Imaging Platform (GIP).
• Priorisierung und Bereitstellung von Initiativen, die die Datenqualität, Zugänglichkeit und Wiederverwendbarkeit für FuE, Translationsforschung und klinische Entwicklung verbessern.
• Aktivieren Sie als primärer Produktbesitzer für die bildgebenden Modalitäten-Analyse-Anwendungen, koordinieren über gRED, pRED, PD, RDT und RIS.
• Der Partner mit wissenschaftlichen, klinischen und technischen Lösungen führt dazu, die Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare und konforme technische Lösungen umzusetzen.
• Verwalten von Stakeholder-Beziehungen und externen Kooperationen, um Interoperabilität, Compliance und strategische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten.
• Übersehen Sie den End-to-End-Lebenszyklus von multimodalen bildgebenden Datenanalyseanwendungen, Visualisierung und Analytik.
• Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Lieferung von Produkterweiterungen, standardisierten Workflows und der Integration von AI/ML-fähigen Werkzeugen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur-, Qualitäts- und Regulierungsteams, um die Einhaltung von GxP-, FAIR- und Data-Governance-Standards zu gewährleisten.
• Führen Sie die Ausrichtung auf FuE-, Diagnose- und Data Science-Funktionen aus, um gemeinsame Daten- und Analysepipeline und einheitliche Prozesse zu ermöglichen.
• Verwalten von Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Meilensteinen für alle digitalen Pathologien und kommunizieren Fortschritte durch Kennzahlen und Leistungsberichte.
• Möglichkeiten zur Erhöhung der Skalierbarkeit, Automatisierung und Effizienz in den Analyse-Workflows identifizieren und implementieren.
• Überwachen Sie die Branchen- und Technologietrends in der digitalen Pathologie, in der AI/ML und in der digitalen Gesundheit, um laufende Produktinnovationen zu führen.
• Identifizierung und Einführung des gemeinsamen Formats für die Bereitstellung, Senkung der Conversion-Kosten und Verbesserung der Inferenzgeschwindigkeit über Harn

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'ingénieur principal dirigera le cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'algorithme, depuis le développement jusqu'à la validation jusqu'au déploiement réglementaire, pour assurer l'alignement avec les cadres de gouvernance GxP, SaMD et Imaging. Agissant en tant que point unique de responsabilisation pour gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS, le rôle fournira des capacités de plate-forme analytique évolutives, favorisera l'automatisation et assurera l'application uniforme des normes de qualité, de documentation et de conformité. Cette position stimule la vision, la stratégie et l'exécution de l'écosystème de l'algorithme d'imagerie, permettant un développement et un déploiement plus rapides, reproductibles et conformes dans les domaines de la recherche et de la clinique. Vous serez responsable de la définition des tâches pour les autres et de la conduite d'initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle à travers un produit. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous entraînerez et dirigerez d'autres ingénieurs, excellerez dans les négociations avec les intervenants et fournirez une orientation pour les objectifs à moyen et à long terme. Vous contribuerez activement aux connaissances techniques, inspirerez l'innovation et dirigerez la conception de solutions multiservices et multimodales complexes. Avec une expertise en architecture et en interopérabilité des modèles AI/ML, des cadres d'applications d'analyse avancés et des fonctionnalités cloud, vous favoriserez la cohérence architecturale, piloterez la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants, et mentorez les ingénieurs seniors pour assurer les plus hautes normes de qualité d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle d'ingénieur principal exige un engagement quotidien avec les partenaires scientifiques, réglementaires, cliniques et informatiques afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie, l'établissement des priorités et l'exécution afin de renforcer la collaboration et la visibilité entre les équipes mondiales, fournissant un pont direct entre la gouvernance de l'imagerie, le développement de l'algorithme et les opérations de la plateforme. La possibilité :
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route des produits multimodaux (y compris la radiologie et la pathologie numérique) Imager des données et des informations au sein de la plateforme mondiale d'imagerie (GIP).
• Privilégier et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives qui améliorent la qualité des données, leur accessibilité et leur réutilisabilité pour la R-D, la recherche translationnelle et le développement clinique.
• Agir en tant que principal propriétaire du produit pour les applications d'analyse des modalités d'imagerie, en coordonnant entre gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS.
• Partenaire avec des pistes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques pour traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques évolutives et conformes.
• Gérer les relations avec les parties prenantes et les collaborations externes pour assurer l'interopérabilité, la conformité et l'alignement stratégique.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie de bout en bout des applications d'analyse de données d'imagerie multimodale, de visualisation et d'analyse.
• Veiller à ce que les améliorations apportées aux produits, les flux de travail normalisés et l'intégration des outils compatibles avec l'IA et le LM soient fournis en temps voulu.
• Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de qualité et de réglementation pour assurer le respect des normes GxP, FAIR et de gouvernance des données.
• Conduire l'alignement entre les fonctions R-D, Diagnostics et Data Science pour permettre le partage de données et d'analyses et des processus unifiés.
• Gérer les dépendances, les risques et les jalons pour tous les produits de pathologie numérique et communiquer les progrès au moyen des ICR et des rapports de performance.
• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des possibilités d'évolutivité, d'automatisation et d'efficacité dans tous les flux de travail d'analyse.
• Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et de la technologie en matière de pathologie numérique, d'IA/ML et de santé numérique pour guider l'innovation de produits en cours.
• Identifier et introduire le format commun pour le déploiement, réduire les coûts de conversion et améliorer la vitesse d'inférence dans tous les secteurs

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Develop and implement strategic plans aligned with organizational goals, integrating managed services, on-premises operations, and cloud initiatives while leveraging AI as a key accelerator.

jobs.title: Gerente de Estratégia Médica
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Gerente de Estratégia Médica, você atuará como um parceiro estratégico crucial dentro do ecossistema de saúde brasileiro, integrando-se ao time médico-científico de Imunologia. Seu papel será vital no lançamento de uma inovação da Roche nas áreas terapêuticas de Nefrologia e Reumatologia, com foco inicial na jornada do paciente com Lúpus Eritematoso Sistêmico (LES) e suas complicações, especialmente a Nefrite Lúpica (NL). Além disso, você será chamado a participar das discussões estratégicas de outras inovações em Imunologia que estão no pipeline.

Sobre a oportunidade:
Sua principal atuação será focada na interação e engajamento com parceiros externos , incluindo médicos, profissionais de saúde, líderes de opinião e decisores. Você será responsável por:

• Articular a narrativa científica da Roche nessas áreas terapêuticas, mantendo-se constantemente atualizado(a) e fornecendo expertise científica e clínica focada em nossos clientes externos.

• Capturar informações de campo e transformá-las em insights estratégicos e acionáveis, colaborando ativamente na definição e constante refinamento de nossa narrativa científica junto ao time de Imunologia.

• Contribuir ativamente para a definição de planos de educação médica e geração de evidências, identificando, comunicando e discutindo potenciais lacunas e necessidades de evidências para o desenvolvimento de um plano integrado de dados.

• Ter um papel ativo nas atividades de medical-marketing, incluindo o posicionamento de produtos da Roche, a construção de planos de contas e a definição dos imperativos estratégicos da Roche para essas áreas terapêuticas.

• Garantir o mais elevado padrão ético, científico e de qualidade, contribuindo para a segurança dos pacientes e a salvaguarda da reputação da Roche.

• Ativar e alavancar o network global da Roche, conectando-se com colaboradores de todo o mundo para maximizar o potencial da nossa rede em benefício do sistema de saúde do Brasil e dos pacientes brasileiros.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Medicina, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou demais áreas da saúde e desejável pós-graduação em Reumatologia, Imunologia ou Nefrologia

• Vivência acadêmica ou experiência na indústria farmacêutica nas áreas de Reumatologia, Imunologia ou Nefrologia.

• Bom conhecimento dos produtos e dinâmicas de mercado em uma ou mais dessas áreas.

• Vivência prévia comprovada na atuação médico-científica de campo em Medical Affairs na indústria farmacêutica, seja como Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Consultor Científico, Gerente Médico-Científico ou Gerente Médico com interação direta com médicos e profissionais de saúde.

• Compreensão sólida do sistema de saúde do Brasil, incluindo políticas de saúde, ambiente de reembolso e avaliação de tecnologias de saúde.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do desenvolvimento de medicamentos farmacêuticos, estratégias e táticas de assuntos médicos, bem como os principais processos de conformidade médica da indústria.

• Disponibilidade para atuar em campo em aproximadamente 50% do tempo, incluindo viagens fora de São Paulo.

• Desejável conhecimento e/ou vivência prévia em estudos clínicos e em geração de evidências de mundo real (RWE)

• Bom entendimento e interesse nas tendências e inovações em saúde digital.

• Inglês avançado.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

• Ter um papel ativo nas atividades de medical-marketing, incluindo o posicionamento de produtos da Roche, a construção de planos de contas e a definição dos imperativos estratégicos da Roche para essas áreas terapêuticas.

• Garantir o mais elevado padrão ético, científico e de qualidade, contribuindo para a segurança dos pacientes e a salvaguarda da reputação da Roche.

• Ativar e alavancar o network global da Roche, conectando-se com colaboradores de todo o mundo para maximizar o potencial da nossa rede em benefício do sistema de saúde do Brasil e dos pacientes brasileiros.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Medicina, Farmácia, Biomedicina ou demais áreas da saúde e desejável pós-graduação em Reumatologia, Imunologia ou Nefrologia

• Vivência acadêmica ou experiência na indústria farmacêutica nas áreas de Reumatologia, Imunologia ou Nefrologia.

• Bom conhecimento dos produtos e dinâmicas de mercado em uma ou mais dessas áreas.

• Vivência prévia comprovada na atuação médico-científica de campo em Medical Affairs na indústria farmacêutica, seja como Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Consultor Científico, Gerente Médico-Científico ou Gerente Médico com interação direta com médicos e profissionais de saúde.

• Compreensão sólida do sistema de saúde do Brasil, incluindo políticas de saúde, ambiente de reembolso e avaliação de tecnologias de saúde.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do desenvolvimento de medicamentos farmacêuticos, estratégias e táticas de assuntos médicos, bem como os principais processos de conformidade médica da indústria.

• Disponibilidade para atuar em campo em aproximadamente 50% do tempo, incluindo viagens fora de São Paulo.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Como Estagiário(a) de Supply Chain, você fará parte de uma equipe colaborativa focada em otimizar nossos processos de Planejamento de Demanda . Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar suas habilidades analíticas na prática . Venha se desenvolver profissionalmente em uma cultura que valoriza a inovação e a melhoria contínua .

A Oportunidade

• Você apoia o time de Planejamento de Demanda nas rotinas analíticas e no ciclo de S&OP .

• Você trabalha com um grande volume de dados, realizando o tratamento, a consolidação e a análise constante de informações .

• Você desenvolve dashboards, relatórios e indicadores de performance essenciais para a área .

• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos e contribui ativamente para a padronização e otimização de fluxos .

• Você apoia a estruturação e o acompanhamento de projetos estratégicos, expandindo seu impacto na organização .

Quem você é

• Você cursa graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Matemática, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas, com previsão de conclusão a partir de 2027 e vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino .

• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias .

• Você possui Excel avançado e grande facilidade para trabalhar com análise e tratamento de dados .

• Você demonstra forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e mantém um perfil estruturado, organizado e com visão processual .

• Você se comunica muito bem e tem a habilidade de transformar dados complexos em informações claras e assertivas .

Preferencial

• Você tem conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares) e noções de S&OP / Planejamento de Demanda .

• Você conhece metodologias de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, Scrum ou similares) .

• Você possui alguma experiência prévia com análise de dados ou iniciativas de melhoria contínua .

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

titleByLocale.de: Digital Sales Spezialist- Near Patient Care
titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des ventes numériques - Soins aux patients proches

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist- Near Patient Care

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Near Patient Care Digital Sales Specialist, where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio in the Point of Care testing space. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in POCC and POC testing workflows, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities:

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Near Patient Care navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct workflow process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the areas responsible for testing.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

• Preferred experience in the POC testing space.

• 3+ years of experien

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete stimati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista di vendita digitale - Vicino alla cura del paziente Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Unisciti all'organizzazione di vendita di Roche Digital Solutions come Specialista di vendite Digital di assistenza sanitaria vicina, dove sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche navify nello spazio di test Point of Care. Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nei flussi di lavoro di test POCC e POC, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, operazioni, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente le parti interessate sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. Responsabilità
• Genera una nuova domanda del cliente attraverso l'intero portafoglio di prodotti di navigazione Near Patient Care (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc).
• Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori a livello esecutivo.
• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita.
• Condurre analisi del processo del flusso di lavoro, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni.
• Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno.
• Adept per tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in azioni interne per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave.
• Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche.
• Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente.
• Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate.
• Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business.
• Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valore differenziato e basato sulle prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle aree responsabili del test. Requisiti
• Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente.
• 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica)
• Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving
• Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni middleware e sistemi LIS ospedalieri
• Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Requisiti preferenziali
• Esperienza preferenziale nello spazio di prova POC.
• 3+ anni di esperienza

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Digital Sales Spezialist - Nahe Patientenpflege Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Kommen Sie mit der Roche Digital Solutions Vertriebsorganisation als Near Patient Care Digital Sales Specialist, wo Sie für den Verkauf des Roche navify digitalen Portfolios im Point Care Testraum verantwortlich sind. Diese feldbasierte Position erfordert konsultierende Vertriebserfahrung und Expertise in POCC- und POC-Test-Workflows, IT-Infrastruktur, Datenfluss, Informatik, Operationen, digitalen Anwendungen (d.h. Middleware, Business Intelligence Tools, etc.) und Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), um effektiv mit Stakeholdern zu kundenspezifischen Roche-Digitallösungen zu konsultieren und strategische Empfehlungen zu digitalen Prozessen bereitzustellen. Diese Position beschäftigt sich früh im Verkaufszyklus, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen, maßgeschneiderte Demos zu liefern und maßgeschneiderte digitale Lösungen in Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Interessenvertretern in den Teams von Roche und Kunden zu entwickeln. In den Warenkorb
• Erstellt neue Kundennachfrage im gesamten Portfolio von Near Patient Care navify Produkten (Middleware, Konnektivität, Informatik, Apps usw.).
• Engagieren Sie in strategischen digitalen Diskussionen mit wichtigen Kundeneinkäufen, von technischen Endnutzern bis hin zu Entscheidungsträgern auf Führungsebene.
• Mit internen Stakeholdern über Vertriebs- und Implementierungsteams zusammenarbeiten, um die Gesamtlösungsverkaufsstrategien zu definieren und auszurichten, um die Vertriebsziele konsequent zu erreichen und zu übertreffen.
• Durchführung von Workflow-Prozessanalysen, Entwicklung von Lösungsvorschlägen und Empfehlungen an Kunden in enger Abstimmung mit internen Interessenvertretern.
• Bereitstellung von Software-Demos und maßgeschneiderten technischen Präsentationen auf interne und externe Publikum.
• Adept bei der Umsetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen in interne Maßnahmen, um diese Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen, während die wichtigsten Geschäftsprioritäten und Ziele ausgewogen werden.
• Starker klinischer und finanzieller Aufwand mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, den Kunden zu verstehen und zu übersetzen, muss den Wert von Roche Digitallösungen effektiv positionieren.
• Effektiv qualifizieren Leads und nutzen Ergebnisse aus Workflow-Analysen und Folgenstudien, um wettbewerbsfähige Differenzierung und Wert für die gesamte Kundenlösung zu bieten.
• Bietet fundiertes technisches Know-how in Bezug auf zugeordnete Produktlinien.
• Arbeiten Sie funktionell mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Informationen und bewährte Praktiken zu teilen und weiterhin aktiv über Trends in der Industrie/Kunden zu informieren, die das Geschäft beeinflussen.
• Folgen Sie einem standardisierten End-to-End-Ansatz, der einen evidenzbasierten, differenzierten Wert für das Lösungsportfolio schafft, sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb der für die Prüfung zuständigen Bereiche. Voraussetzungen
• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (d.h. Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.
• 5+ Jahre relevante oder gleichwertige Erfahrung (d.h. Vertrieb von digitalen Gesundheitslösungen, Diagnostik)
• Muss autonom und mit effektiver Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten organisiert werden
• Vertrautheit mit digitalen Lösungen, Middleware-Lösungen und Krankenhaus-LIS-Systemen
• Erfahrung mit der Präsentation technischer Informationen an große externe und interne Publikum Requisiten bevorzugtenziali
• Bevorzugte Erfahrung im POC-Testraum.
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Spécialiste des ventes numériques - Soins aux patients proches Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Venez rejoindre l'organisation de vente de Roche Digital Solutions en tant que spécialiste des ventes numériques de Near Patient Care, où vous serez responsable de la vente du portefeuille numérique de Roche navify dans l'espace de test Point of Care. Ce poste sur le terrain exige de l'expérience et une expertise en matière de ventes consultatives dans les processus d'essai de POCC et de POC, l'infrastructure informatique, le flux de données, l'informatique, les opérations, les applications numériques (c'est-à-dire les intergiciels, les outils d'intelligence d'affaires, etc.) et les systèmes d'information de laboratoire (LIS) pour consulter efficacement les intervenants sur les solutions numériques Roche personnalisées et formuler des recommandations stratégiques sur les processus numériques. Cette position s'engage dès le début du cycle de vente pour comprendre les besoins des clients, fournir des démos personnalisées et concevoir des solutions numériques personnalisées en partenariat avec des intervenants interfonctionnels dans les équipes de Roche et de clients. Responsabilité
• Génère une nouvelle demande de clients dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Near Patient Care navify (milieux, connectivité, informatique, applications, etc.).
• S'engager dans des discussions stratégiques numériques avec des influences clés sur l'achat des clients, des utilisateurs finaux techniques aux décideurs de niveau exécutif.
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes des équipes de vente et de mise en œuvre afin de définir et d'aligner les stratégies de vente de solutions globales pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente.
• Procéder à l'analyse des processus de travail, élaborer des propositions de solutions et présenter des recommandations aux clients en étroite harmonie avec les parties prenantes internes.
• Fournir des démos logicielles et des présentations techniques adaptées aux publics internes et externes.
• S'efforcer de traduire les besoins des clients en actions internes pour répondre à ces besoins tout en conciliant les priorités et les objectifs clés de l'entreprise.
• Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de comprendre et de traduire les besoins du client pour positionner efficacement la valeur des solutions numériques Roche.
• Qualifier efficacement les pistes et utiliser les résultats de l'analyse de flux de travail et des études d'impact pour fournir une différenciation concurrentielle et une valeur à la solution globale du client.
• Fournit une expertise technique approfondie concernant les gammes de produits assignées.
• Travailler de concert avec les intervenants internes pour partager l'information et les meilleures pratiques tout en restant activement informé des tendances de l'industrie et des clients qui influent sur les entreprises.
• Suivre une approche de bout en bout normalisée qui crée une valeur différenciée fondée sur des données probantes pour le portefeuille de solutions, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des domaines d'essais. Requisiti
• Baccalauréat Diplôme dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. technologie de l'information, technologie médicale, sciences de la vie) ou expérience équivalente.
• 5 ans d'expérience pertinente ou équivalente (vente de solutions numériques de soins de santé, ventes de diagnostics)
• Doit être autonome et organisé avec des compétences efficaces en communication, négociation et résolution de problèmes
• Familiarité avec les solutions numériques, les solutions intermédiaires et les systèmes LIS hospitaliers
• Expérience en matière de présentation d'informations techniques à de larges publics externes et internes Requisiti preferenziali
• Expérience privilégiée dans l'espace d'essais POC.
• 3 ans et plus d'expérience

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description: Business Center Intern

Si estás interesado en el sector salud y tecnología, y ves la complementariedad de conocimientos y
áreas como un potencial para agregar valor:

¡Mira lo que esta vacante tiene preparado como experiencia para ti!

Como Practicante de Business Center, serás el apoyo principal de los Connection Partners en los
diferentes procesos del área, y tendrás también un enfoque en automatizaciones.

• De esta persona se espera colaboración, proactividad, empoderamiento, buena comunicación para
• moverse entre diferentes áreas y equipos, flexibilidad, así como cumplir con Código de conducta y
• Compliance de Roche.

Requisitos:
• Cursos: Relacionados con TI o Administración
• ● Ciclos 6, 7 y 8
• Conocimientos Técnicos:
• ● Inglés Intermedio.
• ● Manejo de herramientas de Automatización e Inteligencia Artificial.
• ● Dominio de Google Workspace y Office (Excel/PowerPoint intermedio).
• ● Nociones de gestión y seguimiento de procesos.

Competencias deseadas:
• ● Planificación y Organización
• ● Trabajo en equipo
• ● Comunicación y Transparencia
• ● Proactividad
• ● Empoderamiento
• ● Alto drive y nivel de compromiso
• ● Empatía hacia los colaboradores
• ● Experiencia mínima de 6 meses en posiciones similares

¿Estás interesado en el puesto? ¡Ven a agregar tus habilidades al equipo!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
Reporting into the Service Intelligence organization, you will help the Roche Support Network (RSN) progress through the data maturity model by applying advanced analytics to our most critical service challenges. Your mission is to identify high-impact use cases and develop the mathematical frameworks to address them. To achieve this, you will identify needs, lead the design and implementation of analytical solutions, provide advice and consulting support to our key business stakeholders and demonstrate value by executing proof-of-concept initiatives and prototyping analytical solutions to answer business questions.

As a Data Scientist, you will position data science as a key competency within the enterprise and be responsible for creating value from data assets using advanced analytics capabilities including data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence methodologies, to identify critical business risk and opportunities for RSN.

You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You have experience in the areas of analytics, data transformation, and data science. You are passionate about applying state-of-the-art analytical methods, as well as cutting edge machine learning algorithms to find solutions to complex business problems.

Role Responsibilities

• Identify high-impact data science use cases, develop and implement innovative solutions to drive business impact and develop state-of-the-art analytical capabilities to address identified needs.

• Evaluate, drive and implement solutions from concept to minimum viable product and final product

• Apply analytical and statistical methods to solve identified use cases in an agile manner using multiple data sources and analytical tools

• Collaborate within cross-functional teams to develop solutions, gain alignment and deliver impactful business insights; engage necessary stakeholders to enable better decision-making

• Interpret and communicate analytics results clearly and concisely to audiences with varying backgrounds and degrees of technical understanding.

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with the broader organization; focus on outcomes that provide most business value

• Partner with data science experts around the world within Roche to share best-in-class solutions and drive collaborative approaches towards data science challenges.

Minimum Requirements

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Mathematics or equivalent field.

• You have at least 2 years of service/industry experience, working in a hands-on capacity as a Data Scientist.

Preferred Requirements

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Mathematics or equivalent preferred.

• 4 years experience in the service industry, working in a hands-on capacity as a Data Scientist.

• Experience with AWS environments preferred.

• Experience with Agile development methods including Scrum and Kanban preferred.

• Experience with Statistics, Data Mining, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Cloud Computing, and Distributed Systems

• Hands-on programming experience (Python, R, etc) along with a solid understanding of statistical and machine learning models. You have experience in implementing statistical learning methods or deep learning frameworks to solve problems.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize within an interdisciplinary environment that includes (data) scientists, analysts, bus

The Position
The Position
Reporting into the Service Intelligence organization, you will help the Roche Support Network (RSN) progress through the data maturity model by applying advanced analytics to our most critical service challenges. Your mission is to identify high-impact use cases and develop the mathematical frameworks to address them. To achieve this, you will identify needs, lead the design and implementation of analytical solutions, provide advice and consulting support to our key business stakeholders and demonstrate value by executing proof-of-concept initiatives and prototyping analytical solutions to answer business questions.

As a Data Scientist, you will position data science as a key competency within the enterprise and be responsible for creating value from data assets using advanced analytics capabilities including data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence methodologies, to identify critical business risk and opportunities for RSN.

You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You have experience in the areas of analytics, data transformation, and data science. You are passionate about applying state-of-the-art analytical methods, as well as cutting edge machine learning algorithms to find solutions to complex business problems.

Role Responsibilities

• Identify high-impact data science use cases, develop and implement innovative solutions to drive business impact and develop state-of-the-art analytical capabilities to address identified needs.

• Evaluate, drive and implement solutions from concept to minimum viable product and final product

• Apply analytical and statistical methods to solve identified use cases in an agile manner using multiple data sources and analytical tools

• Collaborate within cross-functional teams to develop solutions, gain alignment and deliver impactful business insights; engage necessary stakeholders to enable better decision-making

• Interpret and communicate analytics results clearly and concisely to audiences with varying backgrounds and degrees of technical understanding.

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with the broader organization; focus on outcomes that provide most business value

• Partner with data science experts around the world within Roche to share best-in-class solutions and drive collaborative approaches towards data science challenges.

Minimum Requirements

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Mathematics or equivalent field.

• You have at least 2 years of service/industry experience, working in a hands-on capacity as a Data Scientist.

Preferred Requirements

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Mathematics or equivalent preferred.

• 4 years experience in the service industry, working in a hands-on capacity as a Data Scientist.

• Experience with AWS environments preferred.

• Experience with Agile development methods including Scrum and Kanban preferred.

• Experience with Statistics, Data Mining, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Cloud Computing, and Distributed Systems

• Hands-on programming experience (Python, R, etc) along with a solid understanding of statistical and machine learning models. You have experience in implementing statistical learning methods or deep learning frameworks to solve problems.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Investigator Relations Technology Informatics Partner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Site and Investigator Engagement area delivers the comprehensive digital ecosystem and integrated platforms required to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical site interactions, covering efficient study planning, country and site selection, site activation, and patient enrollment forecasting. Additionally, it manages the core technologies to handle complex administrative tasks, including budgeting and negotiation, clinical contracts, payments, and clinical information exchange. The team acts as a strategic liaison connecting Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Country Operations, strategic CROs, and Clinical Sites. Through this alignment, the area architects technology portfolios that foster strong external relationships and drive a unified, partner-centric clinical ecosystem. ​

As an Informatics Partner at this level, you lead strategic and complex cross-functional efforts across countries or domains, aligning initiatives with country-wide priorities and business outcomes. You anticipate and solve complex, systems-level problems, drive innovation, and shape domain vision while managing multiple workstreams with high accountability.

The opportunity:

• Scope/Content Leadership: Leads initiatives across multiple teams, and actively shapes business outcomes. Acts as a subject matter expert, influencing country-wide or cross-functional strategies, and fostering collaborations with stakeholders across organizational levels. Responsible for aligning team or domain objectives with country-wide goals, focusing on strategic projects that drive substantial impact. Frequently manages complex, cross-functional work streams.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads problem-solving at the country-wide or cross-functional level, taking accountability for multiple workstreams or outcomes that influence strategic objectives. Anticipates and mitigates potential issues before they arise, using advanced analysis to address complex problems. Employs a systems-thinking approach to propose solutions that align with business and global goals, demonstrating high accountability in driving sustained improvements and efficiencies across teams. Navigates highly complex, competing demands between global and local teams. Employs data-driven frameworks to transition subjective business priorities into objective, scalable technology roadmaps and robust operational resolutions.

• Stakeholder Management: Manages relationships across Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Co

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Estamos comprometidos no sólo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

What is your Mission?
You will be the key operational engine within Roche Diagnostics Spain (RDE), reporting directly to the leadership team. Your main mission is to ensure business agility and efficiency, freeing up high-value time for our strategic and customer-facing teams.

You will combine excellence in administrative management with innovation, optimizing processes through the implementation of Artificial Intelligence and ensuring regulatory compliance at a national level. If you are passionate about efficiency, technology, and strategic impact, this is your place.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Executive Management and Agile Coordination: Administer and coordinate complex agendas, plan travel, and organize key events for leadership and commercial teams, always prioritizing direct business impact.

• Strategic External and Internal Articulation: Facilitate and coordinate the leaders' interaction with strategic external and internal partners to drive commercial success, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional projects in our commercial headquarters.

• Commercial Strategic Support: Provide direct support to key account teams, including preparing client briefings, managing data in the CRM system, and administrative follow-up on executive actions.

• Pioneer in AI and Automation: Proactively identify repetitive tasks in various areas and design and implement automation solutions, using AI agents (such as generative models).

• Compliance Assurance: Act as a liaison to ensure that all administrative processes strictly comply with internal policies for Finance, Human Resources, and Business Integrity.

• Cross-functional Collaboration and Support: Participate in coordinating mutual support among assistants, ensuring service continuity and a balanced workload across the organization.

What We Look for in You:

• Education: Professional degree or equivalent. Training in project management will be especially valued.

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of demonstrable experience in executive support roles, team coordination, or administrative management in large-scale corporate environments (ideally in matrix or network structures).

• Languages: Fluent command (oral and written) of English and Spanish (essential).

• Digital and Technological Experience and Mindset: Advanced user of cloud ecosystems (Microsoft 365/Google Workspace) and a proactive, demonstrable curiosity for the application of Generative Artificial Intelligence.

Competency:
1. Business and Operation Skills:

• Process Architecture: Ability to analyze a complex activity and break it down into logical, efficient, and automatable flows.

• Prompt Engineering: Practical ability to interact with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) for content generation, summarization,

jobs.title: Staining Software Engineer, Associate
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Staining Software Engineer, Associate you will design and develop staining procedures in close collaboration with assay development. You develop software supplements that install staining procedures along with the underlying database elements required to support staining procedure(s) in the software application.

The Opportunity

• Developing moderate-scoped procedures with senior engineering guidance to ensure cross-platform compatibility and optimal instrument performance.

• Executing comprehensive manual and automated test scripts to validate software functionality and system reliability.

• Adhering to company policies, Product Development Processes (PDP), and Work Instructions to ensure all engineering activities remain compliant.

• Authoring and tracking documentation deliverables while identifying the appropriate reviewers and approvers to maintain project flow.

• Managing Design Change Orders (DCOs), Document Changes (DCs), and PDP Document Approvals (DAs) within the Document Control System.

• Maintaining the Software Design History File (DHF) by organizing documentation deliverables according to established best practices.

• Facilitating project review meetings through professional presentations, minute-taking, and active tracking of action items to ensure on-time delivery.

Who You Are

• You hold a BS degree or equivalent in a directly related discipline, or an

• equivalent combination of education and experience

• 2 years of related experience required. Experience in a regulated industry, desired

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Basic organizational skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and to plan project components to effectively report status to stakeholders.

• Understanding or familiarity with project management tools (such as Smart Sheets, MS Project, or Trello).

• Knowledge of creating software documentation for a medical device, software databases and/or scripting languages

• Skilled with the use of word processing, spreadsheets, graphical and presentation software applications

• Proficient in a document control system(s) (such as Agile).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Information Security and Data Privacy Fundamentals

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Arizona is Primary Location State is 64,400.00 - 119,600.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Scientist - PHCS Digital Pathology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Diagnostics are an integral part of decision-making along every step of a person’s health, wellness and disease journey. A diagnostic test alone can help clinicians change the course of someone’s healthcare experience – and their life. We are a healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, our Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalisation and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness.

The Opportunity
This position is primarily responsible for initiating, directing, and executing scientific research, development, and manufacturing process strategies to support both new and existing products. A central pillar of this role involves creating and scaling a comprehensive digital pathology workflow, bridging the gap between traditional histology and high-throughput data analysis. You will investigate the feasibility of applying a wide variety of scientific principles to potential inventions and products, with a specific emphasis on integrating state-of-the-art imaging tools and automated analysis platforms into the laboratory ecosystem.
As a subject matter expert, you will maintain a broad knowledge of cutting-edge theories, serving as an in-house and outside consultant while making meaningful contributions to scientific literature and international conferences. You may act as a primary spokesperson for corporate scientific affairs and provide strategic advice to top management regarding the evolution of digital pathology and assay innovation. Furthermore, you will participate in and promote the professional growth of junior scientists. Utilizing advanced professional concepts, you will contribute to the development of product and process principles, achieving complex objectives through creative and effective methodologies.

• Digital Pathology & CDx Development: Participate in the creation and implementation of digital pathology workflows for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) projects, ensuring all methods and processes are optimized for clinical-grade imaging and data integrity.

• Research & Experimental Design: Plan and execute complex R&D projects using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to define new components, identify technical challenges, and develop potentially patentable reagents or systems.

• Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyze experimental data to form technical conclusions and implement improvements in work processes or documentation, consistently promoting a "Quality First Time" approach to all deliverables.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross functional teams to share expertise, contribute to project planning, and deliver presentations of results to internal and external stakeholders to advance corporate scientific goals.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline plus 8 or more years of progressive work experienc

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Diagnostics are an integral part of decision-making along every step of a person’s health, wellness and disease journey. A diagnostic test alone can help clinicians change the course of someone’s healthcare experience – and their life. We are a healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, our Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalisation and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness.

The Opportunity
This position is primarily responsible for initiating, directing, and executing scientific research, development, and manufacturing process strategies to support both new and existing products. A central pillar of this role involves creating and scaling a comprehensive digital pathology workflow, bridging the gap between traditional histology and high-throughput data analysis. You will investigate the feasibility of applying a wide variety of scientific principles to potential inventions and products, with a specific emphasis on integrating state-of-the-art imaging tools and automated analysis platforms into the laboratory ecosystem.
As a subject matter expert, you will maintain a broad knowledge of cutting-edge theories, serving as an in-house and outside consultant while making meaningful contributions to scientific literature and international conferences. You may act as a primary spokesperson for corporate scientific affairs and provide strategic advice to top management regarding the evolution of digital pathology and assay innovation. Furthermore, you will participate in and promote the professional growth of junior scientists. Utilizing advanced professional concepts, you will contribute to the development of product and process principles, achieving complex objectives through creative and effective methodologies.

• Digital Pathology & CDx Development: Participate in the creation and implementation of digital pathology workflows for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) projects, ensuring all methods and processes are optimized for clinical-grade imaging and data integrity.

• Research & Experimental Design: Plan and execute complex R&D projects using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to define new components, identify technical challenges, and develop potentially patentable reagents or systems.

• Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyze experimental data to form technical conclusions and implement improvements in work processes or documentation, consistently promoting a "Quality First Time" approach to all deliverables.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross functional teams to share expertise, contribute to project planning, and deliver presentations of results to internal and external stakeholders to advance corporate scientific goals.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline plus 8 or more years of progressive work experienc
